function f_unpack(args)
  return unpack(f_split(args))
end
function f_split(args)
  return split(args,",")
end

function f(args, fn)
  return (fn or spr)(f_unpack(args))
end

function Map_init(actor_inits, fx_inits)
  for celx=0,128-1 do
    for cely=0,64-1 do
      key=mget(celx,cely)
      _load_room(_get_coordinates(celx, cely))
      G_room:init_tile(key, celx, cely)
      if key != 0 and not fget(key, 6) then
        -- recalculate dimensions given a non-empty cell at x,y
        G_room.celw=max(G_room.celw, abs(G_room.celx-celx))
        G_room.celh=max(G_room.celh, abs(G_room.cely-cely))
      end
      if fget(key, 7) then
        add(G_room.foreground_tiles, {celx=celx,cely=cely})
      end

      actor_init = actor_inits[key]
      if actor_init then
        -- place tile under the actor
        mset(celx,cely,G_room.base_spr)
        -- init actor via sprite replacement
        actor=ActorFactory_create(key, cel2pxl(celx)+4, cel2pxl(cely)+4)
        -- center the actor in the G_room
        if fget(key, 1) then
          if (G_room.center_actors_x) actor.x-=4
          if (G_room.center_actors_y) actor.y-=4
        end
        actor_init(actor)
        G_room:init_actor(actor)
        if (actor.type==1) G_room:init_bird(actor)
      end

      fx_init = fx_inits[key]
      if fx_init then
        -- place tile under fx
        mset(celx,cely,G_room.base_spr)
        fx = fx_init(cel2pxl(celx)+4, cel2pxl(cely)+4)
        G_room:init_fx(fx)
      end
    end
  end

  for room_index=0,#G_rooms do
    G_room = G_rooms[room_index]
    G_room:init()
    -- add the player to each room
    del(G_room.actors, G_player) add(G_room.actors, G_player)
  end
end

Map_update=function()
  room_coordinates = _get_coordinates(G_player.celx, G_player.cely)
  pre_index=G_room.index
  if (room_coordinates.index==pre_index) return
  -- we've moved to a new room
  _load_room(room_coordinates)
  -- printh("Loaded room with index: "..room_coordinates.index)
  G_room:reset()
  foreach(G_room.actors, function(a) a:on_enter() end)
  -- adjust initial player position for room dimensions
  G_player.x,G_player.y=clamp_into_room(G_player, G_room)
  G_room:on_enter(pre_index)
  play_music(G_room.music)
end

function _get_coordinates(celx, cely)
  roomx=cel2room(celx)
  roomy=cel2room(cely)
  return {
    -- room-level index
    index=roomx+(roomy*(cel2room(128))),
    -- center of the room in cells
    celx=room2cel(roomx+.5),
    cely=room2cel(roomy+.5),
    -- camera offset in pixels
    camera_x=roomx*128,
    camera_y=roomy*128,
  }
end

function _load_room(room_coordinates)
  existing_room = G_rooms[room_coordinates.index]
  if existing_room then 
    G_room = existing_room
    return
  end

  G_room = RoomFactory_create(room_coordinates)
  G_rooms[G_room.index]=G_room
end

RoomFactory_create=function(coordinates)
  room = _room_base()
  Tables_merge(get_room_defs()[coordinates.index] or {}, room)
  Tables_merge(coordinates, room)
  local edge_overrides=f_split(room.edges)
  room.edges={
    coordinates.index-8,
    coordinates.index+8,
    coordinates.index-1,
    coordinates.index+1,
  }
  for i=1,#edge_overrides do
    if edge_overrides[i] != "" then
      room.edges[i]=edge_overrides[i]
    end
  end
  return room
end

function _room_base()
  return {
    celw=1,celh=1,
    center_glowtracks=true,
    can_collect_birds=true,
    -- top,bottom,left,right
    edges="",
    -- room palette
    base_spr=15,
    door_palcolor=11,
    -- constant state
    foreground_tiles={},
    fx={},  
    foreground_fx={},
    durable_animations={},
    bird_spots={},
    -- transient state
    actors={},
    animations={},
    puzzle_input_seq={},
    -- override functions
    init=noop,
    init_tile=noop,
    init_actor=noop,
    init_bird=noop,
    init_fx=noop,
    adjust_bark=noop,
    on_enter=noop,
    on_button=noop,
    on_bird_collect=noop,
    draw=noop,

    reset=function(self)
      self.animations={}
      self.puzzle_input_seq={}
    end,

    get_actors=function(self, type)
      return self._filter_type(self.actors, type)
    end,

    get_fx=function(self, type)
      return self._filter_type(self.fx, type)
    end,

    _filter_type=function(table,type)
      local filtered={}
      for t in all(table) do
        if (t.type==type) add(filtered, t)
      end
      return filtered
    end,

    get_edge=function(self, edge)
      return G_rooms[self.edges[edge]]
    end,

    open_doors=function(self, type, is_horizontal, _sfx)
      local did_open=false
      self:add_delayed_animation(function()
        foreach(
          self:get_actors(type or 3),
          function(door)
            if (not is_horizontal or door.is_horizontal == is_horizontal) did_open=door:open()
          end)
        if (did_open) sfx(_sfx or 22)
      end, type and 0 or 30, true)
    end,

    add_fx=function(self,fx,is_foreground)
      if is_foreground then
        add(self.foreground_fx,fx)
      else
        add(self.fx,fx)
      end
    end,

    remove_expired_entities=function(self)
      _rm_expired=function(_table)
        local expired={}
        for elem in all(_table) do
          if (elem.expiry_time and G_time-elem.expiry_time>=0) add(expired, elem)
        end
        for elem in all(expired) do
          del(_table, elem)
        end
      end
      _rm_expired(self.actors)
      _rm_expired(self.fx)
      _rm_expired(self.foreground_fx)
    end,

    on_sing=function(self, color)
      if (not self.can_collect_birds) return
      birds = self:get_actors(1)
      for bird in all(birds) do
        if not bird.is_collected and not bird.is_hidden and bird.pal_color == color.pal_color then
          bird.is_collected=true
          add(G_player.birds, bird)
          self:add_delayed_animation(function() bird:sing() end, 15)
          self:add_delayed_animation(function() bird:sing() end, 21)
          self:add_delayed_animation(function() bird:fly_to_target(G_player) end, 30)
          self:open_doors() -- solve the first puzzle if not solved
          return
        end
      end
    end,

    init_bird_spots=function(self, args)
      local cels=f_split(args)
      for i=1,#cels,2 do
        fx_init_tile(43, cels[i]+.5, cels[i+1]+.5)
        add(self.bird_spots, {celx=cels[i], cely=cels[i+1]})
      end
    end,

  -- PrintModule
    -- print to top-left corner of room
    print=function(self, string, x, y)
      print(string, self.camera_x+(x or 0), self.camera_y + (y or 0), 7)
    end,

    -- print to center of room at cely
    printc=function(self, string, y, color)
      -- single-pixel spaces
      str_w = #string - 1
      for i = 1, #string do
        -- normal char length
        str_w += 3
        -- wide chars
        if (string[i] >= "\x80") str_w += 4
      end
      print(string, cel2pxl(self.celx)-(str_w/2), y, color or 7)
    end,

    print_script=function(self, durations, lines, cely)
      -- durations is a list of ints representing (pause,line) pairs
      -- lines is a list of lines in display order
      durations=f_split(durations)
      local next_time = G_time
      for i = 1, #lines do
        next_time += durations[(i*2)-1] -- add pause time
        line_duration = durations[i*2]
        local line_start_time = next_time
        local line_end_time = nil
        local show_line=false
        if (line_duration) line_end_time = line_start_time+line_duration
        next_time=line_end_time
        self:add_animation(function()
          while true do
            if (G_time==line_end_time) return
            if (G_time==line_start_time) show_line=true
            if (show_line)self:_printc_lines(lines[i], cely)
            yield()
          end
        end)
      end
    end,

    _printc_lines=function(self, lines, cely)
      local cely = (cely or 13.5)-((#lines-1)/2)
      for line in all(lines) do
        self:printc(line, self.camera_y+cel2pxl(cely))
        cely+=1
      end
    end,

  -- AnimationModule
    add_animation=function(self, animation, is_durable)
      add(is_durable and self.durable_animations or self.animations, cocreate(animation))
    end,

    add_delayed_animation=function(self, fn, delay, is_durable)
      local run_at = G_time+delay
      self:add_animation(function()
        while true do
          if (G_time-run_at >= 0) fn() return
          yield()
        end
      end, is_durable)
    end,

    play_animations=function(self)
      self:_play_animations(self.animations)
      self:_play_animations(self.durable_animations)
    end,

    _play_animations=function(self, animation_table)
      expired_animations={}
      for animation in all(animation_table) do
        if costatus(animation) == 'dead' then add(expired_animations, animation)
        else coresume(animation) end
      end
      for expired_animation in all(expired_animations) do
        del(animation_table, expired_animation)
      end
    end,

  -- PuzzleModule
    add_puzzle_seq=function(self, color)
      puzzle = self.puzzle
      seq = self.puzzle_input_seq
      if (not puzzle) return
      if (puzzle.solved_time) return
      palcolor_solution=puzzle.palcolor_solution
      add(seq, color.pal_color)
      for i=1,#seq do
        if palcolor_solution[i]!=seq[i] then
          self.puzzle_input_seq={}
          local clear_time=G_time
          self:add_delayed_animation(function()
            foreach(self:get_actors(8), function(flower)
              if (flower.glow_start and flower.glow_start<=clear_time) flower.glow_start=nil
            end)
          end, 30)
          return
        end
      end
      if #seq==#palcolor_solution then
        puzzle.solved_time=G_time
        puzzle:solved_fn(self)
      end
    end,

  -- BirdSongModule
    set_bird_song=function(self, colors, song_delay)
      local wrapped = {}
      foreach(colors, function(c) add(wrapped, {c}) end)
      self._bird_song_fn = function()
        return BirdSong_init(
          self:get_actors(1),
          {
            color_seq=wrapped,
            song_delay=song_delay or 120,
            first_song_delay=40
          })
      end
      self.bird_song=self._bird_song_fn()
    end,

    set_bird_chime=function(self, colors)
      self.bird_song = BirdSong_init(
        self:get_actors(1),
        {
          count=3,
          color_seq={colors},
          first_song_delay=15,
          song_delay=15,
        }, true
      )
    end,

    play_bird_song=function(self)
      if (not self.bird_song) return false
      if (costatus(self.bird_song) == 'dead') return false
      coresume(self.bird_song)
      return true
    end,

    reset_bird_song=function(self)
      if (not self._bird_song_fn) return
      self.bird_song=self._bird_song_fn()
    end
  }
end

BirdSong_init = function(birds, args, is_chime)
  local color_seq = args.color_seq
  local count = args.count
  local bird_delay=20
  local song_delay=args.song_delay
  local first_song_delay=args.first_song_delay

  local index=1
  local seq_length = #color_seq
  local next_sing_time = G_time+first_song_delay

  _song_coroutine = function()
    while true do
      if (count==0) return
      if (_play_song_next()) _update_indexes()
      yield()
    end
  end

  _play_song_next = function()
    local did_sing = false
    local colors=color_seq[index]
    for bird in all(birds) do
      for color in all(colors) do
        did_sing = _try_bird_sing(bird, color, next_sing_time)
          or did_sing
      end
    end
    return did_sing
  end

  _try_bird_sing = function(bird, color, next_sing_time)
    if (bird.sprt.key != color.bird_key) return false
    if (G_time != next_sing_time) return false
    bird:sing(is_chime)
    return true
  end

  _update_indexes = function()
    index+=1
    next_sing_time = G_time + bird_delay
    if (index <= seq_length) return
    index=1
    next_sing_time = G_time + song_delay
    if (count) count-=1
  end

  return cocreate(_song_coroutine)
end

Puzzle_init = function(solution, solved_fn)
  -- hacks below. i've overloaded this object to support
  -- various solution types to reduce code token count
  palcolor_solution={}
  for s in all(solution) do
    if (type(s)=="table") s=s.pal_color
    add(palcolor_solution, s)
  end
  return {
    solution=solution,
    palcolor_solution=palcolor_solution,
    solved_fn=solved_fn, 
  }
end

function ActorFactory_create(key, x, y)
  actor={
    type=-1,
    is_solid=true,
    sprt={},
    -- coordinates
    x = x,
    y = y,
    w = 4,
    h = 4,
    -- movement
    dx = 0,
    dy = 0,
    -- animation
    frame = 0,
    -- override functions
    update=noop,
    collide=noop,
    draw=noop,
    draw_foreground=noop,
    on_enter=noop,

    set_properties=function(self, properties)
      Tables_merge(properties, self)
    end,

    is_solid_actor=function(self, a2)
      return self.is_solid
    end,

    set_sprt=function(self, sprt,_sfx)
      if (self.sprt==sprt) return false
      if (self.set_time and G_time-self.set_time < self.sprt.duration) return false
      sprt.frames = sprt.frames or 1
      sprt.celw = sprt.celw or 1
      sprt.celh = sprt.celh or 1
      sprt.y_offset = sprt.y_offset or 0
      
      if (_sfx) sfx(_sfx)
      self.set_time=nil
      if (sprt.duration) self.set_time=G_time
      self.sprt=sprt
      self.frame=0
      return true
    end,

    set_tile=function(self, spr)
      mset(self.celx, self.cely, spr)
    end,

    -- debug=function(self)
    --   pset(self.x,self.y,8)
    --   rect(
    --     self.x-(self.w),
    --     self.y-(self.h),
    --     self.x+(self.w),
    --     self.y+(self.h),
    --     8)
    -- end,
  }

  setmetatable(actor,
    {__index = function(table, key)
      if (key == "celx") return pxl2cel(table.x)
      if (key == "cely") return pxl2cel(table.y)
      return rawget(table, key)
    end})
  
  actor:set_sprt({key=key})
  add(G_room.actors, actor)
  return actor
end

function init_player(player)
  G_player=player
  player:set_properties({
    is_active=true,
    is_hidden=true, -- init as hidden on title screen
    h=2.5,
    w=2.5,
    y=player.y-2, -- adjust starting position slightly
    note_display={},
    birds={},

    -- has_bow=true, -- debug
    -- flower=80,
  })

  function player:update()
    self.dx, self.dy = 0,0
    if (self.move_lock or self.is_hidden or G_win) return
    self.state = nil

    if btn(❎) and btn(🅾️) then
      self.state=1
      self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_SIT)
      self:_show_note_display()
      -- sing
      if (btnp(⬅️)) self.flip_x=true self:_sing(COLORS_BLUE)
      if (btnp(➡️)) self.flip_x=false self:_sing(COLORS_PINK)
      if (btnp(⬆️)) self:_sing(COLORS_YELLOW)
      if (btnp(⬇️)) self:_sing(COLORS_RED)
    else
      self:_clear_note_display()
      -- bark
      if btnp(❎) then
        self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_BARK, 10)
        init_bark()
      else
        self.state=0
      end
      -- move
      local dx,dy=0,0
      if (btn(⬅️)) dx-=1
      if (btn(➡️)) dx+=1
      if (btn(⬆️)) dy-=1
      if (btn(⬇️)) dy+=1
      if (dx>0) self.flip_x=false
      if (dx<0) self.flip_x=true
      self.dx,self.dy=dx,dy
    end
  end

  function player:collide(a2)
    -- player collects flower
    if a2.type==0 then
      sfx(21)
      self.flower = a2.sprt.key
      destroy(a2)
    end

    if a2.type==10 then
      sfx(21)
      self.has_bow = true
      destroy(a2)
    end

    if a2==G_girl then
      -- if (true) G_room:win() return -- debug
      if (G_player.flower) G_room:win() return
      if (self.y>a2.y and self.y<a2.y+5) self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_HUG)
    end

    if (a2.type == 7) a2:press()
  end

  function player:draw()
    if (self.flower) spr(self.flower, self.x-4, self.y-cel2pxl(1.7), 1, 2)
    if (self.state != 0) return
    if (abs(self.dx)>0 or abs(self.dy)>0) self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_RUN) return
    self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_STAND)
  end

  function player:draw_foreground()
    local x = (self.flip_x and self.x-5 or self.x-3)
      + (self.state==1 and (self.flip_x and 1 or -1) or 0)
    local y = self.y-(
      self.sprt==SPRT_DOG_HUG and 5
      or ((self.frame>=1 and self.frame<3) or self.sprt==SPRT_DOG_BARK) and 7 or 6)
    if (self.has_bow) spr(78, x, y, 1, 1, self.flip_x)
  end

  function player:_sing(color)
    self:_clear_note_display()
    if (not self:set_sprt(SPRT_DOG_SING, color.player_sfx_sing)) return
    self:_create_note(color)
    G_room:on_sing(color)
    self.sing_state_start=G_time+9
  end

  function player:_clear_note_display()
    foreach(self.note_display, destroy)
    self.note_display = {}
    self.sing_state_start = nil
  end

  function player:_show_note_display()
    if (self.sing_state_start == nil) self.sing_state_start = G_time
    if (G_time-self.sing_state_start <= 6) return
    if (#self.note_display>0) return
    for _, color in pairs({COLORS_BLUE,COLORS_PINK,COLORS_YELLOW,COLORS_RED}) do
      local fx = self:_create_note(color)
      fx.expiry_time=nil
      fx.freeze_delay = 10
      add(self.note_display, fx)
    end
  end

  function player:_create_note(color)
    if (color == COLORS_BLUE) then
      -- left
      note_x = self.x-4
      note_y = self.y
      note_update_fn = function(fx) fx.x-=.2 end
    elseif (color == COLORS_PINK) then
      -- right
      note_x = self.x+10
      note_y = self.y
      note_update_fn = function(fx) fx.x+=.2 end
    elseif (color == COLORS_YELLOW) then
      -- up
      note_x = self.x+3
      note_y = self.y-7
      note_update_fn = function(fx) fx.y-=.2 end
    else
      -- down
      note_x = self.x+3
      note_y = self.y+8
      note_update_fn = function(fx) fx.y+=.2 end
    end
    return fx_init_note(note_x, note_y, color.pal_color, note_update_fn)
  end
end

function init_bird(bird, color)
  bird:set_properties({
    type=1,
    last_turn_time=G_time+30,
    color=color,
    can_scare=true,
    pal_color=color.pal_color,
    sit_sprt=bird.sprt,
  })

  function bird:reset()
    self:set_properties({
      expiry_time=false,
      is_hidden=false,
      is_active=false,
      target=false,
      dx=0,
      dy=0,
    })
    self:set_sprt(self.sit_sprt)
  end

  function bird:scare()
    if (not self.can_scare or self.is_scared or self.is_hidden or self.target) return
    G_room:add_animation(function()
      self:_turn(self.x-G_player.x < 0)
      sfx(12)
      self.is_scared=true
      self:set_sprt(SPRT_BIRD_JUMP)
      for i=1,4 do
        spr(42,self.flip_x and self.x-2 or self.x-4, self.y-13)
        yield()
      end
      self.is_scared=false
      self:set_sprt(self.sit_sprt)
      G_room:reset_bird_song()
    end)
  end

  function bird:fly_to_birdspot(spot)
    self:fly_to_target({x=cel2pxl(spot.celx+.5), y=cel2pxl(spot.cely+.3)})
  end

  function bird:fly_to_target(target)
    self.is_active=true
    self.is_solid=false
    if (not self.is_silent) sfx(17)
    self.target=target
    return
  end

  function bird:hide_color(pal_color)
    self.pal_color=pal_color
  end

  function bird:update()
    if (not self.target) return
    local diffx = self.target.x-self.x
    local diffy = self.target.y-self.y
    local magnitude = sqrt((diffx*diffx) + (diffy*diffy))
    self.dx = (diffx/magnitude)*1.5
    self.dy = (diffy/magnitude)*1.5
    self.flip_x = diffx>=0
    if (abs(self.x-self.target.x) < 1 and abs(self.y-self.target.y) < 1) then
      self.x = self.target.x
      self.y = self.target.y
      self:reset()
    end
  end

  function bird:collide(a2)
    if (a2 == G_player and self.target==G_player) then
      G_room:on_bird_collect()
      if G_room.puzzle and not G_room.puzzle.solved_time then
        G_room.puzzle.solved_time=G_time-31
        foreach(G_room:get_actors(8), function(a) a.glow_start=G_time end)
      end
      fx_init_particle_vacuum()
      sfx(30, 3)
      destroy(self)
    end
  end

  function bird:_turn(flip_x)
    self.flip_x=flip_x
    self.last_turn_time=G_time
  end

  function bird:sing(is_chime)
    -- hack to handle the multi blue bird puzzle
    -- birds are identified by a hidden color which is overridden to blue
    -- but use `not is_chime` here because the chime sounds better with multiple tones!
    sfx((self.pal_color==12 and not is_chime) and 6 or self.color.bird_sfx_sing)
    fx_init_note(
      self.x+3.2,
      self.y-6.4,
      self.pal_color,
      function(fx) fx.y-=0.08 end)
    G_room:add_animation(function()
      self:set_sprt(SPRT_BIRD_JUMP)
      yield() yield()
      self:set_sprt(self.sit_sprt)
    end, true)
  end

  function bird:draw()

function init_bunny(a)
  a:set_properties({
    type=6,
    w=4,
    h=4,
    initial_x=a.x,
    initial_y=a.y,
  })
  a.sfx_cycle=true

  function a:collide(a2)
    if a2.type == 9 then
      self.is_glowtile_collide=true
      activated = a2:activate()
    end
  end

  function a:run_from_player()
    if (self.is_hidden) return
    if (self.sprt==SPRT_BUNNY_HOP) return
    self:_set_glowtrack()
    local diffx=self.x-G_player.x
    local diffy=self.y-G_player.y
    if abs(diffx) > abs(diffy) then
      self:run((diffx >= 0) and 1 or -1, 0)
    else
      self:run(0, (diffy >= 0) and 1 or -1)
    end
  end

  function a:run(dx,dy)
    self.is_active=true
    self.dx=1*(dx or 0)
    self.dy=1*(dy or 0)
  end

  function a:draw()
    if (abs(self.dx)==0 and abs(self.dy)==0) then
      self:set_sprt({key=127})
    else
      self:set_sprt(SPRT_BUNNY_HOP)
      self:_set_glowtrack()
      self.flip_x=not(self.dx >= 0)
      if (self.frame==0) sfx(flr(rnd(2))+19)
    end
    self.is_glowtile_collide=false
  end

  function a:_set_glowtrack()
    if (self.is_glowtile_collide) return
    if abs((self.x-self.initial_x)%8)==0 and abs((self.y-self.initial_y)%8)==0 then
      local x = self.x
      local y = self.y
      -- this is a hack to avoid placing a track under the bunny right
      -- before it stops against a wall
      G_room:add_delayed_animation(function()
        if (self.sprt.key!=127) fx_init_glowtrack(x,y)
      end, 2)
    end
  end

    type=type or 3,
    pal_color=G_room.door_palcolor,
    is_open=false,
    delta=direction%2==0 and 1 or -1,
    is_horizontal = direction>0,
  })

  function door:open()
    if (self.is_open) return false
    self.is_open=true
    G_room:add_animation(function()
      local next_update_time = G_time
      while true do
        if G_time - next_update_time >=0 then
          next_update_time=G_time+4
          self:_update_position()
          if self.w==0 or self.h==0 then
            self.is_hidden=true
            destroy(self)
          end
        end
        yield()
      end
    end, true)
    return true
  end

  function door:_update_position()
    if self.is_horizontal then
      self.x += self.delta/2
      self.w -= abs(self.delta)/2
    else
      self.y += self.delta/2
      self.h -= abs(self.delta)/2
    end
  end

  function door:draw()
    rectfill(
      self.x-(self.w),
      self.y-(self.h),
      self.x+(self.w-1),
      self.y+(self.h-1),
      self.pal_color

function _fx_init_particles(x, y, count, fn)
  fx = FxFactory_create(x,y)
  fx.particles={}
  for i=1,count do add(fx.particles, fn(fx)) end

  function fx:draw()
    for p in all(self.particles) do
      p:draw()
      p.act-=1
      if (p.act<0) del(self.particles, p)
    end
    if (#self.particles==0) destroy(self)

  G_room:add_fx(fx, true)

function _fx_set_glow(fx, palcolor_replace, palcolor_1, palcolor_2, _spr, speed)
  local speed = speed or .2
  local index=1
  local cycle={
    palcolor_1,palcolor_1,palcolor_1,palcolor_1,
    palcolor_2,palcolor_2}

  function fx:draw()
    -- update glow effect
    local t=G_time-self.start_time
    if (rnd()<speed and cycle[index]==palcolor_1)
      or (t%8==0 and cycle[index]!=palcolor_1) then
      index+=1
      if (index > #cycle) index=1
    end
    pal(palcolor_replace, cycle[index])
    spr(_spr,self.x-4,self.y-4)
  end
  G_room:add_fx(fx)
  return fx

function FxFactory_create(x,y)
  return {
    start_time=G_time,
    x=x,y=y,
    draw=noop,
  }
end

-- INIT
function _init()
  f("0x1000, 0x1000, 0x2000",reload)
  poke(0x5f5c, 255) -- disable btnp repeat

  G_time=-32768 -- global frame count
  G_rooms,G_room={},{} -- resolved room defs by index
  G_win,G_music=nil,nil
  Map_init(get_actor_defs(), get_fx_defs())
  Map_update()
end

-- UPDATE
function _update()
  G_time+=1
  G_room:remove_expired_entities()
  -- Update all actors
  foreach(G_room.actors, update_actor)
  -- Resolve what just happened
  foreach(G_room.actors, commit_move)
  -- Handle any room change before drawing
  Map_update()
end

function update_actor(actor)
  if (not actor.is_active) return
  actor:update()
  for a2 in all(get_overlaps(actor,actor.dx,actor.dy)) do
    actor:collide(a2)
  end
end

function commit_move(actor)
  if (not actor.is_active) return
  if abs(actor.dx)>0 and not is_solid(actor, actor.dx, 0) then
    actor.x += actor.dx
  else
    actor.dx = 0
  end
  if abs(actor.dy)>0 and not is_solid(actor, 0, actor.dy) then
    actor.y += actor.dy
  else
    actor.dy = 0
  end
  clamp_outside_room(actor, G_room)
end

-- check both walls and actors
function is_solid(actor, dx, dy)
  new_x = actor.x+dx
  new_y = actor.y+dy
  -- allow the actor through 1-cell gaps
  actor_cell_w = actor.w - .01
  actor_cell_h = actor.h - .01
  return (
    is_solid_cell(actor, new_x-actor_cell_w,new_y-actor_cell_h) or
    is_solid_cell(actor, new_x+actor_cell_w,new_y-actor_cell_h) or
    is_solid_cell(actor, new_x-actor_cell_w,new_y+actor_cell_h) or
    is_solid_cell(actor, new_x+actor_cell_w,new_y+actor_cell_h)
  ) or is_solid_actor(actor, dx, dy)
end

function is_solid_cell(actor, x, y)
  return actor.is_solid and fget(mget(pxl2cel(x), pxl2cel(y)), 0)
end

function is_solid_actor(a, dx, dy)
  for a2 in all(get_overlaps(a,dx,dy)) do
    if (a:is_solid_actor(a2) and a2:is_solid_actor(a)) return true
  end
  return false
end

function get_overlaps(a, dx, dy)
  overlaps={}
  foreach(G_room.actors, function(a2) add_overlap(a,a2,dx,dy,overlaps) end)
  return overlaps
end

function add_overlap(a, a2, dx, dy, overlaps)
  if (a == a2) return
  if (abs((a.x+dx) - a2.x) >= a.w+a2.w) return
  if (abs((a.y+dy) - a2.y) >= a.h+a2.h) return
  add(overlaps, a2)
  return overlaps
end

function clamp_outside_room(actor, room)
  -- for a room with dimensions smaller than the screen, kick the
  -- actor out of the screen if the actor is outside the room
  clamped_x,clamped_y,did_clamp=clamp_into_room(actor,room)
  if (not did_clamp) return
  if (actor!=G_player) destroy(actor) return

  function dx(edge) return (actor.x-G_room.camera_x) + edge.camera_x end
  function dy(edge) return (actor.y-G_room.camera_y) + edge.camera_y end
  -- top edge
  if (clamped_y > actor.y) then
    edge = room:get_edge(1)
    actor.y=cel2pxl(edge.cely+8)-actor.h
    actor.x=dx(edge)
    return
  end
  -- bottom edge
  if (clamped_y < actor.y) then
    edge = room:get_edge(2)
    actor.y=cel2pxl(edge.cely-8)+actor.h
    actor.x=dx(edge)
    return
  end
  -- left edge
  if (clamped_x > actor.x) then
    edge = room:get_edge(3)
    actor.y=dy(edge)
    actor.x=cel2pxl(room:get_edge(3).celx+8)-actor.w
    return
  end
  -- right edge
  if (clamped_x < actor.x) then
    edge = room:get_edge(4)
    actor.y=dy(edge)
    actor.x=cel2pxl(room:get_edge(4).celx-8)+actor.w
    return
  end
end

function clamp_into_room(actor, room)
  -- for a room with dimensions smaller than the screen, pull the
  -- actor in if the actor is on the screen but outside the room
  x=mid(
    cel2pxl(room.celx-room.celw)+actor.w,
    actor.x,
    cel2pxl(room.celx+room.celw)-actor.w)
  y=mid(
    cel2pxl(room.cely-room.celh)+actor.h,
    actor.y,
    cel2pxl(room.cely+room.celh)-actor.h)
  return x,y,(x!=actor.x or y!=actor.y)
end

-- DRAW
function _draw()
  cls()
  camera(G_room.camera_x,G_room.camera_y)
  
  if G_dark and G_dark>0 then
    G_player.move_lock=true
    G_dark-=1
    if G_dark==0 then
      play_music(G_room.music)
    end
    return
  end
  G_player.move_lock = G_player.sprt.move_lock
  
  map()
  G_room:draw()
  G_room:play_bird_song()
  foreach(G_room.fx,draw_fx)
  foreach(G_room.actors,draw_actor)
  G_room:play_animations()
  for tile in all(G_room.foreground_tiles) do
    key=mget(tile.celx,tile.cely)
    spr(key,cel2pxl(tile.celx),cel2pxl(tile.cely))
  end
  foreach(G_room.foreground_fx,draw_fx)
  -- if G_debug then
  --   foreach(G_room.actors, function(actor) actor:debug() end)
    -- G_room:print("mem: "..stat(0).."/2048\ncpu: "..(stat(1)*100).."%")
  -- end
end

function draw_fx(fx)
  fx:draw()
  pal()
end

function draw_actor(actor)
  if (actor.is_hidden) return
  actor:draw()
  _sprt=actor.sprt

  -- advance animation frames
  df = abs(actor.dy)+abs(actor.dx)
  if actor.type==1 then
    --birds flap wings faster
    df*=0.5
  elseif abs(actor.dx)>0 and abs(actor.dy)>0 then
    -- account for diagonal movement
    df *= 0.3125
  else
    df *= 0.5
  end
  actor.frame += df
  actor.frame %= _sprt.frames

  -- draw the sprite
  if (_sprt.key>0) then
    if _sprt.align_celw then
      -- align sprite to the side
      spr_x=actor.x-(cel2pxl(_sprt.align_celw)/2)
      if (actor.flip_x) spr_x -= cel2pxl(_sprt.celw-_sprt.align_celw)
    else
      -- center the sprite
      spr_x=actor.x-(cel2pxl(_sprt.celw)/2)
    end
    spr_y=(actor.y-(cel2pxl(_sprt.celh)/2))+_sprt.y_offset
    spr(
      _sprt.key + actor.frame,
      spr_x, spr_y,
      _sprt.celw, _sprt.celh,
      actor.flip_x)
    pal()
  end
  actor:draw_foreground()
end

-- ***********************************************
-- *                   UTILS                     *
-- ***********************************************

function play_music(id, delay)
  -- ENDGAME THEME
  if id == 20 then
    G_player.is_endgame=true
  end
  -- override with endgame music
  if G_player.is_endgame and id == 5 then
    id = 20
  end

  -- WIN (FLOWER) THEME
  if (G_player.flower and id!=-1) id=39

  -- if G_dark always stop music
  if (G_dark and G_dark>0) id=-1
  if id and id!=G_music then
    G_music=id
    music(id, delay or 120)
  end
  return id
end

function Tables_merge(merge_from, merge_into)
  for k,v in pairs(merge_from) do merge_into[k] = v end
end

function destroy(entity)
  entity.expiry_time = G_time + 1
end

function delay_sfx(args)
  local _sfx, delay=f_unpack(args)
  G_room:add_delayed_animation(function() sfx(_sfx) end, delay)
end

function cel2pxl(cels) return cels*8 end
function pxl2cel(pxls) return pxls/8 end
function cel2room(cels) return cels\16 end
function room2cel(rooms) return rooms*16 end

function noop() end

function dofade()
	local p,kmax,col,k=flr(mid(0,fadeperc,1)*100)
	for j=1,15 do
		col=j+128
		kmax=flr((p+(j*1.46))/22)
		for k=1,kmax do col=dpal[col] end 
		pal(j,col,1)

end

function checkfade()

function glitchline()
	local d={-2,-1,0,1,2}
	glitchy=(glitchy+.2)%200
	for x=0,128 do
		local p=pget(x+rnd(d),glitchy)
		if p==0 then p=2 end
		pset(x,glitchy,p)
	end

function wait(f)
	repeat 
		f-=1
		flip()
	until f<0
end

function fadeout(spd)
	if (spd==nil) spd=.04
	repeat 
		fadeperc=min(fadeperc+spd,1)
		dofade() flip()
	until
	fadeperc==1
end

function smooth(v,dv)
	if v>dv then v-=ceil((v-dv)/4)
	elseif v<dv then v+=ceil((dv-v)/4) end
	return v
end

function has(t,e)
	local ret=false
	for _,v in pairs(t) do
		if (v==e) ret=true
	end
	return ret
end

function onoff(n)

	elseif (n<=0 or n==false) then

function load_level(n)
	submode=""
	local ps={} --pipes
	
	--map clone
	for _x=0,7 do
		for _y=0,7 do
			local x=_x+(n-1)%16*8
			local y=_y+(n-1)\16*8
			mset(_x,_y,mget(x,y+8))
			if (mget(_x,_y)!=0) add(ps,{x=_x,y=_y})
		end
	end
	
	--cursor
	local pp=rnd(ps) --rnd pipe
	gcx=pp.x gcy=pp.y
	cx=gcx*8+31 cy=gcy*8+31
	cdx=cx cdy=cy
end

function rotate(tile)
	if fget(tile,0) then return tile+1
	elseif fget(tile,1) then return tile-1
	elseif fget(tile,2) then return tile-3
	else return tile end
end

function check_win()
	local ps={} --all pipes on lvl
	--adding pipes
	for x=0,7 do
		for y=0,7 do
			if mget(x,y)!=0 then
				add(ps,{x=x,y=y,t=mget(x,y)})
			end
		end
	end
	
	--loop for all pipes
	for p in all(ps) do
		--current pipe sides
		local er1,ed1,el1,eu1=0,0,0,0
		if (has(p1➡️,p.t)) er1=1
		if (has(p1⬇️,p.t)) ed1=1
		if (has(p1⬅️,p.t)) el1=1
		if (has(p1⬆️,p.t)) eu1=1
		local er2,ed2,el2,eu2=0,0,0,0
		if (has(p2➡️,p.t)) er2=1
		if (has(p2⬇️,p.t)) ed2=1
		if (has(p2⬅️,p.t)) el2=1
		if (has(p2⬆️,p.t)) eu2=1
		local er3,ed3,el3,eu3=0,0,0,0
		if (has(p3➡️,p.t)) er3=1
		if (has(p3⬇️,p.t)) ed3=1
		if (has(p3⬅️,p.t)) el3=1
		if (has(p3⬆️,p.t)) eu3=1
		--presumed pipe sides
		local cr1,cd1,cl1,cu1=0,0,0,0
		if (er1==1 and has(p1⬅️,mget(p.x+1,p.y))) cr1=1
		if (ed1==1 and has(p1⬆️,mget(p.x,p.y+1))) cd1=1
		if (el1==1 and has(p1➡️,mget(p.x-1,p.y))) cl1=1
		if (eu1==1 and has(p1⬇️,mget(p.x,p.y-1))) cu1=1
		local cr2,cd2,cl2,cu2=0,0,0,0
		if (er2==1 and has(p2⬅️,mget(p.x+1,p.y))) cr2=1
		if (ed2==1 and has(p2⬆️,mget(p.x,p.y+1))) cd2=1
		if (el2==1 and has(p2➡️,mget(p.x-1,p.y))) cl2=1
		if (eu2==1 and has(p2⬇️,mget(p.x,p.y-1))) cu2=1
		local cr3,cd3,cl3,cu3=0,0,0,0
		if (er3==1 and has(p3⬅️,mget(p.x+1,p.y))) cr3=1
		if (ed3==1 and has(p3⬆️,mget(p.x,p.y+1))) cd3=1
		if (el3==1 and has(p3➡️,mget(p.x-1,p.y))) cl3=1
		if (eu3==1 and has(p3⬇️,mget(p.x,p.y-1))) cu3=1
		--check both sides
		local sc=er1+ed1+el1+eu1+er2+ed2+el2+eu2+er3+ed3+el3+eu3
		if (er1==1 and cr1==1) sc-=1
		if (ed1==1 and cd1==1) sc-=1
		if (el1==1 and cl1==1) sc-=1
		if (eu1==1 and cu1==1) sc-=1

		if (ed2==1 and cd2==1) sc-=1
		if (el2==1 and cl2==1) sc-=1

		if (ed3==1 and cd3==1) sc-=1

	end

  {id="shotgun",name="shotgun",icon=157,apply=function()bullet_multi_count=1 end},
  {id="mir",name="mirror shot",icon=156,apply=function()mirror_shot_enabled=true end},
  {id="ric",name="ricochet",icon=154,apply=function()bullet_ricochet_count=1 bullet_bounce_enabled=true end},
  {id="fire_dash",name="fire dash",icon=138,apply=function()fire_dash_unlocked=true end},
  {id="sword",name="ghost sword",icon=155,apply=function()ghost_sword_unlocked=true end}
}

-- Stackable upgrades (can be repeated)
upgrade_pool={
  {id="dmg",name="damage +5",icon=140,apply=function()bullet_damage+=5 end},
  {id="hp",name="hp +1",icon=148,apply=function()player_health+=1 end},
  {id="mov",name="move speed",icon=153,apply=function()player_speed+=0.2 end},
  {id="mag",name="magnet range",icon=150,apply=function()magnet_range+=10 end},
  {id="dash",name="dash distance",icon=149,apply=function()dash_speed+=1 end},
  {id="reload",name="reload speed",icon=174,apply=function()revolver_reload_delay=flr(revolver_reload_delay*0.8)end}
}
magnet_range=15
fire_dash_unlocked=false
ghost_sword_unlocked=false
ghost_sword_x=0
ghost_sword_y=0
ghost_sword_angle=0
-- removed: current_target_enemy (use helper)
bullet_target_enemy=nil

function choose_random_upgrades()
  local pool={}
  
  -- Add stackable upgrades (always available)
  for u in all(upgrade_pool) do
    add(pool,u)
  end
  
  -- Add skills that aren't unlocked yet
  for s in all(skills_pool) do
    if s.id=="dyn" and not dynamite_unlocked then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="ghost" and not ghost_gun_unlocked then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="shotgun" and bullet_multi_count==0 then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="mir" and not mirror_shot_enabled then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="ric" and bullet_ricochet_count==0 then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="fire_dash" and not fire_dash_unlocked then add(pool,s)
    elseif s.id=="sword" and not ghost_sword_unlocked then add(pool,s)
    end
  end
  
  local selected={}
  for i=1,3 do
    if #pool==0 then break end
    local idx=flr(rnd(#pool))+1
    add(selected,pool[idx])
    deli(pool,idx)
  end
  return selected
end

function _init()
  player_x=map_center_x
  player_y=map_center_y
  gun_angle=0
  map_seed=flr(rnd(1000000))
  cam_x=player_x-64
  cam_y=player_y-64
  game_state="intro"
  music(0) -- play patterns 00..05 as defined in tracker
end




function _update()
    if game_state=="intro" then
    if btnp(5) then
      sfx(36)
      if tutorial_screen==1 then
        tutorial_screen=2
        tutorial_slide=0
      elseif tutorial_screen==2 then
        tutorial_slide=1
        t=function()return 0 end
      end
    end
    if tutorial_slide>0 then
      tutorial_slide=min(tutorial_slide+0.1,1)
      if tutorial_slide>=1 then
        game_state="playing"
        t=time
      end
    end
    return
  end
  
  
  if ghost_gun_unlocked then
    ghost_gun.x+=(player_x+12-ghost_gun.x)*0.1
    ghost_gun.y+=(player_y+4-ghost_gun.y)*0.1
    ghost_gun.bullet_timer=(ghost_gun.bullet_timer or 0)+1
    if (ghost_gun.bullet_timer%30)==0 then
      local gx,gy=ghost_gun.x+4,ghost_gun.y+4
      local n=nearest_enemy(gx,gy,false)
      local dx,dy=cos(gun_angle),sin(gun_angle)
      if n then dx=n.x+4-gx dy=n.y+4-gy local l=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy) if l>0 then dx/=l dy/=l end end
      add(bullets,{x=gx,y=gy,dx=dx*bullet_speed,dy=dy*bullet_speed,color=11,trail={},source="ghost"})
      ghost_gun.recoil=2
    end
    ghost_gun.recoil=max((ghost_gun.recoil or 0)-0.2,0)
  end

  -- ghost sword orbiting logic
  if ghost_sword_unlocked then
    ghost_sword_angle=(ghost_sword_angle or 0)+0.02
    ghost_sword_x=player_x+8+cos(ghost_sword_angle)*20
    ghost_sword_y=player_y+8+sin(ghost_sword_angle)*20
    
    -- check for enemy collisions
    for e in all(enemies) do
      local dx=ghost_sword_x-(e.x+4)
      local dy=ghost_sword_y-(e.y+4)
      if sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)<8 then
        e.hp-=20 e.hit_timer=10 e.last_damage=20 e.damage_color=11
        if e.hp<=0 then on_enemy_killed(e,ghost_sword_x-(e.x+4),ghost_sword_y-(e.y+4)) end
      end
    end
  end

  if game_over then
    time=function()
      if game_over then return death_time else return t() end
    end
    game_over_slide=min(game_over_slide+0.1,1)
    if btnp(5) then
      sfx(36)
      game_state="playing"
      run()
    end
    return
  end

  if level_up_pending then
    time=function()
      if level_up_pending then return 0 else return t() end
    end
    if btnp(0) then 
      selected_card=max(1,selected_card-1)
      sfx(32, 1)
    end
    if btnp(1) then 
      selected_card=min(3,selected_card+1)
      sfx(32, 1)
    end
    if btnp(5) then
      sfx(36)
      level_up_pending=false
      local upgrade=offered_upgrades[selected_card]
      if upgrade then 
        upgrade.apply()
        invulnerable_timer=60
      end
    end
    return
  end

  local px=player_x
  local py=player_y

  local move_x, move_y = 0, 0
  
  if btn(0) then 
    move_x -= player_speed
    if not player_facing_left and turn_transition_timer==0 then
      turn_transition_timer=8
      turn_transition_stage=0
    end
    player_facing_left=true 
  end
  if btn(1) then 
    move_x += player_speed
    player_facing_left=false 
  end
  if btn(2) then move_y -= player_speed end
  if btn(3) then move_y += player_speed end
  
  if move_x ~= 0 and move_y ~= 0 then
    move_x /= 1.41
    move_y /= 1.41
  end
  
  px += move_x
  py += move_y

  player_prev_direction=player_direction
  
  if direction_transition_timer>0 then
  else
    local is_moving=btn(0) or btn(1) or btn(2) or btn(3)
    
    if is_moving then
      player_direction="down"
      if btn(2) and (btn(0) or btn(1)) then
        player_direction="up_diag"
      elseif btn(3) and (btn(0) or btn(1)) then
        player_direction="down_diag"
      elseif btn(2) then
        player_direction="up"
      elseif btn(3) then
        player_direction="down"
      elseif btn(0) or btn(1) then
        player_direction="side"
      end
      
      player_last_movement_direction=player_direction
    else
      player_direction=player_last_movement_direction
    end
    
    if player_direction!=player_prev_direction then
      local cardinal_dirs={"up","down","side"}
      local is_prev_cardinal=false
      local is_current_cardinal=false
      
      for dir in all(cardinal_dirs) do
        if player_prev_direction==dir then is_prev_cardinal=true end
        if player_direction==dir then is_current_cardinal=true end
      end
      
      if is_prev_cardinal and is_current_cardinal then
        direction_transition_timer=direction_transition_duration
        player_target_direction=player_direction
        
        -- existing diagonal transitions
        if (player_prev_direction=="side" and player_direction=="down") or
           (player_prev_direction=="down" and player_direction=="side") then
          player_direction="down_diag"
        elseif (player_prev_direction=="side" and player_direction=="up") or
               (player_prev_direction=="up" and player_direction=="side") then
          player_direction="up_diag"
        -- new opposite direction transitions
        elseif (player_prev_direction=="up" and player_direction=="down") then
          player_direction="down_diag" -- up -> down_diag -> down
        elseif (player_prev_direction=="down" and player_direction=="up") then
          player_direction="up_diag" -- down -> up_diag -> up
        elseif (player_prev_direction=="side" and player_direction=="side") then
          -- left to right or right to left - use diagonal transition
          if player_facing_left then
            player_direction="down_diag" -- left -> down_diag -> right
          else
            player_direction="up_diag" -- right -> up_diag -> left
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  if direction_transition_timer>0 then
    direction_transition_timer-=1
    if direction_transition_timer==0 and player_target_direction then
      player_direction=player_target_direction
      player_target_direction=nil
    end
  end
  
  if turn_transition_timer>0 then
    turn_transition_timer-=1
    if turn_transition_timer==0 then
      turn_transition_stage=0
    end
  end

  player_x=mid(0,px,1024-16)
  player_y=mid(0,py,1024-16)
  

  -- autotarget logic - always run this regardless of movement
  local target_enemy=nearest_enemy(player_x+8,player_y+8,false)
  if target_enemy then
    local desired_angle=atan2(target_enemy.y+4-(player_y+8),target_enemy.x+4-(player_x+8))
    local diff=(desired_angle-gun_angle+0.5)%1.0-0.5
    gun_angle+=diff*0.2
  end

  if (btn(0) or btn(1) or btn(2) or btn(3)) and rnd()<0.6 then
    local px=player_x+8
    local py=player_y+16
    emit(px,py,(btn(1) and 0.3 or 0)-(btn(0) and 0.3 or 0)+(rnd(1)-0.5)*0.4,(btn(3) and 0.3 or 0)-(btn(2) and 0.3 or 0)+(rnd(1)-0.5)*0.4-0.2,15+flr(rnd(10)),5+flr(rnd(3)),1,nil,true)
  end


  if btnp(5) and dash_timer==0 and dash_cooldown_timer==0 then
    dash_timer=5
    sfx(35)
    invulnerable_timer=60
    -- prefer input direction; if none, use character direction
    local dx_input=(btn(1) and 1 or 0)-(btn(0) and 1 or 0)
    local dy_input=(btn(3) and 1 or 0)-(btn(2) and 1 or 0)
    dash_dx=dx_input
    dash_dy=dy_input
    local len=sqrt(dash_dx*dash_dx+dash_dy*dash_dy)
    if len==0 then
      local d=player_direction or player_last_movement_direction or "down"
      local sx=player_facing_left and -1 or 1
      dash_dx=(d=="side" or d=="up_diag" or d=="down_diag") and sx or 0
      dash_dy=(d=="up" or d=="up_diag") and -1 or ((d=="down" or d=="down_diag") and 1 or 0)
      len=sqrt(dash_dx*dash_dx+dash_dy*dash_dy)
    end
    if len>0 then
      dash_dx/=len
      dash_dy/=len
    end
    dash_cooldown_timer=dash_cooldown
  end

  if dash_timer>0 then
    dash_timer-=1
    player_x+=dash_dx*dash_speed
    player_y+=dash_dy*dash_speed
    
    -- Fire dash damage and particles
    if fire_dash_unlocked then
      -- Make player invulnerable during fire dash
      invulnerable_timer=max(invulnerable_timer,60)
      
       for e in all(enemies) do
        if abs(e.x-player_x)<12 and abs(e.y-player_y)<12 then
          e.hp-=15 e.hit_timer=10 e.last_damage=15 e.damage_color=8
          if e.hp<=0 then on_enemy_killed(e,player_x-e.x,player_y-e.y) end
        end
      end
      
      -- Fire particles
       for i=1,3 do
        emit(player_x+8+rnd(8)-4,player_y+8+rnd(8)-4,rnd(2)-1,rnd(2)-1-0.5,8+rnd(4),8+rnd(2),nil,nil)
      end
    end
    
    if #dash_trails>=3 then
      deli(dash_trails,1)
    end
    add(dash_trails,{
      x=player_x,
      y=player_y,
      spr_id=nil,
      life=6
    })
  end

  for t in all(dash_trails) do
    t.life-=1
    if t.life<=0 then
      del(dash_trails,t)
    end
  end

  cam_x=mid(0,(player_x+8)-64,1024-128)
  cam_y=mid(0,(player_y+8)-64,1024-128)




  enemy_spawn_timer+=1
  if enemy_spawn_timer >= enemy_spawn_delay and #enemies < 50 then
    enemy_spawn_timer = 0
    spawn_enemy()
  end

  for e in all(enemies) do
    local dx,dy=player_x-e.x,player_y-e.y
    local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
    if d>1 then 
      local speed_mult = min(0.8, 0.5 + (player_level - 1) * 0.03)
      local s = player_speed * speed_mult
      e.x += (dx/d) * s
      e.y += (dy/d) * s
    end
    for o in all(enemies) do if e!=o and abs(e.x-o.x)<16 and abs(e.y-o.y)<16 then local x=e.x-o.x local y=e.y-o.y if x*x+y*y<16 then e.x+=x*0.1 e.y+=y*0.1 end end end
    if abs(e.x-player_x)<8 and abs(e.y-player_y)<8 and invulnerable_timer==0 then
      player_health-=1 camera_shake_timer=10 hit_flash_timer=10 invulnerable_timer=60
      if player_health<=0 then game_over=true death_time=flr(time()) game_over_slide=0 sfx(38) end
      del(enemies,e)
    end
  end


  last_target_dx=last_target_dx or 1
  last_target_dy=last_target_dy or 0

  -- bullet targeting logic - continuous
    local px=player_x+4
    local py=player_y+4
    bullet_target_enemy=nearest_enemy(px,py,true)

  if btnp(4) and revolver_current>0 and not revolver_reloading and manual_fire_cooldown<=0 then
    sfx(33, 0)
    bullet_timer=0
    revolver_current-=1
    manual_fire_cooldown=7
    revolver_shake_timer=8
    
    if revolver_current<=0 then
      revolver_reloading=true
      revolver_reload_timer=revolver_reload_delay
      revolver_rotation=0
      -- sfx removed
    end

    last_target_dx=last_target_dx or 1
    last_target_dy=last_target_dy or 0

    local dx,dy
    local nearest=bullet_target_enemy
    if nearest then
      dx=nearest.x+4-px dy=nearest.y+4-py
      local len=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
      if len>0 then dx/=len dy/=len last_target_dx=dx last_target_dy=dy gun_angle=atan2(dy,dx) end
    else dx=last_target_dx dy=last_target_dy end



    add(bullets,{x=px,y=py,dx=dx*bullet_speed,dy=dy*bullet_speed,trail={}})
    if mirror_shot_enabled then
      local mirror_dx=-dx*bullet_speed
      local mirror_dy=-dy*bullet_speed
      add(bullets,{x=px,y=py,dx=mirror_dx,dy=mirror_dy,trail={}})
    end

    if bullet_multi_count>0 then
        for i=1,bullet_multi_count do
            local angle_offset=bullet_multi_angle*(i%2==0 and 1 or -1)*ceil(i/2)
            local spread_dx=cos(gun_angle+angle_offset)*bullet_speed
            local spread_dy=sin(gun_angle+angle_offset)*bullet_speed
            add(bullets,{
                x=px,
                y=py,
                dx=spread_dx,
                dy=spread_dy,
                trail={}
            })
        end
    end
  end

  -- update bullets
  for b in all(bullets) do
    b.x+=b.dx b.y+=b.dy
    emit(b.x,b.y,0,0,6,10,1)
    if b.x<0 or b.x>1024 or b.y<0 or b.y>1024 then del(bullets,b) end
  end

  -- bullet collision with enemies
  for b in all(bullets) do
    if not b.bounces then b.bounces = 0 end
    
    local hit = false
    for e in all(enemies) do
        if not hit and abs(b.x - e.x) < 6 and abs(b.y - e.y) < 6 then
            -- Apply damage (ghost gun ignores upgrades)
            local dmg = (b.source=="ghost") and 10 or bullet_damage
            e.hp -= dmg
            e.hit_timer = 10
            e.last_damage = dmg
            if b.source=="ghost" then e.damage_color=11 end
            hit = true
            
            -- Handle ricochet
            if bullet_bounce_enabled and b.bounces < bullet_ricochet_count and b.source!="ghost" then
                -- Find next closest enemy
                local next_target = nil
                local closest_dist = 999
                
                for next_e in all(enemies) do
                    if next_e != e then
                        local dx = next_e.x - b.x
                        local dy = next_e.y - b.y
                        local dist = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
                        if dist < closest_dist then
                            closest_dist = dist
                            next_target = next_e
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                -- If found another target, redirect bullet
                if next_target then
                    local dx = next_target.x - b.x
                    local dy = next_target.y - b.y
                    local dist = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
                    b.dx = (dx/dist) * bullet_speed
                    b.dy = (dy/dist) * bullet_speed
                    b.bounces += 1
                    
                    -- Add bounce effect
                    for i=1,6 do emit(b.x,b.y,rnd(2)-1,rnd(2)-1,10,8+b.bounces,1) end
                else
                    del(bullets, b)
                end
            else
                del(bullets, b)
            end
            
            if e.hp <= 0 then
                if e.hit_timer and e.hit_timer > 0 then
                    emit(e.x+4,e.y-6,0,-0.5,30,7,nil,nil,nil,"damage_number",e.last_damage)
                end
                on_enemy_killed(e,b.dx,b.dy)
            end
            break
        end
    end
  end

  -- ghost bullet logic removed

  if dynamite_unlocked then
    dynamite_timer += 1
    if dynamite_timer >= dynamite_cooldown then
      dynamite_timer = 0
      local nearest=nearest_enemy(player_x+4,player_y+4,false)
      if nearest then
        local bx = player_x + 4
        local by = player_y + 4
        local tx = nearest.x + 4
        local ty = nearest.y + 4
        -- throw directly at target with slight overshoot
        tx = bx + (tx - bx) * 1.2
        ty = by + (ty - by) * 1.2
        local angle = atan2(ty - by, tx - bx)
        local speed = 2.5
        local vx = cos(angle) * speed
        local vy = sin(angle) * speed
        local dynamite = {
          x = bx,
          y = by,
          dx = vx,
          dy = vy,
          height = 0,
          vyz = -3, -- higher arc
          gravity = 0.3,
          exploded = false,
          timer = 0
        }
        add(dynamites, dynamite)
      end
    end
  end

  -- update dynamites with arched motion and explosion
  for d in all(dynamites) do
    d.timer += 1
    d.vyz += d.gravity
    d.height += d.vyz
    d.x += d.dx
    d.y += d.dy
    -- dynamite shadow and trail effect
    if d.height < 0 then
      emit(d.x,d.y,rnd(0.2)-0.1,rnd(0.2)-0.1,6,8,1)
    end
    if d.height > 0 then
      d.height = 0
      d.vyz = -d.vyz * 0.6
      if abs(d.vyz) < 0.4 then
        d.vyz = 0
      end
    end
    if not d.exploded and d.timer >= 5 and d.height == 0 then
      d.exploded = true
      local px = d.x
      local py = d.y
      -- explosion flash and shake
      shake_timer = 5
      circfill(px, py, 12, 7)
      for j=1,18 do local a=rnd(1) local s=1+rnd(1) emit(px,py,cos(a)*s,sin(a)*s,10,8+flr(rnd(2)),1) end
      for e in all(enemies) do
        local dx = px - (e.x + 4)
        local dy = py - (e.y + 4)
      if sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy) < 18 then
          -- Area damage: 50 damage to all enemies in range
          e.hp -= 50
          e.hit_timer = 10
          e.last_damage = 50
          e.damage_color = 8
          
          -- Visual explosion effect on hit enemies
          for i=1, 6 do
            local a = rnd(1)
            local s = rnd(1)
            emit(e.x+rnd(8)-4,e.y+rnd(8)-4,cos(a)*s,sin(a)*s,8,8+flr(rnd(2)))
          end
          
          -- Kill enemy if HP reaches 0
            if e.hp<=0 then on_enemy_killed(e,dx,dy) end
        end
      end
    end
    if d.exploded and d.timer > 10 then
      del(dynamites, d)
    end
  end

  -- update particles
  for p in all(particles) do
      p.x += p.dx
      p.y += p.dy
    
    -- Apply gravity if particle has it
    if p.gravity then
      p.dy += p.gravity
    end
    
    p.life -= 1
    if p.life <= 0 then
      del(particles, p)
    else
      -- Handle fading for walking dust particles
      if p.fade then
        local ratio = p.life / (p.max_life or 20)
        if ratio < 0.3 then
          p.color = 1 -- Fade to black
        elseif ratio < 0.6 then
          p.color = 5 -- Dark gray
        end
      elseif p.type!="blood" then
        -- keep blood splashes red; others use original color shift
        local ratio = p.life / (p.max_life or 6)
        p.color = (ratio < 0.5) and 9 or 10
      end
    end
  end

  -- update blood stains life and fade
  for b in all(blood_stains) do
    b.life-=1
    if b.life<=0 then del(blood_stains,b) end
  end

  -- gradually increase spawn rate
  spawn_increase_timer += 1
  if spawn_increase_timer >= spawn_increase_delay then
    spawn_increase_timer = 0
    enemy_spawn_delay = max(10, enemy_spawn_delay - 5) -- cap minimum delay
  end

  -- xp gem logic (reset & simplified)
  for g in all(xp_gems) do
    -- If collected, always switch to collect_bounce state and reset bounce
    if not g.collected and abs(g.x - player_x) < 8 and abs(g.y - player_y) < 8 then
        g.collected = true
        g.collect_timer = 0
        g.collect_duration = 15
        g.z = 0
        g.vz = -2.5 - rnd(1.0)
        g.gravity = 0.3
        g.bounce = 0
        g.max_bounces = 1
        g.state = "collect_bounce"
    end

    -- Drop animation (only if not collected)
    if not g.collected and g.state == "bouncing" then
        g.z += g.vz
        g.vz += g.gravity
        -- Bounce when hitting ground
        if g.z >= 0 then
            g.z = 0
            g.vz = -g.vz * 0.5
            g.bounce += 1
            if abs(g.vz) < 0.2 or g.bounce >= g.max_bounces then
                g.state = "idle"
                g.vz = 0
                g.z = 0
            end
        end
    end

    -- Collection animation (overwrites drop)
    if g.collected and g.state == "collect_bounce" then
        g.x = player_x + 4
        g.y = player_y + 4
        g.z += g.vz
        g.vz += g.gravity
        if g.z >= 0 then
            g.z = 0
            g.vz = -g.vz * 0.5
            g.bounce += 1
            if abs(g.vz) < 0.2 or g.bounce >= g.max_bounces then
                g.state = "collected_done"
            end
        end

function emit(x,y,dx,dy,life,color,shape,gravity,fade,type,damage_text)

    x=x,y=y,dx=dx or 0,dy=dy or 0,
    life=life or 6,max_life=life or 6,
    color=color or 10,
    size=shape,shape=shape,
    gravity=gravity,fade=fade,
    type=type,damage_text=damage_text
  })
end

function add_xp_gem_at(x,y)
  if #xp_gems<MAX_XP_GEMS then
    add(xp_gems,{x=x,y=y,vz=-2.5-rnd(1.5),z=0,gravity=0.3,bounce=0,max_bounces=3,state="bouncing"})
  end
end

function on_enemy_killed(e,hx,hy)
  add_xp_gem_at(e.x,e.y)
  -- blood splash particles
  local bx,by=e.x+4,e.y+4
  if hx and hy then
    local base=(atan2(hy,hx)+0.5)%1
    for i=1,20 do local a=base+(rnd(0.3)-0.15) local s=2+rnd(3) emit(bx,by,cos(a)*s,sin(a)*s,8+rnd(8),8,1,0.2,nil,"blood") end
  else
    for i=1,20 do local a=rnd(1) local s=2+rnd(3) emit(bx,by,cos(a)*s,sin(a)*s,8+rnd(8),8,1,0.2,nil,"blood") end
  end
  add_blood(bx,by)
  kill_count+=1
  del(enemies,e)
end

function nearest_enemy(ax,ay,onscreen)
  local best=nil
  local bestd=999999
  for e in all(enemies) do
    if not onscreen or (e.x>cam_x-8 and e.x<cam_x+136 and e.y>cam_y-8 and e.y<cam_y+136) then
      local dx=e.x+4-ax
      local dy=e.y+4-ay
      local d=dx*dx+dy*dy
      if d<bestd then bestd=d best=e end
    end
  end
  return best
end

function add_blood(x,y)
  for i=1,28 do
    local l=60+flr(rnd(90))
    add(blood_stains,{x=x+rnd(12)-6,y=y+rnd(8)-4,life=l,max=l})
  end
end

function get_floor_sprite(x,y)
    local rx=x+map_seed*0.1
    local ry=y+map_seed*0.15
    local large_noise=(sin(rx*0.005)+cos(ry*0.005))*0.5+0.5
    local medium_noise=(sin(rx*0.01)+cos(ry*0.01))*0.5+0.5
    local small_noise=(sin(rx*0.02)+cos(ry*0.02))*0.5+0.5
    local organic_value=(large_noise*0.6+medium_noise*0.3+small_noise*0.1)
    local horizontal_stretch=(sin(rx*0.003)+cos(ry*0.008))*0.5+0.5
    local vertical_stretch=(sin(rx*0.008)+cos(ry*0.003))*0.5+0.5
    local stone_influence=(organic_value+horizontal_stretch*0.3+vertical_stretch*0.3)/1.6
    if stone_influence>0.92 then
        local seed=(x*928371+y*472882+map_seed)%#stone_sprites+1
        return stone_sprites[seed]
    else
        local seed=(x*73856093+y*19349663+map_seed*83492791)%#vegetation_sprites+1
        return vegetation_sprites[seed]
    end
end



function spawn_enemy()
    local available_types={}
    local game_time=flr(time())
    for i,etype in ipairs(enemy_types) do
        if game_time>=etype.unlock_time then add(available_types,i) end
    end
    if #available_types==0 then add(available_types,1) end
    local type_idx=available_types[flr(rnd(#available_types))+1]
    local enemy_type=enemy_types[type_idx]
    local margin=20
    local ex,ey
    local side=flr(rnd(4))
    if side==0 then ex=cam_x-margin ey=cam_y+rnd(128)
    elseif side==1 then ex=cam_x+128+margin ey=cam_y+rnd(128)
    elseif side==2 then ex=cam_x+rnd(128) ey=cam_y-margin
    else ex=cam_x+rnd(128) ey=cam_y+128+margin end
    add(enemies,{x=ex,y=ey,type=type_idx,hp=enemy_type.hp,first_sprite=enemy_type.first_sprite})
end

function draw_enemy(e)
    ovalfill(e.x+2,e.y+7,e.x+6,e.y+9,0)
    local frames={e.first_sprite,e.first_sprite+16,e.first_sprite+32,e.first_sprite+48}
    local frame_index=flr(time()*6)%#frames+1
    local current_frame=frames[frame_index]
    local flip=e.x<player_x
    spr(current_frame,e.x,e.y,1,1,flip)
    
    -- draw targeting indicator (dotted circle) if this enemy is the bullet target - draw on top
    if e==bullet_target_enemy then
        for i=0,8 do
            local angle=i/9
            local x=e.x+4+cos(angle)*10
            local y=e.y+4+sin(angle)*10
            pset(x,y,8)
        end
    end
    
    local etype=mid(1,e.type or 1,#enemy_types)
    if e.hp<enemy_types[etype].hp then
        local max_hp=enemy_types[etype].hp
        local hp_width=8
        local hp_filled=(hp_width*e.hp)/max_hp
        rectfill(e.x,e.y-2,e.x+hp_width,e.y-1,0)
        rectfill(e.x,e.y-2,e.x+hp_filled,e.y-1,8)
    end
    if e.hit_timer and e.hit_timer>0 then
        e.hit_timer-=1
        local damage_color=e.damage_color or 7
        print(e.last_damage,e.x+4,e.y-6-(10-e.hit_timer),damage_color)
    end
end









function draw_revolver_counter()
  local center_x=111
  local center_y=111
  local shake_x=0
  local shake_y=0
  
  if revolver_shake_timer>0 then
    shake_x=rnd(1)-0.5
    shake_y=rnd(1)-0.5
  end
  
  local circle_x=center_x+1+shake_x
  local circle_y=center_y+1+shake_y
  local spacing=8
  
  -- Original bullet positions with rotation applied to the whole chamber
  local bullet_positions={{x=center_x+shake_x,y=center_y-spacing+shake_y},{x=center_x+spacing-1+shake_x,y=center_y-spacing/2+shake_y},{x=center_x+spacing-1+shake_x,y=center_y+spacing/2+shake_y},{x=center_x+shake_x,y=center_y+spacing+shake_y},{x=center_x-spacing+1+shake_x,y=center_y+spacing/2+shake_y},{x=center_x-spacing+1+shake_x,y=center_y-spacing/2+shake_y}}
  
  -- Apply rotation to the entire chamber
  if revolver_reloading then
    for i=1,revolver_bullets do
      local pos=bullet_positions[i]
      local dx=pos.x-center_x
      local dy=pos.y-center_y
      local rotated_x=center_x+cos(revolver_rotation)*dx-sin(revolver_rotation)*dy+1
      local rotated_y=center_y+sin(revolver_rotation)*dx+cos(revolver_rotation)*dy
      bullet_positions[i]={x=rotated_x,y=rotated_y}
    end
  end
  
  circfill(circle_x,circle_y,spacing+5,0)
  for i=1,revolver_bullets do
    local pos=bullet_positions[i]
    if i<=revolver_current then spr(170,pos.x-2,pos.y-2,1,1) else spr(171,pos.x-2,pos.y-2,1,1) end
  end
  spr(172,center_x-2+shake_x,center_y-3+shake_y,1,1)
end

comment_1: Nice! I like the style, the art and animation is great, but the current map/background makes it harder to see and enjoy that (maybe fewer colors and objects would be good?). I love the dash effect and it's really cool how it gets the fire effect once you get that upgrade. I was wondering what it would be like if the moves could be more controlled. For example, I really like deliberately shooting the gun, but what if you actually and to aim it too? And what if some of the upgrades were a special move you could with X? (maybe dynamite could be one). It would be less automated but I think that would make the game unique compared to others of it's genre. Another instance of how that could be interesting is when I got the mirror-shot upgrade and I was thinking it would be fun to aim the shot once I lined up enemies on either side of me. Thanks for reading my ideas, great job so far!

		if abs(this.spd.x) > maxrun then
	 		this.spd.x=appr(this.spd.x,sign(this.spd.x)*maxrun,deccel)
		else
			this.spd.x=appr(this.spd.x,xinput*maxrun,accel)
		end
		
		--facing direction & footsteps
		if this.spd.x~=0 then
			this.flip.x=(this.spd.x<0)
			
			if on_ground and not on_platform then
				step_timer+=1
				if step_timer>=30 then
					init_object(land_particles,this.x,this.y+4)
					step_timer=0
				end
			end
		else
			step_timer=29
		end

		--gravity
		local maxfall=1
		local gravity=0.075

		if abs(this.spd.y) <= 0.075 then
			gravity*=0.25
		end
		
		if not on_ground then
			this.spd.y=appr(this.spd.y,maxfall,gravity)
		end

		--jump		
		if this.jbuffer>0 then
			if this.grace>0 then
				sfx(63) 
				this.jbuffer=0
				this.grace=0
				this.spd.y=-0.9
				init_object(land_particles,this.x,this.y+4)
			end
		end
	
		--calculate x_prompt position
		posx=this.x+1
		_posy(this)
		
	
		--current segment
		curseg=this.x\128
		start_seg=(curseg-1)*8+1 --start drawing at
		if start_seg<1 then
			start_seg=1
		end
	
		local int = 3
		local c = 162
		if progress < 3 then
			int = progress
			c = 32
		end
		dist=(tar_segs[int]*128+c-this.x)\16

		--animation
		this.spr_off+=0.125

		if not on_ground then
			this.spr=3
		elseif btn(k_down) then
			this.spr=5
		elseif btn(k_up) then
			this.spr=7
		elseif (not btn(k_left) and not btn(k_right)) then
			this.spr=1
		else
			this.spr=1+this.spr_off%4
		end
		
		--was on the ground
		this.was_on_ground=on_ground
		
	end,
	
	draw=function(this)

		spr(this.spr,this.x,this.y,1,1,this.flip.x) --,this.flip.y
		_draw_x_prompt(this)
		
	end
}

function init_object(type,x,y)

	local obj = {}
	obj.type = type
	obj.collideable=true
	obj.solids=true

	obj.spr = type.tile
	obj.flip = {x=false,y=false}

	obj.x = x
	obj.y = y
	obj.hitbox = { x=0,y=0,w=8,h=8 }

	obj.spd = {x=0,y=0}
	obj.rem = {x=0,y=0}

	obj.is_solid=function(ox,oy,flag)
		if oy>0 and not obj.check(platform,ox,0) and obj.check(platform,ox,oy) then
			return true
		end
		return tile_flag_at(obj.x+obj.hitbox.x+ox,obj.y+obj.hitbox.y+oy,obj.hitbox.w,obj.hitbox.h,obj,flag) --solid_at(obj.x+obj.hitbox.x+ox,obj.y+obj.hitbox.y+oy,obj.hitbox.w,obj.hitbox.h,obj)
	end
	
	obj.collide=function(type,ox,oy)
		local other
		for i=1,count(objects) do
			other=objects[i]
			if other ~=nil and other.type == type and other != obj and other.collideable and
				other.x+other.hitbox.x+other.hitbox.w > obj.x+obj.hitbox.x+ox and 
				other.x+other.hitbox.x+other.hitbox.w > obj.x+obj.hitbox.x+ox and 
				other.y+other.hitbox.y+other.hitbox.h > obj.y+obj.hitbox.y+oy and
				other.x+other.hitbox.x < obj.x+obj.hitbox.x+obj.hitbox.w+ox and 
				other.y+other.hitbox.y < obj.y+obj.hitbox.y+obj.hitbox.h+oy then
				return other
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
  
	obj.check=function(type,ox,oy)
		return obj.collide(type,ox,oy) ~=nil
	end

	obj.move=function(ox,oy)
		local amount
	
		-- [x] get move amount
		obj.rem.x += ox
		amount = flr(obj.rem.x + 0.5)
		obj.rem.x -= amount
		obj.move_x(amount,0)
    
		-- [y] get move amount
		obj.rem.y += oy
		amount = flr(obj.rem.y + 0.5)
		obj.rem.y -= amount
		obj.move_y(amount,0)
	end

	obj.move_x=function(amount,start)
		if obj.solids then
			local step = sign(amount)
			for i=start,abs(amount) do
				if not obj.is_solid(step,0) then
					obj.x += step
				else
					obj.spd.x = 0
					obj.rem.x = 0
					break
				end
			end
		else
			obj.x += amount
		end
	end
 
	obj.move_y=function(amount)
		if obj.solids then
			local step = sign(amount)
			for i=0,abs(amount) do
				if not obj.is_solid(0,step) then
					obj.y += step
				else
					obj.spd.y = 0
					obj.rem.y = 0
					break
				end
			end
		else
			obj.y += amount
		end
	end

	add(objects,obj)
		if obj.type.init~=nil then
			obj.type.init(obj)
		end
		return obj
	end

	function destroy_object(obj)
		del(objects,obj)
	end

function appr(val,target,amount)
	return val > target 
		and max(val - amount, target) 
		or min(val + amount, target)
end

function sign(v)
	return v>0 and 1 or
	v<0 and -1 or 0
end

	return rnd(1)<0.5

--tile flag at players position relative to static map segment
function tile_flag_at(x,y,w,h,obj,flag)
	local seg = 1 + flr(y/64) + flr(x/128)*8 --mapseg that player is in

	for i=max(0,flr(x%128/8)),min(15,(x%128+w-1)/8) do
		for j=max(0,flr(y%64/8)),min(7,(y+h-1)%64/8) do
			if fget(tile_at(i,j,obj,seg),flag) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

	local segpos = seglib[world_map[seg]]
	return mget(segpos.mx + i, segpos.my + j)

	local hit=this.collide(player,dx,dy)

 end

description: Up and Away Take to the skies and explore a tiny world from the basket of your hot air balloon. Play as Lucy, a young adventurer on a journey to visit her grandma on a distant island in the clouds. Navigate the wind currents from island to island, meeting colourful locals along the way as you drift towards your destination in this short, relaxing, atmospheric game. How to Play Use the buttons on your hot air balloon to control your altitude Navigate the wind currents from island to island Credits Up and Away was written and designed by Ross McCormick . The music was composed by Ross McCormick . The game is written entirely in Pico-8. Dedicated to my fiancée, Lucy. Changelog 1.0: Initial release 1.1: ​Added checkpoints when landing on new islands, allowing players to save their progress and continue from their last island on a new play session. Fixed a bug where interacting with an NPC just as you moved past them could softlock the dialogue. Fixed a bug where jumping at the same time as talking to an NPC would launch the player into the air indefinitely, softlocking the game.

function _init()

		dset(0, 0) -- set the high score to zero on first play
	else
		highscore = dget(0)
	end
	inertiaon, musicon = true, true
	_update60, _draw, gameover = updatemenu, drawmenu, false

	initgame()
end

function initmenu()

end

function initgame()

function drawgame()

function updatemenu()

	drawsigns()
	rectfill(0, 9, 128, 10, 4)
	spr(224, 9 + logooffset, 6, 9, 2)

	-- highscore

	if menupage == 1 then
		printshadow("\14start", 11, 43, 4)
		printshadow("\14instructions", 11, 51, 4)
		if musicon then

		else
			printshadow("\14music: off", 11, 59, 4)
		end
		if inertiaon then

		else

		if (not gameover and hasreleasebuttons) and (btnp(❎) or btnp(🅾️)) then

	playerspeed, playerhsize, playerbulletspeed, playercasespeed, playerrocketammo, playerrocketreloadcounter, playerfirerate, playerfirecounter, playerbanking, playerhudinertia, playerlives, playerdying, playerdeathcounter, playerinvulnerablecountdown, playervel, playerpos, playerbullets, playercases, playerguns, playerrockets = 1.4, 8, 8, 0.5, 3, 700, 4, -1, false, 0.2, 3, false, 0, 0, v2make(0, 0), v2make(64, 100), {}, {}, {}, {}

			end
		end

		return
	elseif playerinvulnerablecountdown > 0 then

	end

	-- === movement ===

	inputvector = v2make(0, 0)

-- general math utilities

function clamp(value, minimum, maximum)
	value = min(value, maximum)
	value = max(value, minimum)
	return value
end

function lerp(a,b,t) 
	return a+(b-a)*t 
end

function rndrange(low, high)
	return (low + rnd(high - low))
end

-- split a string into sub-strings separated by | and then into arrays
function split2d(text)
	local myarray = split(text, "|")
	for i = 1, #myarray do
		myarray[i] = split(myarray[i], ",")
	end
	return myarray
end


-- 2d vector math
-- assumes vectors are in the form v = { x = 0, y = 0}

-- use this to create a vector 2
function v2make(_x, _y)
	return { x = _x, y = _y }
end

v2zero, v2up, v2down, v2left, v2right = v2make(0, 0), v2make(0, -1), v2make(0, 1), v2make(-1, 0), v2make(1, 0)
-- don't assign variables to be equal to these vectors, that will link them both ways!
-- a = v2zero is the same as v2zero = a
-- only use these for comparison

function v2length(v)
	return sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y)
end

-- a quick way to check length without a square-root
-- function v2squarelength(v)
-- 	return v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y
-- end

-- function v2dot(v1, v2)
-- 	return (v1.x * v2.x + v1.y * v2.y)
-- end

function v2normalize(v)
	return v2scale(v, 1 / v2length(v))
end

function v2scale(v, amount)
	return v2make(v.x * amount, v.y * amount)
end

function v2add(v1, v2)
	return v2make(v1.x + v2.x, v1.y + v2.y)
end

-- subtract v2 from v1
function v2sub(v1, v2)
	return v2make(v1.x - v2.x, v1.y - v2.y)
end

function v2rotate(v, angle)
	local x2 = cos(angle) * v.x - sin(angle) * v.y
	local y2 = sin(angle) * v.x + cos(angle) * v.y
	return {x = x2, y = y2}
end

-- returns a random unit-length vector
function v2randomnormalized()
	local angle = rnd(1) -- pico-8 angles go from 0 to 1 (turns), starting at 3 o'clock going anti-clockwise
	return v2make(cos(angle), sin(angle))
end

-- returns a random unit-length vector between min and max angle.
-- Zero is 3 o'clock, angles increase anti-clockwise, inputs are in degrees
function v2randominrange(min, max)
	if (min > max) min -= 360
	min = min / 360
	max = max / 360
	local randomangle = min + rnd(abs(max - min))
	return v2make(cos(randomangle), sin(randomangle))
end

-- a quick way to check if 2 points are close, returns true if p2 is within p1's bounding box distance
function v2proximity(p1, p2, distance)
	if abs(p1.x - p2.x) > distance then
		return false
	elseif abs(p1.y - p2.y) > distance then
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end

function v2lerp(v1, v2, t)
	return v2make(lerp(v1.x, v2.x, t), lerp(v1.y, v2.y, t))
end

-- simulate a particle
-- requires a particle p = { life = 0, pos = v2zero, vel = v2zero, drag = 1 (no drag), force = v2zero (optional) }
function v2simulate(p)
	if p.force then
		p.vel = v2scale(v2add(p.vel, p.force), p.drag)
	else
		p.vel = v2scale(p.vel, p.drag)
	end
	p.pos = v2add(p.pos, p.vel)
	if (p.life)	p.life += 1
end

-- fast simulation for bullets with no drag, force
function v2simulatefast(p)
	p.pos = v2add(p.pos, p.vel)
	if (p.life)	p.life += 1
end

	for b in all(playerbullets) do

		-- === player bullet collision === --
		for e in all(enemies) do

				local flipx = rnd(1) < 0.5

				newhit.pos.y += 8

				for i=1, 2 do -- 2 sparks per hit
					local newspark = {

						drag = 0.95,
					}
					newspark.pos.y -= rndrange(4, 6)
					add(sparks, newspark)
				end
				del(playerbullets, b)
				if (e.type != 5 or (e.type == 5 and not e.invulnerable)) takedamage(e, 1, 6)
			end
		end
	end

	for c in all(playercases) do
		v2simulate(c)
		if (c.life == 30) del(playercases, c)
	end

	for s in all(sparks) do
		v2simulate(s)
		if (s.life == 15) del(sparks, s)
	end

	for r in all(playerrockets) do
		v2simulate(r)
		-- smoke
		local newsmoke = {
			life = rnd(10),
			pos = v2add(r.pos, v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), rnd(3))),
			vel = v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), 0.1),
			force = v2scale(v2down, rndrange(0.01, 0.04)),
			drag = 0.95,
		}
		newsmoke.pos.y += 10
		add(smoke, newsmoke)

		if (r.pos.y < -10) del(playerrockets, r)
		
		-- rocket collision
		for e in all(enemies) do
			if v2proximity(r.pos, e.pos, e.size + 2) then
				local exp = { pos = v2make(r.pos.x, r.pos.y), life = 0 }
				add(rocketexplosions, exp) -- the explosion will damage enemies
				for i = 0, 5 do -- fire and smoke
					createexplosionfire(r.pos, false)
				end
				for i = 0, 20 do -- sparks
					local newspark = {
						pos = r.pos,
						life = -15,
						vel = v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), 0.5 + rnd(3)),
						drag = 0.95,
					}
					add(sparks, newspark)
				end
				del(playerrockets, r)
			end
		end
	end
	
	for b in all(enemybullets) do
		if v2proximity(b.pos, playerpos, b.size) then -- hit player
			loselife()
			del(enemybullets, b)
		else
			if b.drag then
				v2simulate(b)
			else
				v2simulatefast(b)
			end
			-- cull bullets
			if (b.pos.x > 138 or b.pos.x < -10 or b.pos.y > 138 or b.pos.y < -10) del(enemybullets, b)
		end
	end
end

			-- spawn blobs
			if t % 6 == 0 then
				local newblob = {
					pos = v2make(e.pos.x - 4 + rnd(6),e.pos.y - 3),
					vel = v2make(rndrange(-0.1, 0.1), 0),
					force = v2make(0, -0.005 - rnd(0.02)),
					drag = 0.95,
					life = 0
				}
				add(e.blobs, newblob)
			end

			-- update blobs
			for b in all(e.blobs) do
				v2simulate(b)
				if (b.life > 60) del(e.blobs, b)
			end

			if not e.spawning then
				if e.shottype == 1 then
					shootstream(e)
				elseif e.shottype == 2 then
					shootsshotgun(e)
				end
			end
		elseif etype == 3 then
			-- mosquito
			e.pos = v2lerp(e.pos, e.dest, 0.06)
			e.life += 1
			if e.life == 120 then
				shootsingle(e)
			elseif e.life > 120 then
				if not (playerdying) then
					-- seek player
					local toplayer = v2normalize(v2sub(playerpos, e.pos))
					e.dest = v2add(e.dest, toplayer)
				else
					e.dest.y += 1.5
				end
			end
			if (e.pos.y > 130) del(enemies, e)
		elseif etype == 4 then
			-- self-destruct tank
			e.life += 1
			e.shotcounter -= 1
			if e.life < 200 then
				-- seek destination
				e.pos = v2lerp(e.pos, e.dest, 0.02)
			elseif e.life == 200 then
				setfinaldest(e)
			else
				gyrate(e, 0.2, 0.15, 0.1, 0.01)
			end

			if e.life > 200 and e.life <= 260 then
				shoottankspread(e, false)
			end

			if e.life > 400 and e.life < 460 then
				-- vibrate arms before suicide
				if (t % 20 == 0) e.shotcounter = 10
			elseif e.life >= 460 and e.life < 520 then
				if (t % 10 == 0) e.shotcounter = 5
			elseif e.life >= 520 and e.life < 600 then
				shoottankspread(e, true)
			elseif e.life > 600 then
				takedamage(e, 0, 1)
			end
		elseif etype == 5 then 
			-- boss update
			if e.dying then
				e.life += 1
				if e.life % 30 == 0 then
					spawngiblets(e)
					sfx(6 + flr(rnd(2)))
				end
				if e.life == 181 then
					del(enemies, e)
					spawnscore(e.pos.x - e.size, e.pos.y, e.score, 7)
					victory = true
					endgame()
				end
				return
			end
			
			-- seek destination
			if e.spawning then
				e.pos = v2lerp(e.pos, e.dest, 0.013)
				if (v2proximity(e.pos, e.dest, 1.5)) then
					e.spawning = false
					e.finishedspawningtime = time()
					setfinaldest(e)
				end
			else
				gyrate(e, 0.07, 0.2, 0.05, 0.02)
				if not e.invulnerable then
					shootbosspattern(e)
				else
					e.hitpoints += e.initialhitpoints / 150
					if e.hitpoints >= e.initialhitpoints then
						e.invulnerable = false
						e.hitpoints = e.initialhitpoints
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- set the destination for an enemy to gyrate about
function setfinaldest(e)
	e.gyratestarttime = time()
end

function updateghosts()
	for g in all(ghosts) do
		g.life += 1
		if (g.life > 180) del(ghosts, g)
		if not playerdying then
			local vectortoplayer = v2sub(playerpos, g.pos)
			local speed = 0.03 * max(0, 60 - v2length(vectortoplayer))
			g.pos = v2add(g.pos, v2scale(v2normalize(vectortoplayer), speed))
		end
		if t % 5 == 0 then
			local newghosttrail = {
				pos = v2make(g.pos.x, g.pos.y),
				life = 0,
				vel = v2scale(v2randominrange(250, 290), 0.5),
				force = v2make(0, 0.001),
				drag = 0.98,
			}
			add(ghosttrails, newghosttrail)
		end
		if v2proximity(g.pos, playerpos, 2) and not playerdying then -- hit player
			del(ghosts, g)
			ghostcounter += 1
			spawnscore(g.pos.x - 16, g.pos.y, 50 * ghostcounter, 14)
			sfx(13, 3)
		end
	end
	-- trails
	for t in all(ghosttrails) do
		v2simulate(t)
		if (t.life > 40) del(ghosttrails, t)
	end
end

			else

			end
		elseif e.bonuscountdown > 0 then

		else
			pal(1, 1)
		end

			local tmod16, tailframe = t % 16, 107

				tailframe = 74
			elseif tmod16 < 8 then
				tailframe = 75
			elseif tmod16 < 12 then
				tailframe = 106
			end
			spr(tailframe, xpos - 4, ypos - 20, 1, 2)
		elseif etype == 2 then
			---=== medium enemies ===---
			ypos -= jitter(e)
			spr(56, xpos - 8, ypos - 8, 2, 1) -- head
			local tentaclesprite = 72
			if (e.shotcounter > 0) tentaclesprite = 58
			spr(tentaclesprite, xpos - 8, ypos, 2, 1) -- tentacles
		elseif etype == 3 then
			---=== flappy enemies ===---
			ypos -= jitter(e)
			spr(46, xpos - 8, ypos - 8, 2, 2, e.flipx) 
			-- wings
			local tmod9 = t % 9
			if tmod9 < 3 then
				spr(126, xpos - 17, ypos - 4, 2, 1)
				spr(126, xpos + 1, ypos - 4, 2, 1, true)
			elseif tmod9 < 6 then
				spr(142, xpos - 17, ypos - 4, 2, 1)
				spr(142, xpos + 1, ypos - 4, 2, 1, true)
			end
		elseif etype == 4 then

			if tmod > 9 then

			elseif tmod > 6 then
				pal(5, 12) pal(6, 11) pal(7, 4) pal(8, 13)
			elseif tmod > 3 then
				pal(5, 11) pal(6, 4) pal(7, 13) pal(8, 12)

			end

			local blink = 0

				spr(93, xpos + 10, ypos + 4, 2, 1, true)
			else
				spr(95, xpos - 16, ypos + 7, 1, 2)
				spr(95, xpos + 8, ypos + 7, 1, 2, true)
			end
			-- body
			spr(108, xpos - 16, ypos - 12, 2, 3)
			spr(108, xpos, ypos - 12, 2, 3, true)
			-- eyes
			spr(159 + blink, xpos - 8, ypos + 2)
			spr(175 + blink, xpos + 1, ypos + 3)
			pal(1, 1) pal(5, 5) pal(6, 6) pal(7, 7) pal(8, 8)
		elseif etype == 5 then
			---=== BIG BOSS draw ===---
			ypos -= jitter(e)
			-- tentacle animation
			spriteframe = 0
			if (t % 9 > 2) spriteframe = 1
			if (t % 9 > 5) spriteframe = 2
			spr(128 + spriteframe * 4, xpos, ypos - 20, 4, 6)
			spr(136 - spriteframe * 4, xpos - 32, ypos - 20, 4, 6, true)
			-- boss body
			spr(156, xpos, ypos - 20, 3, 5)
			spr(156, xpos - 24, ypos - 20, 3, 5, true)
			-- health bar
			if not e.dying and not e.spawning then
				rectfill(8, 10, 120, 12, 3)
				local healthbarcolor = 12
				if (e.lifestage == 1) healthbarcolor = 11
				if (e.lifestage == 2) healthbarcolor = 4
				local healthfraction = e.hitpoints / e.initialhitpoints
				rectfill(64 - (56 * healthfraction), 10, 64 + (56 * healthfraction), 12, healthbarcolor) 
			elseif e.dying then
				-- shrinking health bar frame
				if e.life < 56 then
					rectfill(8 + 56 * (e.life / 56), 10, 120 - 56 * (e.life / 56), 12, 3)
				end
			end
			if e.spawning then
				for i = 0, 200, 200 do
					if (t % 30 > 3) printshadow("\14 warning! giant alien approaching!", i - t * 1.2 % 200, 50, 4)
					if (t % 30 == 4) sfx(14)
				end
