function jitter(e)
	if e.hitcounter > 0 then
		return rndrange(1, 3)
	else
		return 0
	end
end

function shootstream(enemy)
	if (playerdying or gameover) return
	local tmod = t % 240
	if tmod > 80 and tmod < 100 or tmod > 140 and tmod < 160 then
		if t % 4 == 0 then
			enemy.shotcounter = 10
			local shotvector = v2scale(v2normalize(v2sub(playerpos, enemy.pos)), 1.5)
			local newbullet = {
				pos = enemy.pos,
				vel = shotvector,
				color = 9,
				size = 2
			}
			add(enemybullets, newbullet)
			sfx(9, 2)
		end
	end
end

function shootsshotgun(enemy)
	if (playerdying or gameover) return
	if t % 240 == 0 then
		enemy.shotcounter = 10
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local shotangle = 0.7
			if (i % 2 == 0) shotangle = 0.8
			local shotvector = v2make(cos(shotangle), sin(shotangle))
			shotvector = v2scale(shotvector, 1.2 + 0.1 * (i \ 2))
			local newbullet = {
				pos = enemy.pos,
				vel = shotvector,
				drag = 0.995,
				color = 8,
				size = 2
			}
			add(enemybullets, newbullet)
		end
		sfx(9, 2)
	end
end

function shoottankspread(enemy, suicideshot)
	if (playerdying or gameover) return
	local shottime = 10
	if t % shottime == 0 then
		if suicideshot then
			shottime = 7
			sfx(11, 2)
		else
			sfx(10, 2)
		end
		enemy.shotcounter = 10
		for i = 0, 6 do
			local shotangle = 1 / 6 * i
			if (suicideshot) shotangle += t / 200 
			local shotvector = v2make(cos(shotangle), sin(shotangle))
			local newbullet = {
				pos = v2make(enemy.pos.x, enemy.pos.y + 8),
				vel = shotvector,
				drag = 1,
				color = 8,
				size = 3
			}
			add(enemybullets, newbullet)
		end
	end
end

function bossbullet(enemy, spacing, count, offset, _size, speed)
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local newbullet = {
			vel = v2make(cos(time() / spacing + i / count + offset) * speed, sin(time() / spacing + i / count + offset) * speed),
			color = 9,
			size = _size
		}
		newbullet.pos = v2add(v2make(enemy.pos.x, enemy.pos.y + 8), v2scale(newbullet.vel, 10))
		add(enemybullets, newbullet)
	end
end

function shootbosspattern(enemy)
	if (playerdying or gameover) return
	if (t % 300 == 0) spawnghost(v2make(enemy.pos.x, enemy.pos.y + 30))

	if enemy.lifestage == 0 then
		-- easy pattern
		if t % 5 == 0 and t % 50 > 30 then -- small bullets
			bossbullet(enemy, 4.5, 6, 0, 2, 0.6)
			bossbullet(enemy, 4.5, 6, 0.01, 2, 0.63)
			bossbullet(enemy, 4.5, 6, 0.02, 2, 0.66)
		end
		if t % 80 == 0 or t % 160 == 10 or t % 160 == 20 then -- aimed shot
			shootsingle(enemy)
		end
	elseif enemy.lifestage == 1 then
		-- middle pattern
		if t % 5 == 0 and t % 100 < 80 then
			bossbullet(enemy, 12, 4, 0, 2, 0.4 + (t % 100) * 0.005)
		end
		if t % 15 == 0 and t % 100 > 10 then
			sfx(10, 2)
			bossbullet(enemy, -10, 4, 0, 2, 0.6)

		end
	else
		-- hard pattern
		if t % 7 == 0 and t % 42 > 13 then -- small bullets
			enemy.shotcounter = 10
			bossbullet(enemy, 15, 5, 0.05, 2, 0.7)
			bossbullet(enemy, 15, 5, -0.05, 2, 0.7)
		end
		if t % 40 == 0 then -- fat bullets
			sfx(10, 2)
			bossbullet(enemy, 15, 5, 0.005, 3, 0.68)
			bossbullet(enemy, 15, 5, -0.005, 3, 0.72)
		end
		if enemy.hitpoints < enemy.initialhitpoints / 2 and (t % 50 == 0) then 
			-- aimed shot after half health gone
			shootsingle(enemy)
		end
	end
end

function shootsingle(enemy)
	if (playerdying or gameover) return
	local bulletsource = v2make(enemy.pos.x, enemy.pos.y)
	bulletcolor = 9
	if enemy.type == 5 then
		bulletsource.y += 12 
		bulletcolor = 10
	end
	local newbullet = {
		pos = bulletsource,
		vel = v2scale(v2normalize(v2sub(playerpos, bulletsource)), 1.5),
		color = bulletcolor,
		size = 2
	}
	add(enemybullets, newbullet)
	sfx(8, 2)
end

function takedamage(e, damage, hitflash)
	e.hitpoints -= damage
	if (damage == 0 and e.type != 5) e.hitpoints = 0 -- special case when colliding with player
	if e.hitpoints <= 0 then
		if e.type == 1 then
			sfx(5, 3)
		else
			sfx(6 + flr(rnd(2)))
		end

		if (e.bonuscountdown > 0) then
			spawnghost(e.pos)
		end

		if e.type == 5 then
			e.invulnerable = true
			if e.lifestage < 2 then
				e.lifestage += 1
				spawngiblets(e)
			else
				e.dying = true
				e.hitcounter = 0
			end
		else
			spawnscore(e.pos.x - e.size, e.pos.y, e.score, 7)

			-- giblets
			spawngiblets(e)
			del(enemies, e)
		end
	else
		e.hitcounter = hitflash
	end
end

function spawnghost(_pos)
	local newghost = {
		pos = _pos,
		life = 0
	}
	add(ghosts, newghost)
end

function spawnscore(posx, posy, _score, _color)
	score += _score>>>16
	local newpoints = {
		x = posx,
		y = posy,
		value = _score,
		color = _color,
		life = 0
	}
	add(deathpoints, newpoints)
end

function spawngiblets(e)
	local gibcount, etype = e.type * 3, e.type
	if (etype == 3) gibcount = 6 
	if (etype == 4) gibcount = 16
	if (etype == 5) gibcount = 30
	for i = 1, gibcount do
		local newgib = {
			pos = v2add(e.pos, v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), rndrange(2, 5))),
			vel = v2scale(v2randominrange(40, 120), rndrange(1, 4)),
			drag = 0.95,
			force = v2make(rndrange(-0.01, 0.01), 0.03),
			life = rndrange(-10, 10),
			sprite = flr(rndrange(76, 80))
		}
		if etype == 4 or etype == 5 then	-- add eyeball gibs to crab enemy
			if i == gibcount - 1 then
				newgib.sprite = 106
				newgib.life = -20
			elseif i == gibcount then
				newgib.sprite = 122
				newgib.life = -20
			end
		end
		newgib.flipx = newgib.vel.x > 0
		add(gibs, newgib)
	end
	-- green splat
	local newsplat = {
		pos = v2make(e.pos.x, e.pos.y), -- need to copy the values, not just pass the e.pos table
		life = 0,
		size = e.type * 2
	}
	if (etype == 3) newsplat.size = 4 
	add(enemysplats, newsplat)
end

function spawnpopcornenemies(bonus, count, startx, starty, startangle, _veer)
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local newenemy = {}
		do
			local _ENV = newenemy
			type, bonuscountdown, hitpoints, hitcounter, size, score, pos, veer = 1, bonus, 2, 0, 5, 10, { x = startx, y = starty}, _veer
		end
		newenemy.life = i * -16
		newenemy.vel = v2scale({ x = cos(startangle), y = sin(startangle) }, 1.2)
		newenemy.pos = v2add(newenemy.pos, v2scale(newenemy.vel, -16 * i))
		add(enemies, newenemy)
	end
end

function spawnflappyenemies(bonus, startx, count)

		do
			local _ENV = newenemy
			type, bonuscountdown, facing, hitcounter, blobs, spawning, hitpoints, size, life, score = 3, bonus, _facing, 0, {}, false, 8, 8, 0 - i * 10, 30
		end
		newenemy.pos, newenemy.dest, newenemy.flipx = v2make(64, -30), v2make(startx + rndrange(-15, 15), 55 - i * 12), rnd(1) < 0.5
		add(enemies, newenemy)
	end

function spawnmediumenemies(bonus, startx, destx, desty, count)
	local mediumenemycount = 0
	for e in all(enemies) do
		if (e.type == 2) mediumenemycount += 1
	end
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		if mediumenemycount < 15 then
			local _shottype = 1
			if (rnd(1) < 0.5) _shottype = 2
			local newenemy = {}
			newenemy.dest, newenemy.pos, newenemy.randomoffset = v2make(destx, desty), v2make(startx, -20), 0.1 * i
			do
				local _ENV = newenemy
				type, bonuscountdown, hitcounter, shotcounter, shottype, blobs, hitpoints, spawning, size, score = 2, bonus, 0, 0, _shottype, {}, 15, true, 8, 50
			end
			
			if i > 0 then
				newenemy.pos = v2add(newenemy.pos, v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), 10))
				newenemy.dest = v2add(newenemy.dest, v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), 20))
				newenemy.dest = v2make(clamp(newenemy.dest.x, 20, 108), clamp(newenemy.dest.y, 20, 80))
			end
			add(enemies, newenemy)
			mediumenemycount += 1
		end
	end
end

function spawntankenemy(bonus, _destx, _desty)
	local newenemy = {}
	do
		local _ENV = newenemy
		type, bonuscountdown, hitpoints, hitcounter, size, shotcounter, life, score = 4, bonus, 250, 0, 12, 0, 0, 400
	end
	newenemy.randomoffset, newenemy.pos, newenemy.dest = rnd(1), v2make(64, -30), v2make(_destx, _desty)
		
	add(enemies, newenemy)

function spawnbossenemy()
	local newenemy = {}
	do
		local _ENV = newenemy
		type, bonuscountdown, initialhitpoints, hitpoints, hitcounter, size, shotcounter, life, score, lifestage,  invulnerable, spawning, dying, randomoffset = 5, 0, 600, 0, 0, 22, 0, 0, 500, 0, true, true, false, 0
	end
	newenemy.pos, newenemy.dest = v2make(64, -40), v2make(64, 30)
	add(enemies, newenemy)
end

-- move on a sine/cosine pattern
function gyrate(e, xspeed, xscale, yspeed, yscale)
	e.pos.x += cos(e.randomoffset + (time() - e.gyratestarttime) * xspeed) * xscale
	e.pos.y -= sin(e.randomoffset + (time() - e.gyratestarttime) * yspeed) * yscale
end

function runschedule()
	if scindex <= #schedule and time() - starttime + debugtime > schedule[scindex][1] then
		if schedule[scindex][2] == 1 then
			spawnpopcornenemies(schedule[scindex][3], schedule[scindex][4], schedule[scindex][5], schedule[scindex][6], schedule[scindex][7], schedule[scindex][8])
		elseif schedule[scindex][2] == 2 then
			spawnflappyenemies(schedule[scindex][3], schedule[scindex][4], schedule[scindex][5])
		elseif schedule[scindex][2] == 3 then
			spawnmediumenemies(schedule[scindex][3], schedule[scindex][4], schedule[scindex][5], schedule[scindex][6], schedule[scindex][7])
		elseif schedule[scindex][2] == 4 then
			spawntankenemy(schedule[scindex][3], schedule[scindex][4], schedule[scindex][5], schedule[scindex][6], schedule[scindex][7])
		else
			spawnbossenemy()
		end
		scindex += 1
	end
end

		if (p.life > 40) del(deathpoints, p)
		p.life += 1
	end
end

function printshadow(text, x, y, textcolor)
	print(text, x + 1, y, 3)
	print(text, x, y, textcolor)
end

function initvfx()
	smokefills, firefills, smoke, fires, wind, rocketexplosions, explosionfire, gibs, bigtrails, enemysplats, ghosttrails, hudsize, hudspeed, hudcolor = split("0b1010111110101111.1, 0b1011111110101111.1, 0b1011111111101111.1, 0b1011111111111111.1"), split("0b1111010111110101.1,	0b1111010111111101.1, 0b1111011111111101.1,	0b1111011111111111.1"), {}, {}, v2make(0, 0), {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, 12, 0.5, 180
end

function updatevfx()
	wind.x = sin(time() / 20) / 15
	wind.y = cos(time() / 25) / 20

	for s in all(smoke) do
		v2simulate(s)
		s.force = v2add(s.force, v2scale(v2randomnormalized(), 0.004)) -- turbulence
		s.vel = v2add(s.vel, wind) -- add wind
		if (s.life > 50) del(smoke, s)
	end

	for f in all(fires) do
		v2simulate(f)
		f.vel = v2add(f.vel, wind) -- add wind
		if (f.life > 90) del(fires, f)
	end

	for f in all(explosionfire) do
		v2simulate(f)
		if (f.life > 55) del(explosionfire, f)
	end

	for exp in all(rocketexplosions) do
		if exp.life == 0 and not exp.forplayerdeath then -- look for nearby enemies to damage
			-- damage nearby enemies
			for e in all(enemies) do
				if e.pos.y > 0 and v2proximity(exp.pos, e.pos, 30) then
					if (e.type != 5 or (e.type == 5 and not e.invulnerable)) takedamage(e, 20, 25)
				end
			end
		end
		exp.life += 1
		if (exp.life > 40) del(rocketexplosions, exp)
	end

	for g in all(gibs) do
		v2simulate(g)
		if t % 5 == 0 then
			local newgibtrail = {
				pos = g.pos,
				life = rndrange(-5, 0),
			}
			add(gibtrails, newgibtrail)
		end
		if (g.life > 40) del(gibs, g)
	end

	for gt in all(gibtrails) do
		gt.life += 1
		gt.pos.y += 0.3
		if (gt.life > 20) del(gibtrails, gt)
	end

	for splat in all(enemysplats) do
		splat.life += 1
		if (splat.life > 10) then
			del(enemysplats, splat)
		else
			splat.pos.y -= 4
		end
	end
end

function drawuppervfx() -- visual effects that draw above the enemies
	-- rocket trails
	local smokesize = 6
	for s in all(smoke) do
		if s.life < 10 then 
			fillp(smokefills[1])
		elseif s.life < 20 then
			fillp(smokefills[2])
			smokesize = 5
		elseif s.life < 30 then
			fillp(smokefills[3])
			smokesize = 4
		else
			fillp(smokefills[4])
			smokesize = 3
		end
		circfill(s.pos.x, s.pos.y, smokesize, 15)
	end
	
	-- gibtrails & gibs
	fillp()
	for gt in all(gibtrails) do
		local gibsize, gibcolor = 3, 11
		if (gt.life > 15) then
		 	gibcolor = 13 gibsize = 2
		elseif (gt.life > 15) then
			gibcolor = 12 gibsize = 2
		elseif (gt.life > 5) then
			gibsize = 2
		end
		circfill(gt.pos.x, gt.pos.y, gibsize, gibcolor)
	end

	for g in all(gibs) do
		spr(g.sprite, g.pos.x - 4, g.pos.y - 4, 1, 1, g.flipx)
	end
	
	

	-- explosions
	fillp()
	for exp in all(rocketexplosions) do
		local flashcolor = 7
		if exp.life < 8 then
			if (exp.life > 4) flashcolor = 15
			circfill(exp.pos.x, exp.pos.y, 20 - exp.life * 2, flashcolor) -- flash
			oval(exp.pos.x - exp.life * 5, exp.pos.y - exp.life * 3, exp.pos.x + exp.life * 5, exp.pos.y + exp.life * 3, 7)
		end
	end

	for f in all(explosionfire) do
		if f.life < 5 then
			spr(12, f.pos.x - 8, f.pos.y - 8, 2, 2, f.flipx, f.flipy)
		elseif f.life < 15 then
			spr(14, f.pos.x - 8, f.pos.y - 8, 2, 2, f.flipx, f.flipy)
		elseif f.life < 25 then
			spr(44, f.pos.x - 8, f.pos.y - 8, 2, 2, f.flipx, f.flipy)
		elseif f.life < 35 then
			fillp(0b1010111110101111.1)
			circfill(f.pos.x, f.pos.y, 6, 5)
			fillp()
		else
			fillp(0b1010111110101111.1)
			circfill(f.pos.x, f.pos.y, 6, 2)
			fillp()
		end
	end

	-- enemy splats
	for es in all(enemysplats) do
		local splatcolor = 4
		if (rnd(1) < 0.5) splatcolor = 11
		local splatsize = min(rndrange(es.size * 4, es.size * 6), 15)
		if (es.life > 7) fillp(░)
		circfill(es.pos.x + rndrange(-3, 3), es.pos.y + rndrange(-3, 3), splatsize, splatcolor)
	end
	fillp()
end

		end

	end
end

description: How To Play Z - Shoot X - Rockets Arrow keys - Move Some enemies have a blue outline - when they die, collect their ghost for a large score bonus. Each ghost is worth 50 points times the number of ghosts collected so far - so the key to a high score is to not miss any of the ghosts. After you've used your rockets 3 times, they take 10 seconds to reload. Save your rockets for difficult situations or blue enemies. Inertia is on by default, which makes the player's helicopter move smoothly. If you prefer more responsive controls without acceleration and deceleration you can turn inertia off. With inertia on changing direction takes a small amount of time, the player's movement flows more like a real helicopter. Inertia off feels like a traditional arcade shmup, where you can change direction or stop instantly. Inertia off is also slightly easier. Choose whichever mode you enjoy more. --line of sight calc
function los(x1,y1,x2,y2)
 local frst,sx,sy,dx,dy=true
 
 if dist(x1,y1,x2,y2)==1 then 
 	return true 
 end
 
 if y1>y2 then
  x1,x2,y1,y2=x2,x1,y2,y1
 end
 sy,dy=1,y2-y1

 if x1<x2 then
  sx,dx=1,x2-x1
 else
  sx,dx=-1,x1-x2
 end
 
 local err,e2=dx-dy
 
 while not(x1==x2 and y1==y2) do
  if not frst and iswalkable(x1,y1,"sight")==false then return false end
  e2,frst=err+err,false
  if e2>-dy then
   err-=dy
   x1+=sx
  end
  if e2<dx then
   err+=dx
   y1+=sy
  end
 end
 return true 
end

function calcdist(tx,ty)
 local cand,candnew,step={},{},0
 distmap=blankmap(-1)
 add(cand,{x=tx,y=ty})
 distmap[tx][ty]=0
 repeat
  step+=1
  candnew={}
  for c in all(cand) do
   for d=1,4 do
    local dx=c.x+dirx[d]
    local dy=c.y+diry[d]
    if inbounds(dx,dy) and distmap[dx][dy]==-1 then
     distmap[dx][dy]=step
     if iswalkable(dx,dy) then
      add(candnew,{x=dx,y=dy})
     end
    end
   end
  end
  cand=candnew
 until #cand==0
end

function digworm(x,y)
 local dr,stp=1+flr(rnd(4)),0
 
 repeat
  mset(x,y,1)
  if not cancarve(x+dirx[dr],y+diry[dr],false) or (rnd()<0.5 and stp>2) then
   stp=0
   local cand={}
   for i=1,4 do
    if cancarve(x+dirx[i],y+diry[i],false) then
     add(cand,i)
    end
   end
   if #cand==0 then
    dr=8
   else
    dr=getrnd(cand)
   end
  end
  x+=dirx[dr]
  y+=diry[dr]
  stp+=1
 until dr==8 
end

function cancarve(x,y,walk)
	if not inbounds(x,y) then 
		return false 
	end
 local walk= walk==nil and iswalkable(x,y) or walk
  if iswalkable(x,y)==walk then
  return sigarray(getsig(x,y),crv_sig,crv_msk)!=0
 end
 return false
end

function bcomp(sig,match,mask)
 local mask=mask and mask or 0
 return bor(sig,mask)==bor(match,mask)
end

function getsig(x,y)
 local sig,digit=0
 for i=1,8 do
  local dx,dy=x+dirx[i],y+diry[i]
  if iswalkable(dx,dy) then
   digit=0
  else
   digit=1
  end
  sig=bor(sig,shl(digit,8-i))
 end
 return sig
end

function sigarray(sig,arr,marr)
 for i=1,#arr do
  if bcomp(sig,arr[i],marr[i]) then 
   return i
  end
 end
 return 0
end

 flags[_x][_y]=flg
 repeat

    local dx,dy=c.x+dirx[d],c.y+diry[d]

     flags[dx][dy]=flg
     add(candnew,{x=dx,y=dy})
    end
   end
  end
  cand=candnew
 until #cand==0
end

 repeat
  drs={}
  for _x=0,15 do
   for _y=0,15 do
    if not iswalkable(_x,_y) then
     local sig=getsig(_x,_y)
     found=false
     if bcomp(sig,0b11000000,0b00001111) then
      x1,y1,x2,y2,found=_x,_y-1,_x,_y+1,true
     elseif bcomp(sig,0b00110000,0b00001111) then
      x1,y1,x2,y2,found=_x+1,_y,_x-1,_y,true
     end
     _f1=flags[x1][y1]
     _f2=flags[x2][y2]
     if found and _f1!=_f2 then
      add(drs,{x=_x,y=_y,f1=_f1,f2=_f2})
     end
    end
   end
  end
  
  if #drs>0 then
   local d=getrnd(drs)
   add(doors,d)
   mset(d.x,d.y,1)
   growflag(d.x,d.y,d.f1)
   del(flaglib,d.f2)  
  end
 until #drs==0

description: Ruby Eyes A game about becoming beautiful. You are but a wee skeleton residing in the Necromancer's Tower . You realize that your skull would be so much prettier if you had some rubies where your eyes would be. Rumor has it that the necromancer holds some very impressive gems. Maybe you should go take a look? ————————————————————————————————————————— Controls ⬆️⬇️⬅️➡️ - Movement ❎or X - Menu/Select 🅾️or Z - Back How to Play Move north at the beginning of the game to play a tutorial. There is no button to wait a turn, try bumping into a door or item to delay your movement. You won't succeed on your first try. Learn from your previous attempts to reach the Necromancer! v1.2 — 1/22/24 Improved item drop interactions with background elements Stats stay in line when above 10 Damage text no longer goes off the top of the screen Fixed healing from cultist damage Necromancer no longer summons bones after being defeated Removed gaps on 3-way doors Weakened Golem Soul Strengthened Cultist Soul Rebalanced monster HP and damage Made souls slightly rarer Reduced value of Marrow Quality, Bone Density, and Calcium Intake Boss Room contains less milk Reduced Vase spawn rate Golem now has little arms Final room is more impressive Improved color fading Updated some sprites v1.1 — 1/20/24 Increased value of Marrow Quality The on-death damage of Cultists is now reduced by Bone Density Improved likelihood of getting something useful from a Vase Reduced Milk availability in the early game Reduced max hp of Scorpion, Flies, and Golem Reduced damage of Ghost, Ogre, and Spider Reduced vision of Ghost and Pumpkinhead Removed Max HP component of the Goblin's Soul Swapped Goblin and Scorpion Souls Doors should no longer spawn next to each other Room generation tweaked HP can no longer drop below 0 Updated level palettes

function map_animate(num)
  local ani_tile, ani_no_frames, ani_cur_frame, ani_time, ani_count = unpack(map_animator[num])
  if ani_count == ani_time then
    ani_count = 0
    local t = (ani_tile \ 16) * 512 + (ani_tile - (ani_tile \ 16) * 16) * 4
    local c = t + 4 * ani_cur_frame
    for i = 0, 7 do
      memcpy(t + (i * 64), c + (i * 64), 4)
    end
    ani_cur_frame += 1
    if ani_cur_frame > ani_no_frames then
      ani_cur_frame = 1
    end
  end
  ani_count += 1
  map_animator[num] = {
    ani_tile, ani_no_frames, ani_cur_frame, ani_time, ani_count
  }
end
function update_camera()
  local hx, hy = p.x, p.y

  if p.path_travel then
    if #p.travel_pts > 0 then
      local ln = p.travel_pts[#p.travel_pts]
      hx, hy = ln.x, ln.y
    end
  elseif ear_active then
    if p.is_zipping then
      hx, hy = p.x, p.y
    else
      local ln = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes]
      hx = p.x + ln.dx
      hy = p.y + ln.dy
    end
  end
  local room_x = flr(hx / (room_w * tile_size))
  local room_y = flr(hy / (room_h * tile_size))
  cam_tx = room_x * room_w
  cam_ty = room_y * room_h
  local target_cx = cam_tx * tile_size
  local target_cy = cam_ty * tile_size

    cam_x += (target_cx - cam_x) * 0.25
    cam_y += (target_cy - cam_y) * 0.25
  else
    cam_x = target_cx
    cam_y = target_cy
  end
end

function spr_out(s, x, y, fx, fy, w, h)
  w = w or 1
  h = h or 1
  for i = 1, 15 do
    pal(i, 0)
  end
  spr(s, x - 1, y, w, h, fx, fy)
  spr(s, x + 1, y, w, h, fx, fy)
  spr(s, x, y - 1, w, h, fx, fy)
  spr(s, x, y + 1, w, h, fx, fy)

  spr(s, x, y, w, h, fx, fy)
end
function tile_at(wx, wy)
  return mget(flr(wx / tile_size), flr(wy / tile_size))
end
function is_solid(wx, wy)
  return fget(tile_at(wx, wy), wall_flag)
end
function is_platform(wx, wy)
  return tile_at(wx, wy) == 37
end
function is_solid_for_body(wx, wy)
  local tx, ty = flr(wx / 8), flr(wy / 8)
  if tx < 0 or tx >= 128 or ty < 0 or ty >= 64 then return true end
  if fget(mget(tx, ty), 0) then return true end
  local oc = #objs
  for i = 1, oc do
    local o = objs[i]
    if o.kind == "ninjin_wide" then
      if wx >= o.x and wx < o.x + o.w and wy >= o.y and wy < o.y + o.h then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
function overlaps_wall(x, y, w, h)
  w = w or tile_size
  h = h or tile_size
  return is_solid_for_body(x, y)
      or is_solid_for_body(x + w - 1, y)
      or is_solid_for_body(x, y + h - 1)
      or is_solid_for_body(x + w - 1, y + h - 1)
end
function overlaps_platform(x, y, w, h)
  w = w or tile_size
  h = h or tile_size
  local by = y + h - 1
  return is_platform(x, by)
      or is_platform(x + w - 1, by)
      or is_platform(x + w / 2, by)
end

function update_particles()
  local cols = { 0, 5, 13, 6, 13, 5, 0 }
  for p in all(particles) do
    p.x += sin(time() * 0.2 + p.offset) * p.sp
    p.y += cos(time() * 0.15 + p.offset) * (p.sp * 0.5)
    p.x -= 0.005

    p.y %= 128

  end

function resolve_obj_vs_tiles(o, check_platform)
  o.x += o.vx
  if overlaps_wall(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) then
    local sign = (o.vx > 0) and 1 or -1
    while overlaps_wall(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) do
      o.x -= sign
    end
    o.vx = 0
    o.x = flr((o.x + 4) / 8) * 8
  end
  local falling = o.vy > 0
  o.y += o.vy
  if check_platform and falling and overlaps_platform(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) then
    while overlaps_platform(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) do
      o.y -= 1
    end
    o.vy = 0
    o.y = flr((o.y + 4) / 8) * 8
  end
  if overlaps_wall(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) then
    local sign = (o.vy > 0) and 1 or -1
    while overlaps_wall(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h) do
      o.y -= sign
    end
    o.vy = 0
    o.y = flr((o.y + 4) / 8) * 8
  end

            local ok = (k == "pull_ceil" and p.cur_dy == -1) or (k == "pull_r" and p.cur_dx == 1) or (k == "pull_l" and p.cur_dx == -1) or (k == "pull_b" and p.cur_dy == 1)
            if not ok then wh = false end
          end
        end
        if wh then
          if tile_at(tip_x + 4, tip_y + 4) == 74 then
            p_die()
            return
          end
          local hitting_wall = wh_orig
          if hitting_wall and p.ear < effective_ear_max then
            if p.zip_dx == 0 and p.zip_dy == 0 then
              if p.cur_dy == -1 then
                p.zip_dx, p.zip_dy = 0, 1
                sfx(16)
                start_hit(4, 2, 1)
              end
            end
            if p.zip_dx != 0 or p.zip_dy != 0 then
              local bt = mget(flr((p.x + 4) / 8), flr((p.y + 4) / 8))
              local b = push_bend[bt]
              local es, efx = nil, false
              if b then
                local res = b[p.zip_dx + p.zip_dy * 3]
                if res then
                  p.zip_dx, p.zip_dy = res[1], res[2]
                  es, efx = res[3], res[4]
                  sfx(16)
                  start_hit(2, 2, 1)
                end
              end
              if not es then
                es = (p.zip_dx != 0) and 7 or 1
              end
              local hit_obj, o = overlaps_obj_any(p.x + p.zip_dx * 8, p.y + p.zip_dy * 8, tile_size, tile_size)
              if hit_obj and o.kind == "ninjin_tall" then
                p.y = stomp_ninjin_tall(o)
                p.ear_locked = true
                p.ear_hit_wall = wh_orig
                p.zip_dx, p.zip_dy = 0, 0
                return
              end
              if not overlaps_wall(p.x + p.zip_dx * 8, p.y + p.zip_dy * 8, tile_size, tile_size) then
                p.x += p.zip_dx * 8
                p.y += p.zip_dy * 8
                p.vy = 0
                p.is_zipping = true
                for n in all(p.ear_nodes) do
                  n.dx -= p.zip_dx * 8
                  n.dy -= p.zip_dy * 8
                end
                add(p.ear_nodes, { dx = -p.zip_dx * 8, dy = -p.zip_dy * 8, s = es, fx = efx, cdx = -p.zip_dx, cdy = -p.zip_dy }, 1)
                p.ear += 1
                return
              else
                p.zip_dx, p.zip_dy = 0, 0
              end
            end
          end
          p.ear_locked = true
          p.ear_hit_wall = wh_orig
        else
          local bt = mget(flr((tip_x + 4) / 8), flr((tip_y + 4) / 8))
          local es = (p.cur_dx != 0) and 7 or 1
          local efx = false
          local bend = bend_map[bt]
          if bend then
            local res = bend[p.cur_dx + p.cur_dy * 3]
            if res then
              p.cur_dx, p.cur_dy, es, efx = res[1], res[2], res[3], res[4]
              sfx(16)
              start_hit(1, 1, 0.5)
            end
          end
          add(p.ear_nodes, { dx = tip_dx, dy = tip_dy, s = es, fx = efx, cdx = p.cur_dx, cdy = p.cur_dy })
          p.ear = next_len
          local kind, tx, ty = special_tile_at(tip_x + 4, tip_y + 4)
          if kind then
            local ok = (kind == "hook") or (kind == "pull") or (kind == "pull_ceil" and p.cur_dy == -1) or (kind == "pull_r" and p.cur_dx == 1) or (kind == "pull_l" and p.cur_dx == -1) or (kind == "pull_b" and p.cur_dy == 1)
            if ok then
              p.ear_locked = true
              p.ear_flag = kind
              p.ear_tip_tx, p.ear_tip_ty = tx, ty
              start_hit(6, 2, 1)
              sfx(8)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  else
    if p.ear > 0 then
      p.ear_retracting = true
      if not p.was_retracting then
        sfx(21)
        p.was_retracting = true
      end
    end
    if p.ear == 0 then
      p.was_retracting = false
      p.ear_retracting = false
    end
    if p.ear_locked and p.ear_flag then
      trigger_ear_action(p.ear_flag, p.ear_tip_tx, p.ear_tip_ty)
      p.ear_flag = nil
      p.ear_locked = false
    end
    if #p.ear_nodes > 0 then
      del(p.ear_nodes, p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes])
      p.ear = #p.ear_nodes
      if p.ear > 0 then
        local ln = p.ear_nodes[p.ear]
        p.cur_dx, p.cur_dy = ln.cdx, ln.cdy
      else
        p.cur_dx, p.cur_dy = 0, -1
      end
    else
      if p.has_key then
      end
    end
    p.ear_locked, p.ear_flag, p.ear_hit_wall = false, nil, false
    p.zip_dx, p.zip_dy = 0, 0
  end
end
function trigger_ear_action(flag, tx, ty)
  if flag == "switch" then
    mset(tx, ty, 0)
    toggle_door_linked_to(tx, ty)
  elseif flag == "stem" then
    mset(tx, ty, 0)
    if ty > 0 then
      mset(tx, ty - 1, 38)
    end
    spawn_ninjin_tall(tx, ty)
    spawn_fx(tx * tile_size, ty * tile_size, fx_pull_frames, fx_frame_ticks)
    sfx(3)
    sfx(5)
    sfx(7)
    start_hit(16, 4, 1)
  elseif flag == "pull_ceil" then
    if p.cur_dy == -1 then
      trigger_wall_pull(tx, ty, 0, -1, 1, 0, 52, 51)
    end
  elseif flag == "pull_r" then
    if p.cur_dx == 1 then
      trigger_wall_pull(tx, ty, 1, 0, 0, 1, 51, 32)
    end
  elseif flag == "pull_l" then
    if p.cur_dx == -1 then
      trigger_wall_pull(tx, ty, -1, 0, 0, 1, 52, 33)
    end
  elseif flag == "pull_b" then
    if p.cur_dy == 1 then
      trigger_wall_pull(tx, ty, 0, 1, 1, 0, 33, 32)
    end
  elseif flag == "pull" then
    p.path_travel = true
    p.travel_pts = {}
    for n in all(p.ear_nodes) do
      add(p.travel_pts, { x = p.x + n.dx, y = p.y + n.dy, s = n.s, fx = n.fx })
    end
    p.ear_nodes = {}
    p.ear = #p.travel_pts
    sfx(8)
  end
end
function toggle_door_linked_to(switch_tx, switch_ty)
  for ty = 0, 63 do
    for tx = 0, 127 do
      if mget(tx, ty) == 9 then
        mset(tx, ty, 8)
        return
      end
    end
  end
end
function trigger_wall_pull(tx, ty, ox, oy, sx, sy, c1, c2)
  mset(tx, ty, 0)
  for i = -1, 1 do
    local wx, wy = tx + ox + i * sx, ty + oy + i * sy
    mset(wx, wy, 0)
    spawn_fx(wx * 8, wy * 8, fx_break_frames, fx_frame_ticks)
  end
  mset(tx + ox - 2 * sx, ty + oy - 2 * sy, c1)
  mset(tx + ox + 2 * sx, ty + oy + 2 * sy, c2)
  sfx(6)
  sfx(7)
  start_hit(16, 4, 3)
end
function update_path_travel()
  if #p.travel_pts == 0 then
    p.path_travel = false
    p.ear = 0
    p.ear_nodes = {}
    p.cur_dx, p.cur_dy = 0, -1
    p.vx = 0
    p.vy = 0
    return
  end
  if (p.game_timer % 3 == 0) sfx(26)
  local target = p.travel_pts[1]
  local dx = target.x - p.x
  local dy = target.y - p.y
  local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
  local speed = mid(2, p.ear * 0.5, 8)
  if dist <= speed then
    p.x, p.y = target.x, target.y
    del(p.travel_pts, target)
    p.ear = #p.travel_pts
  else
    p.x += (dx / dist) * speed
    p.y += (dy / dist) * speed
  end
end
function move_player()
  calculate_ear_aabb()
  p.x += p.vx
  local hit, o = overlaps_obj_any(p.x, p.y, tile_size, tile_size)
  if hit then
    if o.kind == "key" and not o.captured and not p.has_key then
      p.has_key = true
      p.held_key = o
      p.key_x, p.key_y = o.x, o.y
      o.captured = true
      sfx(19)
      start_hit(8, 4, 1)
    elseif o.kind == "ear_upgrade" then
      p.can_extend = true
      del(objs, o)
      sfx(22)
      start_hit(15, 5, 2)
    elseif o.kind == "carrot" then
      p.carrots += 1
      del(objs, o)
      sfx(4)
      start_hit(8, 4, 1)
    end
  end
  if p.has_key then
    local side_x = p.x + (p.dir == 1 and 8 or -1)
    if try_unlock_door(side_x, p.y)
        or try_unlock_door(side_x, p.y + 7) then
    end
  end
  local ct = tile_at(p.x + 4, p.y + 4)
  if ct == 74 then
    p_die()
  elseif ct == 90 then
    p.spawn_x = flr(p.x / 8) * 8
    p.spawn_y = flr(p.y / 8) * 8
  elseif ct == 105 then
    sfx(13)
    mset(flr((p.x + 4) / 8), flr((p.y + 4) / 8), 0)
  elseif ct == 108 then
    sfx(15)
    mset(flr((p.x + 4) / 8), flr((p.y + 4) / 8), 0)
    p.timer_running = false
  end
  local hit_any, hit_o = overlaps_solid_any(p.x, p.y, tile_size, tile_size - 1)
  if hit_any or ear_overlaps_wall_x(p.x) then
    local sign = (p.vx > 0) and 1 or (p.vx < 0 and -1 or 0)
    if sign == 0 then
      if (overlaps_solid_any(p.x + 1, p.y, tile_size, tile_size - 1) or ear_overlaps_wall_x(p.x + 1)) then
        sign = 1
      else
        sign = -1
      end
    end
    local safety = 0
    while (overlaps_solid_any(p.x, p.y, tile_size, tile_size - 1) or ear_overlaps_wall_x(p.x)) and safety < 16 do
      safety += 1
      p.x -= sign
    end
    p.vx = 0
    p.x = flr((p.x + 4) / 8) * 8
  end
  local falling = p.vy > 0
  local prev_y = p.y
  p.y += p.vy
  if falling then
    for o in all(objs) do
      if stomp_obj_if_possible(o, prev_y, p.y) then
        p.on_ground = false
        return
      end
    end
  end
  local hit_wall = overlaps_wall(p.x, p.y) or (p.vy < 0 and ear_overlaps_wall_at(p.x, p.y))
  local hit_platform = falling and overlaps_platform(p.x, p.y) and not overlaps_platform(p.x, prev_y)
  if hit_wall or hit_platform then
    local sign = (p.vy > 0) and 1 or -1
    if hit_platform then
      while overlaps_platform(p.x, p.y) do
        p.y -= 1
      end
    else
      if sign == -1 then
        while overlaps_solid_any(p.x, p.y, tile_size, tile_size) or ear_overlaps_wall_at(p.x, p.y) do
          p.y -= sign
        end
      else
        while overlaps_solid_any(p.x, p.y, tile_size, tile_size) do
          p.y -= sign
        end
      end
    end
    if p.vy > 0 then p.on_ground = true end
    p.vy = 0
    p.y = flr((p.y + 4) / 8) * 8
  else
    p.on_ground = false
  end
  if p.vy >= 0 then
    if overlaps_wall(p.x, p.y + 1) or overlaps_platform(p.x, p.y + 1) then
      p.on_ground = true
    end
  end
end
function _init()
  music(0)
  menuitem(1, "checkpoint", p_die)
  map_animator = { { 24, 3, 1, 6, 0 } }
  init_player()
  init_objects_from_map()
  init_particles()
  update_camera()
  cam_x = cam_tx * tile_size
  cam_y = cam_ty * tile_size
  p.is_dead = true
  p.death_t = 40
end
function _update()
  local btn4 = btn(4) and not p.ear_retracting
  if update_msg() then return end
  update_death()
  if p.is_dead and p.death_t < 35 then
    return
  end
  update_hit()
  update_particles()
  if hitstop_t > 0 then
    update_camera()
    return
  end
  if not p.is_dead and p.timer_running then
    p.game_timer += 1
    if p.game_timer > 18000 then
      p.game_timer -= 18000
      p.game_sec_offset += 600
    end
  end
  if p.path_travel then
    update_objs()
    update_fx()
    update_burst_particles()
    update_path_travel()
    update_camera()
    return
  end
  update_objs()
  update_fx()
  update_burst_particles()
  local gravity_suspended = p.is_zipping or (p.ear > 0 and (not btn4 or p.on_ground or p.ear_flag == "pull"))
  if gravity_suspended then
    p.vy = 0
    if not btn4 then
      if not (p.is_zipping and (p.zip_dx != 0 or p.zip_dy != 0)) then
        p.is_zipping = false
      end
    end
  else
    p.vy = min(p.vy + gravity, 8)
  end
  if p.on_ground then
    p.coyote_t = coyote_max
    p.ear_retracting = false
  elseif p.coyote_t > 0 then
    p.coyote_t -= 1
  end
  local ear_busy = p.ear_flag or p.ear_captured_key or p.is_zipping or p.extending
  if not ear_busy then
    if btnp(0) then
      p.buf_dir = -1
      p.buf_t = buffer_max
    elseif btnp(1) then
      p.buf_dir = 1
      p.buf_t = buffer_max
    end
  end
  if p.buf_t > 0 then
    p.buf_t -= 1
  else
    p.buf_dir = 0
  end
  if p.coyote_t > 0 and p.buf_t > 0 then
    local dx = p.buf_dir * hop_vx
    local vy = hop_vy
    if btn4 and (p.ear_locked or p.ear > 0) then
      vy = 0
    end
    p.dir = p.buf_dir
    local nx = p.x + dx
    local ny = p.y + vy
    if not overlaps_wall(nx, p.y)
        and not ear_overlaps_wall_x(nx)
        and not overlaps_wall(nx, ny)
        and not ear_overlaps_wall_at(nx, ny) then
      p.vx = dx
      p.vy = vy
      p.hop_t = p.hop_max
      p.buf_t = 0
      p.buf_dir = 0
      p.coyote_t = 0
      sfx(1)
      spawn_fx(p.x, p.y, fx_walk_frames, fx_frame_ticks, p.dir)
    end
  end
  if p.hop_t > 0 then p.hop_t -= 1 end
  move_player()
  p.vx *= 0.6
  if abs(p.vx) < 0.1 then
    p.vx = 0
    p.x = flr((p.x + 4) / 8) * 8
  end
  update_ear()
  if p.has_key then
    local tx, ty
    if #p.ear_nodes > 0 then
      local ln = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes]
      tx, ty = p.x + ln.dx, p.y + ln.dy
    else
      tx, ty = p.x, p.y - 10
    end
    p.key_x += (tx - 2 - p.key_x) * 0.2
    p.key_y += (ty - 4 - p.key_y) * 0.2
    if tile_at(p.key_x + 4, p.key_y + 4) == 78 then
      reset_keys()
      sfx(25)
      start_hit(10, 5, 2)
    end
  elseif p.ear_captured_key then
    local ln = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes]
    if ln then
      if tile_at(p.x + ln.dx + 4, p.y + ln.dy + 4) == 78 then
        reset_keys()
        sfx(25)
        start_hit(10, 5, 2)
      end
    end
  end
  update_camera()
  local tx, ty = flr((p.x + 4) / 8), flr((p.y + 4) / 8)
  if mget(tx, ty) == 10 then
    start_msg(tx, ty)
  end
end
function _draw()
  cls()
  map_animate(1)
  draw_particles()
  shake_ox = 0
  shake_oy = 0
  if shake_t > 0 and shake_mag > 0 then
    shake_ox = flr(rnd(shake_mag * 2 + 1)) - shake_mag
    shake_oy = flr(rnd(shake_mag * 2 + 1)) - shake_mag
  end
  camera(flr(cam_x + shake_ox), flr(cam_y + shake_oy))
  map(flr(cam_x / 8), flr(cam_y / 8), flr(cam_x / 8) * 8, flr(cam_y / 8) * 8, 17, 17)
  draw_objs()
  draw_fx()
  draw_burst_particles()
  if p.can_extend then
    print("🅾️ / z push!", 176, 280, 13)
  end
  local px = flr(p.x)
  local py = flr(p.y)
  local flip_x = (p.dir == -1)
  if p.path_travel then
    for i = 1, #p.travel_pts do
      local t = p.travel_pts[i]
      if i == #p.travel_pts then
        spr(18, t.x, t.y, 1, 1, t.fx)
      else
        spr(t.s, t.x, t.y, 1, 1, t.fx)
      end
    end
  else
    for i = 1, #p.ear_nodes - 1 do
      local n = p.ear_nodes[i]
      local f = (n.fx ~= flip_x)
      if n.s == 8 or n.s == 62 then
        f = n.fx
      end
      spr(n.s, px + n.dx, py + n.dy, 1, 1, f)
    end
  end
  if not p.path_travel then
    local hx, hy = px, py - tile_size
    local h_dx, h_dy = 0, -1
    if #p.ear_nodes > 0 then
      local ln = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes]
      hx, hy = px + ln.dx, py + ln.dy
      local pn_dx, pn_dy = 0, 0
      if #p.ear_nodes > 1 then
        local pn = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes - 1]
        pn_dx, pn_dy = pn.dx, pn.dy
      end
      h_dx = (ln.dx > pn_dx) and 1 or (ln.dx < pn_dx and -1 or 0)
      h_dy = (ln.dy > pn_dy) and 1 or (ln.dy < pn_dy and -1 or 0)
    end
    local hs = p.can_extend and 16 or 63
    local hfx = false
    if h_dx == 1 then
      hs = 60
    elseif h_dx == -1 then
      hs = 60
      hfx = true
    elseif h_dy == 1 then
      hs = 61
    end
    local body_room_y = flr(py / (room_h * tile_size))
    local head_room_y = flr(hy / (room_h * tile_size))
    if body_room_y ~= head_room_y then
      hs = 50
    end
    if p.ear_locked then
      if p.ear_flag ~= nil then
        hs = 18
      elseif p.ear_hit_wall then
        if h_dy == -1 then
          hs = 34
        elseif h_dy == 1 then
          hs = 57
        elseif h_dx == 1 then
          hs = 41
        elseif h_dx == -1 then
          hs = 41 hfx = true
        end
      end
    end
    local f = (hfx ~= flip_x)
    if #p.ear_nodes > 0 or p.ear_locked then
      if (hs == 60 or hs == 41 or hs == 18) and h_dx != 0 then
        f = hfx
      end
    end
    spr(hs, hx, hy, 1, 1, f)
  end
  spr(17, px, py, 1, 1, flip_x)
  if p.ear_captured_key then
    local ln = p.ear_nodes[#p.ear_nodes]
    if ln then
      spr_out(71, px + ln.dx, py + ln.dy)
    end
  end
  if p.has_key then
    spr_out(71, p.key_x, p.key_y)
  end
  local total_sec = flr(p.game_timer / 30) + p.game_sec_offset
  local m = flr(total_sec / 60)
  local s = total_sec % 60
  local tstr = (m < 10 and "0" or "") .. m .. ":" .. (s < 10 and "0" or "") .. s
  local col = 7
  if not p.timer_running then
    if sin(time() * 1) < 0 then col = 0 end
    print("ninjin oukoku!", 2, 128 + 2, 1)
    print("dev: shoma", 2, 128 + 10, 1)
    print("thank you for playing!", 20, 172, 13)
    print(tstr, 56, 192, col)
    local carrot_x = 64 - (p.carrots * 6) / 2
    for i = 0, p.carrots - 1 do
      spr(106, carrot_x + i * 6, 200)
    end
  end
  camera()
  draw_msg()
end

author: Munro
description: Now featuring: 100% more FOV, interactive tutorial, highscores, and two player co-op! The DARK LORD's dungeon denizens are hungry: for KNOWLEDGE. Maintain a vast collection of books and fulfill your ghoulish patrons' requests in this tiny library simulator! Requests Patrons at each of the counters will request a book by various criteria like Title, Author, Subject, Call Number, etc. (Optional) Retrieve a card from the catalog drawers to help with locating the requested book. There are four sets of catalog cards, organized Title, Author, Subject, and Call Number respectively. Navigate to the corresponding bookcase and retrieve the book. Return to the counter to hand the book to the patron and gain score. After 5 minutes, the library will close its doors and your score will be tallied. (In the options menu you may disable the timer) Returns Patrons may return books which they drop off. Use the book's Call Number to return it to the correct location on the bookcase shelves and gain score. Call Numbers [Aisle][Bookcase][Letter Code] Example: 12F Class: Nature Subject: Celestial Letter Code: F Directions: Go to the aisle labeled 10-15, then the bookcase labeled 12. Shelves are organized alphabetically by letter code. 12F would come after 12E and before 12G. Credits Game & Art by Munro Music by Gruber ( Vol 1 and Vol 2 ) Originally made for LOWREZJAM 2025
comment_1: Fun and technically impressive!! Great game! You should update the cover art, it doesn’t make it justice! This one is way better:
comment_2: That's such a fun take on the dungeon crawler! Thank you for sharing this. I especially like the 'UI' of the different catalogues and inventories, and that you have to 'physically' move to them. This feels quite immersive.
comment_3: This is a great zen-out time using a uncommon theme, which is wonderful...these are the types of games I love seeing on PICO8. Just weird enough...something I hope to make one day :) I also dig the "you gotta make it a game" type of thing too. There's no real pressure here, no score or anything really, so it lets you define your goals. And yet another lowrez entry that looks and plays great. I apparently really need to give that mode a try.
comment_4: Loved this game! Sadly I had an issue in the endless mode where it wouldn't register me returning a book :( still had a wonderful time though!
comment_5: Really like the game and glad that there's no rush or time limit! Question: when I went to retrieve a book the card said that it was "disordered" so a different book was in its place. What should I do in that case?

author: benjamin_soule
game_code:
function init_game()
	
	reset()
	extcmd("rec")
	lvl=1
	
	-- states ( 31 sta dans le code 3tokens + 62 tokens a recup )
	sta={}
	for i=0,128 do sta[i]=0 end
	for i=0,31 do sta[80+i]=dget(10+i) end
	sta[224]=99	
	
	


	-- level
	level=mke()
	level.bt=0
	level.boulders=0
	level.upd=function(e)
		e.bt=max(e.bt-1,0)	
	
		--[[ bounce all ( 100 )
		local tbl={}
		for e in all(root) do
			if e.br then add(tbl,e) end
		end
		for i=1,#tbl do for j=i+1,#tbl do
			local a,b=tbl[i],tbl[j]
			local d=a.br+b.br-dist(a,b)
			if d>0 then
				local d=1
				a.x+=cos(an)*d/2
				a.y+=sin(an)*d/2
				b.x-=cos(an)*d/2
				b.y-=sin(an)*d/2
			end
		end end
		--]]

	
	end
	level.dr=function(e,x,y)
		map(0,0,0,0,16,16)

		--
		-- 
		local function dr_sta(from,to,y,ec,tired,last)
			local a={}
			for i=from,to do for j=1,sta[i] do				
				add(a,j==sta[i] and last==i and i+7 or i) 
			end end 
			--if tired>0 then add(a,100+tired) add(a,0)	end
			local w=#a*ec+(tired>0 and 8 or 0)
			local x=64-w/2
			rectfill(x,y,x+w,y+7,0)
			for id in all(a) do
				spr(id,x,y)
				--[[
				if id>100 then
					print(id-100,x+2,y+1,7)
					break
				else
					spr(id,x,y)
				end
				--]]
				x+=ec
			end	
			if tired>0 then
				print(tired,x+2,y+1,7)
				spr(23,x+6,y)
			end

			
		end		
		-- lives
		local function show_life(e,x)
			
			local y=64
			local hp=e.hp
			y-=hp*3
			if e.⧗hit then		
				y-=e.hurt*3
				if blk then hp=hp+e.hurt end				
			end
			
			for i=0,hp-1 do
				spr(11,x,y+i*6)
			end
			
		end
		show_life(h,0)
		if level.boss then
			show_life(level.boss,123)
		end	

		
		-- skills
		dr_sta(68,79,0,9,0)
		dr_sta(0,3,122,6,h.tired,h.last)

		-- floor
		local s="floor:"..lvl
		print(s,128-#s*4-9,10,1)
		-- day
		print("day:"..gday(),10,10,1)
		-- xp
		pm("xp:"..dget(1),64,116,1)		

		--[[ compass ( 113 tokens )
		local x,y=116,116
		local arc=4+sta[73]*2
		spr(4,x-1,y-1)
		for di=1,arc do
			local dmg=get_dmg(di-1)
			local di=(sword.di-di)%8
			local dx,dy=gd(di,dir8)
			local sq=dsq(h.sq,di,dir8)
			if is_wall(sq) then break end
			local cl=1
			if sq.ent and sq.ent.hp then
				cl=dmg>=sq.ent.hp and 7 or 8
			end			
			print(dmg,x+dx*6-1,y+dy*6-1,cl)		
			if cl==8 then break end
		end
		--]]
		
		-- zones
		for e in all(e) do if e.zone then
			local a={
				0b0011011011001001,
				0b0110110010010011,
				0b1100100100110110,
				0b1001001101101100,
			}		
			for sq in all(e.zone) do
				local x,y=sq.x*8,sq.y*8
				color(8)
				fillp(a[(t%4)+1])
				rectfill(x,y,x+7,y+7,8)
				fillp()
			end		
		end end
		
	end
	
	
	-- overlay
	ovl=mke()
	ovl.dr=function()
		
		-- run focus
		clip(8,8,112,112)		
		local c=1-((h.rfocus or 0)-8)/8
		if c>0 and c<1 then
			circ(h.x+3,h.y+3,4+c*16	,11)
		end
		clip()
		
		-- hint
		for di=0,3 do
			local sq=dsq(h.sq,di)
			local id=sq.ent and sq.ent.it
			if id and id>=64 and sq.ent.it<80 then
				local x,y,ww,hh=8,8
				if h.y<64 then y=88 end
				map(80,0,0,y)
				local d=split(item_desc,",")
				local i=id-64				
				local desc=d[i*2+1].."\n"..d[i*2+2]
				pm(desc,64,y+16,7)
			end
		end
		

		
		
	end
	
	--
	def_par=level
	ground=mke()
	
	-- grid
	squares={}
	for y=0,15 do for x=0,15 do
		local sq={x=x,y=y}
		add(squares,sq)		
	end end


	--

	
	-- hero
	init_hero()
	
	-- dev start
	for x=16,32 do
		local k=mget(x,16)
		if k==0 then break end
		if k>=128 then
			mk_mon(k)				
		elseif k<12 then
			lvl=k
		else
			inc_sta(k)
		end
	end
	
	
	-- gift
	if chk(84) then inc_sta(64+irnd(3)) end
	if chk(98) then inc_sta(68+irnd(9)) end
	
	
	--
	new_level()
	
	
	
end

-- grid
function gd(di,a,n)
	di=di%8
	a=a or dirs
	n=n or 1
	return a[di*2+1]*n,a[di*2+2]*n
end
function gsq(x,y)
	if x<0 or x>=16 or y<0 or y>=16 then
		return nil
	end
	return squares[y*16+x+1]
end
function dsq(sq,di,a,n)
	local dx,dy=gd(di,a,n)
	return gsq(sq.x+dx,sq.y+dy)
end
function gsq_at(x,y)
	return gsq(flr(x/8),flr(y/8))
end
function gp(sq)
	return sq.x*8,sq.y*8
end

function goto_sq(e,sq,t,f)

	local tempo=h.run and max(tempo-h.run,2) or tempo
	t=t or tempo
	leave_sq(e)
	e.sq=sq
	for sq in all(get_squares(e)) do
		sq.ent=e		
	end	
	local tx=sq.x*8
	local ty=sq.y*8
	if t~=0 then
		mvt(e,tx,ty,t,f)
	else
		e.twc=nil
		e.x=tx
		e.y=ty
		exe(f)
	end	
	
	-- QUEUE
	if e.sta==3 then
		local p=mke(e.x,e.y,ground)
		p.life=8
		p.dr=function(p,x,y)
			if p.life<3 then apal(1) end
			--apal(p.life>3 and 11 or 1)
			spr(180,x,y)
			pal()
		end
	end



end
function leave_sq(e)
	for sq in all(get_squares(e)) do
		if sq.ent==e then sq.ent=nil end
	end	
	--e.sq=nil
end
function get_squares(e,bsq)
	local a={}
	bsq=bsq or e.sq	
	if not bsq then return a end
	for x=0,e.sz-1 do for y=0,e.sz-1 do
		add(a,gsq(bsq.x+x,bsq.y+y))
	end end
	return a
end

--
function play()

	-- CHECK END LEVEL
	local sum=0
	for e in all(level) do if e.mid then sum=sum+1 end end
	if sum==0 and h.upd then
		lvl+=1
		for e in all(level) do if e.it then vanish(e) end end
		wt(8,new_level)
		return
	end
	
	-- CHECK GAMEOVER
	if h.dead then
		if not level.gmo then gameover() end
		wt(16,play_monsters)
		return
	end
	
	-- BOULDERS
	level.boulders-=1
	for i=1,level.boulders do
		rockslide(h,free_sq(nil,0,5),1,1)
	end		

	-- READY MONS
	for e in all(level) do e.ok=e.mid and e.sq end

	h.ready=1
end
function end_turn()



	--run
	if h.run then 
		local function f() h.ready=true end
		wt(max(tempo-h.run,2),f)
		h.run+=1
		return
	end
	
	--
	h.ready=false
	
	--again
	if chk(4,true) then
		sfx(0)
		h.⧗again=8
		play()
		return
	end
	
	
	play_monsters()

end

--
function new_level()

	

	--prelude
	if lvl==1 then		
		dinc(0,1)
		fx_emote(h,"day "..dget(0))		
	else
		fx_emote(h,"lvl "..lvl)
	end
	
	-- regen all
	local function f()
		if regen() then wt(2,f) end
	end
	f()
	
	-- WAVE
	local danger=1+flr(lvl^1.4)  -- 1.5>27  1.4>21
	local monsters={}
	while danger>0 do
		local a={}
		for x=0,16 do
			local k=mget(x,16)-192
			if k>0 and k<=danger and mget(x,17)-192<=lvl then	
				add(a,x) 
			end
		end
		local x=rnd(a)
		danger-=mget(x,16)-192
		for y=18,24 do
			local mid=mget(x,y)
			if mid>0 then
				add(monsters,mid)
			else
				break
			end
		end		
	end
	
	-- LEVEL UP
	if lvl==10 and chk(89) then	
		monsters={140,130,130,130}
	elseif lvl%2==0 and lvl<=10 then
		level_up()
	else
		if lvl>=5 and chk(94) then mk_item(94) end
		local function f()
			dinc(1,1)
			fx_emote(h,"+1xp")
		end		
		wt(32,f)
	end

	
	
	-- SPAWN
	local function spawn()
		sfx(63)
		local mid=rnd(monsters)
		del(monsters,mid)
		local e=mk_mon(mid)
		e.⧗spawn=8
		if #monsters>0 then
			wt(4+irnd(4),spawn)
		else
			play()
		end
	end	
	wt(8,spawn)
	
end
function gameover()
	
	level.gmo=1
	local e=mke()

function hmov(di)


	h.ldi=di
	if di==0 then h.flp=nil end
	if di==2 then h.flp=1 end
	
	
	local nsq,osq=dsq(h.sq,di),h.sq
	local obs=nsq and nsq.ent
	local function swm()
		sword.⧗mov=6
	end		
	local function bump(e)
		sfx(4)
		local dx,dy=gd(di)
		e.x+=dx*3
		e.y+=dy*3
		mv(e,-dx*3,-dy*3,4)
		stop_run()
	end			
	
	
	-- bump in wall / stealth
	if not nsq or is_wall(nsq) then
		if chk(85) and chk(2,true) and not h.cover and not h.run then
			h.cover=1
			h.⧗cover=8
			sfx(15)
		else
			bump(h)
		end
		return	
	end
	

	-- take item
	local it=obs and obs.it
	if it then		
		h.ready=false
		local function grab()			
			kl(obs)
			inc_sta(it)
			h.ready=true
			inc_sta(mget(it,18),-1)
			inc_sta(mget(it,19))
			if it==94 then h.hp+=2 end
			if obs.greed then 
				fx_emote(h,"greed")
				inc_sta(93,-1) 
			end

			for e in all(level) do if e.it then
				if chk(93) then
					e.greed=1
				else
					vanish(e) 
				end
			end end

			
			sfx(26)			
		end
		mvt(obs,h.x,h.y,8,grab)		
		obs.twcv=ease_in
		return 
	end
		
	-- bump in monsters / headbutt
	if not h.roll and obs and obs~=sword then
		if chk(83) and chk(1,true) then
			uncover()
			h.ready=false
			punch(h,di)			
			obs.sumsick=1
			hit(obs,2,di/4)
			local tsq=dsq(obs.sq,di)
			if not obs.dead and is_free(tsq,obs) then
				goto_sq(obs,tsq,tempo)
			end
			wt(tempo,end_turn)			
		else
			bump(h)
			bump(obs)
		end
		return
	end
	
	
	local delay
	sfx(1)

	-- roll
	if h.roll then
	
		while nsq and nsq.ent do
			nsq=dsq(nsq,di)		
		end
		

		
		if not nsq then
			bump(h)
		elseif h.roll[#h.roll]==nsq then			
			deli(h.roll,#h.roll)
			goto_sq(h,nsq)
			inc_sta(0,1)
			sfx(61)
		elseif is_free(nsq) then
			if chk(0,true) then
				add(h.roll,h.sq)
				goto_sq(h,nsq)
				sfx(0)
				h.⧗again=8
			else
				bump(h)
			end
		end		
		
		return	
	end
	
	
	
	-- straight / normal move		
	if h.focus>0 and chk(80) then

		local tsq=dsq(nsq,sword.di,dir8)
		local trg=tsq and tsq.ent
		if trg==h then trg=nil end
		
		if is_wall(tsq) or (trg and not chk(74) ) then
			bump(h)
			return
		end		
		h.ready=false
		if not tsq or trg then
			if trg then
				if not dodge(trg) then
					local dmg=sta[74]
					--if tsq.x==h.sq.x or tsq.y==h.sq.y then dmg+=sta[74]*2 end
					if h.run then 
						dmg=dmg+flr(max(h.run-2,0)/2) 
					end
					stop_run()
					delay=tempo
					noise()
					hit(trg,dmg,di/4)
				end
			end
			punch(h,di)
			punch(sword,di)
			uncover()
		else
		
			fx_smoke(tsq==h.sq and sword.sq or h.sq)
			leave_sq(h)
			leave_sq(sword)
			goto_sq(h,nsq)
			goto_sq(sword,tsq)
			h.⧗mov=6
			regen()
		end
		swm()
		

		
	else -- normal move

		local ssq=sword.sq
		h.⧗mov=6
		

		
		leave_sq(h)
		leave_sq(sword)			
		goto_sq(h,nsq)
		goto_sq(sword,osq)			
		sword.di=((di+2)%4)*2
		wt(2,swm)	
		h.di=di			
		
		

		if nsq==ssq  then		
			if chk(91) then	sfx(0) h.⧗again=8 return end
		else
			h.ready=false
			fx_smoke(ssq)
		end
		regen()
	
	end	

	
	wt(delay,end_turn)
		
end



function swing()
	uncover()
	h.ready=false
	local k=0
	local tempo=1
	local impact,blue
	noise(2)


	--local extra_hit=1+sta[70]
	local slice=1
	local arc=4+sta[73]*2
	local dmg=1

	local function thrust()
	
	
		local di=(sword.di-1)%8
		local sq=dsq(h.sq,di,dir8)
		local trg=sq and sq.ent

		-- end arc
		if k==arc then
			if chk(2) and not impact then 
				blue=1
				hero_shoot()
			end		
			end_turn()
			return		
		end

		-- stop on wall

			end_turn()
			return				
		end

		-- hit

		local d=4
		local dx,dy=cos(an)*d,sin(an)*d		
		
		-- target
		if trg then
			impact=1

			if dodge(trg) then
				
			elseif slice then	
				local rdmg=max(sta[74]+sta[82],dmg)+bonus
				--			
				exhaust(3+sta[76]*2-sta[74]-sta[92]-sta[68]*2)
				
				if trg.hp<(trg.hpm or trg.hp) then
					rdmg=rdmg+sta[72]
				end				
				if trg.hp<=rdmg then
					mv(sword,-dx,-dy,8)
				else					
					slice=chk(1,true)
					mv(sword,dx,dy,8)
					sword.twcv=uturn	
				end
				hit(trg,rdmg,di/8,thrust)
				dmg+=sta[70]-1
				return
			else
				end_turn()
				return			
			end
			
		end
			
		-- spin
		k+=1	
		dmg+=1
			
		-- fx
		local x,y=gp(sword.sq)
		local e=mke(x,y)
		e.life=2+k
		e.di=sword.di
		e.dr=function(e,x,y)
			pal(7,sget(40+min(e.life,8),blue and 2 or 0))
			spr(48+e.di,x,y)
			pal()
		end
		
		-- move sword
		sword.di=di
		goto_sq(sword,sq,0)
		thrust()
 end

	
	h.⧗swing=8
	thrust() 	

	
end
function regen()
	if h.run or h.cover then return end
	
	if h.tired>0 then
		h.tired-=1
		return true
	end
	
	for k=0,3 do
		if sta[k]<sta[64+k] then
			if h.last then
				h.last=nil
				return true
			end
			sta[k]+=1
			h.last=not chk(97) and k or nil
			return true
		end
	end
	h.last=nil
end

function mke(x,y,par)

	local e={
		x=x or 0,
		y=y or 0,
		z=0,
		vx=0,vy=0,vz=0,frict=1,
		we=0,
		t=0, sz=1,
		par=par
	}
	if par then
		add(par,e)
	end
	return e
end
function upe(e)
	e.t+=1
	exe(e.upd,e)
	
	-- phys
	local bc=1
	if e.bt and level.bt==0 then
		bc=.1
	end
	
	e.vz=e.vz+e.we*bc
	e.x+=e.vx*bc
	e.y+=e.vy*bc
	e.z+=e.vz*bc
	local fr=e.frict^bc
	e.vx*=fr
	e.vy*=fr
	e.vz*=fr
	
	if e.z>0 then
		e.z=0
		e.vz*=-.75
		e.vx*=.75
		e.vy*=.75
	end
	
	
	-- ⧗
	for k,v in pairs(e) do
		if sub(k,1,1)=="⧗" then
			e[k]=v>0 and v-1 or nil	
		end
	end
	
	-- tween
 if e.twc then
  if e.flh then
		anm(e.x,e.y,104,4,2)
	end
 
  local c=min(e.twc+bc/e.tws,1)
  local cc=e.twcv and e.twcv(c) or c
  e.x=e.sx+(e.ex-e.sx)*cc
  e.y=e.sy+(e.ey-e.sy)*cc
  e.z=e.stz+(e.ez-e.stz)*cc
  if e.jmp then   
   e.z+=sin(c/2)*e.jmp
  end  
  e.twc=c 

	if c==1 then
   e.twc,e.jmp,e.twcv,e.flh=nil
	 exe(e.twf)
  end
	
	
 end 	
 
	
	-- life	
	if e.life then
		e.life=e.life-bc
		if e.life<=0 then	kl(e)	end	
	end	
	foreach(e,upe)
end
function dre(e)
	local x=e.x
	local y=e.y+e.z
	if (e.blk and t%2==0 and e.life<e.blk) then return end

	if e.z<0 and e.sz then
		local r=e.sz*4
		dark_circ(x+r-e.z*.02,y+r-e.z*1.2,r)
	end

	if e.⧗mov then		
		y=y+sin(e.⧗mov/12)*2
	end		
	
	-- borders
	if e.bcl then
		apal(e.bcl)
		for di=0,3 do
			local dx,dy=gd(di)
			e.dr(e,x+dx,y+dy)
		end
		pal()

description: Here's Clockwise Knight ! story Karnoth messed up big time and now sulks in his dungeon, pretending to feel guilty. Too late! The Clockwise Knight is already on his way, and he won’t stop until Karnoth’s head rolls. goal Each run costs 1 day and rewards you with XP Spend XP to lock or unlock skills between days. Your final score is the number of days it took you to find and slay Karnoth. controls [Arrow Keys] move knight [v] swing your sword 180° [hold c] roll ( need green orb ) swing damage Your sword deals 1-4 damage depending on swing distance Red Orbs let you strike again if your swing is stopped by a high-HP enemy -1 damage per ennemy hit Many items may change these rules : extra damage, longer arc, minimum damage etc. Exhaustion Swing and using armor's orb drain knight for 3 and 6 turns. While knight is tired, he can't regenerate orbs Some items/skills can change the swing's drain ammount. preview

There are two minor things that I'd like to note, though. Maybe a character effect, like a blue version of the blood drop that appears on enemies under certain conditions, could help with making that clearer. Anyway, this game was a lot of fun!

--mouse required
--by werxzy



function lerp(a, b, t) 
	local c = (b-a)*t
	if abs(c) < 0.01 then
		return b
	end
	return a + c
end

function clerp(a, b, c, t)
	return lerp(lerp(a,b,t), lerp(b,c,t), t)
end

function nearest64(x, y)
	return x\64*64, y\64*64
end

function magnitude(x, y) -- safe for smaller values
	return sqrt(x*x + y*y)
end

function thline(x1, y1, x2, y2, r, c)
	if(c) color(c)
	local dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
	local m = max(abs(dx), abs(dy))

	local sx, sy = dx / m, dy / m
	for i = 0,m do
		circfill(x1, y1, r)
		x1 += sx
		y1 += sy
	end
	circfill(x2, y2, r)
end

function line_iter(x1, y1, x2, y2)
	local dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
	local m = max(abs(dx), abs(dy))

	local sx, sy, i = dx / m, dy / m, 0

	return function()
		if i > m then
			return
		elseif i == m then
			i += 1
			return x2, y2
		else
			i += 1
			local x, y = x1, y1
			x1 += sx
			y1 += sy
			return x, y
		end
	end
end

function ct(o, func, ...)
	func = o[func]
	if(func) func(...)
end

function left_pad(s, c, n)
	while(#s < n) s = c .. s
	return s
end

-- plays sound effect only if it is on screen
function sfx_at(x, y, ...)
	if box_hit(x, y, cam_x-2, cam_y-2, 68, 68) then
		sfx(...)
	end
end



-- special env funcions
-- nil values don't work well

--[[
b = pack #10 #31 #0 #1
iter = all b 
val = iter
LABEL "loop
print val
val = iter
GOTO "loop val
]]
-- [[
function call(s)
	local i, inst, labels = 1, split(s, "\n"), {}

	function LABEL(s)
		labels[s] = i
	end
	function GO_TO(s, condition) -- can only jump back
		if(condition) i = labels[s]
	end

	while inst[i] do
		local line = inst[i]
		-- print(line) -- for debugging
		if line[1] ~= "-" and #line > 1 then
			local s, par, re = split(line, " ", false), {}, "_"
			if s[2] == "=" then
				re = deli(s, 1)
				deli(s, 1)
			end

			-- get value of parameters
			for p in all(s) do
				if p[1] == '"' then -- string
					add(par, sub(replace(replace(p, '"', " "), "\\", "\n"), 2))
					
					-- add(par, sub(p, 2))

				elseif tonum(p) then -- number
					add(par, tonum(p))

				else -- variable
					local o, key = env_path(p) -- variable
					add(par, o[key])
				end
			end

			-- call functions and sets value
			local o, key = env_path(re)
			o[key] = deli(par, 1)(unpack(par))
		end
		i += 1
	end
end

function env_path(target)
	local o, tab = _ENV, split(target, ".")
	local last = deli(tab)
	
	for t in all(tab) do
		o = o[t]
	end

	return o, last
end

function SET(val)
	return val
end

function SUM(a, b)
	return a + b
end

function replace(s, a, b)
	local s3 = ""
	for s2 in all(split(s, a, false)) do
		s3 ..= b .. s2
	end
	return sub(s3, 2)
end

function _init()
call[[
poke 0x5f2c 3 0x5 
-- 64x64 resolution, mouse on and pointer lock

poke 0x5f36 0x2 
-- allow even diameter

extcmd "set_title "Mouse Required
room_setup
mouse_player.hide = SET 1

]]
	cam_x, cam_y = obj_room_pos(ROOM_TITLE, "0,0")
end

	poke(0x5f81,ord("werxzy.itch.io",1,14))
	?"\^!5f80u"
end

intro, mouse_speed, transition_type, transition_peeking, controls_invert, anti_sliding, respawn_delay 
	= -30, 1, 1, true, false, 0, 0

function _update60()
	if respawn_delay > 0 then
		respawn_delay -= 1

		if respawn_delay == 30 then
			if checkpoint_current then
				mouse_player.x, mouse_player.y = checkpoint_current.x, checkpoint_current.y
			else
				mouse_player.x, mouse_player.y = obj_room_pos(ROOM_START)
			end
			mouse_player:up_last_pos()
			snap_camera()
		end
			
		if respawn_delay == 0 then
			if(checkpoint_current) checkpoint_current:interact()
			mouse_player.hide = false
			part_obj(mouse_player, 6)
			s_respawn()
		end
	end


	if not intro then
		mouse_player.lclick, mouse_player.shake 
			= stat"34"&1 ~= 0 or btn"4", btn"5"

		local mdx, mdy = stat"38", stat"39"
		if anti_sliding > 0 then
			mdx -= anti_sliding * 0.5
			local m = magnitude(mdx, mdy)
			local m2 = m - anti_sliding
			if m2 > 0.01 then
				mdx, mdy = mdx/m*m2, mdy/m*m2
			else
				mdx, mdy = 0, 0
			end
		end

		
		mdx += tonum(btn"1") - tonum(btn"0") << 2
		mdy += tonum(btn"3") - tonum(btn"2") << 2

		local ms = mouse_speed / (controls_invert and -8 or 8)
		mouse_player.dx, mouse_player.dy 
			= mid(-10, 10, mdx * ms),  mid(-10, 10, mdy * ms)

		cam_update()
	end

	obj_update()
	part_update()
end

function _draw()
	call[[
cls 7
clip 0 0 64 64
room_draw
]]

	
	if intro then
		intro += 1
		if(intro == 20) s_fall()

		local rx, ry = obj_room_pos(ROOM_TITLE, "30,-32")
		local x, y = rx + sin(t())*3, ry + intro

		cam_y = max(cam_y, y-32)
		spr((t()*16-2.5)%8+68, x, y, 1, 2)
		if intro%2 == 0 then
			part_new(x+2, y, 6, 0.7)
		end
		if y > ry+127 then
			mouse_player.hide, intro = false
			mouse_player.x += 4
			mouse_player.y += 3

			local o = obj_cursor_slot(mouse_player.x, mouse_player.y)
			obj_below(o)
			part_box(mouse_player.x-4, mouse_player.y+4, 8, 8, 6)
			o:interact(mouse_player)
			s_crash()
			music(0, 3000)
		end
		
	end


	part_draw()

	
	camera()
	if mouse_player.held 
	and (mouse_player.held.name == "pencil" or mouse_player.held.name == "eraser") 
	and not player_first_drop then
		?"\^o1ffshake/x to drop", 2, 58, 7
	end
end






objs = {}

DIRS = {[0] = split"1,0", split"0,-1", split"-1,0", split"0,1"}

-- adds new object
-- if x and y are strings, x is room position, y is relative position
function obj_new(x, y, o)
	if type(x) == "string" then 
		x, y = obj_room_pos(x, y)
		if o.xl then
			o.xl, o.yl = x, y
		end
	end

	o.x, o.y, o.layer = x, y, o.layer or 0
	obj_update_room(add(objs, o))
	return o
end

function obj_destroy(o)
	obj_unlink_room(o)
	del(objs, o)

	if o.solid or o.coll then
		paths_prep()
	end
end

function obj_update()
	for o in all(objs) do
		if(o.update) o:update()
	end
end

-- remove object from all associated tables
function obj_unlink_room(o)
	if o.room then
		del(o.room.objs, o)
		o.room = nil
	end
end

function obj_update_room(o)
	local r1 = room_at(o.x, o.y)
	if r1 ~= o.room then
		if o.room then
			del(o.room.objs, o)
		end

		o.room, r1 = r1, r1.objs

		for i = #r1, 0, -1 do
			if i == 0 or o.layer >= r1[i].layer then
				add(r1, o, i+1)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-------------------------------------------

-- object can be picked up
function otype_pickup(tab, on_click, on_hold, on_release)
	tab.pickup, tab.on_click, tab.on_hold, tab.on_release = true, on_click, on_hold, on_release
	tab.interact = function(o, cursor)
		cursor.held, o.holder = o, cursor
		obj_unlink_room(o)
		s_pick_up_item(cursor.x, cursor.y)
	end
end

function obj_drop(o)
	if o and o.held then
		local held = o.held
		if o == mouse_player and held.name == "pencil" then
			player_first_drop = true
		end
		held.x, held.y, o.dshake, o.held, held.holder = o.x, o.y, 0
		obj_update_room(held)
		s_drop_item(o.x, o.y)
	end
end

function obj_spr_drawn(tab, id, w, h, no_shadow)
	tab.sp_id, tab.sp_dx, tab.sp_dy, w, h 
		= id, 0, 0, w or 1, h or 1
	if not no_shadow then
		tab.draw0 = function(o)
			spr(tab.sp_id, 
				o.x + (o.pickup and 0 or tab.sp_dx), 
				o.y + (o.pickup and 0 or tab.sp_dy) + (o.pickup and 1 or 3), w, h)
		end
	end
	tab.draw = function(o)
		spr(tab.sp_id, 
			o.x + (o.pickup and 0 or tab.sp_dx), 
			o.y + (o.pickup and 0 or tab.sp_dy), w, h)
	end
end

function obj_hit(px, py, o)
	return box_hit(px, py, o.x, o.y, o.w or 8, o.h or 8)
end

function box_hit(x1, y1, x2, y2, w, h)
	return x1 >= x2 and y1 >= y2 and x1 < x2+w and y1 < y2+h
end

function obj_link(from, to)
	if from.links then
		add(from.links, to)
	else
		from.links = {to}
	end
end

-- for "trigger" and "untrigger"
function obj_trigger(o, func, ...)
	for l in all(o.links) do
		ct(l, func, l, ...)
	end
end

function obj_solid(x, y) 
	for o in all(room_at(x, y).objs) do
		if (o.solid and obj_hit(x, y, o)) -- standard box collision
		or (o.coll and o:coll(x, y)) then -- custom collision
			return true
		end
	end
end

function find_obj_in(room, name)
	for o in all(room.objs) do
		if o.name == name then
			return o
		end
	end
end

function obj_room_pos(room, pos)
	room, pos = split(room), split(pos or "32,32")
	return room[1]*64 + pos[1], room[2]*64 + pos[2]
end

function obj_below(o)
	add(objs, del(objs, o), 1)
end


-------------------------------------------

-- for triggers
function obj_fake(f1, f2)
	return {trigger = f1, untrigger = f2}
end

function obj_cursor(x, y, col1, col2)
	return obj_new(x, y, {
		dx = 0, dy = 0,
		col1 = col1 or 7, col2 = col2 or 13,
		layer = 5,
		up_last_pos = function(o)
			o.xl, o.yl, o.lclick_prev, o.shake = o.x, o.y, o.lclick
		end,
		update = function(o)
			-- if o == mouse_player and stat"34"&2 ~= 0 then -- TEMP
			-- 	o.x += o.dx o.y += o.dy
			-- end

			if(o.hide) return 

			if o.shake then
				local a = sin(t()*4)
				o.dx += a
				o.dy -= a
			end

			if o.dx|o.dy ~= 0 then
				o.dx, o.dy, o.x, o.y = 0, 0, move_check(o.x, o.y, o.dx, o.dy)
			end

			obj_update_room(o)

			local held = o.held
			-- if cursor tries to interact
			if o.lclick and not o.lclick_prev then 
				if not o.held then
					s_click_down(o.x, o.y)
				end

				if held then
					ct(held, "on_click", held, o)

				else -- interact with object item
					local objs = o.room.objs
					for i = #objs, 1, -1 do
						local o2 = objs[i]
						if o2.interact and obj_hit(o.x, o.y, o2) then
							o2:interact(o)
							o.first_held = true
							break
						end
					end
				end

			elseif o.held then -- holding an object
				if o.first_held then
					o.first_held = o.lclick
				else
					if o.lclick then -- held down for more than 1 frame
						ct(held, "on_hold", held, o)

					elseif o.lclick_prev and not o.lclick then -- on releasing
						ct(held, "on_release", held, o)
					end
				end
			end

			if not o.lclick and o.lclick_prev and not o.held then
				s_click_up(o.x, o.y)
			end


			
			
			local dx, dy = o.x - o.xl, o.y - o.yl -- change in position

			o.xd, o.yd = lerp(o.xd, dx, 0.2), lerp(o.yd, dy, 0.2) -- smoothed out change

			local dx, dy = dx - o.xd, dy - o.yd
			if(dx*o.xd >= 0) dx *= 0.5
			if(dy*o.yd >= 0) dy *= 0.5
			o.dd = lerp(o.dd, magnitude(dx, dy) *  (6 - abs(o.yd*dx - o.xd*dy)), 0.1)

			if held and not o.lclick and (o.dd > 8 or o.shake) then
				o.dshake += 1
				if o.dshake > 20 then
					obj_drop(o)
				end
			else
				o.dshake = 0
			end

			o:up_last_pos()

function obj_button(x, y, w, h)
	local o = obj_new(x, y, {
		name = "button",
		layer = -2,
		w = w, h = h,
		held_down = {},
		
		interact = function(o, cursor)
			if not o.only_one or #o.held_down == 0 then
				add(o.held_down, cursor) -- table of all cursors holding it

				if #o.held_down == 1 then -- first object clicking
					obj_trigger(o, "trigger", cursor, o.text)
					s_button_down(o.x, o.y)
				end
			end
		end,

		update = function(o)
			for c in all(o.held_down) do
				if not c.lclick -- if no longer held
				or (not o.release_on_room and not obj_hit(c.x, c.y, o)) -- goes off of cursor
				or (o.release_on_room and o.room ~= c.room) then -- if not in same room
					del(o.held_down, c)

					if #o.held_down == 0 then -- final one releases
						obj_trigger(o, "untrigger", cursor, o.text)
						s_button_up(o.x, o.y)
					end
				end
			end
		end,

		draw = function(o)
			rrectfill(o.x, o.y+1, o.w, o.h, 1, 2)
			local unpushed = #o.held_down == 0 
			if unpushed then
				rrectfill(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 1, 8)
			end
			if(o.text) print(o.text, o.x+2, o.y+(unpushed and 1 or 2), unpushed and 2 or 8)
		end
	})

	return o
end

function obj_cursor_slot(x, y, inv)

					if o.inverted and o.holding == mouse_player then

					o.holding = nil

				else

						o.holding.y = o.y+6.5
					else
						o.holding.x = o.x+2.5
						o.holding.y = o.y+1.5

					o.holding.dx *= 0.1
					o.holding.dy *= 0.1
				end

			end

		interact = function(o, cursor)
			if o.holding == cursor then -- release held cursor if clicked
				cursor.no_shadow, o.holding = false

				-- they suffered quite enough, they may return to normal
				if o.inverted and cursor == mouse_player then
					SETT_INVERT:set_val(0)
				end
			
			elseif not o.inverted and not controls_invert 
			or o.inverted and controls_invert and cursor == mouse_player then 
				if not o.holding then
					o.holding = cursor
					cursor.no_shadow = true
					obj_trigger(o, "trigger")
					o.letgo = 0
				end
			end
		end
	})
	if not inv then

	end

function obj_checkpoint(x, y)
	local xx, yy = 3.5, 8.5 -- draw offset
	local o = obj_new(x, y, {
		a = 0, av = 0,
		update = function(o)
			local px = o.x+xx+o.av
			if obj_hit(mouse_player.x, mouse_player.y, o) then
				if checkpoint_current ~= o then -- activate checkpoint
					checkpoint_current = o
					o.av = mouse_player.dx > 0 and 3 or -3
					part_some(px, o.y, 8, 5)
					s_checkpoint()

				elseif abs(o.av) < 1 then -- wobble flag
					o.av += (mouse_player.dx + mouse_player.dy) * 0.2
					if abs(o.av) > 1 then
						part_some(px, o.y, 8, 1)
					end
				end
			end

			o.av -= o.a * 0.1
			o.av *= 0.9
			o.a += o.av
			if abs(o.a) + abs(o.av) < 0.2 then
				o.a, o.av = 0, 0
			end  
		end,

		interact = function(o)
			o.av += (rnd() + 0.5) * sgn(rnd()-0.5)
		end,

		draw0 = function(o)
			-- key_spr(o.x, o.y + (o.pickup and 1 or 3), o.pickup)
			local x, y = o.x+xx, o.y+yy
			local xa = x + o.a
			rectfill(x, y, xa, y)
			if checkpoint_current == o then
				rectfill(xa, y, xa+5, y)
				circfill(xa, y, 1)
				circfill(xa-sgn(o.a), y, 1)
			end
		end,

		draw = function(o)
			local x, y = o.x+xx, o.y+yy
			local x3, y3 = x + o.a, y-10 + abs(o.a) * 0.5
			local x2, y2 = clerp(x, x, x3, 0.5), clerp(y, y-4, y3, 0.5)

			local xm, ym = (x2+x3)*0.5, (y2+y3)*0.5
			local xf, yf = xm + (y2-y3), ym + (x3-x2)

			-- pole and foot outline
			rrectfill(x-2, y-1, 5, 3, 1, 1)
			thline(x, y, x2, y2, 1)
			thline(x2, y2, x3, y3, 1)

			-- flag outline
			if checkpoint_current == o then
				for i = 0,1,0.045 do
					thline(lerp(x2, x3, i), lerp(y2, y3, i), xf, yf, 1, 1)
				end
			end
			
			-- pole and foot
			rectfill(x-1, y, x+1, y, 13)
			thline(x, y, x2, y2)
			thline(x2, y2, x3, y3)
			
			-- flag
			if checkpoint_current == o then
				for i = 0,1,0.045 do
					thline(lerp(x2, x3, i), lerp(y2, y3, i), xf, yf, 0, 8)
				end
			end

		end,
	})

	o.y -= 1

	return o
end

	cam_x, cam_y = cam_xt, cam_yt
end

function cam_update()
	cam_xt, cam_yt = nearest64(mouse_player.x, mouse_player.y)
	
	if transition_type == 0 then
		cam_x, cam_y = lerp(cam_x, cam_xt, 0.06), lerp(cam_y, cam_yt, 0.06)

	elseif transition_type == 1 then
		cam_x, cam_y = mid(cam_x, cam_xt, cam_x + sgn(cam_xt - cam_x)*2), mid(cam_y, cam_yt, cam_y + sgn(cam_yt - cam_y)*2)
	
	elseif transition_type == 2 then
		cam_x, cam_y = cam_xt, cam_yt
	end


	-- peak into next room and keep cursor on screen
	local p = transition_peeking and 6 or 0
	cam_x = mid(cam_x, mouse_player.x-p, mouse_player.x-64+p)
	cam_y = mid(cam_y, mouse_player.y-p, mouse_player.y-64+p)
end

function POS(x, y)
	return x | y >>> 16
end

function UNPOS(p)
	return p & 0xffff, p<<16 & 0xffff
end

function UNPOS_CENTER(p)
	local x, y = UNPOS(p)
	return x*64+32, y*64+32
end

-- new room at grid position
function room_new(x, y)
	local r = {
		objs = {},
		walls = {},

	for i = 1,15 do
		add(r.dust, {x*64+rnd"64", y*64+rnd"64"})
	end

	rooms[POS(x,y)] = r
	return r

-- checks if point can move through 
-- returns final position of movement
function move_check(x, y, dx, dy)
	local found = true

	while found do
		found = false

		if dx ~= 0 do
			local d = mid(-1, 1, dx) -- would want to round to next 8 instead, but this is fine
			local new_x = x + d
			
			if not is_solid(new_x, y) then
				dx -= d
				x, found = new_x, true
			end
		end

		if dy ~= 0 do
			local d = mid(-1, 1, dy)
			local new_y = y + d
			
			if not is_solid(x, new_y) then
				dy -= d
				y, found = new_y, true
			end
		end
	end

	return x, y
end

function is_solid(x, y)
	return map_solid(x, y) or obj_solid(x, y)
end

function map_solid(x, y)
	-- return fget(mget(x\8, y\8), 0)
	return fget(mget(x\8, y\8), x>>2&1 | y>>1&2)
end

-- prepares the data for path finding
-- will need to be called every time a wall changes
-- TODO? diagonals, possible, but not necessary
-- DOES NOT CONSIDER OBJECTS OTHER THAN WALLS
function paths_prep()

	pathing_data = {}
	-- pathing[POS(x,y)] = {POS(x,y), ...} (connected rooms)

	local x2, y2 = 15, 5

	for x = 0, x2 do -- give each a table
		for y = 0, y2 do
			pathing_data[POS(x, y)] = {}
		end
	end

	-- if there's more, instead put this into a loop
	local banned = {
		[POS(4, 5)] = true,
	}

	for x = 0, x2 do
		for y = 0, y2 do
			local pos1 = POS(x, y)
			if not banned[pos1] then
				local pos2 = POS(x+1, y)
				
				-- check if can connect to room to right
				if x < x2 and not banned[pos2] then -- not to void
					local tx1, ty = (x+1)*64 - 2, y*64 + 32
					local tx2 = tx1 + 3
					if not is_solid(tx1, ty) and not is_solid(tx2, ty) then -- both sides are not blocked
						add(pathing_data[pos1], pos2)
						add(pathing_data[pos2], pos1)
					end
				end
				
				local pos3 = POS(x, y+1)
				-- check if can connect to room below
				if y < y2 and not banned[pos3] then  -- not to void
					local ty1, tx = (y+1)*64 - 2, x*64 + 32
					local ty2 = ty1 + 3
					if not is_solid(tx, ty1) and not is_solid(tx, ty2) then -- both sides are not blocked
						add(pathing_data[pos1], pos3)
						add(pathing_data[pos3], pos1)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


function paths_plan(x1, y1, x2, y2, final_rad)

	local from, to = POS(x1\64,y1\64), POS(x2\64,y2\64)
	local queue, flood = {to}, {[to] = to} -- start from to (mades it easier)
	
	-- same room, just do direct path
	if from == to then
		return {{x2, y2, final_rad or 0}}
	end

	-- floodfill algorithem
	while queue[1] do
		local p = deli(queue, 1)

		for p2 in all(pathing_data[p]) do -- all neighbors
			if not flood[p2] then -- if not visited
				flood[p2] = p
				if count(queue, p2) == 0 then
					add(queue, p2)
				end

				if p2 == from then -- found target, exit early
					queue = {} 
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	if(not flood[from]) return -- didn't reach

	local prev, path = from, {{x1, y1, 0}}

	while prev ~= to do -- traverse flood field to get points
		local a = prev
		prev = flood[prev]

		local x1, y1 = UNPOS_CENTER(a)
		local x2, y2 = UNPOS_CENTER(prev)
		
		add(path, {lerp(x1,x2,0.5), lerp(y1,y2,0.5), 0}) -- mid point (doorway)
		add(path, {x2, y2, 10}) -- room center
	end

	add(path, {x2, y2, final_rad or 0}) -- add final position

	return path
end




function ai_trigger(mouse, message)
	return obj_fake(function()
		mouse:ai_message(message)
	end)
end


function ai_add(mouse, inst)
	mouse.old_update, mouse.inst = mouse.update, inst

	mouse.update, mouse.ai_message = function(o)
		if o.ai_action then
			assert(coresume(o.ai_action, o))
			if costatus(o.ai_action) == "dead" then
				o.ai_action = nil
			end
		end
		
		mouse:old_update()

	end, function(o, message)
		o.ai_action = cocreate(o.inst[message])
		assert(o.ai_action)
	end
end


-- finds a path
function ai_find_path(mouse, x2, y2, speed, rad, final_rad)
	local path = paths_plan(mouse.x, mouse.y, x2, y2, final_rad)
	
	if not path then
		return true
	end

	ai_move(mouse, path, speed, rad) -- replace current function with new one
end

function ai_move(mouse, path, speed, rad, accel)
	local sdx, sdy, speed, rad, accel = 0, 0, speed or 0.65, rad or 1, accel or 0.1

	while path[1] do
		local p = path[1]
		local dx, dy = p[1] - mouse.x, p[2] - mouse.y
		local m = magnitude(dx, dy)

		if m < rad + (p[3] or 0) then -- at destination
			deli(path, 1)

		else
			sdx = mid(lerp(sdx, dx/m*speed, accel), -dx, dx)
			sdy = mid(lerp(sdy, dy/m*speed, accel), -dy, dy)
		end

		mouse.dx, mouse.dy = sdx, sdy -- set up movement
		yield()
	end
end

function ai_wait(time)
	for i = 1,tonum(time) do
		yield()
	end
end

function ai_until_same_room(o, o2)
	o2 = o2 or mouse_player
	while(o.room ~= o2.room) yield()
end

function ai_click(o, sp)
	ai_wait(sp)
	o.lclick = true
	ai_wait(sp)
	o.lclick = false
	ai_wait(sp)
end

function ai_solve_numpad(o, np)
	::again::
	while not np:correct_so_far() and np.status == 0 do
		for o2 in all(o.room.objs) do
			if o2.text then
				ai_find_path(o, o2.x+4, o2.y+4)
				break
			end
		end
		ai_click(o, 4)
	end

	while(np.status > 0) yield()

	for c in all(np.pass) do
		-- find right button
		local b = nil
		for o2 in all(o.room.objs) do
			if o2.text == c then
				b = o2
				break
			end
		end

		ai_find_path(o, b.x+4, b.y+4)
		if(not np:correct_so_far()) goto again
		ai_click(o, 15)
		if(not np:correct_so_far()) goto again
	end
end

function follow_player_until(o, func)
	while func() do
		if o.room ~= mouse_player.room then
			if ai_find_path(o, mouse_player.room.xc, mouse_player.room.yc, nil, nil, 20) then
				ai_wait"45"
			end
		end
		yield()
	end
end

function ai_find_empty_slot(o)
	while not o.no_shadow do
		for o2 in all(o.room.objs) do
			if o2.name == "slot" and not o2.holding then
				ai_move(o, {{o2.x+3, o2.y+3}})
				ai_click_nohold(o, 5)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function ai_draw_path(o, room, p)
	for p in all(split(p, "|")) do
		local path = {}
		for p in all(split(p, ">")) do
			add(path, {obj_room_pos(room, p)})
		end
		ai_move(o, path, nil, nil, 0.3)
		o.lclick = not o.lclick
	end
	o.lclick = false
end

function ai_drop_item(o)
	while o.held do 
		o.shake = true 
		yield() 
	end
end

function ai_click_nohold(o, n)
	local x, y = o.x, o.y
	::again::
	ai_click(o, n)
	if o.held then
		ai_up_and_drop(o)
		ai_move(o, {{x, y}})
		goto again
	end
end

function ai_up_and_drop(o)
	for i = 1,35 do
		o.dy = -0.5
		yield()
	end
	ai_drop_item(o)
end




particles = {}

function part_update()
	for p in all(particles) do
		p[1] += p[5]
		p[2] += p[6]
		p[5] *= 0.96
		p[6] *= 0.98
		p[3] -= 0.02
		if p[3] <= 0 then
			del(particles, p)
		end
	end
end

function part_draw()
	for p in all(particles) do
		circfill(unpack(p))
	end
end

function part_new(x, y, c, sp)
	sp = sp or 1
	add(particles, {
		x,
		y,
		(rnd(2)+1) * sp,
		c,
		(rnd()-0.5) * sp,
		(-rnd()*0.7) * sp
	})
end

function part_obj(o, c)
	part_box(o.x, o.y, o.w or 8, o.h or 8, c)
end

function part_box(x, y, w, h, c)
	for i = 1,20 do
		part_new(x + rnd(w), y + rnd(h), c)
	end
end

function part_some(x, y, c, n, sp)
	for i = 1,n do
		part_new(x+rnd"2"-1, y+rnd"2"-1, c, sp)
	end
end

	o1.x<o2.x+o2.w and
	o1.y>o2.y and
	o1.y<o2.y+o2.h
end
function ch_onscreen(o,marg)--46t
	if marg==nil then
		marg=0
	end
	local m1=127+marg
	local m2=0-marg
	if o.x>m1 or o.x<m2 or o.y>m1 or o.y<m2 then
	return false end
	return true
end
function scroll(obj)--scrolling the map happens here
	for o in all(obj) do
		o.x,o.y=
		cycle(o.x,-300,300),
		cycle(o.y,-300,300)
		o.x-=worldspx
		o.y-=worldspy
	end
end

function angle_to(ob1,ob2)
	return atan2(ob2.y-ob1.y,ob2.x-ob1.x)
end

function cycle(val,mn,mx)--could maybe be replaced with%
	if val>mx then
		val=mn
		elseif val<mn then
		val=mx
	end
	return val
end

function sectfillp(x,y,r,c,s,d)
	color(c)
	local e=s+mid(d,1,-1)
	if s>e then
	s,e=e,s
	end
	d=abs(d)
	while d>0 do
		e=s+min(d,0.25)
		local sx,sy,ex,ey,mx,my,se=sin(s)*r,cos(s)*r,sin(e)*r,cos(e)*r,0,0,-1
		if sy>ey then
			sx,sy,ex,ey=ex,ey,sx,sy
		end
		local rx,ry,lx,ly=sx,sy,ex,ey
		if my>ey then
			mx,my,ex,ey=ex,ey,mx,my
		end
		if sy>my then
			sx,sy,mx,my=mx,my,sx,sy
		end	
		local sr,er=s%1\0.25,e%1\0.25
		color(deli(col) or c)
		local seg=sr==1 and er==2 and sy or sr==3 and er==0 and ey
		if seg then
			for u=seg,r*sgn(sy),sgn(sy) do
				local xi=(sqrt((r+u)*(r-u))+0.5)\1
				rectfill(x-xi,u+y,x+xi,u+y)
			end
		end
		color(deli(col) or c)
		local i,j,xl,xr=(mx-sx)/(my-sy),(ex-sx)/(ey-sy),x+sx,x+sx
		for u=sy/1,my/1 do
			rectfill(xl,u+y,xr,u+y)
			xl+=i
			xr+=j
		end
		color(deli(col) or c)
		local i,j,xl=(ex-mx)/(ey-my),(ex-sx)/(ey-sy),x+mx
		for u=my/1,ey/1 do
			rectfill(xl,u+y,xr,u+y)
			xl+=i
			xr+=j
		end
		color(deli(col) or c)
		j,xl,xr=(lx-rx)/(ly-ry),x+rx,x+rx
		for u=ry,ly do
			local xi=(sqrt((r+u)*(r-u))+0.5)\1*sgn(lx+rx)
			rectfill(xi+x,u+y,xr,u+y)
			xr+=j
		end
		s+=0.25
		d-=0.25
	end
end
