function spawn_bird()--70 t
	if normal_mode then
		sfx"56"
		local p={}
		p.r,p.c,p.an_div=5,8,12
		p.bodyr,p.headr=5,3.75
		p.a,p.an_a,p.flapa,p.anspd=0,0,0,.05
		p.x,p.y=rnd"128"+128,rnd"128"+128
		p.z,p.spd=35,.5
		p.sw_t=240+rnd"120"
		p.action=chase_bird
		p.tired,p.giveup=0,(rnd"4"*1000)+600
		p.underwater=false
		add(birds,p)
	end
end

function chase_bird(p)
	p.anspd=(5-p.spd*.99)/60
	p.an_div=7+p.spd*1.6
	bpnt.a+=bpnt.av/20
	bpnt.x,bpnt.y=sin(bpnt.a)*bpnt.out+64,cos(bpnt.a)*bpnt.out+64
	bpnt.out=64-(worldspd*16)
	p.a,p.spd=angle_to(p,bpnt),dist(p,bpnt)/20
	bpnt.out=mid(bpnt.out,0,64)
	if globalcbseen_air then
		p.sw_t-=1
		p.tired+=1
		if alive then
		if p.sw_t<1 then
			p.sw_t=0
			p.action=dive_bird
		end
		end
		else p.sw_t+=.5
	end
	if not globalcbseen_air then
		p.tired+=5
	end
	if not alive then
		p.action=fly_off_bird
	end
end

function fly_off_bird(p)
	if not p.draw then
		del(birds,p)
		if alive then
		ach_vals[5]+=1
		end
	end
end

function dive_bird(p)
	p.sw_t+=1
	p.spd,p.anspd=0,0
	local _t=p.sw_t/30
	p.a=angle_to(p,bpnt)
	p.z,p.x,p.y,p.r=lerp(p.z,4,_t),lerp(p.x,64,_t),lerp(p.y,64,_t),lerp(p.r,3,_t)
	p.headr=p.r*.8
	p.an_a,p.an_div=-.1,3
	bpnt.x,bpnt.y=64,64
	p.sw_t=mid(p.sw_t,0,30)
	if flr(p.z)==12 then
		p.underwater=true
		explode(p,1,7,15,circ,upd_parts2)
		for i=1,5 do
		spawnsplash(64+rnd"3",64+rnd"3",18)
		end
	end
	if _t>=1 then
	if not globalcbseen_air then
		p.action=dive_up_bird
	end
		alive=false
		for v in all(visjes) do
			if v.c==2 then
				if _t>.5 then
				if not v.cbseen_air then
					p.action=dive_up_bird
				end
				explode(p,2,2,20,circfill)
				del(visjes,v)
				sfx"60"
				end
			end
		end
		for p in all(preds) do
			p.action=idle_pred
		end
		p.action=dive_up_bird
		sfx"63"
		sfx"34"
	end
end

function dive_up_bird(p)
	p.r+=.2
	p.z+=2
	p.spd+=.25
	p.anspd+=.005
	p.an_div=12
	if flr(p.z)==12 then
		p.underwater=false
		explode(p,1,7,15,circ,upd_parts2)
		for i=1,3 do
			spawnsplash(64,64,18)
		end
	end
	if p.r>=5 then
		p.action=fly_off_bird
	end
end

function upd_bird()--333t
	for p in all(birds) do
		p.an_a+=p.anspd
		p.action(p)
		do_for_all_mobs(p)
		p.spd=mid(p.spd,.1,5)
		bpnt.av=1-dist(p,bpnt)/1000
		bpnt.av=mid(bpnt.av,0,.1)
		p.bodyr=p.r+sin(p.an_a+.75)/5
		if p.tired>=p.giveup then
			p.tired=mid(p.tired,0,p.giveup)
			p.action=fly_off_bird
		end
	end
end

	p.c,p.z=8,1

	if p.draw then
		if p.tired<1 then
			for v in all(visjes) do

					if within_s_r(v,p) then
						if v.cbheard then
							p.targ,p.sw_t=v,30
							p.action=charge_jump
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function check_angle(p)
	local _a=angle_to(p,p.targ)
	if p.a-.15<_a and p.a+.15>_a then
		local _v=p.targ
		p.action=startle_pred
		if _v.c!=2 then
			_v.swim_t=120
			_v.a=angle_to(p,_v)
			pick_message(_v,6)
		end
		else p.action=idle_pred
		p.targ=nil
	end
end

function startle_pred(p)
	if not p.noise then
		p.noise=true
		sfx"39"
	end
	if p.targ then
		swap_col(p,1)
		if dist(p,p.targ)>5 then
			p.a=angle_to(p,p.targ)
			p.spd+=.1
		end
		if p.pat_id==5 then
			p.action=chase_pred
			p.noise=nil
		end
	end
end

function _init()	
	cartdata"ooooggll_baba_demake"
	if (dget(1) == 0) dset(1, 1)
	if (dget(0) == 0) dset(0, 1)
	
	-- enable keyboard input
	poke(0x5f2d, 1)
	
	-- keep palette

	win_time = -25
	max_win_time = 50
	cloud_time = -25

function _update()
	if end_screen then
		if (btnp(🅾️) or btnp(❎)) and cloud_time == -25 then
			transition(function()
				end_screen = false
				end_cutscene = false
				blossom = nil
				title = true
				title_scroll = 0
				music"13"
				reset_time()
				load_level(1)
			end)
		end
	elseif title then
		title_update()
		
		if (title_scroll > 0) title_scroll -= 0.04
	else
		game_update()
		
		-- timer
		frames += 1
		
		seconds += frames \ 30
		frames %= 30
		
		minutes += seconds \ 60
		seconds %= 60 
		
		hours += minutes \ 60
		minutes %= 60
		
		-- save timer in cartdata
		dset(2, frames)
		dset(3, seconds)
		dset(4, minutes)
		dset(5, hours)
		
		if (title_scroll < 1) title_scroll += 0.04
	end

		cloud_time -= 1
		
		if cloud_time == 0 then
			cloud_func()
		end
	end
	
	-- update this each frame so the label goes back to "clear savedata" if you pressed it once then unpaused the game. probably not the most efficient way to do it but whatever.
	menuitem(3, "clear savedata", function()
		menuitem(3, "are you sure?", function()
			dset(0, 1) -- current level
			dset(1, 1) -- level progress
			load_level(1)
			title = true

function game_update()
	turn = false
	
	-- r to restart (when not holding ctrl as well)
	if stat(28, 21) and not stat(28, 224) then
		if cloud_time == -25 then
		 transition(function() 
		 	load_level(lvl)
		 end)
		 
		 sfx"58"
		end
	end
	
	-- t to return to title
	if stat(28, 23) and cloud_time == -25 then
		title = true
		return
	end
	
	if move_time == 0 and win_time <= 0 then
		-- clear move amounts
		for unit in all(units) do
			unit.move_amt = vector(0, 0)
			unit.been_stopped = nil
		end
		
		moving_units = {}
		
		-- undo
		if btn(❎) and not end_cutscene then
			if #undos > 0 then
				move_time = 5
				undo()
				
				interpret_text()
				do_autotiling()
			end
		else
			-- decide if we're doing a turn or not
			for unit in all(prop_lookup.you) do
				if btn(⬅️) or btn(➡️) or btn(⬆️) or btn(⬇️) then
					move_time = 5
					turn = true
					
					break
				end
			end
			
			-- idle
			if btn(🅾️) then
				move_time = 5
				turn = true
			end
		end
	end
	
	if turn then
		-- record this turn before we go to the next one
		add_undo()
	
		-- schedule units to move
		for unit in all(prop_lookup.you) do
			-- YOU
			if btn(⬅️) then
			 unit:move(-1, 0, "you")
			elseif btn(➡️) then
				unit:move(1, 0, "you")
			elseif btn(⬆️) then
			 unit:move(0, -1, "you")
			elseif btn(⬇️) then
			 unit:move(0, 1, "you")
			end
		end		
		
		-- MOVE
		for unit in all(prop_lookup.move) do
			if unit:can_move(unit.dir.x, unit.dir.y) then
				unit:move(unit.dir.x, unit.dir.y, "move")
			else
				unit:move(-unit.dir.x, -unit.dir.y, "move")
			end
		end
		
		local x_schedule, y_schedule = {}, {}
		
		-- add to separate schedules
		-- for x and y axes
		for unit, moves in pairs(moving_units) do
			if moves.x ~= 0 then
				add(x_schedule, {unit, moves.x})
			end
			
			if moves.y ~= 0 then
				add(y_schedule, {unit, moves.y})
			end
		end
	
		::x_loop::
		
		for item in all(x_schedule) do
			local unit, amt, reason = unpack(item)
			local step = sign(amt)
			
			unit.x += step
			amt -= step
			
			unit:update_cell()
			
			-- remove from list if it's
			-- done all its moves
			if amt == 0 then
				del(x_schedule, item)
			else
				item[2] = amt
			end
		end
		
		-- if on top of a STOP unit,
		-- put the moving unit back
		-- one tile and remove from
		-- schedule. also check for
		-- unpushable push chains.
		cancel_moves(x_schedule, "x")
		
		-- if on top of a PUSH unit,
		-- move it one tile forwards.
		do_pushes("x")
		
		-- keep going if there's more
		-- moves to be done
		if (#x_schedule > 0) then
			goto x_loop
		end
		
		::y_loop::
		
		for item in all(y_schedule) do
			local unit, amt, reason = unpack(item)
			local step = sign(amt)
			
			unit.y += step
			amt -= step
			
			unit:update_cell()
			
			if amt == 0 then
				del(y_schedule, item)
			else
				item[2] = amt
			end
		end
		
		cancel_moves(y_schedule, "y")
		
		do_pushes("y")
		
		if (#y_schedule > 0) then
			goto y_loop
		end
	
		-- read text once it's
		-- been moved
		interpret_text()
		
		-- transmutations
		for unit in all(units) do
			local new_types = {}
			
			-- get a list of units to turn into
			for prop, _ in pairs(unit.properties) do
				if (
					sprites[prop] 
					or prop == "text" 
					and not unit.text
					or prop == "all") 
					and not (unit.properties[unit.name] 
					or unit.properties.text 
					and unit.text
				) then
					-- x is all
					if prop == "all" then
						for name, _ in pairs(name_lookup) do
							if sub(name, 1, 2) ~= "t_" then
								add(new_types, name)
							end
						end
					else
						add(new_types, prop)
					end
				end
			end
			
			-- create all necessary units
			for name in all(new_types) do
				if (name == "text") name = "t_" .. unit.name
				local new = new_unit(name, unit.x, unit.y)
				
				new.dir = unit.dir
				new.draw_x, new.draw_y = unit.draw_x, unit.draw_y
			end
			
			-- delete original unit if it was converted
			if #new_types > 0 then
				if (unit.tiling) unit:update_tiling_nearby()
				unit:destroy(true, false, true)
			end
		end
		
		-- read text again after
		-- transmutations
		interpret_text()
		
		-- do actions for properties that
		-- activate once per turn
		post_turn_props()
		
		-- this can most likely be removed to increase performance - some post-turn props affect text reading but it's not common.
		interpret_text()
		
		-- dynamic tiling
		do_autotiling()
	end
	
	-- win particles
	srand(time())
	for unit in all(prop_lookup.win) do
		if rnd() > 0.8 then
			make_particle("win", unit.draw_x + 4, unit.draw_y + 4, 3, 0, 0)
		end
	end
	
	-- end particles
	for unit in all(prop_lookup["end"]) do
		if rnd() > 0.7 then
			make_particle("end", unit.draw_x + 4, unit.draw_y + 4, 12, 0, 0)
		end
	end
	
	-- hot particles
	for unit in all(prop_lookup.hot) do
		if rnd() > 0.995 then
			make_particle("smoke", unit.draw_x + 4, unit.draw_y + 4, 12, rnd(0.5) - 0.25, rnd(0.5) - 0.4)
		end
	end
	
	-- move animation
	for unit in all(units) do
		unit:slide_pos()
	end
	
	if move_time > 0 then
		move_time -= 1
	end
	
	if win_time > -25 then
		win_time -= 1
	end
	
	for unit in all(units) do
		unit.created_this_turn = nil
	end
	
	-- rotate the blossom
	if blossom then
		blossom.dir += 0.01
		
		-- also make it bloom if we've got all the text
		local can_bloom = true
		for word in all(text_units) do
			if not word.collected then
				can_bloom = false
				break
			end
		end
		
		if can_bloom then
			if blossom.dist < 10 then
				blossom.dist += 0.2
			else
				-- let baba enter the blossom
				for unit in all(name_lookup.baba) do
					if unit.x == (blossom.x - 4) / 8 and unit.y == (blossom.y - 4) / 8 and move_time == 0 then
						transition(function()
							end_screen = true
						end)
						unit:destroy(true)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	update_particles()
end

		for k, v in pairs(var) do

	return new

	local x, y = x1, y1

-- @new
function new_unit(spr_or_name, x, y, extra)
	local unit = {
		id = (extra and extra.id) or max_id + 1,
		
		x = x,
		y = y,
		
		draw_x = x * 8,
		draw_y = y * 8,
		
		dir = vector(1, 0),
		move_amt = vector(0, 0), -- amount the object is moving this turn
		
		properties = {}
	}
	
	max_id = max(unit.id, max_id)
	
	-- YOU CAN DO BOTH new_unit(1)
	-- AND new_unit("baba")
	if type(spr_or_name) == "number" then
		unit.spr = spr_or_name
		unit.name = types[spr_or_name]
	else
		unit.name = spr_or_name
		unit.spr = sprites[spr_or_name]
	end
	
	unit.directional = directional_sprites[unit.name]
	unit.tiling = tiling_sprites[unit.name]
	
	-- copy extra data
	for k, v in pairs(extra) do
		unit[k] = v
	end
	
	if fget(unit.spr, 0) then
		unit.text = true
		add(text_units, unit)
	end
	
	if fget(unit.spr, 1) then
		unit.noun = true
		add(noun_units, unit)
	end
	
	if fget(unit.spr, 2) then
		unit.verb = true
		add(verb_units, unit)
	end
	
	if fget(unit.spr, 3) then
		unit.prop = true
		add(prop_units, unit)
	end
	
	if fget(unit.spr, 4) then
		unit.cond = true
		add(cond_units, unit)
	end
	
	-- add to default layer if necessary
	if not (key(below_layer, unit.name) or key(default_layer, unit.name) or key(above_layer, unit.name) or unit.text) then
		add(default_layer, unit.name)
	end
	
	-- @move
	function unit:move(x, y, reason)
		-- put in schedule
		if moving_units[unit] then
			moving_units[unit] += vector(x, y)
		else
			moving_units[unit] = vector(x, y)
		end
		
		-- record move amount for later
		unit.move_amt += vector(x, y)
			
		unit.dir = vector(sign(x), sign(y))
	
		-- update autotiling
		if unit.tiling then
			unit:update_tiling_nearby()
		end
		
		qsfx"63"
	end
	
	-- @push
	function unit:push(x, y, exclude)
		if (x == 0 and y == 0) return
		
		x = sign(x)
		y = sign(y)
		
		local push_again = {}
		
		for other in all(prop_lookup.push) do
			if self:colliding(other) and not other.been_pushed and (not exclude or not key(exclude, other)) and not (other.move_amt.x == x and other.move_amt.y == y) then
				other.been_pushed = true
				
				other.x += x
				other.y += y
				
				-- keep in bounds
				other.x = mid(0, other.x, lvl_w - 1)
				other.y = mid(0, other.y, lvl_h - 1)
				
				other:update_cell()
				
				other.dir.x = x
				other.dir.y = y
				
				if other.tiling then
					other:update_tiling_nearby()
				end
				
				add(push_again, other)
			end
		end
		
		-- push chain (once stack has been moved)
		for other in all(push_again) do
			other:push(x, y, push_again)
		end
	end
	
	-- x, y is the direction the unit is facing - it's pushing backwards though. obviously.
	function unit:push_back(x, y)
		-- this maybe can loop through the schedule and not every unit
		for other in all(units) do
			if sign(other.move_amt.x) == x and sign(other.move_amt.y) == y and unit:colliding(other) and not other.been_stopped then
				other.x -= x
				other.y -= y
				
				other:update_cell()
				
				if other.properties.stop or other.properties.push then
					other:push_back(x, y)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	function unit:colliding(other, x, y, check_self, check_fly)
		local x, y = x or 0, y or 0
		return self.x + x == other.x and self.y + y == other.y and (self ~= other or check_self) and (not check_fly or self.properties.fly == other.properties.fly)
	end
	
	function unit:colliding_prop(prop, x, y, check_self, check_fly)
		local x, y = x or 0, y or 0
		for other in all(prop_lookup[prop]) do
			if self:colliding(other, x, y, check_self, check_fly) then
				return other
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- @can
	function unit:can_move(x, y)
		if (x == 0 and y == 0) return true
		
		-- STOP units (that don't also have PUSH)
		for other in all(prop_lookup.stop) do
			if self:colliding(other, x, y) and not other.properties.push and not (unit.properties.open and other.properties.shut or unit.properties.shut and other.properties.open) and not other.properties.weak then
				return false
			end
		end
		
		-- edges
		if unit.x + x < 0 or unit.x + x > lvl_w - 1 or unit.y + y < 0 or unit.y + y > lvl_h - 1 then
			return false
		end
		
		-- push chains
		for other in all(prop_lookup.push) do
			if self:colliding(other, x, y) and not other.properties.weak then
				return other:can_move(x, y)
			end
		end
		
		return true
	end
	
	-- check if it's already inside
	-- a STOP unit or inside a PUSH
	-- unit that can't be pushed
	function unit:stopped(x, y, last_checked)
		-- STOP units (that don't also have PUSH)
		for other in all(prop_lookup.stop) do
			if self:colliding(other) and not other.properties.push and not other.properties.weak and not (other.properties.shut and self.properties.open or other.properties.open and self.properties.shut) then
				return true
			end
		end
		
		-- edges
		if self.x < 0 or self.x > lvl_w - 1 or self.y < 0 or self.y > lvl_h - 1 then
			return true
		end
		
		if self == last_checked then
			stop("infinite loop in unit:stopped")
			return true
		end
		
		-- push chains
		for other in all(prop_lookup.push) do
			if self:colliding(other) and not other.properties.weak then
				return not other:can_move(x, y, self)
			end
		end
	end
	
	function unit:add_prop(prop)
		-- add to prop lookup table (if it's not already in it)
		if not self.properties[prop] then
			if prop_lookup[prop] then
				add(prop_lookup[prop], self)
			else
				prop_lookup[prop] = {self}
			end
			
			self.properties[prop] = true
		end
	end
	
	-- @destroy
	function unit:destroy(no_particles, forget, skip_tiling)
		if not no_particles then
			for i = 0.125, 1, 0.125 do
				make_particle("destroy", unit.draw_x + 4, unit.draw_y + 4, 2, cos(i) * 2, sin(i) * 2)
			end
		end
		
		-- remove from all tables
		del(units, unit)
		del(name_lookup[unit.name], unit)
		del(text_units, unit)
		del(noun_units, unit)
		del(verb_units, unit)
		del(prop_units, unit)
		del(cond_units, unit)
		
		unit:remove_from_grid()
		
		for prop, _ in pairs(unit.properties) do
			del(prop_lookup[prop], unit)
		end
		
		-- add unit's name to the undo so it can be recreated later
		-- ..unless it was deleted in the process of undoing (in which case we should definitely not recreate it)
		if not forget and not unit.created_this_turn then
			local last_unit = undos[#undos][unit.id]
			if last_unit then
				add(last_unit, unit.name)
				add(last_unit, vector(unit.move_amt.x, unit.move_amt.y))
			else
				undos[#undos][unit.id] = {unit.x, unit.y, vector(unit.dir.x, unit.dir.y), unit.name, vector(unit.move_amt.x, unit.move_amt.y)}
			end
		end
			
		-- update autotiling
		if unit.tiling and not skip_tiling then
			unit:update_tiling_nearby()
		end
	end
	
	function unit:draw()
		-- lava steals watr sprite
		if unit.name == "lava" then
			pal(12, 9)
		end
		
		-- color modifiers
		if unit.properties.pink then
			for i = 1, 15 do
				pal(i, 14)
			end
		end
			
		if unit.directional then
			local sprite = unit.dir.x ~= 0 and 1 or unit.dir.y == -1 and 2 or 3
			
			spr(directional_sprites[unit.name][sprite], unit.draw_x, unit.draw_y, 1, 1, unit.dir.x == -1, false)
		else
			spr(unit.spr, unit.draw_x, unit.draw_y)
		end
		
		pal()
	end
	
	function unit:slide_pos()
		local targ_x, targ_y = self.x * 8, self.y * 8
		
		if end_cutscene and unit.collected then
			self.draw_x += (blossom.x - 4 - self.draw_x) * 0.2
	  self.draw_y += (blossom.y - 4 - self.draw_y) * 0.2

function read_text(dirx, diry)
	local firstwords = {}
	
	-- make a list of words that could possibly be the first word in a sentence
	-- aka nouns not preceded by NOT or a condition
	for noun in all(noun_units) do
		local x, y = noun.x - dirx, noun.y - diry
		
		-- skip through NOTs and look at words before that
		-- ex: BABA ON NOT NOT KEKE IS YOU - makes sure KEKE isn't considered a firstword
		
		while word_at("not", x, y) do
			x -= dirx
			y -= diry
		end
		
		local is_firstword = true
	
		-- preceded by AND & a noun
		if word_at("and", x, y) and text_type_at("noun", x - dirx, y - diry) then
			is_firstword = false
		end
		
		-- preceded by a condition & a noun (with possible NOTs in between)
		if text_type_at("cond", x, y) then
			while word_at("not", x - dirx, y - diry) do
				x -= dirx
				y -= diry
			end
			
			if text_type_at("noun", x - dirx, y - diry) then
				is_firstword = false
			end
		end
		
		if (is_firstword) add(firstwords, noun)
	end
	
	-- start with each firstword and read sentences
	for noun in all(firstwords) do
		local sentence = {}
		local x, y = noun.x + dirx, noun.y + diry
		
		-- scan for NOTs in front
		local px, py = noun.x - dirx, noun.y - diry
		
		repeat
			local prefix_not = word_at("not", px, py)
			if prefix_not then
				add(sentence, prefix_not, 1)
				
				px -= dirx
				py -= diry
			end
		until not prefix_not
		
		-- add the noun itself to the sentence
		add(sentence, noun)
		
		-- used if jumping to ::after_firstword:: from the conditional block
		local verb_after_cond
		-- used if jumping to a condition after a NOT
		local cond_after_not
		-- if the sentence has an invalid part at the end we forget about it and submit the last valid version of it
		local last_valid_sentence
		
		::after_firstword::
		
		-- get possible next words
		local verb = verb_after_cond or text_type_at("verb", x, y)
		local noun_and = word_at("and", x, y)
		local cond = cond_after_not or text_type_at("cond", x, y)
		local cond_not = word_at("not", x, y)
		
		if verb then
			add(sentence, verb)
			
			x += dirx
			y += diry
			
			::property::
			
			-- NOT after verb
			x, y = check_nots(x, y, dirx, diry, sentence)
			
			local prop = text_type_at("prop", x, y) 
				or text_type_at("noun", x, y)
			
			if prop then
				add(sentence, prop)
				
				x += dirx
				y += diry
				
				-- backup the sentence since it should technically be valid now
				last_valid_sentence = {}
				for k, v in pairs(sentence) do
					last_valid_sentence[k] = v
				end
				
				-- multiple properties separated by AND
				local prop_and = word_at("and", x, y)
				if prop_and then
					add(sentence, prop_and)
					
					x += dirx
					y += diry
					
					goto property
				end
				
				-- complete sentence
				add(code, sentence)
				
				goto continue
			else
				if last_valid_sentence then
					add(code, last_valid_sentence)
				end
				
				goto continue
			end
		elseif noun_and then
			-- multiple subjects separated by AND
			add(sentence, noun_and)
			
			x += dirx
			y += diry
			
			x, y = check_nots(x, y, dirx, diry, sentence)
			
			local noun2 = text_type_at("noun", x, y)
			if noun2 then
				add(sentence, noun2)
				
				x += dirx
				y += diry
				
				goto after_firstword
			else
				goto continue
			end
		elseif cond then
			-- ★ conditionals ★
			add(sentence, cond)
			
			x += dirx
			y += diry
			
			::another_cond::
			
			x, y = check_nots(x, y, dirx, diry, sentence)
			
			-- noun after condition
			local noun2 = text_type_at("noun", x, y)
			if noun2 then
				add(sentence, noun2)
				
				x += dirx
				y += diry
			else
				goto continue
			end
			
			-- more nouns
			local cond_and = word_at("and", x, y)
			if cond_and then
				add(sentence, cond_and)
				
				x += dirx
				y += diry
				
				goto another_cond
			end
			
			-- end of condition (jump to verb, but ::property:: isn't visible so we'll jump right outside it and force entry)
			local verb = text_type_at("verb", x, y)
			if verb then
				verb_after_cond = verb
				
				goto after_firstword
			end
			
			goto continue
		elseif cond_not then
			add(sentence, cond_not)
			
			x += dirx
			y += diry
			
			-- multiple NOTs
			x, y = check_nots(x, y, dirx, diry, sentence)
			
			local cond = text_type_at("cond", x, y)
			
			if cond then
				cond_after_not = cond
				
				goto after_firstword
			end
			
			goto continue
		else
			goto continue
		end
		
		::continue::
	end
end

function check_nots(x, y, dirx, diry, sentence)
	repeat
		local not_word = word_at("not", x, y)
		if not_word then
			add(sentence, not_word)
			
			x += dirx
			y += diry
		end
	until not not_word
	
	return x, y
end

function add_rule(rule)
	local sentence = {}
	for word in all(split(rule, "-")) do
		local spr = sprites["t_" .. word]
		
		add(sentence, {
			name = "t_" .. word,
			noun = fget(spr, 1),
			verb = fget(spr, 2),
			prop = fget(spr, 3),
			cond = fget(spr, 4)
		})

function apply_properties()
	prop_lookup = {}
	
	-- clear unit properties
	for unit in all(units) do
		unit.properties = {}
	end
	
	for sentence in all(code) do
		local subj_nouns = {}
		local verb
		local props = {}
		local cond
		local cond_nouns = {}
		
		-- cond preceded by NOT
		local not_cond
		
		for i, word in ipairs(sentence) do
			local name = sub(word.name, 3)
			
			-- attach NOT to words
			if ((word.noun or word.prop) and i > 1 and sentence[i - 1].name == "t_not") name = "not_" .. name
			if (word.cond and i > 1 and sentence[i - 1].name == "t_not") not_cond = true
			
			if (word.cond) cond = name
			if (word.verb) verb = name
			
			if verb then
				-- add properties
				if (word.noun or word.prop) add(props, name)
			elseif cond then
				-- add nouns as the condition of the sentence
				if (word.noun) add(cond_nouns, name)
			else
				-- add nouns as the subject of the sentence
				if (word.noun) add(subj_nouns, name)
			end
		end
		
		-- actually apply properties
		if verb == "is" then
			local selected_units = {}
			
			for subj in all(subj_nouns) do
				if subj == "text" or subj == "not_all" then
					selected_units = text_units
				elseif subj == "all" or subj == "not_text" then
					for unit in all(units) do
						if (not unit.text) add(selected_units, unit)
					end
				elseif sub(subj, 1, 4) == "not_" then
					-- subject preceded by NOT
					for unit in all(units) do
						if unit.name ~= sub(subj, 5) and not unit.text then
							add(selected_units, unit)
						end
					end
				else
					selected_units = name_lookup[subj]
				end
				
				-- apply to selected units (if condition is met)
				for unit in all(selected_units) do
					if not cond or check_cond(unit, cond, cond_nouns, not_cond) then
						for prop in all(props) do
							unit:add_prop(prop)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			color(7)
			?"unsupported verb used: " .. (verb and verb.name or "nil")
			for i, word in ipairs(sentence) do
				?word.name
			end
			stop()
		end
	end
	
	-- cancel out properties
	for unit in all(units) do
		for k, v in pairs(unit.properties) do
			if sub(k, 1, 4) == "not_" then
				local prop = sub(k, 5)
				unit.properties[prop] = nil
				del(prop_lookup[prop], unit)
			end
		end
	end
end

function check_cond(unit, cond, cond_nouns, not_cond)
	local cond_met = true
	if cond == "on" then
		for name in all(cond_nouns) do
			for other in all(name_lookup[name]) do
				if unit ~= other and unit.x == other.x and unit.y == other.y then
					goto on_type
				end
			end
			
			cond_met = false
			
			::on_type::
		end
	elseif cond == "near" then
		for name in all(cond_nouns) do
			for other in all(name_lookup[name]) do
				if other ~= unit and abs(unit.x - other.x) <= 1 and abs(unit.y - other.y) <= 1 then
					goto next_name
				end
			end
			cond_met = false
			
			::next_name::
		end
	elseif cond == "with" then
		for name in all(cond_nouns) do
			if #name_lookup[name] == 0 then
				cond_met = false
				break
			end
		end
	end
	
	if (not_cond) cond_met = not cond_met
	
	return cond_met
end

function add_undo()
	local state = {}
	local last_state = undos[#undos]
	local changed = false
	
	for unit in all(units) do
		local last_unit = last_state and last_state[unit.id]
		if last_unit then
			local x, y, dir = unpack(last_unit)
			
			-- only add to the undo state if one of its values changed
			if not (x == unit.x and y == unit.y and dir.x == unit.dir.x and dir.y == unit.dir.y) then
				state[unit.id] = {unit.x, unit.y, vector(unit.dir.x, unit.dir.y)}
				changed = true
			else
				-- add pointer to last state to not take up too much memory
				state[unit.id] = last_state[unit.id]
			end
		else
			state[unit.id] = {unit.x, unit.y, vector(unit.dir.x, unit.dir.y)}
			changed = true
		end
	end
	
	-- don't add if nothing changed
	if changed then
		add(undos, state)
	end
	
	-- forget earlier undos if reaching the memory limit
	while stat(0) > 1800 do
		deli(undos, 1)
	end
end

function undo()
	local state = deli(undos, #undos)
	
	for unit in all(units) do
		local last_unit = state[unit.id] or get_last(unit)
		
		if last_unit then
			local x, y, dir = unpack(last_unit)
			local changed_pos = false
			
			-- tiling
			if unit.x ~= x or unit.y ~= y then
				changed_pos = true
				unit:update_tiling_nearby()
			end
			
			unit.x, unit.y, unit.dir = x, y, vector(dir.x, dir.y)
		
			if changed_pos then
				unit:update_tiling_nearby()
				
				unit:remove_from_grid()
				unit:add_to_grid()
			end
		
			-- remove from the list so all that's left is units that need to be created
			state[unit.id] = nil
		else
			-- unit didn't exist in the past and must be destroyed
			unit:destroy(true, true)
			unit:update_tiling_nearby(true)
		end
	end
	
	-- recreate units that were destroyed
	-- the only units still in the list at this point are the ones that don't exist now but did last turn
	-- since each unit removes itself from the list as it goes
	for id, unit in pairs(state) do
		local x, y, dir, name, move_amt = unpack(unit)
		if name then
			new_unit(name, x, y, {dir = dir, id = id, draw_x = (x + move_amt.x) * 8, draw_y = (y + move_amt.y) * 8})
		end
	end
	
	qsfx"62"
end

function get_last(unit, turns_back)
	for i = #undos - (turns_back or 0), 1, -1 do
		local last = undos[i][unit.id]
		if last then
			return last
		end
	end
end

description: Disclaimer: While this demake does contain an introduction level for each new element, I would highly recommend you play the original game before this! Because the demake is a lot shorter than the original, the difficulty ramps up faster than it probably should. Controls Arrows - Move X/V - Undo C/Z - Idle R - Restart level T - Title screen Levels There are 4 "worlds" containing 8 levels each, adding up to 32 levels in total. Save Data Your progress will be saved automatically. It will keep track of which levels you've unlocked, which one you were currently on, and your time. You can clear your save data from the pause menu. You can also press "U" to unlock all levels in your save. Visibility Since some text can be hard to read depending on the background, there is an option in the pause menu to disable text darkening whenever a piece of text isn't part of a sentence. Walkthrough If you need help with any levels, you can reference this walkthrough: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5RoxG4gywTo Credits Baba Is You - By Hempuli (Arvi Teikari) Baba Is You Demake - By ooooggll (me) Playtesting - The Baba Is You Discord PICO-8 - By Lexaloffle Making of Baba Is You Demake This project started over a year ago, in a different form. Originally it was called Ba Is Yo, as I was using a larger text size that only allowed for two letters per word (the rest of the word had to be extrapolated by the player). I got pretty far into this project but ran into severe lag issues which killed my motivation. I also got a little ambitious with some of the features, namely the fact that I tried to implement WORD. A few months later, I restarted basically from scratch, with much better optimizations in place. I also managed to get condition-type text working with the text interpreter! The last few optimizations were related to autotiling and didn't actually happen until the last minute, for some reason. I'm really happy with how smoothly it runs now though. -- dust bunny
-- by adam atomic

adj = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}}
dt = {17,18,19,20,21,22,23}
introtime = 50
sparkles = {}
dusts = {}
blocks = {}

function _init()
	title = true
	ending = false
	endtimer = 0
	
	cartdata("dust_bunny")
	level = dget(0)
end

function loadlevel()
	win = false
	wintime = 0
	left = 0
	pspr = 1
	topy = 16
	sx = (level%8)*16
	sy = flr(level/8)*16
	for y=0,15 do
		for x=0,15 do
			t = mget(sx+x,sy+y)
			if t != 0 and y < topy then
				topy = y
			end
			if t == 1 or t == 5 then
				px = x
				py = y
				psx = 0
				psy = 0
				mset(x,y,0)
				offsets = {{0,0,t}}
			elseif dirt(t) then
				left += 1
				mset(x,y,rnd(dt))
				dust(x,y)
			else
				if level < 4 and t >= 2 and t <= 4 then
					block(x,y)
				end
				mset(x,y,t)
			end
		end
	end
	collect()
end

function collect()
	collected = false
	for po in all(offsets) do
		for a in all(adj) do
			pax = px+po[1]+a[1]
			pay = py+po[2]+a[2]
			t = mget(pax,pay)
			if t >= 2 and t <= 4 then
				add(offsets,{pax-px,pay-py,t})
				mset(pax,pay,0)
				block(pax,pay)
				collected = true
			end
		end
	end
	if collected then
		psx = 0
		psy = 0
	 collect()
	end
end

function _update()
	if ending then
		runending()
		return
	end
	if title then
		runtitle()
		return
	end
	if intro > 0 then
		runintro()
		return
	end
	if win then
		runwin()
		return
	end
	input()
	move()
	if left == 0 then
		level += 1
		if level <= 30 then
			dset(0,level)
		else
			dset(0,0)
		end
		win = true
		wintime = 0
	end
end

function runending()
	if endtimer == 0 then
		px = -1
		py = 7
		for y=0,15 do
			for x=0,15 do
				mset(x,y,0)
			end
		end
	end
	if (endtimer<500) endtimer += 1
	if endtimer > 60 and (btnp(4) or btnp(5)) then
		run()
		return
	end
	delay = 5
	if px < 16 and endtimer > 50 and endtimer%delay==0 then
		px += 1
		psx = -4
		mset(px,py,rnd(dt))
		dust(px,py)
	end
end

function runtitle()
	if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		title = false
		if (level<=0) level = 1
		intro = introtime
	end
end

function runintro()
	intro -= 1
	if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		intro = 0
	end
	if (intro<=0) loadlevel()
end

function runwin()
	if (wintime<500) wintime+=1
	rf = min(31,wintime)
	for r=0,rf do
		for y=0,r do
			for x=0,r-y do
				t = mget(min(15,x),min(15,y))
				if wall(t) then
				 mset(x,y,t+16)
				 sparkle(x,y)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if wintime>90 or btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		for s in all(sparkles) do
			del(sparkles,s)
		end
		sparkles = {}
		if level <= 30 then
			intro = introtime
		else
			ending = true
			offsets = {{0,0,5}}
		end
		return
	end
end

function input()
	if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		loadlevel()
		return
	end
	nx = 0
	ny = 0
	if (btnp(0)) nx = -1
	if (btnp(1)) nx =  1
	if (btnp(2)) ny = -1
	if (btnp(3)) ny =  1
	if (ny!=0) nx = 0
end

function move()
	if (nx==0 and ny==0) return
	hitwall = false
	for po in all(offsets) do
		npx = px+po[1]+nx
		npy = py+po[2]+ny
		t = mget(npx,npy)
		if wall(t) then
			hitwall = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not hitwall then
		for po in all(offsets) do
			if po[3] == 3 or po[3] == 5 then
				tx = px+po[1]
				ty = py+po[2]
				mset(tx,ty,rnd(dt))
				dust(tx,ty)
				left += 1
			end
		end
		px += nx
		py += ny
		psx = -nx*4
		psy = -ny*4
		collect()
		for po in all(offsets) do
			tx = px+po[1]
			ty = py+po[2]
			t = mget(tx,ty)
			if dirt(t) then
				mset(tx,ty,0)
				left -= 1
				if po[3] == 4 then
					po[3] = 3
				end
				dust(tx,ty)
			end
		end
	end
end

function sparkle(x,y)
	add(sparkles,{8,x*8+rnd(8)-4,y*8+rnd(8)-4})
end

function dust(x,y)
	add(dusts,{8,x*8+rnd(8)-4,y*8+rnd(8)-4-2})
end

function block(x,y)
	add(blocks,{8,x*8,y*8})
end

function dirt(t)
	return t >= 16 and t <= 31
end

function wall(t)
	return t >= 32 and t <= 47
end

function _draw()
	cls()
	if title then
		drawtitle()
		return
	end
	if ending then
		drawending()
		return
	end
	if intro > 0 then
		drawintro()
		return
	end
	drawmap()
	drawplayer()
	drawpings()
end

function drawtitle()
	map()
	pry = 100
	rectfill(44,pry-4,82,pry+8,2)
	msg = "resume"
	if (level == 0)	msg = "begin"
	print(msg,64-#msg*2,pry,7)
end

function drawending()
	if endtimer >= 20 then
		msg = "the end"
		print(msg,64-#msg*2,57,7)
		map()
		drawplayer()
		drawpings()
	end
end

function drawintro()
	if intro < 35 then
		msg = "level "..level
		print(msg,64-#msg*2,60,7)
	end
end

function drawmap()
	if (wintime>=28)	pal(1,7)
	map()
	pal()
	if level >= 4 and not win then
		for l=1,30 do
			clr = 1
			if (l == level) clr = 13
			pset(33+l*2,topy*8+2,clr)
		end
	end
end

function drawplayer()
	hop = 0
	if psx != 0 then
		psx = psx/2
		if(abs(psx)<1) psx = 0
		hop = 2
	end
	if psy != 0 then
		psy = psy/2
		if(abs(psy)<1) psy = 0
		hop = 2
	end
	if (psy < 0) hop = 4
	apx = px*8+psx
	apy = py*8+psy
	for po in all(offsets) do
		spr(po[3],apx+po[1]*8,apy+po[2]*8-hop)
	end
end

function drawpings()
	for d in all(dusts) do
		d[1] -= 1
		if d[1] == 0 then
			del(dusts,d)
		else
			sp = 31-flr(d[1]/2)
			spr(sp,d[2],d[3])
		end
	end
	for b in all(blocks) do
		b[1] -= 1
		if b[1] == 0 then
			del(blocks,b)
		else
			bt = b[1]/2
			rect(b[2]-4+bt,b[3]-4+bt,b[2]+12-bt,b[3]+12-bt,7)
		end
	end
	for s in all(sparkles) do
		s[1] -= 1
		if s[1] == 0 then
			del(sparkles,s)
		else
			sp = 27-flr(s[1]/2)
			spr(sp,s[2],s[3])
		end
	end
end

function colli(xx,yy)
	local x1=flr((xx+2)/8)
	local y1=flr((yy+4)/8)

	local dl=fget(mget(x1,y2),0)

	return 0
	else
	return 1
	end

function dist(x0,y0,x1,y1)
  -- scale inputs down by 6 bits
  local dx=(x0-x1)/64
  local dy=(y0-y1)/64
  
  -- get distance squared
  local dsq=dx*dx+dy*dy
  
  -- in case of overflow/wrap
  if(dsq<0) return 32767.99999
  
  -- scale output back up by 6 bits
  return sqrt(dsq)*64
end

description: Pico Valley! I love that cozy games are finally getting big, and one of my favorite cozy games is,without a doubt, Stardew Valley. I played Harvest Moon growing up and enjoyed it a lot, but when somebody told me about Stardew Valley my mind was just blown. This is why I decided to make a Stardew Valley demake that i could have played growing up. Update:18.11.23 I hate reading old code. Well at least I can be sure I got better since April :D Let's go. added the ability to play the brilliant Journey Of The Prairie King Demake which was quite the undertaking. A lot of things needed to work together in order to return the player to the original game with all of the progress saved. Read more about it on the Journey Of The Prairie King page. repixeled a lot of sprites, toned down the contrast added the graveyard added the saloon and 2 new NPC`s added save file detection rewrote token wastezones(the rest of the code is still a hot mess though) adjusted the time scale to 0,7 of the previous value increased the maximum energy added an interaction indicator Update:23.4.23 rebalanced some values you now loose some items if you fall unconcious made music track longer update mining palette It is a 64x64 recreation of Pelican Town and some of its residents. The code started out clean but got messy fast because i wanted to finish this game. I made some boxart and a manual for the game: Before i upload this to itch.io i wanted to upload it here. Here are a few pages from the manual: Things to note: -if you want to keep your progress open the game in Pico8, your progress is saved on every new day -get your fishing rod at the beach -enjoy yourself and don't hesitate to report bugs! -this is somewhat modable and i encourage everybody to make their own little town and characters. author: LokiStriker
description: "From Rust To Ash" is roguelike auto battler where your items are your build. Fight, Loot, Scavenge. Arrange your items to benefit from each other, store items in your backpack for future synergies, scrap what you don't need to increase your health. Do all that you need to survive the encounters before you. The game is designed to be completely played with a mouse, and aided by a keyboard. For Mobile and Handheld users, there is an option in the pause menu (Pause or P on Keyboard) that allows to change turn mouse mode off and allow the directional buttons / joystick to move the cursor, using the "X" button to simulate mouse clicks. On both Mouse/Keyboard and on Mobile/Handheld, the game uses the (Z) key or (O) button to open the inventory when possible. Special thanks to: Epicheezeness, Achie72, LouieChapm, Otto_Piramithu, SmellyFishstiks, Werxzy, Krystman, Zep, Squidlight, Pancelor If you liked the game, consider supporting me by purchasing a copy on https://lokistriker.itch.io/rust . The full version adds some additional items to the roster, as well as a couple of characters you get to pick from at the start of the game. Thank you for playing and I hope you like it!

function create_selector_player(x, y)
  local sp = create_moving_basic(x, y, 8, 8, 3, 0, 0)
  sp.selecting = 0
  sp.moving = false
  --animation things
  --sp.current_spr = 1
  sp.anim_table = ANIM_PLAYER_WALK_D
  sp.anim_index = 1
  sp.prev_dir = sp.direction
  sp.flip_sprite = false
  --draw function
  sp.draw = function(self)
    spr(self.anim_table[self.anim_index], self.pos_x, self.pos_y, 1, 1, self.flip_sprite)
  end
  sp.update = function(self)
    --if direction changes, reset animation index
    if self.direction != self.prev_dir then
      self.anim_index = 1
      self.flip_sprite = false
      self.prev_dir = self.direction
      --update animation table based on direction
      if self.direction == 0 then
        self.flip_sprite = true
        self.anim_table = ANIM_PLAYER_WALK_R
      elseif self.direction == 1 then
        self.anim_table = ANIM_PLAYER_WALK_U
      elseif self.direction == 2 then
        self.anim_table = ANIM_PLAYER_WALK_L
      elseif self.direction == 3 then
        self.anim_table = ANIM_PLAYER_WALK_D
      end
    end
    --increment animation index every 3 frames
    if not self.moving then
      self.anim_index = 2
    elseif select_time % 3 == 0 then
      --loop to begining when index gets too big
      if self.anim_index + 1 > count(self.anim_table) then
        self.anim_index = 1
      else
        self.anim_index += 1
      end
    end
    --reset self velocities
    self.vel_x, self.vel_y = 0, 0
    --[[update inputs]]
    if my_transition.transit_state == "rest" then
      --only move when my_transition is in resting state
      if btn(0) and prev_inputs[1] == false then newest_input = 0 end
      if btnp(1) and prev_inputs[2] == false then newest_input = 1 end
      if btnp(2) and prev_inputs[3] == false then newest_input = 2 end
      if btnp(3) and prev_inputs[4] == false then newest_input = 3 end
      prev_inputs = { btn(0), btn(1), btn(2), btn(3) }
      --set direction and velocities based on inputs
      if (btn(0) or btn(1)) and (btn(2) or btn(3)) then
        if newest_input == 0 and btn(0) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 2, -1
        elseif newest_input == 1 and btn(1) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 0, 1
        elseif newest_input == 2 and btn(2) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 1, -1
        elseif newest_input == 3 and btn(3) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 3, 1
        end
      elseif btn(0) or btn(1) then
        if btn(0) and btn(1) then
          --do nothing
        elseif btn(0) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 2, -1
        elseif btn(1) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 0, 1
        end
      else
        if btn(2) and btn(3) then
          --do nothing
        elseif btn(2) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 1, -1
        elseif btn(3) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 3, 1
        end
      end
    end
    --update selector player moving variable
    if self.vel_x == 0 and self.vel_y == 0 then
      self.moving = false
    else
      self.moving = true
    end
    --limit selector player movement to screen
    local future_px = self.pos_x + self.vel_x
    local future_py = self.pos_y + self.vel_y
    if future_px < 0 or future_px > 128 - self.width then self.vel_x = 0 end
    if future_py < 15 or future_py > 100 - self.height then self.vel_y = 0 end
    --update position
    self.pos_x += self.vel_x
    self.pos_y += self.vel_y
  end
  return sp
end

--CREATE **THE** PLAYER
function create_player()
  local player = create_moving_basic(0, 0, 8, 8, 3, 0, 0)
  player.alive = true
  player.finished = false
  --just a lil' cooldown
  player.shock_cooldown = 0
  player.my_spr = 17
  player.anim_cooldown = 0
  player.anim_index = 1
  player.anim_start = SPR_PLAYER_DOWN_START
  player.spr_flip = false
  --draw function
  player.draw = function(self)
    if player.alive then
      spr(self.my_spr, self.pos_x, self.pos_y, 1, 1, self.spr_flip)
    else
      spr(SPR_PLAYER_DEAD, self.pos_x, self.pos_y)
    end
  end
  --update function
  player.update = function(self)
    --[[update inputs]]
    self.vel_x, self.vel_y = 0, 0
    --only move when shock_cooldown is 0
    if self.shock_cooldown == 0 then
      --check most recent inputs
      if btn(0) and prev_inputs[1] == false then newest_input = 0 end
      if btnp(1) and prev_inputs[2] == false then newest_input = 1 end
      if btnp(2) and prev_inputs[3] == false then newest_input = 2 end
      if btnp(3) and prev_inputs[4] == false then newest_input = 3 end
      prev_inputs = { btn(0), btn(1), btn(2), btn(3) }
      --set direction and velocities based on inputs
      if (btn(0) or btn(1)) and (btn(2) or btn(3)) then
        if newest_input == 0 and btn(0) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 2, -1
        elseif newest_input == 1 and btn(1) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 0, 1
        elseif newest_input == 2 and btn(2) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 1, -1
        elseif newest_input == 3 and btn(3) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 3, 1
        end
      elseif btn(0) or btn(1) then
        if btn(0) and btn(1) then
          --do nothing
        elseif btn(0) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 2, -1
        elseif btn(1) then
          self.direction, self.vel_x = 0, 1
        end
      else
        if btn(2) and btn(3) then
          --do nothing
        elseif btn(2) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 1, -1
        elseif btn(3) then
          self.direction, self.vel_y = 3, 1
        end
      end
    end
    --handles collisions and position update for player
    solid_collisions(self)
    --shock cooldown
    if self.shock_cooldown > 0 then self.shock_cooldown -= 1 end
    --shoot shock
    if btnp(4) and self.shock_cooldown == 0 then
      sfx(3)
      local sh_table = this_level.elements.shocks
      local adj_x = self.pos_x + direc_to_vel_x(self.direction, self.width)
      local adj_y = self.pos_y + direc_to_vel_y(self.direction, self.width)
      add(sh_table, create_shock(adj_x, adj_y, self.direction, 1, sh_table))
      self.shock_cooldown = PLAYER_DEFAULT_SH_COOLDOWN
    end
    --[[animation update]]
    --update anim_start and spr_flip based on direction
    if self.direction == 0 then
      self.anim_start = SPR_PLAYER_SIDE_START
      self.spr_flip = true
    elseif self.direction == 1 then
      self.anim_start = SPR_PLAYER_UP_START
      self.spr_flip = false
    elseif self.direction == 2 then
      self.anim_start = SPR_PLAYER_SIDE_START
      self.spr_flip = false
    elseif self.direction == 3 then
      self.anim_start = SPR_PLAYER_DOWN_START
      self.spr_flip = false
    end
    --check if player is moving
    if self.vel_x != 0 or self.vel_y != 0 then
      --set sprite
      self.my_spr = self.anim_start + self.anim_index
      --subtract cooldown
      self.anim_cooldown -= 1
    else
      --when player is not moving
      --set sprite to stand (index 1)
      self.my_spr = self.anim_start + 1
      --if shock_cooldown is "active", set to "shock face"
      if self.shock_cooldown > 0 then
        if self.direction == 0 or self.direction == 2 then
          self.my_spr = SPR_PLAYER_SHOCK_SIDE
        elseif self.direction == 3 then
          self.my_spr = SPR_PLAYER_SHOCK_DOWN
        end
      end
    end
    --cooldown update
    if self.anim_cooldown < 1 then
      self.anim_cooldown = PLAYER_ANIM_CD_MAX
      self.anim_index += 1
      if self.anim_index > 3 then
        self.anim_index = 0
      end
    end
  end
  return player
end

  --(-1): no selection
  --(0): go to home menu
  --(1): go to controls menu
  --(2): go to credits menu
  --(3): go to level select menu
  --(4): go to level menu (game)
  --(5): go to final menu
  tm.selected_next_menu = -1

  --draw function
  tm.draw = function(self)
    if self.transit_state == "close" then
      rectfill(0, 0, self.rect_width, 128, 1)
    elseif self.transit_state == "open" then
      rectfill(self.rect_width, 0, 128, 128, 1)
    elseif self.transit_state == "rest" then
      --draw nothing
    end
    if debug_toggle then
      print("state:" .. self.transit_state, 2, 64, 7)
    end
  end
  --update function
  tm.update = function(self)
    --check change_ready
    if self.change_ready then
      self:change_game_menu(my_transition.selected_next_menu)
      self:start_open_transit()
    end
    --handle transition states
    if self.transit_state == "close" then
      if self.close_time > 0 then
        self.close_time -= 1
        self.rect_width += self.rect_change_spd
      else
        --when done "closing"
        self.change_ready = true
      end
    elseif self.transit_state == "open" then
      if self.open_time > 0 then
        self.open_time -= 1
        self.rect_width += self.rect_change_spd
      else
        --when done "opening"
        self.transit_state = "rest"
        self.select_next_menu = -1
        self.rect_width = 0
      end
    end
  end
  --change game menu function
  tm.change_game_menu = function(self, menu)
    if menu == 0 then
      _draw = home_draw
      _update = home_update
    elseif menu == 1 then
      _draw = controls_draw
      _update = controls_update
    elseif menu == 2 then
      _draw = credits_draw
      _update = credits_update
    elseif menu == 3 then
      _draw = select_draw
      _update = select_update
    elseif menu == 4 then
      _draw = level_draw
      _update = level_update
    elseif menu == 5 then
      _draw = final_draw
      _update = final_update
    end
  end
  --start closing transition function
  --runs only when transit_state is "rest"!
  tm.start_close_transit = function(self, menu)
    if self.transit_state == "rest" then
      self.transit_state = "close"
      self.close_time = TRANSITION_TIME_MAX
      self.selected_next_menu = menu
    end
  end
  --start open transition function
  tm.start_open_transit = function(self)
    self.change_ready = false
    self.transit_state = "open"
    self.rect_width = 0
    self.open_time = TRANSITION_TIME_MAX
  end
  return tm
end

function create_particle(x, y, type, tb)
  --TYPE GUIDE
  --(1) - Smoke
  --(2) - Fizzle
  local my_vx, my_vy = 0, 0
  if type == 1 then
    my_vx, my_vy = rnd(1) - .5, rnd(1) - .5
  end
  local par = create_moving_basic(x, y, 2, 2, 0, my_vx, my_vy)
  par.life = PARTICLE_LIFE
  par.my_table = tb
  par.anim_cd = 0
  par.my_spr = 0
  par.spr_end = 0
  --type adjustments
  if type == 1 then
    par.my_spr = SPR_SMOKE_START
    par.spr_end = SPR_SMOKE_END
  else
    par.my_spr = SPR_FIZZLE_START
    par.spr_end = SPR_FIZZLE_END
  end
  --draw function
  par.draw = function(self)
    spr(self.my_spr, self.pos_x, self.pos_y)
  end
  --update function
  par.update = function(self)
    --update sprite
    if self.anim_cd > 0 then
      self.anim_cd -= 1
    else
      if self.my_spr < self.spr_end then
        self.my_spr += 1
      end
      self.anim_cd = PARTICLE_ANIM_CD
    end
    --update life
    if self.life > 0 then
      self.life -= 1
    else
      del(self.my_table, self)
    end
    --update position
    self.pos_x += self.vel_x
    self.pos_y += self.vel_y
  end
  return par
end

--Check overlap between two objects
--Must have pos_x, pos_y, width, and height variables
function overlap_check(o1, o2)
  local x_check, y_check = false, false
  if o1.pos_x + o1.width > o2.pos_x and o2.pos_x + o2.width > o1.pos_x then
    x_check = true
  end
  if o1.pos_y + o1.height > o2.pos_y and o2.pos_y + o2.height > o1.pos_y then
    y_check = true
  end
  return x_check and y_check
end

--Check overlap between two objects
--object 1's parameters are plugged in manually
--used for checking future overlaps
function overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, o2)
  local x_check, y_check = false, false
  local o1_px, o1_py = x, y
  if o1_px + w > o2.pos_x and o2.pos_x + o2.width > o1_px then
    x_check = true
  end
  if o1_py + h > o2.pos_y and o2.pos_y + o2.height > o1_py then
    y_check = true
  end
  return x_check and y_check
end

--Check overlap with "solid" objects at specific coordinates
--solid objects include switches, cannons, and walls
function overlap_solids_check(x, y, w, h)
  for sw in all(this_level.elements.switches) do
    if overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, sw) then return true end
  end
  for cn in all(this_level.elements.cannons) do
    if overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, cn) then return true end
  end
  for wall in all(this_level.elements.walls) do
    if overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, wall) then return true end
  end
  --shock blocks
  for sb in all(this_level.elements.sblocks) do
    if overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, sb) then return true end
  end
  return false
end

--Checks if certain object overlaps with sprite with flag 0.
--Returns boolean
function tile_overlap(x, y, w, h, f)
  local px = x / 8 + this_level.map_x
  local py = y / 8 + this_level.map_y
  local w = (w - 1) / 8
  local h = (h - 1) / 8
  if fget(mget(px, py), f)
      --top left
      or fget(mget(px + w, py), f)
      --top right
      or fget(mget(px, py + h), f)
      --bottom left
      or fget(mget(px + w, py + h), f) then
    -- bottom right
    return true
  end
  return false
end

--handle solid collisions for object (player)
--includes solid tiles and wall objects (add later)
function solid_collisions(o)
  local next_px = o.pos_x + o.vel_x
  local next_py = o.pos_y + o.vel_y

  --horizontal collision and position
  if tile_overlap(next_px, o.pos_y, o.width, o.height, 0)
      or overlap_solids_check(next_px, o.pos_y, o.width, o.height) then
    local xv_sign = sgn(o.vel_x)
    for i = 0, 10 do
      if tile_overlap(o.pos_x + xv_sign, o.pos_y, o.width, o.height, 0)
          or overlap_solids_check(o.pos_x + xv_sign, o.pos_y, o.width, o.height) then
        break
      end
      o.pos_x += xv_sign
    end
    o.vel_x = 0
  end
  --set o.pos_x
  o.pos_x += o.vel_x

  if tile_overlap(o.pos_x, next_py, o.width, o.height, 0)
      or overlap_solids_check(o.pos_x, next_py, o.width, o.height) then
    local yv_sign = sgn(o.vel_y)
    for i = 0, 10 do
      if tile_overlap(o.pos_x, o.pos_y + yv_sign, o.width, o.height, 0)
          or overlap_solids_check(o.pos_x, o.pos_y + yv_sign, o.width, o.height) then
        break
      end
      o.pos_y += yv_sign
    end
    o.vel_y = 0
  end
  --set o.pos_y
  o.pos_y += o.vel_y
end

--[[Return x velocity based on speed]]
function direc_to_vel_x(d, spd)
  if d == 0 then return spd end
  if d == 2 then return spd * -1 end
  return 0
end

--[[Return y velocity based on speed]]
function direc_to_vel_y(d, spd)
  if d == 1 then return spd * -1 end
  if d == 3 then return spd end
  return 0
end

--[[Handle all tasks needed upon completing level]]
function level_complete()
  local adj_t = flr(this_level.level_time / 30)
  --update best time
  if this_level.best_time == 0
      or adj_t < this_level.best_time then
    this_level.best_time = adj_t
  end
  --update starred
  if adj_t <= this_level.star_time then
    this_level.starred = true
  end
  --update game_perfected
  local check_starred = true
  for lev in all(level_table) do
    if not lev.starred then
      check_starred = false
    end
  end
  if check_starred then
    game_perfected = true
  end
  --set level to completed
  this_level.completed = true
  --update level progression index
  if my_level + 1 > progress_index then
    progress_index = my_level + 1
  end
end

    my_transition:start_close_transit(0)
  elseif my_transition.transit_state == "rest"

    end
  end
  --update selector player
  selector_player:update()
  --update selector player's selecting variable (overlapping)
  selector_player.selecting = 0
  for b in all(level_tiles) do
    if overlap_check(b, selector_player) then

      selector_player.selecting = b.index

function level_update()
  my_transition:update()

  if this_level.state == 0 then
    --LEVEL STATE: PLAY

    --go back to level select
    if btnp(5) then
      play_menu_sound(1)
      my_transition:start_close_transit(3)
    end

    --update level time counter
    if this_level.level_time < 9999 then
      this_level.level_time += 1
    end

    --update level game state
    if player.finished then
      level_complete()
      sfx(9)
      my_popup:reset()
      this_level.state = 1
    end
    if not player.alive then
      sfx(8)
      my_popup:reset()
      this_level.state = -1
    end

    --[[
      >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
      START OF OBJECT UPDATES AND INTERACTIONS
      <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
    ]]
    --update shocks
    for sh in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
      sh:update()
      if tile_overlap(sh.pos_x, sh.pos_y, 8, 8, 1) then
        sh.alive = false
      end
      --overlap with wall
      for wa in all(this_level.elements.walls) do
        if overlap_check(wa, sh) then sh.alive = false end
      end
      --overlap with gate
      for ga in all(this_level.elements.gates) do
        if ga.is_on and overlap_check(ga, sh) then sh.alive = false end
      end
      --overlap with cannon
      for ca in all(this_level.elements.cannons) do
        if overlap_check(ca, sh) then sh.alive = false end
      end
      --overlap with shockblock
      for sb in all(this_level.elements.sblocks) do
        --if overlap_check(sb, sh) then sh.alive = false end
      end
      --overlap btwn type 2 and type 1/3 shocks
      if sh.alive and sh.type == 2 then
        for sh_other in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
          if sh_other.alive and (sh_other.type == 1 or sh_other.type == 3) then
            if overlap_check(sh, sh_other) then
              sh.direction = sh_other.direction
              sh.vel_x = direc_to_vel_x(sh_other.direction, 1.5)
              sh.vel_y = direc_to_vel_y(sh_other.direction, 1.5)
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    --update spawners
    for sp in all(this_level.elements.spawners) do
      sp:update()
    end
    --update shock blocks
    for sb in all(this_level.elements.sblocks) do
      sb:update()
    end
    --update switches
    for spw in all(this_level.elements.switches) do
      spw:update()
      for sh in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
        if sh.alive and overlap_check(spw, sh) then
          sfx(4)
          sh.alive = false
          this_level.switched_on = not this_level.switched_on
        end
      end
    end
    --update gates
    for g in all(this_level.elements.gates) do
      g:update()
    end
    --update walls
    for w in all(this_level.elements.walls) do
      w:update()
      --wall overlap with cannonballs
      for cb in all(this_level.elements.cannonballs) do
        if cb.alive and overlap_check(cb, w) then
          cb.alive = false
          w.alive = false
        end
      end
      --wall overlap with explosions
      for ex in all(this_level.elements.explosions) do
        if overlap_check(ex, w) then
          w.alive = false
        end
      end
    end
    --update cannons
    for cn in all(this_level.elements.cannons) do
      cn:update()
    end
    --update cannonballs
    for cb in all(this_level.elements.cannonballs) do
      cb:update()
      --cb and shocks
      for sh in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
        if sh.alive and overlap_check(cb, sh) then
          --change direction and velocity
          sfx(6)
          cb.direction = sh.direction
          cb.vel_x = direc_to_vel_x(sh.direction, 1)
          cb.vel_y = direc_to_vel_y(sh.direction, 1)
          sh.alive = false
        end
      end
      --cb and solid tiles
      if tile_overlap(cb.pos_x, cb.pos_y, cb.width, cb.height, 1) then
        cb.alive = false
      end
      --cb overlap with switches
      for sw in all(this_level.elements.switches) do
        if overlap_check(cb, sw) then cb.alive = false end
      end
      --cb overlap with gates
      for ga in all(this_level.elements.gates) do
        if ga.is_on and overlap_check(cb, ga) then cb.alive = false end
      end
      --cb overlap with other cannonballs
      for oc in all(this_level.elements.cannonballs) do
        if oc != cb and overlap_check(cb, oc) then
          cb.alive = false
          oc.alive = false
        end
      end
      --cb overlap with sparkies
      for sr in all(this_level.elements.sparkies) do
        if overlap_check(cb, sr) then
          cb.alive = false
          sr.alive = false
        end
      end
    end
    --update explosions
    for ex in all(this_level.elements.explosions) do
      ex:update()
    end
    --update sparkies
    for sr in all(this_level.elements.sparkies) do
      sr:update()
      --check overlap with shocks (if alive)
      if sr.alive then
        local is_hit = false
        local contact_dir = 0
        for sh in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
          if overlap_check(sr, sh) then
            sfx(6)
            is_hit = true
            contact_dir = sh.direction
            sr.alive = false
            sh.alive = false
            break
          end
        end
        --create a moving shock if hit
        if is_hit then
          local sh_table = this_level.elements.shocks
          --may have some bugs with direction and things
          add(sh_table, create_shock(sr.pos_x, sr.pos_y, contact_dir, 2, sh_table))
        end
      end
      for gt in all(this_level.elements.gates) do
        if gt.is_on and sr.alive then
          if overlap_check(sr, gt) then
            sr.alive = false
          elseif overlap_check_plus(
            sr.pos_x + sr.vel_x, sr.pos_y, sr.width, sr.height, gt
          ) then
            sr.vel_x = sr.vel_x * -1
          end
        end
      end
    end
    --update particles
    for pr in all(this_level.elements.particles) do
      pr:update()
    end

    --update player
    player:update()

    --PLAYER OVERLAP CHECKS:
    --portal
    if overlap_check(player, portal) then
      player.finished = true
    end
    --cannonballs
    for cb in all(this_level.elements.cannonballs) do
      if overlap_check(player, cb) then player.alive = false end
    end
    --gates
    for ga in all(this_level.elements.gates) do
      if ga.is_on and overlap_check(player, ga) then player.alive = false end
    end
    --sparkies
    for sr in all(this_level.elements.sparkies) do
      if overlap_check(player, sr) then player.alive = false end
    end
    --shocks (not type 1)
    for sh in all(this_level.elements.shocks) do
      if sh.type != 1 and overlap_check(player, sh) then
        player.alive = false
      end
    end

    --[[
      >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
      END OF OBJECT UPDATES AND INTERACTIONS
      <<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
    ]]
  elseif this_level.state == -1 then
    --LEVEL STATE: GAME OVER
    if btnp(4) then
      --reset level
      play_menu_sound(0)
      init_level(my_level)
    elseif btnp(5) then
      --go back to level select
      play_menu_sound(1)
      my_transition:start_close_transit(3)
    end
  elseif this_level.state == 1 then
    --LEVEL STATE: COMPLETE
    if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
      play_menu_sound(0)
      if my_level == 15 then
        my_transition:start_close_transit(5)
      else
        --go back to level select (z)
        my_transition:start_close_transit(3)
      end
    end
  end

  --update regarless of game state
  my_popup:update()
end

function final_update()
  my_transition:update()
  final_time += 1
  --update final flash
  if final_time % 6 == 0 then
    final_flash = not final_flash
  end

  if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
    --stop music
    music(-1)
    --play sfx
    play_menu_sound(0)
    my_transition:start_close_transit(0)
  end
end

-- utils

function vec2(x, y)
	return {
		x = x or 0,
		y = y or 0
	}
end

function sign(v)
	return v>0 and 1 or v<0 and -1 or 0
end

function round(v)
	return flr(v+0.5)
end

function clamp(v, a, b)
	return min(max(min(a, b), v), max(a, b))
end

function move_towards(v,target,step)
	return v > target
		and max(target, v-step) 
		or min(target, v+step)
end

-- timers

function dec_if_active(timer_name)
	if get_timer(timer_name) > 0 then
		timers[timer_name] -= 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function is_timer_active(timer_name)
	return get_timer(timer_name) > 0
end

function get_timer(timer_name)
	return timers[timer_name] or 0
end

-- bounds

function new_bounds(x, y, w, h)
	return {x=x, y=y, w=w or 8, h=h or 8}
end

function copy_bounds(b)
	return new_bounds(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h)
end

function translated(b,x,y)
	return new_bounds(b.x + x, b.y + y, b.w, b.h)
end

function bounds_center(b)
	return vec2(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2)
end

function point_rect_col(p, b)
	return p.x >= b.x 
		and p.x <= b.x + b.w
		and p.y >= b.y 
		and p.y <= b.y + b.h
end

function rect_rect_col(b1, b2)
	return point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x, b1.y), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x + b1.w, b1.y), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x, b1.y + b1.h), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x + b1.w, b1.y + b1.h), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x + b1.w / 2, b1.y), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x + b1.w / 2, b1.y + b1.h), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x, b1.y + b1.h / 2), b2)
		or point_rect_col(vec2(b1.x + b1.w, b1.y + b1.h / 2), b2)
end

function rect_circ_col(b,c,r)	
	local x1=b.x
	local x2=b.x+b.w-1
	local y1=b.y
	local y2=b.y+b.h-1
	local r2=r*r

	return dist_squared(x1,y1,c.x,c.y)<r2
		or dist_squared(x2,y1,c.x,c.y)<r2
		or dist_squared(x1,y2,c.x,c.y)<r2
		or dist_squared(x2,y2,c.x,c.y)<r2
end

function dist_squared(x1,y1,x2,y2)
	return (x2-x1)*(x2-x1)+(y2-y1)*(y2-y1)
end

function center_dist_squared(b1, b2)
	return dist_squared(
		b1.x + b1.w / 2,
		b1.y + b1.h / 2,
		b2.x + b2.w / 2,
		b2.y + b2.h / 2
	)
end

-- From UnitVector (https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?tid=38338)
-- takes in a table of 32 0|1 values
function b32pack(nums)
    local b=0
    for i = 0,31 do
        b=b | nums[i]>>(i-15)
    end
    return b
    -- returns a 32-bit number
end

-- From UnitVector (https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?tid=38338)
-- takes a 32-bit number
function b32unpack(b)
    local nums={}
    for i = 0,31 do
        local s=i-15
        local n=(b&1>>s)<<s
        nums[i]=abs(n)
        -- absolute value must be taken since neg values get a -1 in the last bit
    end
    return nums
    -- returns a table of 32 0|1 values
end

function collides(b, f)
	local x1 = round(b.x) / 8
	local x2 = round(b.x + b.w - 1) / 8
	local y1 = round(b.y) / 8
	local y2 = round(b.y + b.h - 1) / 8

	return fmget(x1, y1, f)
		or fmget(x1, y2, f)
		or fmget(x2, y1, f)
		or fmget(x2, y2, f)
end

function collides6(b, f)
	local x1 = round(b.x) / 8
	local x2 = round(b.x + b.w - 1) / 8
	local y1 = round(b.y) / 8
	local y2 = round(b.y + (b.h / 2)) / 8
	local y3 = round(b.y + b.h - 1) / 8

	return fmget(x1, y1, f)
		or fmget(x1, y2, f)
		or fmget(x2, y1, f)
		or fmget(x2, y2, f)
		or fmget(x1, y3, f)
		or fmget(x2, y3, f)
end

function player_hit(x, y)

	local x1 = b.x + 1
	local x2 = b.x + b.w - 3
	local y1 = b.y
	local y2 = b.y + b.h - 1

	return x >= x1
		and x <= x2
		and y >= y1
		and y <= y2
end

function fmget(x,y,f)
	return fget(mget(x,y),f)
end

function is_grounded()
	if (p_vel.y < 0) return false

	local x1 = round(p_sub_bounds.x) / 8
	local x2 = round(p_sub_bounds.x + p_sub_bounds.w - 1) / 8
	local y = round(p_sub_bounds.y + p_sub_bounds.h)
	local my = y / 8
	local edge = y % 8 == 0
	local not_down = not btn(3)

	return fmget(x1,my, 0)
		or fmget(x2,my, 0)
		or (fmget(x1,my, 1)
			and edge and not_down)
		or (fmget(x2,my, 1)
			and edge and not_down)
end

function is_walkable(mx,my)
	return fmget(mx,my, 0) or fmget(mx,my, 1)
end

function is_on_platform_edge()
	local right,my,x1,x2=p_sub_bounds.x + p_sub_bounds.w - 1,round(p_sub_bounds.y + p_sub_bounds.h) / 8,round(p_sub_bounds.x) / 8,round(p_sub_bounds.x + 2) / 8
	local x3,x4 = round(right) / 8,round(right - 2) / 8
	return (is_walkable(x1,my) and not is_walkable(x2,my)) or (
		is_walkable(x3,my) and not is_walkable(x4,my)
	)
end

function apply_gravity(grounded)
	-- Slide on walls
	if p_friction and p_vel.y > 0 then
		p_vel.y = 0.0005
		return
	end

	if not grounded then
		p_vel.y += gravity
	-- if falling and on ground, freeze y velocity
	elseif p_vel.y > 0 then
		p_vel.y = 0
	end
end

function apply_vel_x()
	-- a step is 1 or -1
	local step_x = sign(p_vel.x)
	-- the number of step
	local amt_x = step_x * round(abs(p_vel.x))

	-- for each x increment
	for i = 0, abs(amt_x) do
		-- detect collision		
		-- if there's no collision
		if not collides6(translated(p_sub_bounds, step_x, 0),0) then
			-- move by that increment
			p_sub_bounds.x += step_x

			-- if that's the last step...
			if i == abs(amt_x) then
				-- try to move by the fractionnal part
				local rem_x = p_vel.x-amt_x
				local rem_bounds = translated(p_sub_bounds, rem_x, 0)
				-- if there's still no collision...
				if not collides6(rem_bounds, 0) then
					-- ...apply fractional part to subpixel bounds
					p_sub_bounds.x += rem_x
				end
			end
		-- if there's a collision
		else
			-- snap sub-pixel position to nearest integer
			p_sub_bounds.x = round(p_sub_bounds.x)
			break
		end
	end

	p_sub_bounds.x = clamp(p_sub_bounds.x, 0, 1018)
end

function apply_vel_y()
	local step_y = sign(p_vel.y)
	local amt_y = step_y * round(abs(p_vel.y))

	for i = 0, abs(amt_y) do
		if check_y(step_y) then
			p_sub_bounds.y += step_y

			-- subpixel check
			if i == abs(amt_y) then
				local rem_y = p_vel.y - amt_y
				if check_y(rem_y) then
					p_sub_bounds.y += rem_y
				else
					p_sub_bounds.y = round(p_sub_bounds.y)
				end
			end
		else
			-- stopped by floor or ceiling
			p_vel.y = 0
			timers.p_jump_frames = 0
			break
		end
	end
end

function check_y(offset_y)
	local col_bounds = translated(p_sub_bounds, 0, offset_y)
	local collides_with_ground = collides(col_bounds, 0)
	local on_1way = p_vel.y>0 and is_grounded()
	return not collides_with_ground and not on_1way
end

function beam(ray_en)

 local y0 = ray_en.bounds.y + ray_en.bounds.h

	local x1,y1=x0 + r1*sin(angle),y0 + r1*cos(angle)

	traverse(x1,y1,x0 + r2*sin(angle),y0 + r2*cos(angle), function(x,y)

		end
		
		if (hit_p) hurt_player()

		return hit_something or d_squared>=ray_en.beam_lgth*ray_en.beam_lgth
	end)

function vision_cone(ray_en)
	local x0 = ray_en.bounds.x + 4
	local y0 = ray_en.bounds.y + ray_en.bounds.h
	local t = ray_en.swing_phase+0.25*(room_frames-ray_en.swing_start)/60
	local base_angle = ray_en.angle_to_target or sin(t)*0.5*0.12
	local points = {}
	local target_found = false
	local angles = {}
	local cone_width = 0.002
	
	add(angles, base_angle)

	if ray_en.angle_to_target != nil then
		add(angles, base_angle - cone_width)
		add(angles, base_angle + cone_width)
	end

	local r = 128

	for _, angle in ipairs(angles) do
		local x1=x0 + r*sin(angle)
		local y1=y0 + r*cos(angle)

		traverse(x0,y0,x1,y1,function(x,y)
			local hit_floor=fmget(x/8, y/8, 0)
			local hit_1way=fmget(x/8, y/8, 1)
			local hit_p=player_hit(x,y)

			if angle==base_angle then
				add(points, vec2(x, y))
			end

			if hit_floor or hit_1way or hit_p then
				if hit_p then
					ray_en.angle_to_target = atan2(
						p_bounds.y + p_bounds.h/2 - y0,
						p_bounds.x + p_bounds.w/2 - x0)
					target_found=true
				end
				return true
			end
			return false
		end)

		ray_en.ray_points=points
	end
end

function traverse(x0, y0, x1, y1, should_break)
	local dx=abs(x1-x0)
	local sx=x0<x1 and 1 or -1
	local dy=-abs(y1-y0)
	local sy=y0<y1 and 1 or -1
	local err=dx+dy
	local max=128
	local count=0

	while true do
		count+=1
		if (count >= max) break
		if(should_break(x0,y0)) break
		if (x0==x1 and y0==y1) break
		local e2=2*err
		if e2>=dy then
			err+=dy
			x0+=sx
		end
		if e2<=dx then
			err+=dx
			y0+=sy
		end
	end
end

function new_carriable(type, x, y, w, h)
	local b = new_bounds(x, y, w, h)

	local carriable = {
		bounds = copy_bounds(b),
		sub_bounds = copy_bounds(b),
		vel = vec2(),
		type = type
	}
	
	function carriable:carried()
		return p_carried == self
	end
	
	function carriable:update()
		if self:carried() then
			local p_v_bounds = new_bounds(p_bounds.x - 1, p_bounds.y, 8, p_bounds.h)
			self.bounds.x = p_v_bounds.x + (p_facing == 0 and 0 or 8) - self.bounds.w / 2
			self.bounds.y = p_v_bounds.y + 1
			self.sub_bounds.x = self.bounds.x
			self.sub_bounds.y = self.bounds.y

			if btnp(4) then
				p_carried = nil
				-- avoid getting stuck in walls
				while collides(self.bounds, 0) do
					self.bounds.x += (p_facing == 0 and 1 or -1)
				end

				self.sub_bounds.x = self.bounds.x
			end
		else
			self:apply_gravity()
			self:apply_vel_y()
			self.bounds.x = round(self.sub_bounds.x)
			self.bounds.y = round(self.sub_bounds.y)

			if btnp(4) and not was_carrying then
				local p_c = p_center()
				local self_c = bounds_center(self.bounds)
				if dist_squared(p_c.x, p_c.y, self_c.x, self_c.y) < 30 then
					p_carried = self
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function carriable:apply_gravity()
		if not self:is_grounded() then
			self.vel.y += gravity
		else
			self.vel.y = 0
		end
	end

	function carriable:is_grounded()
		local b = self.sub_bounds
		local x1 = round(b.x) / 8
		local x2 = round(b.x + b.w - 1) / 8
		local y = round(b.y + b.h)
		local my = y / 8
		local edge = y % 8 == 0

		return fmget(x1,my, 0)
			or fmget(x2,my, 0)
			or (fmget(x1,my, 1) and edge)
			or (fmget(x2,my, 1) and edge)
	end

	function carriable:apply_vel_y()
		local step_y = sign(self.vel.y)
		local amt_y = step_y * round(abs(self.vel.y))

		for i = 0, abs(amt_y) do
			if self:check_y(step_y) then
				self.sub_bounds.y += step_y

				if i == abs(amt_y) then
					local rem_y = self.vel.y - amt_y
					if self:check_y(rem_y) then
						self.sub_bounds.y += rem_y
					else
						self.sub_bounds.y = round(self.sub_bounds.y)
					end
				end
			else
				-- stopped by floor or ceiling
				self.vel.y = 0
				break
			end
		end
	end
	
	function carriable:check_y(offset_y)
		return not collides(translated(self.sub_bounds, 0, offset_y), 0)
			and not (self.vel.y>0 and self:is_grounded())
	end

	return carriable;
end

	local collides = false
	local teleporting = 0
	local dest_x = index == 1 and 0 or 3
	local dest_y = index == 1 and 0 or (index == 2 and 1 or 2)

	return {
		update = function()
			collides = center_dist_squared(b, p_bounds) < 30

				if (teleporting > 25 and not btn(4)) or not collides then

			if teleporting > 0 and teleporting <= 25 then

Everything I know about pal() tells me this can't work. After a good half hour of hair pulling, I finally got it : pal(index,value,1) only cares about the last four bits of the integer value if the index. When you do pal(137,141,1) to replace color 137 with color 141, what pico8 does is pal(137 & 0x0F,141,1) or pal(9,141,1) and you seem to purposefully have placed color 137 in index 9 of the palette for the magic pal to work. ... My last question is WHY !

A rudimentary score system. A practice system, where each boss can be practiced against. And the following mechanics: Slow, your character slows down whilst shooting. How much you slow down depends on your selected character (33% speed for Reimu, 50% for Marisa). Bomb, you start with 3 bombs which can be used to clear the screen. For each enemy you defeat, you get one bomb. Lives, when you get hit, you'll lose a life. When you lose all lives, you game over. Lives cannot be replenished, so don't forget to use your bombs! The amount of lives depends on the difficulty chosen. There's probably plenty of bugs in there (I haven't actually tested highscore scores, it probably possible to overflow it), given how I spent roughly a year developing it (on-and-off). The code is a mess and uses so many global variables. But, it is finished and that's what counts :) I will probably release the project files in the future, but I want to write a proper explanation when I do.

function vec3_unit(v)
	local x1=shr(v[1],2)
	local y1=shr(v[2],2)
	local z1=shr(v[3],2)
	local inv_dist=1/sqrt(x1*x1+y1*y1+z1*z1)
	return {x1*inv_dist,y1*inv_dist,z1*inv_dist}
end

function vec3_length(v)
	local x1=v[1]
	local y1=v[2]
	local z1=v[3]
	return sqrt(x1*x1+y1*y1+z1*z1)

function box_sdf(p,params)

	local lx=max(qx,0)
	local ly=max(qy,0)
	local lz=max(qz,0)
	return vec3_length( {lx,ly,lz})+ min(max(qx,max(qy,qz)),0)

	local speed=k_speed

					local room_items=room_info[room_index].items
					for i,item in pairs(room_items)do


						local dx=item.x-ball.x--+room_x*8
						local dy=item.y-ball.y
						local dz=item.z-ball.z--+room_z*8

						
							local d=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)

			end
		
	else --end player control and logic	
	
		--check if we are close to the player
		local dx,dy,dz = player_ball.x-ball.x,player_ball.y-ball.y,player_ball.z-ball.z
		if(abs(dx)+abs(dz)<5)then
			
			--move towards the ball
			local mag = sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz)
			dx/=mag
			dy/=mag
			dz/=mag
			
			ball.vx+=dx*.01
			ball.vz+=dz*.01
			
			--check intersection with player
			
			if(mag<.5)then
				sfx(1)
				local rvx,rvy,rvz = ball.vx,ball.vy,ball.vz
				local rnx,rny,rnz = dx,dy,dz

				local error=vec3_length({rnx,rny,rnz})
				if(error>1.1)rnx/=error rny/=error rnz/=error--ball.p=vec3_copy(ball.start)return false
				--i don't get where this error is coming from. i think it's related to precision...
				
				--local vel_along_normal = vec3_dot(rv,{rnx,rny,rnz})
				vel_along_normal = rvx*rnx+rvy*rny+rvz*rnz
				local e=1 -- bumper restitution
				 -- ball restitution
				local j = -(.25+e)*vel_along_normal

				local ix,iy,iz=rnx*j,rny*j,rnz*j
				ball.vx = ball.vx+ix*(1/ball.mass)
				ball.vy = ball.vy+iy*(1/ball.mass)
				ball.vz = ball.vz+iz*(1/ball.mass)
				
				player_ball.vx = ball.vx-ix*(1/ball.mass)
				player_ball.vy = ball.vy-iy*(1/ball.mass)
				player_ball.vz = ball.vz-iz*(1/ball.mass)
				

				local resolve=(.25-mag)*.51

				ball.x+=rnx*resolve
				ball.y+=rny*resolve
				ball.z+=rnz*resolve
				
				player_ball.x+=-rnx*resolve
				player_ball.y+=-rny*resolve
				player_ball.z+=-rnz*resolve
			
			
			
			end
			
			
			
		end
	
	end
	
	ball.vx*=k_friction
	ball.vy*=k_friction
	ball.vz*=k_friction

	ball.vy-=k_gravity

	ball.x+=ball.vx
	ball.y+=ball.vy
	ball.z+=ball.vz

	local scene_dist=get_local_sdf(ball.x,ball.y,ball.z,ball.r)
	if(scene_dist<ball.r)then
		
		local rvx,rvy,rvz = ball.vx,ball.vy,ball.vz
		local rnx,rny,rnz = estimate_normal(ball.x,ball.y,ball.z,ball.r)

		local e=1 -- bumper restitution
		 -- ball restitution
		local j = -(ball_restitution+e)*vel_along_normal

		local ix,iy,iz=rnx*j,rny*j,rnz*j
		ball.vx = ball.vx+ix*(1/ball.mass)
		ball.vy = ball.vy+iy*(1/ball.mass)
		ball.vz = ball.vz+iz*(1/ball.mass)

		local resolve=(ball.r-scene_dist)*1.01

		if(resolve>.1)then
			sfx(0)
		elseif(resolve>.05)then
			sfx(2)
		end

		ball.x+=rnx*resolve
		ball.y+=rny*resolve
		ball.z+=rnz*resolve
	end
	
	ball.sx,ball.sy=project_point(ball.x,ball.y,ball.z)
	bx,by,ball.depth=project_point(ball.x,ball.y+.22,ball.z)

function get_local_sdf(x,y,z,r)
	
	local min_d=k_max_d
	for ox=-1,1,2 do
		for oy=-1,1,2 do
			for oz=-1,1,2 do
			local cx=ox*r+x
			local cy=oy*r+y
			local cz=oz*r+z

				local mx,my,mz=nearest_block(cx,cy,cz)
				local block=check_map(mx,my,mz)
				if(block!=false and visible_colors[block.color])then
					local d=block.tile.sdf(x-mx,y-my,z-mz)
					min_d=min(d,min_d)
				else
					min_d=min(y-.05,min_d) -- dist to the ground?
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return min_d
end 

function estimate_normal(px,py,pz,r)

	local d=get_local_sdf(px,py,pz,r)
	local nx=d-get_local_sdf(px-.03,py,pz,r)
	local ny=d-get_local_sdf(px,py-.03,pz,r)
	local nz=d-get_local_sdf(px,py,pz-.03,r)
	local length=1/sqrt(nx*nx+ny*ny+nz*nz)
	return nx*length,ny*length,nz*length
end

function quicksort(t, start, endi)
   start, endi = start or 1, endi or #t
  if(endi - start < 1) then return t end
  local pivot = start
  for i = start + 1, endi do
    if t[i].depth <= t[pivot].depth then
      if i == pivot + 1 then
        t[pivot],t[pivot+1] = t[pivot+1],t[pivot]
      else
        t[pivot],t[pivot+1],t[i] = t[i],t[pivot],t[pivot+1]
      end
      pivot = pivot + 1
    end
  end
   t = quicksort(t, start, pivot - 1)
  return quicksort(t, pivot + 1, endi)
end

		local cur_bit = bit_loc%8

		if(band(shl(0b00000001,i),v)>0)byte_list[cur_byte_number]=bor(byte_list[cur_byte_number],bit_mask)
		bit_loc+=1
	end
end

	end

function intersect_ground(x,y,z)
	local k_max_step=.125

		y+=-d
		count-=1
	end
	--if(y<.1)y=0
	return x,y,z
