description: Sphero Version a1 Rescue Blocklandia from the evil clutches of Duke Cube. Find the nine golden keys to unlock the gate to the magic portal and recover the crown. Instructions --Move the Sphero with the arrow keys --Interact with special blocks by rolling over them --Collect keys to open locked doors --Collect floating coins --Grab the crown to win the game! If you beat the game, please post a picture! Implementation Notes There are some tidbits in this cart that might be interesting/useful to other pico8 programmers. Level Storage 8X8 rooms are stored in a compressed format within a long string contained at the end of the P8 file. Blocks are stored in a manner that is closer to a drawing format-- e.g. change current tile, place tile at location x or fill a given region with tile. These instructions are tightly bit packed and then saved a single line of hex for each room. This allowed for 117 unique rooms in the game with a reasonable level of detail before hitting the code compression limit. (15438/15616 in the end!) I have tool to allow for rooms to also be stored in the cart data as well, but it didn't end up being necessary. (I got tired of designing rooms before I got ran out of space.) I have a level editor (also made in pico8), which outputs levels to a text file, that I can share. Sprite Packing This game uses two sprite sheets worth of a sprites by mashing them together-- e.g. the first 2 bits code for sprite sheet one and the second 2 bits code for sprite sheet 2. I posted a demo cart of this earlier, and there are a couple of other carts on the bbs that explain this in more detail. Physics Collisions are handled using signed distance fields for the blocks in the local area of the ball, which make it really easy to check for where and when the sphere of the ball hits something--or multiple somethings. As a bonus, they also make it easy to find the normal at the intersection point, so bouncing type collisions are pretty straight forward. I can do more of a write-up for these things if folks want. -ElectricGryphon

 local hx,hy=b2px(_h)

end

function neighbors(_h)
 local x=_h%21
 local y=flr(_h/21)
 local offx=_if(y%2==1,1,0)
 
 local n2b=function(_x,_y)
  if _x<0 or _x>21 or _y<0 then
   return nil
  end
  return _y*21+_x
 end
 
 return {
	 n2b(x+1,y),       --e
	 n2b(x+offx,y-1),  --ne
	 n2b(x-1+offx,y-1),--nw
	 n2b(x-1,y),       --w

function bezier_eval(curve,frac)
	if #curve>1 then
		-- the spirit of bezier curve
		-- evaluation is recursive.
		-- for specific powers, this
		-- could be boiled down to
		-- straightforward, non-
		-- recursive math, but this is
		-- a general-purpose solution.
		local subcurve={}
		for i=2,#curve do
			local p0,p1=curve[i-1],curve[i]
			add(subcurve,lerp(p0,p1,frac))
		end
		return bezier_eval(subcurve,frac)
	end
	return curve[1]
end

function lerp(p0,p1,frac)
	assert(#p0==#p1)
	local carf=1-frac
	local pfrac={}
	for i=1,#p0 do
		add(pfrac,p0[i]*carf+p1[i]*frac)
	end

comment_1: This is a great implementation of the mechanics! But I am not sure this rotating randomizes or gives more control. Have to play more, the game is good!
comment_2: My Highscore was 59700 and I played for ~15 minutes. I really enjoyed this! I used to play a flash version of this game several years ago, so it's very cool to see it so well implemented in pico-8! Yours definitely has the better graphics - I love the gumball theme and the animations. I did find the spinning to be a little unpredictable at times though, sometimes a shot would barely move things and other times it would send it spinning wildly despite shooting similar shots. I guess this is something I could get used to in time, if intended, but it did feel a little bit like a bug at first. Really looking forward to playing more! Edit: Came back and got a better score (725750) in about 25 minutes of play. One thing I noticed is that it is possible to exploit the scoring system by simply missing on purpose once only 1-2 colours remain in the pool and letting the balls build up before knocking them off for large combos. I don't know if you want to reward this strategy or not, but if not I would suggest changing the score amount to scale down based on how many colours are 'active' (ie in the new ball pool). So for example when there are only 1-2 colours available each ball cleared will be worth less than when there are 4-5 colours available. This would make later stages worth more points and discourage 'cheesing' the end of a stage to farm more points.
comment_3: I got 59110 and really enjoyed it! I'll probably come back and play it more when I have the time.
comment_4: @maleficmax Did you notice that you can preview your next 2 gumballs? And that you can bounce shots off of walls? I think the fun is in knowing what shots you want to make one and two turns in advance and positioning the board to make those future shots possible. Do I take the high risk shot for high reward or do I play it safe to set myself up for success later on? I love that stuff.
comment_5: @historymaker118 Thanks for the feedback! I was aware of the scoring exploit you mention. I also thought of solving it by ramping up the difficulty more rapidly and forcing players out of the round sooner, but it seemed too devastating to more casual players. I've gone the route you suggest instead. So the more colors there are in play, the higher the score multiplier is. I figure that buffing in the inverse of our situation and then removing the buff feels more rewarding than slashing the score even though it's effectively the same. Regarding your physics observation, the amount of force applied to the gumball mass is relative to the number of balls. So when there are fewer balls, a shot made at the same angle will move it quite a lot more. Is this what you're referring to?

function mp(array,fn)

function fixval(v)
	if v=="" then
		return nil
	elseif type(v)=="string" and v[1]=="{" then
	 	return arraydata(sub(v,2,#v-1))
	elseif glob[v]~=nil then
		return glob[v]
	end
	return v
end

function arraydata(str)
	return mp(split(str,":"),fixval)
end

function data(str,globname)
	local lines=split(str,"\n")
	local props,d=split(deli(lines,1)),{}
	for l in all(lines) do
		local o,v={class=globname},split(l)
		for i=1,#v do
			o[props[i]]=fixval(v[i])
		end
		add(d,o)

			d[o.name]=o
			if(globname)glob[globname.."."..o.name]=o
		end
	end
	return d
end

function findnearitems(pos,layers,r)
	local items={}
	for layer in all(layers) do
		
		local lr=r or layer.vdist
		local x0,z0=getcellidx(layer,{pos[1]-lr,0,pos[3]-lr})
		local x1,z1=getcellidx(layer,{pos[1]+lr,0,pos[3]+lr})
		for z=z0,z1 do
			for x=x0,x1 do
				for i in all(layer.cells[z][x]) do
					local ipos=i.pos or getspritepos(i)
					if v_len(v_minus(ipos,pos))<lr then
						add(items,i)
					end
				end
			end
		end  
	end
	return items
end

function v_plus(a,b)
	return {a[1]+b[1],a[2]+b[2],a[3]+b[3]}
end

function v_minus(a,b)
	return {a[1]-b[1],a[2]-b[2],a[3]-b[3]}
end

function v_times(v,f)
	return {v[1]*f,v[2]*f,v[3]*f}
end

function v_dot(a,b)
	return a[1]*b[1]+a[2]*b[2]+a[3]*b[3]
end

function v_cross(a,b)
	return {
		a[2]*b[3]-a[3]*b[2],
		a[3]*b[1]-a[1]*b[3],
		a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1]
	}
end

function v_len(v)
	local x,y,z=unpack(v)
	local d=abs(x)+abs(y)+abs(z)
	x/=d y/=d z/=d
	return sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z)*d
end

function v_normalised(v)
	return v_times(v,1/v_len(v))
end



function m_times(a,b)
	local r={}
	for y=1,3 do
		for x=0,2 do   
			r[x*3+y]=a[  y]*b[x*3+1]
			        +a[3+y]*b[x*3+2]
			        +a[6+y]*b[x*3+3]
		end
		r[9+y]=a[  y]*b[10]
		      +a[3+y]*b[11]
		      +a[6+y]*b[12]
		      +a[9+y]
	end
	return r
end

function m_transformvec(m,v)
	local x,y,z=unpack(v)
	return {
		m[1]*x+m[4]*y+m[7]*z,
		m[2]*x+m[5]*y+m[8]*z,
		m[3]*x+m[6]*y+m[9]*z
	}
end

function m_transformpt(m,p)
	local x,y,z=unpack(p)
	return {
		m[1]*x+m[4]*y+m[7]*z+m[10],
		m[2]*x+m[5]*y+m[8]*z+m[11],
		m[3]*x+m[6]*y+m[9]*z+m[12]
	}
end

function m_transposed(m)
	return {
		m[1],m[4],m[7],
		m[2],m[5],m[8],
		m[3],m[6],m[9],
		0,0,0 
	}
end

function m_cheapinverse(m)
	
	
	local t=m_column(m,4)
	m=m_transposed(m)	
	t=v_times(m_transformvec(m,t),-1)
	m_column(m,4,t)
	return m
end  
	
function m_fixup(m)
	
	
	
	local x,y,z=m_column(m,1),m_column(m,2),m_column(m,3)
	y=v_normalised(y)
	x=v_normalised(v_cross(y,z))
	z=v_normalised(v_cross(x,y))
	return basis(x,y,z,{m[10],m[11],m[12]})
end

function m_column(m,i,v)
	i=i*3-2
	if v then
		m[i],m[i+1],m[i+2]=unpack(v)
	else
		return {m[i],m[i+1],m[i+2]}
	end
end 



function translate(x,y,z)
	if(type(x)=="table")return translate(unpack(x))
	return {
		1,0,0,
		0,1,0,
		0,0,1,
		x,y,z
	}
end

function rotx(ang)
	local s,c=sin(ang),cos(ang)
	return {
		1,0,0,
		0,c,-s,
		0,s,c,
		0,0,0
	}
end

function roty(ang)
	local s,c=sin(ang),cos(ang)
	return {
		c,0,-s,
		0,1,0,
		s,0,c,
		0,0,0
	}
end

function rotz(ang)
	local s,c=sin(ang),cos(ang)
	return {
		c,-s,0,
		s,c,0,
		0,0,1,
		0,0,0
	}
end

function euler(x,y,z)
	return m_times(
		roty(y),
		m_times(
			rotx(x),
			rotz(z)))
end

function basis(x,y,z,t)
	t=t or split"0,0,0"
	local m=translate(t)
	m_column(m,1,x)
	m_column(m,2,y)
	m_column(m,3,z)
	return m
end

function lookdir(p,dir)
	local z=v_normalised(dir)
	local x=v_normalised(v_cross({0,1,0},z))
	local y=v_cross(z,x)
	return basis(x,y,z,p)
end

function lookat(p,targ)
	return lookdir(p,v_minus(targ,p))
end

function renderpoly(verts)

	
	
	local allvis=true
	for v in all(verts) do
		if(not v.p)allvis=false
	end

	if not allvis then
		for plane in all(viewplanes) do
			verts=clippoly(verts,plane)
  			if(#verts<3)return
		end
	end
	
	local ssv=mp(verts,getprojected)

	
	local ty,ti=ssv[1][2],1
	for i=2,#ssv do
		if ssv[i][2]<ty then
			ti,ty=i,ssv[i][2]
		end
	end 

	
	local ln,rn,y0=ti,ti,max(0,ceil(ty))
	local l1,r1=ssv[ti],ssv[ti]
	local li,ri,l0,r0,lxd,rxd,lx,rx
	for i=2,#ssv do
		
		
		
		
		
		local goleft=l1[2]<r1[2]
		if i==2 or goleft then
			li,l0=ln,l1																					

			ln=li%#ssv+1 																			
			l1=ssv[ln]   																			
			lxd=(l1[1]-l0[1])/(l1[2]-l0[2]) 
			lx=l0[1]+lxd*(y0-l0[2])									
		end
		if i==2 or not goleft then
			ri,r0=rn,r1

			rn=(ri-2)%#ssv+1
			r1=ssv[rn]
			rxd=(r1[1]-r0[1])/(r1[2]-r0[2])
			rx=r0[1]+rxd*(y0-r0[2])
		end  
		local y1=min(min(l1[2],r1[2]),83)

		end
	end

tolerance=0.001

function clippoly(verts,n)
	
	
	
	local dps,needclip={},false
	for v in all(verts) do
		local dp=v_dot(v.pt,n)
		if(dp<0)needclip=true
		add(dps,dp)
	end
	
	if(not needclip)return verts
	
	
	local clippedverts={}
	local pdp=dps[#dps]
	local pv=verts[#verts]
	
	for i,v in ipairs(verts) do
		dp=dps[i]

		
		if pdp> tolerance and dp<-tolerance
		or pdp<-tolerance and dp> tolerance then
			
			local d=-pdp/(dp-pdp)		   
			local x=v_plus(pv.pt,v_times(v_minus(v.pt,pv.pt),d))
			local p=project(x,true)
			add(clippedverts,{pt=x,p=p})
		end
		
		
		if(dp>=-tolerance)add(clippedverts,v)
		
		
		pdp,pv=dp,v
	end
	
	return clippedverts
end

function renderbsp(bsp,xfrm,mv)

	
	
	local pt,n=xfrm[bsp.i].pt,m_transformvec(mv,bsp.n)
	local dp=v_dot(pt,n)
	local side=dp<0 and 1 or 2 
	
	
	local child
	if side==1 then child=bsp.bk else child=bsp.fr end
	if(child)renderbsp(child,xfrm,mv)

	
	for f in all(bsp.f) do
		local mask=f.side&side
		if mask~=0 then
			local verts=mp(f.i,function(i)return xfrm[i] end)
			color(f.col)
			renderpoly(verts)
		end
	end 
	
	
	if side==1 then child=bsp.fr else child=bsp.bk end
	if(child)renderbsp(child,xfrm,mv)	
end

function cliplinebsp(pbsp,side,verts,p0,p1,n0)
	local bsp=side and pbsp.bk or pbsp.fr

	
	if(not bsp) return side and n0 and {p=p0,n=n0}
 
	
	local pt=verts[bsp.i]
	local d0,d1=v_dot(v_minus(p0,pt),bsp.n),v_dot(v_minus(p1,pt),bsp.n)
	
	
	if(sgn(d0)==sgn(d1))return cliplinebsp(bsp,d0<0,verts,p0,p1,n0)
	
	
	local f=d0/(d0-d1)
	local i=v_plus(v_times(p0,1-f),v_times(p1,f))
	
	
	return cliplinebsp(bsp,d0<0,verts,p0,i,n0) or cliplinebsp(bsp,d1<0,verts,i,p1,bsp.n)
end

function linecircletest(p0,p1,pos,r)
	local delta=v_minus(p1,p0)
	local dir=v_normalised(delta)
	local d=v_dot(dir,v_minus(pos,p0))
	local nearest=v_plus(p0,v_times(dir,d))
	return v_len(v_minus(pos,nearest))<=r and d/v_len(delta)
end

function cliplinesprite(s,p0,p1)
	
	if (not linecircletest(p0,p1,getspritepos(s),s.mdl.r))return;

	
	local m=getspritematrix(s)
	local mi=m_cheapinverse(m)
	p0,p1=m_transformpt(mi,p0),m_transformpt(mi,p1)
	local r=cliplinebsp({bk=s.mdl.bsp},true,s.mdl.v,p0,p1)
 
	
	return r and {n=m_transformvec(m,r.n),p=m_transformpt(m,r.p)}
end

function applyairfriction(v,peraxisfriction)
	for axis=1,3 do
		local f=v[axis]^2*peraxisfriction[axis]
		if abs(v[axis])<f then
			v[axis]=0
		else
			v[axis]-=sgn(v[axis])*f
		end
	end  
end

		if(btn(⬅️,1))yi+=1

		yis=lerp(yis,yi,0.1)
		zis=lerp(zis,zi,0.1) 
	end

	
	local lift=g*lerp(1.225/0.660,1,h/6000)

		end

	end

	for e in all(ents) do

		end

	local targi,delta
	if p_targ then
		for i,e in ipairs(ents) do

		end
		
		if(not targi or linetest(ppos,p_targ.pos))p_targ=nil

			local q=w.typ.burst

		local prvi=targi
		repeat

		until p_targ or targi==prvi

	end

					if proj.cntr then

			sprite.m=m_fixup(sprite.m)

			
			vel[3]+=typ.accel
			rocketairfriction[3]=typ.friction
			applyairfriction(vel,rocketairfriction)

			
			vel=m_transformvec(sprite.m,vel)
		end

		local prvpos=pos

		pos=v_plus(pos,vel)

		
		local d

				local dmg=typ.dmg*(rnd(1)+0.5)
				p_health-=dmg p_v=v_plus(p_v,v_times(v_normalised(v_minus(ppos,prvpos)),dmg*0.01))
				sfx(7)
				d=true	
			end
		end
		if not d and pos[2]>=0 or linetest(prvpos,pos) then
			
			detonateproj(typ,pos) 
			d=true
		end
		proj.timer-=1
		if d or proj.timer<=0 then 
			del(projs,proj)
		else
			setspritepos(sprite,pos)
			addsprite(sprite)
		end
	end

	
	if(losproj)losproj.haslos=not linetest(ppos,getspritepos(losproj.sprite)) losproj.losframe=frame
end

function detonateproj(typ,pos)
	
	generateparts(typ.explosion,pos)
	if(not typ.r1)return
	
	
	local units=findnearitems(pos,gamelayers,typ.r1+20)
	for unit in all(units) do
		if typ.flg&unit.typ.flg~=0 then
			local upos=getspritepos(unit.sprite)
			local d=v_len(v_minus(upos,pos))
			d=max(d-unit.typ.colr,0)
			
			
			local f=0
			if     d<typ.r0 then f=1
			elseif d<typ.r1 then f=(d-typ.r0)/(typ.r1-typ.r0)
			end
			
			
			unit.health-=f*typ.dmg
			if unit.health<=0 then
				removeunit(unit)
				generateparts(unit.typ.explosion,upos)

				
				if unit.typ==mission.unittyp 
				and abs(unit.pos[1]-missionx)<=512 and abs(unit.pos[3]-missionz)<=512 then
					missionct-=1

	for part in all(parts) do

		setspritepos(sprite,pos)

		elseif part.timer>=0 then
			if typ.r0 then
				if part.timer<typ.peak then 
					sprite.rad=lerp(typ.r0,typ.r1,part.timer/typ.peak)
				else
					sprite.rad=lerp(typ.r1,0,(part.timer-typ.peak)/(typ.duration-typ.peak))

	end

function getgndcol(x,z)
	z=8192-z																									
	local mx,mz=x/128+64,z/128							
	local ox,oz=mx%1*8,mz%1*8   					
	local i=mget(mx\1,mz\1)  					   
	return sget(i%16*8+ox,i\16*8+oz) 
end

function placesprites(spset,x,z,ang,y)
	ang=ang or 0
	local p=maptoworldvec(x,z,y)
	local m=m_times(translate(p),roty(ang))
	for s in all(spset.sprites) do
		s.pos=s.pos or split"0,0,0"
		local pos,sang=m_transformpt(m,s.pos),ang+(s.ang or 0)
		if s.mdl.health then
			
			spawnunit(
				s.mdl,
				getterritory(pos[1],pos[3])<0,
				pos,
				sang)
		else
			
			addsprite({
				layer=spset.layer,
				mdl=s.mdl,
				pos=pos,
				ang=sang
			})
			local mdl=resolvespritemodel(s,0)
			if mdl==models.hill1 or mdl==models.hill2 then
				addsprite({
					layer=layers.solid,
					mdl=mdl,
					pos=pos,
					ang=sang
				})	
			end
		end
	end
	
	
	
	if spset.w then
		local a=spset.w*128
		add(reserved,{
			x0=p[1]-a,
			z0=p[3]-a,
			x1=p[1]+a,
			z1=p[3]+a  
		})
	end
end

function maptoworld(x,z)
	return (x-64)*128,(64-z)*128
end

function maptoworldvec(x,z,y)
	local wx,wz=maptoworld(x,z)
	return {wx,y or 0,wz}
end

function worldtomap(x,z)
	return x\128+64,64-z\128
end

function isreserved(x,z)
	for r in all(reserved) do
		if r.x0<=x and r.x1>=x and r.z0<=z and r.z1>=z then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function generateunits()
	for typ in all(unittyps) do
		if typ.genweight then

			
			for sz=0,8191,1024 do
				for sx=0,8191,1024 do
					generateunitsrange(sx,sz,1024,typ,typ.genct+rnd(typ.genr)\1,typ.genweight)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function generateunitsrange(sx,sz,rng,typ,cellct,weightfn,force)
	local pts,spawnct={},0
	for i=1,cellct*10 do
		local x,z=sx+rnd(rng),sz+rnd(rng)
		local mx,mz=worldtomap(x,z)
		gnd,byroad=evalmappos(x,z)

		
		local w=not isreserved(x,z) and rnd((byroad==0 and weightfn.w or weightfn.byroadw)[gnd] or 0) or 0

		
		local j=#pts+1
		while j>1 and pts[j-1].w<w do
			j-=1
		end
		add(pts,{x=x,z=z,w=w},j)
	end
	
	
	for i=1,cellct do
		local pt=pts[i]
		if pt.w>0 then

			
			local t=force and 1 or getterritory(pt.x,pt.z)
			if abs(t)>0.03 then
				spawnunit(
					typ,
					t<0,
					{pt.x,0,pt.z},
					rnd(1) and typ.angmask)
				spawnct+=1
			end
		end
	end
	return spawnct
end

function getterritory(x,z)
	return (x-2200)/8192
end

function generatemission()
	missionx,missionz=maptoworld(mission.x+0.5,mission.y+0.5)
	generateunitsrange(missionx-512,missionz-512,1024,mission.unittyp,mission.gen,mission.genweight,true)
	missionct=mission.ct
end
description: WARNING: This game attempts to emulate old 8-bit flight simulators from the 80s and 90s. The flight model leans towards realism rather than easy-to-pickup arcade gameplay (even if it's somewhat primitive compared to serious modern-day flight simulators). As such it's not an easy to pickup game - controlling the helicopter is challenging and takes practice. In combat, even more so. Welcome to Combat Chopper , an 80s helicopter combat flight simulator for Pico-8! Pilot your P8 64k Apachi armored attack helicopter on a series of missions destroying key targets in enemy territory. Getting started Training mode Use the "Training" mode to practice controlling the helicopter before trying to take on any missions. You will need to be comfortable with keeping low, stopping and hovering, and landing, before attempting to engage in combat. Training mode is exactly like career mode, except there are no objectives, and you cannot be shot down. Flight controls The helicopter and weapon systems can be fully controlled using a single controller. When no button is held: Up/down -> Pitch Left/right -> Roll When the circle button (Z) is held: Up/down -> Collective Left/right -> Tail rotor To take off, hold circle (Z) and press the up arrow until the helicopter starts climbing. A little bit of collective will make the helicopter hover just above the ground (due to the "ground cushion effect"). Adding more collective will cause the helicopter to continue climbing. Once airborne, press the arrow keys (without holding circle) to tilt the helicopter, which will cause it to accelerate in that direction. The cockpit gauges help you control your flight: Player 2 controls (optional) Although the game can be played with just one controller you can use a second controller for extra precision. The player 2 arrow keys control the collective (up/down) and tail rotor (left/right). Stopping Being able to stop and hover is a useful skill. Essentially this involves raising the nose and tilting backwards until your speed reduces to zero. However, keep in mind that the helicopter has momentum and it takes some distance to brake from 100mph down to zero. Also tilting backwards at speed will cause the helicopter to climb rapidly making you an easy target for SAM launchers. To avoid this, drop the collective down first before lifting the nose. Try to balance the collective and pitch angle to keep the vertical speed as close to zero as possible. When your speed is close to zero, quickly add collective to avoid dropping quickly. Landing Landing is tricky to master, but is an essential skill. Use the map view to locate your base. It will be at the coordinates you took off from! Alternatively look for the orange dot on the map. Come to a hover next to your base, then turn to face it using the tail rotor controls. Approach the the helipad slowly (~10mph) using the collective and vertical speed indicator to control the rate of descent. As you reach the helipad, tilt the nose up slightly to come to a hover and lower the collective until you touch down onto the helipad. Combat As well as piloting your helicopter, you will also need to destroy enemy units. This involves locating the enemy, targeting them, and selecting and firing the appropriate weapon. Weapons and targeting Hold cross (X) to access the weapon systems. While held: Up/down -> Cycles through available targets. Left/right -> Select the weapon/countermeasure to fire. Tap X to fire the selected weapon at the targeted unit. From left-to-right the weapons are: - No weapon. (I.e. safety on) - Cannon. Effective against all unit types, but has limited range. - Laser guided missile. Seeks the targeted unit. Ineffective against camps and outposts. - Rockets. Fly straight forward. Effective against camps and outposts , but not other targets. - Countermeasures. Used to counter surface to air missiles (SAMs). In order to be targeted, an enemy unit must be visible (i.e. in front of you) and in range. Range depends on your altitude - the higher up you are the greater your targeting range. Beware that this works both ways - enemies can also target you from further away when you are higher up. When a unit is targeted a square reticle is displayed around it, and the unit is displayed in the targeting camera view. Enemy units have a red reticle and an "E" displayed in the bottom left corner of the target camera view. Friendly units have a blue/gray reticle and an "F" displayed. Enemy fire The main threat will be surface-to-air missiles (SAMs). Most units will fire these at you when they spot you. Beware of SAM launchers as they fire more quickly and their missiles do greater damage. The IR and SAM dashboard lights tell you when an enemy is aiming and firing at you. If the IR light is lit an enemy is targeting you and getting ready to fire. The SAM light means a missile has been fired and is actively seeking you, and you should take action to avoid being hit. This might mean: Dropping a countermeasure. This is the most effective way to avoid getting hit, but you only have a limited supply. Each countermeasure lasts for 10 seconds. Dropping behind a hill is occasionally effective, if you have enough time. Attempting to evade by turning tightly or rapidly dropping altitude. This is risky but can work. The other threat is anti-aircraft (AA) guns. These fire shells at you which, unlike SAMs, do not seek and have a shorter range. However there is no warning indicator for AA guns and they are particularly dangerous if they catch you at close range moving slowly, or if you try to take them head on. Damage Damage is displayed in the mission objective display as a red bar. If the bar is fully red then you have been shot down, and your helicopter will crash to the ground. Damage also affects your engine and the amount of lift your rotors can generate. You can repair your helicopter by landing at a friendly helipad, and dropping the collective down to zero. This will also restock your weapons. Missions In career mode you will be given missions. Each involves destroying one or more enemy units at a specific location, then returning to and landing safely at your base. The mission objective is displayed at the top of the dashboard. Use the map to find your way to the objective coordinates. The objective is displayed as a red dot. Once enough units have been destroyed at, or close to, the mission coordinates, the mission objective will change to "Return to Base", and display the base coordinates. Tips Some tips to help keep you in the air. Keep low Flying low is challenging. However keeping under 100 feet prevents you from being lit up like a Christmas tree to every SAM capable enemy unit. Friendly space is to the west If you need to retreat, head west. Use the mountains This is particularly important for missions deeper into enemy territory. The basic approach is: Fly to a mountain, keeping low, and come to a hover beside it. Ideally keeping it between you and enemy units. "Pop up" to 200-300 feet and look around for enemy units. Then drop down again before they can fire at you. Choose the next mountain. Decide which enemy units to destroy or avoid in order to reach the next mountain. Destroy the chosen units. Repeat the process until you are within range of your objective. Watch out for AA guns Getting close to an anti-aircraft gun can quickly spoil your day. Destroy them from range or avoid.

function lerp(
now,posa,posb,start,fin,
t,
extra1,extra2
)
 
	if type(now) == "string" then
		now = anim
	end
	
	if start == nil then
		start = 0
	end
	if fin == nil then
		fin = 1
	end
	
	now = mid(start,now,fin)
	
	interval = fin-start
	
	percent = (now-start)/interval
	
	distance = posb-posa
	
	if t == nil then
		
		return percent*distance+posa
	 
	elseif t == "ease in" then
		
		return (-cos(.25*percent)+1)*distance+posa
	 
	elseif t == "ease out" then
		
		return (-sin(.25*percent))*distance+posa
	 
	elseif t == "ease" then
  
  return (-.5*cos(.5*percent)+.5)*distance+posa
	
	
	elseif t == "overshoot" then
		
		local first = 1-extra2
		
		overshoot = distance*(1+extra1)
		if percent < first then
			lp = percent / first
			return (-.5*cos(.5*lp)+.5)*
			overshoot+posa
		else
		 tp = (percent-first)/(extra2)
			return overshoot+posa-(-.5*cos(.5*tp)+.5)*distance*extra1
		end
		
	elseif t == "bounce" then
		
		local first = 1-extra2
		
		overshoot = distance*(1+extra1)
		if percent < first then
			lp = percent / first
			return (-cos(.25*lp)+1)*
			overshoot+posa
		else
		 tp = (percent-first)/(extra2)
			return overshoot+posa-(-sin(.25*tp))*distance*extra1
		end
		
	end
	
end

description: A PICO-8 sports game starring Jelpi! [8x8] Play solo or together in a mashup of tennis, volleyball, squash, and wallball where the only rule is: two bounces on one side is a point for the other. Controls The controls should all be in the game, but for those who aren't familiar with PICO-8: ESDF is used for player 2 instead of WASD so it works on many international keyboards as well as QWERTY. I recommend that those playing with controller or you PICO-8 veterans go to 'game settings' from the pause menu to make the controls work better for controllers and z/x keys. The game is playable with just arrow keys for each player, but it may make things a little harder for some if the settings aren't changed. ‎ Gamemodes Solo 🏆 Campaign : Help Jelpi ascend the ranks and meet an old comrade... 🧱 Wall : Play a solo match against the wall (The Unbeatable Opponent) to see how long you last (powerups come in handy here) 👁️ Spectate : Watch opponents you have unlocked in campaign play against each other, can help you figure out how to beat a tough opponent (could be together...) ‎ Together 👊💥 Versus : Face each other in a PICO-BALL match, powerups add a lot of depth, craziness and sillyness 🤝💖 Co-op : Work together to keep the ball(s) in the air (the powerups both aid and hinder your juggling ability) Campaign Opponents 💥🏆 Strider [8x8] Newcomer to the game, has a hard time getting shots that go way over their head Heli [8x8] There isn't a rule against flying, but luckily this helicoper-creature isn't too good at catching up to a quick-moving ball Frog [8x8] [8x8] A dapper frog that uses his tongue for some crazy trick shots (which work about half of the time) Bird [8x8] This opponent is actually good at flying and is not afraid to come over to your side, so well-placed aggressive shots are the way to go here Mimo [8x8] Jelpi's old friend and comrade with the same moves, gets more aggressive as the game goes on, which can be taken advantage of... ‎‎ You can wear hats that you unlock from beating each opponent! [40x8] ‎ So, [56x16] Have fun! ‎--------------------------------------- ‎. . . Development Notes I had the idea for this game in the shower somewhere around three months ago from today. A simple multiplayer tennis-like that would be a fun, small little project. As you can probably see, this game didn't quite live up to that second adjective, but I'd say it has successfully fulfilled the first one (which is the more important one). First I made a prototype with boxes and a non-functional net and the game proved to be fun! I had yet to fine tune the physics though, so it was a pretty chaotic and janky (even moreso than it is now :). Then I decided I needed to replace the boxes with characters. I had a hard time coming up with any humanoids within such small pixel counts... [40x16] Then, I had the idea of using Jelpi! (Jelpi is PICO-8's demo/example mascot for those who don't know) I'm so glad this bolt of inspiration struck me because it drastically changed the way the game was shaping up for the better. It gave me so many ideas for stories, situations, opponents, modes, and also gave the game a good artstyle (sorry old doodles of mine still at the back of the match-cart sprite-sheet...) [8x8] [8x8] What's funny is that the menu cart's file size is bigger than the game cart's (this is a multi-cart game with two game files, one for the menus and cutscenes and another for the gameplay). I've also spent about the same amount of time working on both, which is rather ironic. I had to do a lot of token-saving on the menu cart, because the cutscenes take a lot of data, or at least they do in the way I programmed them. This was also my first time putting a lot of effort into a somewhat complex menu, leading to the increased time and spaghetti code invested there. If I were to do it again, I would probably do it quite differently. I had a lot of fun conjuring up the story and making those cutscenes along with remixing the Jelpi music! I've remixed the main song for the title screen and one of the match themes, and the jungle and dragon theme for the other two match songs. The first half of jungle themed one ended up being based off of a song I made for fun a couple of months ago, unrelated to the game, the baseline/intro-melody being stolen directly from that. The dragon one is pretty untouched from me compared to the other tracks. My main addition of the raspy melody is supposed to be like the dragon's roar (it's based off the sound effect used in the intro cutscene), but I don't think that's very obvious. Intro -> Menu Theme (starts at pattern 10): [sfx] The Three Match Tracks (patters 0, 16, and 32): [sfx] These tracks take three channels sometimes, and due to all the rapid sounds in-game they occasionally cut out, but I've tried to make it not too noticeable and I think it's worth it. Balancing the opponents was tough because their difficulty changes a lot based on your playstyle. It's normal if you find the Bird or the Frog harder than Mimo, but hopefully you find Mimo a bit tougher than the Strider! Over the first two months I was pretty inconsistent with my work on the game (I was also busy in those months), but in the last month I've done a ton of work which has brought me to finally complete the project! I'm really happy I used Jelpi for the project, not only because the project was positively affected, but because I feel like there aren't enough Jelpi based games. The only complete Jelpi game I can think of is Pico-Ware, so being able to add to the Jelpi universe is great. We've got to thank Zep for making these adorable characters. I encourage modding of the game, and you can find a little bit of information on how to do that in the Mods section further below. Thanks for reading all these development notes! I'm glad someone's interested in them! version history By the way, the current version is visible in the in-game credits, it's currently 1.1.2. The numbers go, gameNumber.featureUpdate.patchNumber . It's quite likely that I'll have to fix a bug, and I might add some extra hats in the future (I didn't have time to rework the code to allow extra hats from co-op and wall high scores if I wanted to get the game out in July) so the latter two numbers may change, but I don't plan to make a sequel, so the first one probably never will! 1.0.0: original release, 7/29/2025​ 1.0.1: patch, 7/30/2025; ​tweaked strider speed range, slowed the bird slightly to make the match a little easier, fixed the "rewatch intro" pause menu option from replaying the intro incorrectly when chosen while in a submenu, allowed spectate to let you see matches with the next opponent you have to beat in the campaign, removed arrows/esdf text from this Lexaloffle version (for console authenticity and because the people here are already familiar with PICO-8) 1.1.2: features+patch, 7/31/2025; reduced bird force slowed the bird slightly to make the match a little easier, fixed hollow particles showing up as filled in cutscenes, fixed bug where replaying an opponent would reset your save data to as if you had just beaten them for the first time, added ability to see your best match scores against each opponent, added a star on the campaign and home screen if you've beaten the game (or gotten the secret hat), added a secret hat for completionists! 1.1.3: patch, 8/5/2025; fixed crash that occurs when completing matches with a double-digit score, fixed unnecessary double loading on menu when winning a campaign match, made transition peephole cover the winner card when a new match is quickly chosen

function is_level_unlocked(level_num)
    if level_num == 1 then return true end
    -- Check if previous level is completed
    return dget(level_num - 1) > 0
end

function complete_level()
    local current = dget(level) or 0

    if p.pickupsCollected == p.totalPickups and p.totalPickups > 0 and current != 2 then
        dset(level, 2)
    elseif current < 1 then
        dset(level, 1)
    end

    level += 1
    if level > #level_names then
        mode = "menu"
        _init()
        return
    end
    map_init()
end

function menu_update()
    local maxLevel, old_selected = #level_names, menu.selected
    -- Store old selection to check if we need to play sound

    -- Menu controls
    if btnp(0) and old_selected > 1 then
        -- left
        menu.selected -= 1
    elseif btnp(1) and old_selected < maxLevel then
        -- right
        menu.selected += 1
    elseif btnp(2) and old_selected > menu.cols then
        -- up
        menu.selected -= menu.cols
    elseif btnp(3) and old_selected + menu.cols <= maxLevel then
        -- down
        menu.selected += menu.cols
    elseif btnp(5) then
        -- x button
        -- Only start if level is unlocked
        if is_level_unlocked(old_selected) then
            dset(0, old_selected)
            level = old_selected
            mode = "game"
            map_init()
            sfx(sounds.collect2)
        else

        end
    end

    -- Play selection sound if selection changed
    if old_selected != menu.selected then
        sfx(sounds.select, 0)
    end

-- Actually performs the movement if ok
-- x,y is CENTER of object
function move_if_possible(p, hitCallback)
    local old_x, old_y = p.x, p.y

    local dx, dy = p.dx + (p.fx or 0), p.dy + (p.fy or 0)

    p.x += dx
    
    if not canMoveToLocation(p.x, old_y, p.hitbox, p.dy, hitCallback) then
        p.x = old_x
        p.dx = -dx * 0.3
    end
        
    p.y += dy
    
    if not canMoveToLocation(p.x, p.y, p.hitbox, p.dy, hitCallback) then
        p.y = old_y
        p.dy = 0
    end 

    -- limit to map
    p.x = mid(0+4, p.x, 128-4)
    p.y = mid(-48, p.y, 128-4)
    
    -- reset force-x-y values now we've moved
    p.fx = 0
    p.fy = 0
end

-- convert based on current level
function mmget(x, y)
    return mmget2(flr(x/8), flr(y/8))
end

function mmset(x, y, t)
    return mmset2(flr(x/8), flr(y/8), t)
end

function mmget2(tx, ty)
    return mget(tx+mapInfo.tx, ty+mapInfo.ty)
end

function mmset2(tx, ty, t)
    return mset(tx+mapInfo.tx, ty+mapInfo.ty, t)
end

function onPlatform(p)
    local x,y,hitbox=p.x,p.y,p.hitbox
    local b = hitbox[4]+1
    local points = {
        {x=x, y=y+b},    -- Bottom middle
        {x=x+hitbox[1], y=y+b},  -- Bottom left
        {x=x+hitbox[3], y=y+b}  -- Bottom right        
    }
    return firstSolidPoint(points, true, p)
end

function hitbox_overlap(a, b)
    return (a.x + a.hitbox[1]) < (b.x + b.hitbox[3]) and
           (a.x + a.hitbox[3]) > (b.x + b.hitbox[1]) and
           (a.y + a.hitbox[2]) < (b.y + b.hitbox[4]) and
           (a.y + a.hitbox[4]) > (b.y + b.hitbox[2])
end

function point_in_hitbox(x, y, entity)
    return x >= entity.x + entity.hitbox[1] and 
           x <= entity.x + entity.hitbox[3] and
           y >= entity.y + entity.hitbox[2] and 
           y <= entity.y + entity.hitbox[4]
end

function is_valid_one_way_collision(point, entityBottom, surfaceTop)
    -- Only collide when:
    -- 1. Point is near the surface (within 2 pixels)
    -- 2. Entity is above the surface (not already inside)
    return point.y - surfaceTop < 4 and
           entityBottom < surfaceTop + 4
end

function is_solid_point_in_entities(point, entities, currentEntity, falling)
    for e in all(entities) do
        -- Don't check collision with self
        if e != currentEntity and e.solid and point_in_hitbox(point.x, point.y, e) then
            -- For one-way platforms, only collide when falling
            if e.solid == "oneWay" then
                if falling and is_valid_one_way_collision(
                    point,
                    currentEntity.y + currentEntity.hitbox[4],
                    e.y + e.hitbox[2]
                ) then
                    return point
                end
            else
                return point
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function firstSolidPoint(points, falling, entity)
    for point in all(points) do
        local x, y = point.x, point.y
        local tx, ty = flr(x/8), flr(y/8)
        
        -- First check solid entities (items and npcs)
        local entityPoint = is_solid_point_in_entities(point, items, entity, falling) or 
                          is_solid_point_in_entities(point, npcs, entity, falling)
        if entityPoint then
            return entityPoint
        end

        -- Then check map tiles
        local tile = mmget2(tx, ty)
        
        -- one-way tiles
        if fget(tile, 2) then
            if falling and is_valid_one_way_collision(
                point,
                entity.y + entity.hitbox[4],
                ty * 8
            ) then
                return point
            end
        elseif tx<0 or tx > 16 or ty < 0 or ty > 16 or fget(tile, 0) then

-- hitbox {left, top, right, bottom}
function canMoveToLocation(x, y, hitbox, dy, hitCallback)
    local solid = firstSolidPoint({
        {x=x, y=y+hitbox[2]},    -- Top middle
        {x=x, y=y+hitbox[4]},    -- Bottom middle
        {x=x+hitbox[1], y=y},    -- Middle left
        {x=x+hitbox[3], y=y},     -- Middle right
        {x=x+hitbox[1], y=y+hitbox[2]},  -- Top left
        {x=x+hitbox[3], y=y+hitbox[2]},  -- Top right
        {x=x+hitbox[1], y=y+hitbox[4]},  -- Bottom left
        {x=x+hitbox[3], y=y+hitbox[4]}  -- Bottom right        
    }, dy > 0, {x=x, y=y, hitbox=hitbox})
    
    if solid then
        if (hitCallback) hitCallback(solid.x, solid.y)
        return false
    end
    return true
end

-- avoid overflow 32k
function dist(x0,y0,x1,y1)
  local dx, dy=(x0-x1)/64, (y0-y1)/64
  local dsq=dx*dx+dy*dy
  if(dsq<0) return 32767.99999
  return sqrt(dsq)*64
end

function apply_hitbox_collision(e1, e2, e2ImpulseMultiplier_)
    local e2ImpulseMultiplier = e2ImpulseMultiplier_ or 1
    
    if hitbox_overlap(e1, e2) then
        -- Find centers of entities
        local e1_centerx,e1_centery,e2_centerx,e2_centery = e1.x,e1.y,e2.x,e2.y

        -- Get collision direction
        local dx,dy = e2_centerx - e1_centerx,e2_centery - e1_centery
        
        -- Normalize direction
        local dist = sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        if dist == 0 then dist = 1 end  -- Prevent division by zero
        local nx,ny = dx/dist,dy/dist

        -- Calculate relative velocity
        local dvx,dvy = e1.dx - e2.dx,e1.dy - e2.dy
        
        -- Calculate impulse with elasticity (0.2)
        local impulse = -(1 + 0.2) * (dvx * nx + dvy * ny)
        impulse = mid(-4, impulse, 4)
        
        -- Apply velocities with friction
        local friction = 0.8
        e1.dx = mid(-6, (e1.dx + impulse * nx) * friction, 6)
        e1.dy = mid(-6, (e1.dy + impulse * ny) * friction, 6)
        e2.dx = mid(-6, (e2.dx - impulse * nx * e2ImpulseMultiplier) * friction, 6)
        e2.dy = mid(-6, (e2.dy - impulse * ny * e2ImpulseMultiplier) * friction, 6)

        -- Additional velocity dampening for very fast objects
        if abs(e1.dx) > 4 then e1.dx *= 0.9 end
        if abs(e1.dy) > 4 then e1.dy *= 0.9 end
        if abs(e2.dx) > 4 then e2.dx *= 0.9 end
        if abs(e2.dy) > 4 then e2.dy *= 0.9 end

        -- Push apart (separation)
        e1.fx = -nx
        e2.fx = nx
        e1.fy = -ny
        e2.fy = ny

        return true
    end
    return false
end

function check_hazard_collision(entity)
    -- Check each corner of the entity's hitbox
    local xhb1,xhb3,yhb2,yhb4 = entity.x + entity.hitbox[1],entity.x + entity.hitbox[3],entity.y + entity.hitbox[2],entity.y + entity.hitbox[4]
    local points = {
        {x=xhb1, y=yhb2},  -- Top left
        {x=xhb3, y=yhb2},  -- Top right
        {x=xhb1, y=yhb4},  -- Bottom left
        {x=xhb3, y=yhb4}   -- Bottom right
    }

    for point in all(points) do
        local tx, ty = flr(point.x/8), flr(point.y/8)
        local tile = mmget2(tx, ty)
        
        -- Assuming spikes use flag 3, adjust if needed
        if fget(tile, 3) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function npc_update_turn_around_and_fall(npc, accel, topSpeed, endFallCallback, endStunnedCallback, fly)
    animate_next(npc)

    if npc.stunned > 0 then
        npc.stunned -= 1
        npc.dx *= 0.85
        if npc.stunned == 0 and endStunnedCallback then
            endStunnedCallback(npc)
        end
    end
    
    local walking, standing = (npc.stunned or 0) == 0, onPlatform(npc)
    if walking then
        npc.flipX = npc.dx < 0
        
        -- For flying entities or entities on platform
        if standing or fly then
            npc.dx = mid(-topSpeed, npc.dx + (npc.flipX and -1 or 1) * accel, topSpeed)

            if endFallCallback and npc.fallStartY != nil then
                endFallCallback(npc, npc.y - npc.fallStartY)
            end
            npc.fallStartY = nil
            
            -- Set up look ahead position
            local lookAhead = {
                x = npc.x + (npc.flipX and -2 or 2),
                y = npc.y + 1,
                hitbox = npc.hitbox
            }
            
            local shouldTurn = false
            
            -- Check for platform edge (only for non-flying entities)
            if not fly and not onPlatform(lookAhead) then
                shouldTurn = true
            end
            
            -- Check for screen boundaries (for all entities)
            if (npc.dx < 0 and lookAhead.x <= 4) or (npc.dx > 0 and lookAhead.x >= 124) then
                shouldTurn = true
            end
            
            -- Turn around if needed
            if shouldTurn then
                npc.flipX = not npc.flipX
                npc.dx = -npc.dx
            end
        end
    end

    if not standing and not fly then
        npc.dy += 0.15
        if (npc.fallStartY == nil) npc.fallStartY = npc.y
    end

    if fly then 
        npc.dy = 0.98*npc.dy
    end

    move_if_possible(npc)
end

    end

        -- loop unless busy
        p.animFrame += 1

            else

function player_update()
    local standing = onPlatform(p)

    -- unstick
    local stuck = onPlatform({x=p.x, y=p.y-1, hitbox=p.hitbox})
    if stuck then
        p.fy -= 1
    end

    local centerTileX, centerTileY, oldDy = flr(p.x/8), flr(p.y/8), p.dy
    local centerTile = mmget2(centerTileX, centerTileY)

    -- if end busy anim - return to stand
    animate_next(p, function ()
        set_anim(p, 'stand')
    end)

    local animName, oldFlipX, speed = 'stand', p.flipX, sqrt(p.dx*p.dx + p.dy*p.dy)

    if powerups[p.powerup] and powerups[p.powerup].update then
        powerups[p.powerup].update(p)
    end

    if (p.powerupActive == 0) or (powerups[p.powerup] and not powerups[p.powerup].actionOverrideControls) then
        -- left right buttons to move player
        if standing then
            -- on-ground controls
            if btn(0) then
                p.dx -= 0.1
                p.flipX = true
                animName = 'walk'
            elseif btn(1) then
                p.dx += 0.1
                p.flipX = false
                animName = 'walk'
            end

            -- drag
            p.dx *= 0.90

            -- jump
            if btnp(4) then
                p.dy = -2.2
                sfx(sounds.jump,0)
            end
        else
            animName = 'jump'
            -- jump/falling controls
            if btn(0) and p.dx > -1 then
                p.flipX = true
                p.dx -= 0.08
            elseif btn(1) and p.dx < 1 then
                p.dx += 0.08
                p.flipX = false
            end

            -- less drag in air
            p.dx *= 0.96

            -- gravity
            p.dy = min(2, p.dy + 0.1)
        end

        -- use powerups
        if p.powerup and powerups[p.powerup] and powerups[p.powerup].action and btnp(5) then
            powerups[p.powerup].action(p)
        end

        -- collect/swap powerups
        local wasOnPowerup, isOnPowerup = p.onPowerup, false
        for name, powerupInfo in pairs(powerups) do
            if centerTile == powerupInfo.spr then
                isOnPowerup = true
                if not wasOnPowerup and p.powerup != name then
                    if p.powerup then
                        mmset2(centerTileX, centerTileY, powerups[p.powerup].spr)
                    else
                        mmset2(centerTileX, centerTileY, 0)
                    end
                    p.powerup = name
                    sfx(sounds.powerup,0)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        p.onPowerup = isOnPowerup

        -- collect cakes etc
        for name, pickupInfo in pairs(pickup_info) do
            if centerTile == pickupInfo.spr then
                mmset(p.x, p.y, 0) 
                sfx(sounds.collect2,0)

                p.pickupsCollected += 1
        
                -- Check if we've collected all pickups
                if p.pickupsCollected == p.totalPickups and p.totalPickups > 0 then
                    sfx(sounds.fanfare2)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    end

    end

    move_if_possible(p, function(x, y)

            end
        end

function isShadowed(tx, ty)
    return fget(mmget2(tx, ty), 1)
end

-- auto-outline the level (expensive)
-- then write to memory
-- then can restore v.fast in-game
function save_bg()
    cls()
    map(mapInfo.bgtx, 48, 0, 0, 16, 16)

    map(mapInfo.tx, mapInfo.ty, 0, 0, 16, 16, 0b00000010)

    -- auto-outline
    for tx = 0, 15 do
        for ty = 0, 15 do
            if isShadowed(tx, ty) then
                if not isShadowed(tx, ty - 1) then
                    spr(80, tx * 8, ty * 8 - 1)
                end
                if not isShadowed(tx, ty + 1) then
                    trans(11)
                    spr(96, tx * 8, (ty + 1) * 8, 1, 1)
                    palt()
                    spr(80, tx * 8, ty * 8 + 1, 1, 1, false, true)
                end
                if not isShadowed(tx - 1, ty) then
                    spr(81, tx * 8 - 1, ty * 8)
                end
                if not isShadowed(tx + 1, ty) then
                    spr(81, tx * 8 + 1, ty * 8, 1, 1, true)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    memcpy(0x8000, 0x6000, 0x2000)
end

function _draw()

        sspr(0, 64, 64, 32, 0, 0, 128, 64)
        sspr(64, 64, 64, 32, 0, 64, 128, 64)

    elseif mode == "menu" then

        if p.powerupActive > 0 and p.powerup == "viking" then
            cls(frameNumber % 2 == 0 and 7 or 0)

        end

        printo(mapInfo.name, 9 + (level > 9 and 6 or 3), 1, 10)

        for part in all(particles) do
            part:draw()
        end

        for npc in all(npcs) do
            npc:draw()
        end

        player_draw()

        for item in all(items) do
            item:draw()
        end
    end
end

function map_init()
    reload(0x2000, 0x2000, 0x1000)
    sfx(21, 0)

    mapInfo = {
        -- two rows of 8 levels each
        tx = ((level - 1) % 8) * 16,
        ty = (level - 1) >= 8 and 16 or 0,
        bgtx = level_bgs[level] * 16,
        name = level_names[level],
        weather = level_weathers[level]
    }

    player_init()
    particle_init()
    npc_init()
    items_init()
    snow_init()
    save_bg()
end

function find_level_tile(tile, all, replaceTile, callback)
    for tx = mapInfo.tx, mapInfo.tx + 15 do
        for ty = mapInfo.ty, mapInfo.ty + 15 do
            if mget(tx, ty) == tile then
                if replaceTile then
                    mset(tx, ty, replaceTile)
                end
                -- remove level start position
                callback((tx - mapInfo.tx) * 8, (ty - mapInfo.ty) * 8)
                if not all then
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- dino sort
-- by adam atomic

adj = {{0,2},{0,-2},{2,0},{-2,0}}
rocks = {64,66,68,70}

data_steg = {12,"stegosaurus",
"avoids other stegosaurs.",
"always hungry for cycads."}

data_trex = {8,"tyrannosaurus",
"avoids other tyrannosaurs.",
"always hungry for prey."}

data_brnt = {13,"brachiosaurus",
"they do travel in herds.",""}

data_rptr = {14,"velociraptor",
"always hungry for prey.",
"uses cycads for ambushes."}

data_gall = {9,"gallimimus",
"always travel in herds.",
"always avoid predators."}

data_comp = {11,"compsognathus",
"try to avoid predators,",
"or hide by cycad patches."}

data_eggs = {15,"dinosaur egg",
"eggs are safest when no",
"other dinos are around."}

data_cycad = {3,"cycad",
"ancient fern-like plant.",""}

function _init()
	mode = -1
	title = true
	cartdata("dino_sort")
	level = dget(0)
	if level > 0 then
		mode = 0
	end
	dailyok = dget(1) != dailyseed()
end

function start()
	if mode == 0 then
		loadlevel()
		intro = 50
	elseif mode == 1 then
		generate()
		intro = 10
	elseif mode == 2 then
		generatedaily()
		intro = 10
	end
	oldhappy = happy
	gajunk = 0
	bounce = 0
	wintime = 0
end

function loadlevel()
 cx = 0
 cy = 0
	r = level*8
	if level <= 14 then
		r += 8
	else--if level <= 28 then
		r += 24
	end
	sx = r%128
	sy = flr(r/128)*8
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			t = mget(sx+x,sy+y)
			if cx==0 and cy==0 and dino(t) then
				cx = x*2
				cy = y*2
			end
			if (rock(t)) t = rnd(rocks)
			mset2(x*2,y*2,t)
		end
	end
	scan()
end

function mset2(x,y,t)
	if t == 0 then
		mset(x,  y,  0)
		mset(x+1,y,  0)
		mset(x,  y+1,0)
		mset(x+1,y+1,0)
	else
		mset(x,  y,  t)
		mset(x+1,y,  t+1)
		mset(x,  y+1,t+16)
		mset(x+1,y+1,t+17)
	end
end

function _update()
	if title then
		runtitle()
		return
	end
	if intro > 0 then
		runintro()
		return
	end
	if wintime==0 then
		input()
		move()
	end
	win()
end

function runintro()
	if level == 46 then
		rundailywin()
		return
	end
	intro -= 1
	if intro == 0 and level == 27 then
		dset(0,0)
		run()
	end
end

function rundailywin()
	if intro > 40 then
		intro -= 1
		return
	end
	--if btnp(0) or btnp(1) or btnp(2) or btnp(3) then
		--dcopied = true
		--printh(dstring,"@clip")
	--else
	if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		run()
	end
end

function runtitle()
	if btnp(2) and mode > -1 then
		mode -= 1
		if mode == 0 and level == 0 then
			mode = -1
		end
		sfx(2)
	elseif btnp(3) and (mode < 1 or (dailyok and mode <2)) then
		mode += 1
		if mode == 0 and level == 0 then
			mode = 1
		end
		sfx(2)
	end
	if btnp(4) or btnp(5) then
		if mode == -1 then
			level = 1
			mode = 0
		end
		title = false
		sfx(0)
		start()
	end
end

function input()
	nx = 0
	ny = 0
	if (btnp(0)) nx = -1
	if (btnp(1)) nx = 1
	if (btnp(2)) ny = -1
	if (btnp(3)) ny = 1
	if (nx*ny!=0) ny = 0
end

function move()
	if (nx==0 and ny==0) return
	if btn(4) or btn(5) then
		t = mget(cx,cy)
		nt = mget(cx+nx*2,cy+ny*2)
		if dino(t) then
			if dino(nt) or cycad(nt) or rock(nt) then
				return
			end
			mset2(cx,cy,nt)
			mset2(cx+nx*2,cy+ny*2,t)
			sfx(2)
			if mode == 2 then
				dmoves += 1
			end
		end
	end
	ocx = cx
	cx += nx*2
	cy += ny*2
	if (cx<0) cx = 0
	if (cx>14) cx = 14
	if (cy<2) cy = 2
	if (cy>12) cy = 12
	if cx != ocx and cx == 14 and happy == total then
		sfx(2)
	end
	scan()
end

function scan()
	happy = 0
	total = 0
	for y=0,14,2 do
		for x=0,14,2 do
			if dino(mget(x,y)) then
				total += 1
				if (check(x,y)) happy += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if (dino(mget(cx,cy))) check(cx,cy)
end

function check(x,y)
	q1 = 0
	q2 = 0
	b1 = 0
	b2 = 0
	v = false
	t = mget(x,y)
	if steg(t) then
		q1 = herd(x,y,t)
		q2 = plant(x,y)
		b1 = q1 == 1
		b2 = q2 > 0
		v = b1 and b2
	elseif trex(t) then
		pt = t--fix overwrite issue
		q1 = herd(x,y,t)
		q2 = prey(x,y,pt)
		b1 = q1 == 1
		b2 = q2 > 0
		v = b1 and b2
	elseif brnt(t) then
		q1 = herd(x,y,t)
		q2 = 0
		b1 = q1 >= 3
		b2 = true
		v = b1 and b2
	elseif rptr(t) then
		q1 = prey(x,y,t)
		q2 = plant(x,y)
		b1 = q1 > 0
		b2 = q2 > 0
		v = b1 and b2
	elseif gall(t) then
		q1 = herd(x,y,t)
		q2 = carn(x,y)
		b1 = q1 >= 3
		b2 = q2 == 0
		v = b1 and b2
	elseif comp(t) then
		q1 = carn(x,y)
		q2 = plant(x,y)
		b1 = q1 == 0
		b2 = q2 > 0
		v = b1 or b2
	elseif eggs(t) then
		q1 = danger(x,y,t)
		q2 = 0
		b1 = q1 == 0
		b2 = b1
		v = b1 and b2
	end
	updino(x,y,v)
	return v
end

function updino(x,y,v)
	t = mget(x,y)
	if v and sdino(t) then
		mset2(x,y,t-32)
	elseif not v and hdino(t) then
		mset2(x,y,t+32)
	end
end

function cmpdino(t,r)
	ct = t
	cr = r
	if (sdino(ct)) ct -= 32
	if (sdino(cr)) cr -= 32
	return ct == cr
end

function plant(x,y)
	cnt = 0
	for a in all(adj) do
		t = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if (cycad(t)) cnt += 1
	end
	return cnt
end

function prey(x,y,r)
	cnt = 0
	for a in all(adj) do
		t = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if (not cmpdino(t,r) and dino(t)) cnt += 1
	end
	return cnt
end

function carn(x,y)
	cnt = 0
	for a in all(adj) do
		t = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if (trex(t) or rptr(t)) cnt += 1
	end
	return cnt
end

function danger(x,y,r)
	cnt = 0
	for a in all(adj) do
		t = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if (dino(t) and not cmpdino(t,r)) cnt += 1
	end
	return cnt
end

function herd(x,y,r)
	nbr = {}
	herdloop(x,y,r)
	return #nbr
end

function herdloop(x,y,r)
	add(nbr,y*16+x)
	for a in all(adj) do
		ax = x+a[1]
		ay = y+a[2]
		t = mget(ax,ay)
		if cmpdino(t,r) and not nbrctn(ay*16+ax) then
		 herdloop(ax,ay,r)
		end
	end
end

function nbrctn(i)
	for n in all(nbr) do
		if (n == i) return true
	end
	return false
end

function win()
	if (happy != total) return
	if (cx != 14) return
	winstart = btnp(4) or btnp(5)
	if wintime > 0 or winstart then
		if wintime == 0 then
			sfx(4)
			if mode == 0 then
				level += 1
				dset(0,level)
			elseif mode == 2 then
				level += 1
				dset(1,lastseed)
				dstop = time()
			end
		end
		wintime += 1
		if wintime > 72 then
			needprep = false
			if mode == 2 then
				mode = 0
				needprep = true
			end
			start()
			if needprep then
				prepdailymap()
			end
		end
	end
end

function prepdailymap()
	dmx = 4
	dmy = 4
	dstring = "Daily Dino Sort: "..dmoves.." moves in "..fmtdtime().." seconds!\n"
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			t = mget(x,24+y)
			if sdino(t) then
				t = 96
			elseif hdino(t) then
				t = 97
			elseif rock(t) then
				t = 98
			elseif cycad(t) then
				t = 99
			else
				t = 0
			end
			mset(x+dmx,y+dmy,t)
		end
	end
	dstring = dstring.."https://adamatomic.itch.io/dino-sort"
end

function dino(t)
	return hdino(t) or sdino(t)
end

function hdino(t)
	return t>=2 and t<=14
end

function sdino(t)
	return t>=34 and t<=46
end

function cycad(t)
	return t==32
end

function rock(t)
	return t>=64 and t<=78
end

function steg(t)
	return t==2 or t==34

function trex(t)
	return t==4 or t==36

function brnt(t)
	return t==6 or t==38

function rptr(t)
	return t==8 or t==40

function gall(t)
	return t==10 or t==42

function comp(t)

function eggs(t)

function dailyseed()
	year = stat(90)-2024
	month = stat(91)+year*12
	day = stat(92)+month*31
	return day
end

function post(msg)
	cls()
	print(msg,64-#msg*2,61,15)
	flip()
end

function fakemsg()
	return "generating "..(10+flr(rnd(90)))
end

function generate()
	post(fakemsg())
	wide = rnd(2) < 1.1
	boilerplate()
	stamprocks()
	stamps = 13-#rockcoords
	if (wide) stamps = 21-#rockcoords
	bail = 0
	while stamps > 0 and bail < 50 do
		stamps -= rndstamp()
		bail += 1
	end
	post(fakemsg())
	if not prevalidate() then
		generate()
		return
	end
	shuffles = 0
	while shuffles < 10 do
		shuffles += 1
		unsolve()
		cache()
		level = 45
		loadlevel()
		if happy > total*0.4 then
			uncache()
		else
			shuffles = 10
		end
	end
	if happy > total*0.4 then
		generate()
		return
	end
	cachesad()
end

function unsolve()
	for i=1,400 do
		x = 1+flr(rnd(6))
		y = 2+flr(rnd(5))
		dt = mget(x,y)
		if dt>=2 and dt<=14 then
			for a in all(gadj) do
				sx = x+a[1]
				sy = y+a[2]
				if mget(sx,sy) == 0 then
					mset(sx,sy,dt)
					mset(x,y,0)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function prevalidate()
	zeros = 0
	for y=1,6 do
		for x=1,6 do
			if mget(x,y) == 0 then
				zeros += 1
			end
		end
	end
	if zeros < 3 then
		return false
	end
	if wide then
		if zeros > 6 then
			return false
		end
	else
		if zeros > 5 then
			return false
		end
	end
	variety = false
	nerd = 0--1st non-herd species
	herdct = 0
	nerdct = 0
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			dt = mget(x,y)
			if dt==2 or dt==4 or dt==8 then
				nerdct += 1
				if nerd > 0 and dt != nerd then
					variety = true
				else
					nerd = dt
				end
			end
			if dt==6 or dt==10 or dt==12 or dt==14 then
				herdct += 1
				if nerd > 0 then
					variety = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if variety then
		if herdct == 0 then
			return true
		else
			return nerdct/herdct > 0.5
		end
	end
	return false
end

function rndstamp()
	func = flr(rnd(7))
	if func == 0 then
		return stampstego()
	elseif func == 1 then
		return stamptrex()
	elseif func == 2 then
		return stampbronto()
	elseif func == 3 then
		return stampraptor()
	elseif func == 4 then
		return stampgally()
	elseif func == 5 then
		return stampcompy()
	elseif func == 6 then
		return stampeggs()
	end
end

function msetr(mx,my,mw,mh,mt)
	for y=my,mh do
		for x=mx,mw do
			mset(x,y,mt)
		end
	end
end

function boilerplate()
	msetr(0,0,7,7,0)
	if wide then
		msetr(0,1,7,6,64)
		msetr(1,2,6,5,0)
	else
		msetr(1,1,6,6,64)
		msetr(2,2,5,5,0)
	end
end

function stamprocks()
	rndrocks()
	rndrocks()
	if wide then
		rndrocks()
		rndrocks()
		rndrocks()
	end
	rndplaza()
	if wide then
		rndplaza()
	end
	rockcoords = {}
	rx = 2
	rw = 5
	if wide then
		rx = 1
		rw = 6
	end
	for y=2,5 do
		for x=rx,rw do
		 if mget(x,y)==64 then
		  add(rockcoords,{x,y})
		 end
		end
	end
end

function rndrocks()
	if wide then
		mx = 1+flr(rnd(5))
	else
		mx = 2+flr(rnd(3))
	end
	my = 2+flr(rnd(3))
	mw = mx+flr(rnd(2))
	mh = my+flr(rnd(2))
	msetr(mx,my,mw,mh,64)
end

function rndplaza()
	if wide then
		mx = 1+flr(rnd(5))
	else
		mx = 2+flr(rnd(3))
	end
	my = 2+flr(rnd(3))
	mw = mx+1
	mh = my+1
	msetr(mx,my,mw,mh,0)
end

function stampstego()
	return stamppdino(2,false)
end

function stamptrex()
	sout = 0
	for i=1,10 do
		rx = 2+rnd(5)
		if (wide) rx = 1+rnd(6)
		ry = 2+rnd(5)
		if mget(rx,ry)==0 and gcp(rx,ry,4) then
			if picky(rx,ry,4) then
				mset(rx,ry,4)
				sout += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return sout
end

function stampbronto()
	return stampherd(6)
end

function stampraptor()
	return stamppdino(8,true)
end

function stampgally()
	return stampherd(10)
end

function stampcompy()
	return stamppdino(12,false)
end

function stampeggs()
	sout = 0
	for i=1,6 do
		ex = 2+rnd(5)
		if (wide) ex = 1+rnd(6)
		ey = 2+rnd(5)
		if mget(ex,ey)==0 then
			if picky(ex,ey,14) then
				mset(ex,ey,14)
				sout += 1
			end
		end
	end
	return sout
end

function stamppdino(dt,pred)
	if (#rockcoords == 0) return 0
	sout = 0
	rc = rnd(rockcoords)
	for i=1,8 do
		chance = rnd(2) <= 1
		if (pred) chance = true
		if chance then
			ra = rnd(gadj)
			stx = rc[1]+ra[1]
			sty = rc[2]+ra[2]
			if mget(stx,sty) == 0 then
				if not pred or gcp(stx,sty,dt) then
					if picky(stx,sty,dt) then
						mset(stx,sty,dt)
						sout += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if (sout == 0) return sout
	mset(rc[1],rc[2],32)
	return sout
end

function stampherd(dt)
	sout = 0
	for i=1,20 do
		bx = 2+rnd(5)
		if (wide) bx = 1+rnd(6)
		by = 2+rnd(5)
		for h=1,10 do
			hp = rnd(herds)
			herdok = true
			for y=by,by+hp[2]-1 do
				for x=bx,bx+hp[1]-1 do
					if mget(x,y) != 0 then
						herdok = false
					end
					if not picky(x,y,dt) then
						herdok = false
					end
				end
			end
			if herdok then
				for y=by,by+hp[2]-1 do
					for x=bx,bx+hp[1]-1 do
						mset(x,y,dt)
						sout += 1
					end
				end
				return sout
			end
		end 
	end
	return sout
end

function gcp(x,y,dt)
	for a in all(gadj) do
		gcpt = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if gcpt==2 or gcpt==6 or gcpt==12 then
		 return true
		end
		if dt==4 and gcpt==8 then
			return true
		end
		if dt==8 and gcpt==4 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function picky(x,y,dt)
	for a in all(gadj) do
		gcpt = mget(x+a[1],y+a[2])
		if dt!=14 and gcpt==14 then
			return false
		end
		if dt==2 and gcpt==dt then
			return false
		end
		if dt==4 and (gcpt==dt or gcpt==10) then
		 return false
		end
		if dt==8 and (gcpt==dt or gcpt==10) then
		 return false
		end
		if dt==10 and (gcpt==4 or gcpt==8) then
			return false
		end
		if dt==14 and (gcpt==2 or gcpt==4 or gcpt==6 or gcpt==8 or gcpt==10 or gcpt==12) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function cache()
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			mset(x,24+y,mget(x,y))
		end
	end
end

function uncache()
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			mset(x,y,mget(x,24+y))
		end
	end
end

function cachesad()
	for y=0,7 do
		for x=0,7 do
			t = mget(x*2,y*2)
			if sdino(t) then
				mset(x,24+y,t)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- zep&co
-- px9 decompress

-- x0,y0 where to draw to
-- src   compressed data address
-- vget  read function (x,y)
-- vset  write function (x,y,v)

function
    px9_decomp(x0,y0,src,vget,vset)

    local function vlist_val(l, val)
        -- find position and move
        -- to head of the list

        local v,i=l[1],1
        while v!=val do
            i+=1
            v,l[i]=l[i],v
        end
        l[1]=val
    end

    -- bit cache is between 8 and
    -- 15 bits long with the next
    -- bits in these positions:
    --   0b0000.12345678...
    -- (1 is the next bit in the
    --   stream, 2 is the next bit
    --   after that, etc.
    --  0 is a literal zero)
    local cache,cache_bits=0,0
local str=ord(src,8)--dho
local pos=str and 1 or src--dho
    function getval(bits)
        if cache_bits<8 then
            -- cache next 8 bits
            cache_bits+=8
            --cache+=@src>>cache_bits
            --src+=1
--decomp from str
cache+=(str and ord(src,pos) or @pos)>>cache_bits --dho
pos+=1 --dho
        end

        -- shift requested bits up
        -- into the integer slots
        cache<<=bits
        local val=cache&0xffff
        -- remove the integer bits
        cache^^=val
        cache_bits-=bits
        return val
    end

    -- get number plus n
    function gnp(n)
        local bits=0
        repeat
            bits+=1
            local vv=getval(bits)
            n+=vv
        until vv<(1<<bits)-1
        return n
    end

    -- header

    local
        w,h_1,      -- w,h-1
        eb,el,pr,
        x,y,
        splen,
        predict
        =
        gnp"1",gnp"0",
        gnp"1",{},{},
        0,0,
        0
        --,nil

    for i=1,gnp"1" do
        add(el,getval(eb))
    end
    for y=y0,y0+h_1 do
        for x=x0,x0+w-1 do
            splen-=1

            if(splen<1) then
                splen,predict=gnp"1",not predict
            end

            local a=y>y0 and vget(x,y-1) or 0

            -- create vlist if needed
            local l=pr[a] or {unpack(el)}
            pr[a]=l

            -- grab index from stream
            -- iff predicted, always 1

            local v=l[predict and 1 or gnp"2"]

            -- update predictions
            vlist_val(l, v)
            vlist_val(el, v)

            -- set
            vset(x,y,v)
        end
    end
end

function pd_rotate(x,y,rot,mx,my,w,flp,scale)
 scale=scale or 1
 w*=scale*4

 local cs,ss=cos(rot)*.125/scale,sin(rot)*.125/scale
 local sx,sy=mx+cs*-w, my+ss*-w
 local hx=flp and -w or w

 local halfw = -w
 for py=y-w,y+w do
  tline(x-hx,py,x+hx,py,sx-ss*halfw,sy+cs*halfw,cs,ss)
  halfw+=1
 end
end

description: How to Play Cattle Crisis is an arcade shoot 'em up game (Shmup). Pilot your fighter jet to defeat evil aliens and save our precious cows! Cattle Crisis is a short game and currently features one level. Arrow keys - Move the jet (X) Button - Shoot (O) Button - Hyper / Bomb System As you shoot enemies or collect 🐄, your meter will fill. Once it passes the halfway point, you can activate Hyper Mode by pressing the Hyper button. While in Hyper Mode, the meter gradually depletes. Taking a hit will end Hyper Mode, but you won’t lose a life. Pressing the Hyper button again during Hyper Mode unleashes a devastating bomb, which consumes half of the remaining meter—if any is left. Scoring Shooting enemies at close range increases your score (up to 4×) and causes more 🐄 to drop, allowing you to charge the meter faster. While in Hyper Mode, enemies drop ⭐ instead of 🐄, which grant extra points. The value of each ⭐ is shown in the top-right corner during Hyper Mode. Each enemy defeated in Hyper Mode increases the ⭐ value. Activating a bomb turns all nearby bullets into additional ⭐. Video Series Cattle Crisis was created as part of a tutorial series on how to make an Advanced Shmup from scratch . Credits This game was written and designed by me, Krystian Majewski. The music was composed by Sebastian Haßler , a music composer for film, TV and videogames. The cover illustration was created by Mag Draws . This project would have not been possible without the generous donations from my supporters on Ko-fi . Thank you! function getplayer(pi)
	for y=0,4*16-1 do
		for x=0,8*16-1 do
			if mget(x,y) == pi then
				mset(x,y,0)
				px = x
				py = y
				pflip = false
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function _update()
	if ending2 then
		runending2()
		return
	end
	if ending then
		runending()
		return
	end
	if waketime > 0 then
  wakeup()
	 return
	end
	input()
	move()
	poop()
	restore()
	doors()
end

function tick(v,s)
	return v/s == flr(v/s)
end

function runending2()
	if endtime2 < 500 then
		endtime2 += 1
	end
	if endtime2 > 50 then
		adj = endtime2 - 50
		if adj < 30 then
			if (tick(adj,8)) poop()
		elseif adj < 60 then
			if (tick(adj,4)) poop()
		elseif adj < 90 then
			if (tick(adj,2)) poop()
		elseif adj < 120 then
			poop()
		elseif adj < 150 then
			poop()
			poop()
		else
			poop()
			poop()
			poop()
			poop()
		end
	end
	if py < 0 then
		for y=0,15 do
			mset(120,y,0)
		end
		py = 15
		regenstars()
	end
	if (endtime2 == 180) sfx(12)
	if (endtime2 > 330) run()
end

function runending()
	if endtime < 500 then
		endtime += 1
	end
	if endtime > 260 then
		if anykey() then
			if missedskulls > 0 then
				run()
			else
				endit2()
			end
		end
	end
end

function wakeup()
	if asleep and anykey() then
	 asleep = false
	 sfx(13)
	end
	if (not asleep) waketime -= 1
end

function anykey()
	 return btnp(0) or btnp(1) or btnp(2) or btnp(3) or btnp(4) or btnp(5)
end

function input()
	nx = 0
	if (btnp(0)) nx = -1
	if (btnp(1)) nx = 1
end

function track(ox,oy,tx,ty)
	for r in all(restores) do
		if r[4] == ox and r[5] == oy then
			r[4] = tx
			r[5] = ty
			return
		end
	end
	add(restores,{mget(ox,oy),ox,oy,tx,ty})
end

function move()
	if (nx == 0) return
	if (nx < 0) pflip = true
	if (nx > 0) pflip = false
	ni = mget(px+nx,py)
	if iswall(ni) then
		if iscrate(px,nx,py) then
			normal = true
			if mget(px+nx,py)==45 then
				dtrack(px+nx,py)
			end
			if isskull(mget(px+nx+nx,py)) then
				if mget(px+nx,py) == 44 then
					track(px+nx+nx,py,px+nx+nx,py)
					mset(px+nx+nx,py,45)
					sfx(1)
					normal = false
					dtrack(px+nx+nx,py)
				else
					track(px+nx+nx,py,-1,-1)
				end
			end
			if normal then
				if mget(px+nx,py) != 44 then
					track(px+nx,py,px+nx+nx,py)
				end
				mset(px+nx+nx,py,ni)
			end
			slid = 0
			if flr(rnd(3)) >= 1 then
				slid = 17
			end
			mset(px+nx,py,slid)
			falltile(px+nx+nx,py)
		else
			return
		end
	end
	px += nx
	moved = 3
	sfx(rnd(stsfx))
	fall()
end

function isskull(ni)
	return ni == 43
end

function iswall(ni)
	return ni >= 44
end

function isspikes(ni)
	return ni == 48
end

function isdoor(ni)
	return ni == 30 or ni == 31 or ni == 46 or ni == 47
end

function iscrate(x,dx,y)
	if (not iswall(mget(x+dx,y))) return false
 if (iswall(mget(x+dx+dx,y)) or isdoor(mget(x+dx+dx,y))) return false
 if (iswall(mget(x+dx,y-1))) return false
	return true
end

function fall()
	blomp = 0
	while not iswall(mget(px,py+1)) do
		py += 1
		blomp += 1
	end
	if blomp > 1 then
	 sfx(3)
	 landed = 6
	 landx = px
	 landy = py
	 landtime = 10
	end
end

function falltile(x,y)
	blomp = 0
	skx = -1
	sky = -1
	f = mget(x,y)
	if f == 45 then
		dtrack(x,y)
		skx = x
		sky = y
	end
	while not iswall(mget(x,y+1)) and not isdoor(mget(x,y+1)) do
		blomp += 1
		of = f
		if isskull(mget(x,y+1)) then
			skx = x
			sky = y+1
			if f == 44 then
				sfx(1)
				f = 45
				track(x,y+1,x,y+1)
			else
				track(x,y+1,-1,-1)
			end
		end
		if (of != 44)	track(x,y,x,y+1)
		mset(x,y+1,f)
		scrape = 0
		if flr(rnd(3)) >= 1 then
			scrape = 18
		end
		mset(x,y,scrape)
		y += 1
	end
	if isspikes(mget(x,y+1)) then
		sc = mget(x,y)
		if sc == 44 or sc == 45 then
			if (sc == 44) mset(x,y,0)
			if (sc == 45) mset(x,y,43)
			sfx(4)
			poptime = 6
			popx = x
			popy = y
		end
	end
	if skx >= 0 and sky >= 0 then
		dtrack(skx,sky)
		dtrack(x,y)
	end
	if blomp > 1 then
		sfx(3)
		landx = x
	 landy = y
	 landtime = 10
	end
end

function poop()
	if btnp(4) or ending2 then
		if iswall(mget(px,py-1)) then
		 sfx(rnd(stsfx))
		 pooped = 3
		 return
		end
		if isspikes(mget(px,py+1)) then
			sfx(4)
			popx = px
			popy = py
			poptime = 6
			pooped = 3
		 return
		end
		pt = mget(px,py)
		if isskull(pt) then
			track(px,py,px,py)
			mset(px,py,45)
			dtrack(px,py)
			sfx(1)
		elseif isdoor(pt) then
			track(px,py,-1,-1)
			mset(px,py,44)
			sfx(rnd(bbsfx))
		else
			mset(px,py,44)
			if endtime2 < 210 then
				sfx(rnd(bbsfx))
			end
		end
		py -= 1
		pooped = 3
		if py < 0 and not ending2 then
		 endit()
		else
			if not played2f and py < 3*16 then
				sfx(14)
				played2f = true
			end
			if not playedlab and py < 2*16 then
				sfx(15)
				playedlab = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function endit()
	ending = true
	for y=0,4*16-1 do
		for x=0,8*16-1 do
			esc = mget(x,y)
			if esc == 45 or esc == 43 then
				if esc == 43 then
				 missedskulls += 1
				 esc = 39
				end
				add(skulls,esc)
			end
		end
	end
	for r in all(restores) do
		if r[1] == 43 and r[4] == -1 and r[5] == -1 then
			add(skulls,41)
			missedskulls += 1
		end
	end
	for y=0,15 do
		for x=0,15 do
			pxl = 0
			ppt = mget(x,y+32)
			if (ppt == 51) pxl = 15
			sset(56+x,16+y,pxl)
		end
	end
	for y=0,15 do
		for x=0,15 do
			pxl = 0
			ppt = mget(x,y+48)
			if (ppt == 50) pxl = 11
			if (ppt == 48) pxl = 3
			sset(104+x,16+y,pxl)
		end
	end
	for y=0,15 do
		for x=0,15 do
			pxl = 0
			ppt = mget(x+16,y+48)
			if (ppt == 51) pxl = 15
			sset(72+x,16+y,pxl)
		end
	end
	--missedskulls = 0
end

strclr = {1,7,12}
function endit2()
	waketime = 0
	ending2 = true
	px = 120
	py = 28
	regenstars()
end

function regenstars()
	stars = {}
	for s=0,100 do
		stx = 7*128+flr(rnd(127))
		sty = flr(rnd(159))
		add(stars,{rnd(strclr),stx,sty})
	end
end

function canrestore()
	pt = mget(px,py)
	checkdrop = false
	if isdoor(pt) then
		pt2 = mget(px,py+1)
		if pt2 != 44 and pt2 != 45 then
			checkdrop = true
		end
	end
	bail = checkdrop
	for r in all(restores) do
		if iswall(r[1]) then
			if r[2] == px and r[3] == py then
		 	sfx(10)
		 	failed = 6
		 	return false
		 end
		 if bail and r[4] == px and r[5] == py+1 then
		 	bail = false
		 end
		end
	end
	if bail then
		sfx(10)
		failed = 6
	end
	return not bail
end

function restorebounds()
	xl = max(0,cc(px)-1)
	xh = min(8*16-1,cc(px)+16)
	yl = max(0,cc(py)-1)
	yh = min(4*16-1,cc(py)+16)
end

function restore()
	if btnp(5) and canrestore() then
		blomp = false
		restorebounds()
		bubbles = {}
		for y=yl,yh do
			for x=xl,xh do
				t = mget(x,y)
				if t == 44 or t == 45 then
					add(bubbles,{t,x,y})
					blomp = true
				end
			end
		end
		blomp = #bubbles > 0
		for b in all(bubbles) do
			popped = 0
			if flr(rnd(3)) >= 1 then
				popped = 12+flr(rnd(3))
			end
			mset(b[2],b[3],popped)
			if b[1] == 45 then
				dtrack(b[2],b[3])
			end
			del(bubbles,b)
		end
		proc = {}
		for r in all(restores) do
			if r[2] >= xl and r[2] <= xh and r[3] >= yl and r[3] <= yh or r[4] >= xl and r[4] <= xh and r[5] >= yl and r[5] <= yh then
				if r[4] >= 0 and r[5] >= 0 and r[1] != 45 then
					mset(r[4],r[5],0)
				end
				if r[1] == 43 then
					dtrack(r[4],r[5])
				end
				add(proc,del(restores,r))
			end
		end
		if (#proc > 0) blomp = true
		for r in all(proc) do
			for cr in all(restores) do
				if r[2] == cr[4] and r[3] == cr[5] then
					if cr[1] == 43 then
						dtrack(cr[4],cr[5])
					end
					cr[4] = -1
					cr[5] = -1
				end
			end
			mset(r[2],r[3],r[1])
			if r[1] == 43 then
				dtrack(r[2],r[3])
			end
			del(proc,r)
		end
		if blomp then
		 sfx(9)
		 restored = 8
		else
			sfx(10)
			failed = 6
		end
		fall()
	end
end

function dtrack(mdx,mdy)
	add(doords,{mdx,mdy})
end

function doors()
	if (#doords <= 0) return
	screens = {}
	for d in all(doords) do
		soord = {cc(d[1]),cc(d[2])}
		del(doords,d)
		ats = true
		for s in all(screens) do
			if s[1] == soord[1] and s[2] == soord[2] then
				ats = false
			end
		end
		if (ats) add(screens,soord)
	end
	for scr in all(screens) do
		screendoors(scr[1],scr[2])
	end
end
	
function screendoors(scx,scy)
	bs = 0
	for y=scy,scy+15 do
		for x=scx,scx+15 do
			t = mget(x,y)
			if t == 45 then
				bs += 1
			elseif t == 30 then
				mset(x,y,46)
			elseif t == 31 then
				mset(x,y,47)
			end
		end
	end
	if (bs == 0) return
	if not played4sk then
		if bs == 4 and scx == 48 and scy == 0 then
			sfx(16)
			played4sk = true
		end
	end
	for i=0,7 do
		for x=scx,scx+15 do
			if unlock(x,scy+i) then
				bs -= 1
				if (bs == 0) return
			end
		end
		for x=scx,scx+15 do
			if unlock(x,scy+15-i) then
				bs -= 1
				if (bs == 0) return
			end
		end
		for y=scy,scy+15 do
			if unlock(scx+i,y) then
				bs -= 1
				if (bs == 0) return
			end
		end
		for y=scy,scy+15 do
			if unlock(scx+15-i,y) then
				bs -= 1
				if (bs == 0) return
			end
		end
	end
end

function unlock(ux,uy)
	tc = mget(ux,uy)
	ut = -1
	if (tc == 46) ut = 30
	if (tc == 47) ut = 31
	if ut > 0 then
		mset(ux,uy,ut)
		fall()
		return true
	end
	return false
end

rp = {0,1,1,3,3,3,1,1}
ccx = 0
ccy = 0
function _draw()
	if ending2 then
		drawending2()
		return
	end
	if ending then
		drawending()
		return
	end
	clsi = 0
	if (restored > 0) clsi = rp[restored]
	cls(clsi)
	scroll()
	camera(ccx,ccy)
	wakepal()
	map()
	pal()
	drawplayer()
	drawpops()
end

function drawending2()
	clsi = 0
	adj2 = endtime2 - 220
	if (adj2 > 10) clsi = 1
	if (adj2 > 14) clsi = 5
	if (adj2 > 18) clsi = 13
	if (adj2 > 22) clsi = 12
	if (adj2 > 26) clsi = 6
	if (adj2 > 30) clsi = 7
	if (adj2 > 90) clsi = 6
	if (adj2 > 92) clsi = 12
	if (adj2 > 94) clsi = 13
	if (adj2 > 96) clsi = 5
	if (adj2 > 98) clsi = 1
	cls(clsi)
	if adj2 < 40 then
		scroll()
		camera(ccx,ccy)
		for star in all(stars) do
			pset(star[2],star[3],star[1])
		end
		map()
		drawplayer()
	end
end

function drawending()
	et = 120
	cls()
	camera()
	if endtime > et then
		pal(11,1)
		pal(15,1)
	end
	if endtime > 25 then
		if endtime > et then
			pal(3,1)
		else
			pal(1,15)
			pal(3,15)
		end
		pal(11,0)
		map(0,0,0,0,16,8)
		pal()
		if (endtime == 26) sfx(11)
	end
	if endtime > 50 then
		if endtime > et then
			pal(3,1)
			pal(11,1)
		else
			pal(3,11)
		end
		pal(1,0)
		map(0,8,0,64,16,8)
		pal()
		if (endtime == 51) sfx(11)
	end
	pal()
	if endtime > et then
		oski = ski
		ski = min(ceil((endtime-et)/3),#skulls)
		if oski != ski then
			sss = skulls[ski]
			if (sss==41) sfx(3)
			if (sss==43) sfx(rnd(stsfx))
			if (sss==45) sfx(rnd(bbsfx))
		end
		fsx = 16
		fsy = 8
		for i=1,ski do
			im = flr((i-1)/6)
			skx = fsx+(i-6*im-1)*16
			sky = fsy+im*16
			spr(skulls[i],skx,sky,2,2)
		end
	end
end

function scroll()
	tccx = cc(px)*8
	tccy = cc(py)*8
	if abs(ccx-tccx) > 128 or abs(ccy-tccy) > 128 then
		ccx = tccx
		ccy = tccy
	else
		if (ccx < tccx) ccx += 16
		if (ccx > tccx) ccx -= 16
		if (ccy < tccy) ccy += 16
		if (ccy > tccy) ccy -= 16
	end
end

function wakepal()
	if waketime > 0 then
		if waketime >= 60 then
			pal(1,0)
			pal(2,0)
			pal(3,0)
			pal(6,0)
			pal(7,1)
			pal(13,0)
			pal(15,0)
		elseif waketime > 40 then
			pal(1,0)
			pal(2,1)
			pal(3,1)
			pal(6,5)
			pal(7,13)
			pal(13,1)
			pal(15,1)
		elseif waketime > 20 then
			pal(6,13)
			pal(7,6)
			pal(13,5)
			pal(15,13)
		end
	end
end

function drawpops()
	if poptime > 0 then
		poptime -= 1
		spr(39-flr(poptime/3),popx*8,popy*8)
	end
	if landtime > 0 then
		landtime -= 1
		spr(41-flr(landtime/5),landx*8,landy*8)
	end
end

function drawplayer()
	pspr = 32
	if landed > 0 then
		landed -= 1
		pspr = 34
	end
	if pooped > 0 then
		pooped -= 1
		pspr = 35
	end
	if failed > 0 then
		failed -= 1
		pspr = 37
	end
	if moved > 0 then
		moved -= 1
		pspr = 33
	end
	if restored > 0 then
		restored -= 1
		pspr = 36
	end
	if (waketime > 0) pspr = 42
	spr(pspr,px*8,py*8,1,1,pflip)
end

function cc(z)
	return flr(z/16)*16
end
