function char_move_basic(o, dir)
	local isbig, d, x, y = o.big, DIRS[dir], unpack(o.pos[1])
	local nx, ny = x + d[1], y + d[2]
	local cnx, cny, cnx2, cny2 = nx, ny, nx+1, ny+1

	if isbig then
		if dir&1 ~= 0 then
			if dir&2 == 0 then
				cnx += 1
			else
				cny += 1
			end
		else
			if dir&2 == 0 then
				cnx2 -= 1
			else
				cny2 -= 1
			end
		end
	end
	-- stay in bounds
	if(level_is_solid(cnx, cny) or cny > 15 or isbig and (level_is_solid(cnx2, cny2) or cny2 > 15)) return

	local collides = gen_collision_map()
	local c,c2,eats = collides[cnx | cny<<8], collides[cnx2 | cny2<<8]

	if isbig and c and c2 then
		if c.food and c2.food then -- can't eat 2 food at once
			return
		elseif c.food then
			c, eats = {c2}, c
		elseif c2.food then
			c, eats = {c}, c2
		else
			c = {c, c2}
		end
	else
		c = c or isbig and c2 or nil
		if c and c.food then
			eats, c = c
		else
			c = {c}
		end
	end

	local opos_len = #o.pos
	-- could simplify	
	if opos_len == 1 and c and c[1] and not eats -- 1 length bird cannot push
	or eats and eats.candy and opos_len == 1 then -- check earlier to prevent weird queued push
		return
	end

	if opos_len > 1 then -- check if moving into tail, then remove positions
		local lp = o.pos[opos_len]
		local p1 = lp[1] | lp[2]<<8
		if isbig then
			local lp2 = o.pos[#o.pos - 1]
			local tail, p2 = {}, lp2[1] | lp2[2]<<8

			-- add tail section, remove overlapping second to last section
			tail[p1], tail[p1+1], tail[p1+0x100], tail[p1+0x101] = true, true, true, true
			tail[p2], tail[p2+1], tail[p2+0x100], tail[p2+0x101] = nil -- don't merge

			-- can't push into tail
			if(tail[cnx | cny<<8] or tail[cnx2 | cny2<<8]) return

			for k in next, tail do
				collides[k] = nil
			end

		else
			if(cnx == lp[1] and cny == lp[2]) return 
			collides[p1] = nil
		end
	end

	-- try to push objects (happens first to avoid eating food without moving)
	if(c and not level_push(o, c, dir, collides)) return

	sfx(isbig and 62 or 48)
	
	if eats then
		local sp, fx, fy = eats.sp, unpack(eats.pos[1])
		local pos, draw_pos, old_pos = o.pos, o.draw_pos, o.old_pos
		local function check_g()
			o.no_grav = #pos == 1
		end

		if eats.fruit then -- eat fruit
			sfx"49"
			local p = copy_fast(add(pos, copy_fast(pos[opos_len])))
			add(old_pos, copy_fast(p))
			p[1] <<= 3
			p[2] <<= 3
			add(draw_pos, p)
			
			add(undo_actions, {function()
				deli(pos)
				deli(draw_pos)
				deli(old_pos)
				food_new(fx, fy, sp, true)
				check_g()
			end})

		elseif eats.candy then
			sfx"59"
			local last_pos = copy_fast(deli(pos))
			deli(draw_pos)
			deli(old_pos)
			
			particle_segment(last_pos, COLORS[o.col][(#pos&1) + 1])
			
			add(undo_actions, {function()
				add(pos, copy_fast(last_pos))
				add(old_pos, copy_fast(last_pos))
				last_pos[1] <<= 3
				last_pos[2] <<= 3
				add(draw_pos, last_pos)
				food_new(fx, fy, sp, false)
				check_g()
			end})
		end
		check_g()

		-- eating particles
		call_multi(particle_thrown_new, 4, fx*8+4, fy*8+4, sget(sp%16*8 + 4, sp\16*8 + 4)) --sget for food color

		del(objs, eats)

		level_food_check()
	end


	
	-- update body positions
	o.pos[1][3] = dir
	-- roll previous positions over
	for i = #o.pos,2,-1 do
		o.pos[i] = o.pos[i-1]
	end
	-- new head position
	o.pos[1] = {nx, ny, nil, dir~1}
	if dir&2 == 0 then
		o.facing = dir&1 == 1
	end
	level_portal_check()
	level_queue_position_change()
	
	anim_queue(level_gravity_step)
	return true
end

function all_pos(o)
	if not o.big or not o.pos then
		return ipairs(o.pos)
	end

	local i, j, found = 1, -1, {}

	return function()
		::again::
		-- next corner
		j += 1
		if j == 4 then -- next position
			i += 1
			j = 0
		end

		-- check if end
		local p = o.pos[i]
		if(not p) return
		
		-- find position and if duplicate
		local x, y = p[1]+j%2, p[2]+j\2
		local k = x|y>>>16
		if(found[k]) goto again
		found[k] = true

		return i, {x, y}
	end
end

DIRS[0] = split"-1,0"



function level_init(id, for_main_menu, editor)
	-- copy the stored level data to used map data
	local start, birdcol = id > 7 and 0x1000 or 0x2000, 0
	start += id%8*16

	for i = 0,480,32 do
		local addr = start + i*4
		memcpy(0xfe00 + i, addr, 16)
		memcpy(0xfe10 + i, addr + 0x800, 16)
	end

	if not for_main_menu and not editor then
		option_reset(id)
	end

	-- reset tables
	anims, undo_actions, objs, chars, current_save_id = {}, {}, {}, {}, id

	for x = 0,15 do
		for y = 0,15 do
			local id = mget(x, y)

			if fget(id, 2) or fget(id, 3) then -- fruit or fruit
				food_new(x, y, id, fget(id, 2))
			
			elseif id == 47 then -- portal
				if not for_main_menu then
					portal_new(x, y)
				end

			elseif id >= 60 and id <= 63 then
				birdcol = id - 60

			elseif id == 12 or id == 13 then -- generate snakebird
				local prev = {x, y, nil, 0}
				local pos = {prev}

				::next:: -- looking at each neighbor
				local p = pos[#pos]
				for i, d in next, DIRS do
					local x, y = p[1]+d[1], p[2]+d[2]
					if mget(x, y) == i + 28 then -- special sprite id for connecting snakebirds
						mset(x, y)
						prev[4], prev = i, add(pos, {x, y,  i~1}) -- yep
						goto next -- only one neighbor allowed
					end
				end
				if #pos > 1 then
					prev[4] = prev[3]~1 -- last segment has the same direction
				end

				if not for_main_menu then
					birdcol += 1
					char_new(pos, birdcol, id==13)
					birdcol %= #COLORS
				end


			elseif id == 15 then -- box
				local i, pos = 1, {{x, y}}
				while i <= #pos do
					local p = pos[i]
					for i, d in next, DIRS do
						local x, y = p[1]+d[1], p[2]+d[2]
						if mget(x, y) == i + 28 then -- special sprite id
							mset(x, y)
							add(pos, {x, y})
						end
					end
					i += 1
				end

				block_new(pos)

			else
				goto noclear
			end
			mset(x,y)
			::noclear::
		end
	end

	current_char = chars[1] -- control the first snakebird
	level_food_check()
end

function gen_collision_map()
	local collides = {}

	for _,o in next,objs do
		if not o.no_solid then
			for _,p in all_pos(o) do
				collides[p[1] | p[2]<<8] = o
			end
		end
	end

	return collides
end

function level_gravity_step()
	character_spike_check = {}
	level_portal_check()
	if not level_portaling_char then -- don't check yet
		for _,o in next,objs do
			if not o.no_move and not o.no_grav then
				while not o.no_solid and level_push(nil, {o}, 3, nil, level_is_solid_dangerless, true) do
					level_spike_check()
					level_portal_check()
				end
			end
		end
		level_queue_position_change(1)

		-- goes through characters in a lose state
		if next(character_spike_check) then -- if any
			local to_undo = false
			for s in next, character_spike_check do
				to_undo = to_undo or s.char
			end

			anim_queue(function()
				-- snakebird or box disappears in a puff of particles
				for s in next, character_spike_check do
					s.no_draw = true
					for i,p in all_pos(s) do
						particle_segment(p, s.colf or COLORS[s.col][(i&1~1) + 1])
					end
					sfx"51"
				end
				
				-- appends undo
				deli(undo_actions)
				level_undo_record()

				-- wait a few frames
				for i = 1,30 do
					yield()
				end
				character_spike_check = {}
			end)
			-- forces an undo action
			if to_undo then
				input_queue = {level_undo_apply}
			end
		end
		
	end
	level_undo_record()
end

-- currently expects that the first character is fine to move
-- first = first character being pushed
-- char = original pushing character
-- dir = direction
-- collides = collision map, if one isn't already generated
function level_push(char, firsts, dir, collides, is_solid, grav_step)
	collides = collides or gen_collision_map()
	is_solid = is_solid or level_is_solid

	local to_check, checked, dx, dy = firsts, {}, unpack(DIRS[dir])
	
	for _,f in next, firsts do
		checked[f] = true
	end

	while to_check[1] do
		local c = deli(to_check, 1)
		if c.no_move then
			return
		end
		
		local is_solid = c.char and is_solid or level_is_solid

		for _, p in all_pos(c) do
			local nx, ny = p[1] + dx, p[2] + dy
			
			if(is_solid(nx, ny) or ny > 15 and not grav_step) return
			
			local c2 = collides[nx | ny<<8]

			if c2 then
				if c2.no_move -- object being pushed is not allowed to move
				or c2 == char -- current character is being pushed against (would break collision)
				or grav_step and c2.no_grav then
					return
				end
				
				if not checked[c2] then
					checked[c2] = true
					add(to_check, c2)
				end

			end
		end
		-- only need to check that it doesn't push into the first character
	end

	-- valid movement

	for o in next, checked do
		for _,p in next, o.pos do
			p[1] += dx
			p[2] += dy
		end
	end

	return true
end


function ib(x, y)
	return x < 0 or y < 0 -- in bounds
	or x > 15 or y > 16 -- can fall into floor
end
-- just checks level geometry, not characters or fruit
function level_is_solid(x, y)
	return ib(x, y) or fget(mget(x, y))&3 != 0 -- collide into wall or spikes
end

-- same as is_solid, but allows movement into spikes and 1 tile out of bounds
function level_is_solid_dangerless(x, y)
	return ib(x, y) or y < 16 and fget(mget(x, y), 0) -- collide into wall
end


function level_update()
	if not anims[1] and level_portaling_char then

		local lpc = level_portaling_char
		lpc.no_solid, level_portaling_char = true

		if lpc == current_char then
			char_cycle()
		end

		local len, i, speed = #lpc.pos, 2, 1

		-- queues up each step of animation
		local function queue_anim()
			lpc.draw_limit = i

			if i <= len then -- if there's more segments to update
				-- update position of segments
				for j = len,i,-1 do
					local p1, p2 = lpc.pos[j], lpc.pos[j-1]
					for i = 1,4 do
						p1[i] = p2[i]
					end
				end

				-- replace the expected nil entry
				local p = lpc.pos[i]
				p[3] = p[4]~1

				-- update positions, with acceleration
				level_queue_position_change(3, speed)
				speed += 0.4

				i += 1
				anim_queue(queue_anim)

			else -- anim done, prepare next part
				lpc.portaled = true

				deli(undo_actions) -- remove last false
				level_gravity_step()
				if #lpc.pos > 1 then
					level_portal.v = lpc.big and -0.2 or -0.125
				end
				check_level_done()
			end
		end
		anim_queue(function() sfx"54" end)
		anim_queue(queue_anim)

		call_multi(particle_portal, 10, level_portal.x*8+4, level_portal.y*8+4)
		level_portal.v = lpc.big and 0.45 or 0.25
		
	end
end


-- updates the drawing position of characters 
function level_queue_position_change(ty, speed)

	-- {table to alter, table target << 3, index, ...}
	local speed, moving, setting, collides = speed or 1, {}, {}, ty == 1 and gen_collision_map()
	-- moving interpolates a specific value in a table
	-- setting sets a specific value in a table

	for _,o in next, objs do
		if o.draw_pos then
			for i,p in inext, o.pos do
				local p2 = o.draw_pos[i]
				
				-- positions
				if p[1]<<3 ~= p2[1]\1 then
					add(moving, {p2, p[1]<<3 | 0.5, 1})
				end
				
				if p[2]<<3 ~= p2[2]\1 then
					local m = add(moving, {p2, p[2]<<3 | 0.5, 2})
					if ty == 1 then -- assume gravity movement happening
						
						for delt in all(o.big and {split"0,2,4",split"1,2,6"} or {split"0,1,6"}) do
							local x, y, d = p[1]+delt[1], p[2]+delt[2], delt[3]
							local o2 = collides[x | y<<8]
							if o2 and o ~= o2 or level_is_solid_dangerless(x, y) then
								-- lands on something other than itslef
								m[d] = x<<3 
								m[d+1] = y<<3
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if o.char then -- facings
					for i = 3,4 do
						add(setting, {p2, p[i], i})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	anim_queue(function()
		for _,s in next, setting do
			s[1][s[3]] = s[2]
		end
	end)

	if ty == 1 then -- quadradic (gravity)
		
		anim_queue(function()
			local amount = 0
			while moving[1] do
				for m in all(moving) do
					local p, i, done = m[1], m[3]

					p[i], done = towards(p[i], m[2], amount)
					if done then
						for i = 4,6,2 do
							if m[i] then -- landing on surface
								particle_cloud_new(m[i]+2, m[i+1], 1.5)
								particle_cloud_new(m[i]+6, m[i+1], 1.5)
								sfx"50"
							end
						end

						del(moving, m)
					end
				end
				amount += 0.32
				yield()
			end
		end)

	elseif ty == 2 then -- instant
		anim_queue(function()
			for m in all(moving) do
				m[1][m[3]] = m[2]
			end
		end)

	else -- linear
		anim_queue(function()
			while moving[1] do
				local s = ty == 3 and speed or min(#input_queue/2+1, 2) * speed
				for m in all(moving) do
					local p, i, done = m[1], m[3]

					p[i], done = towards(p[i], m[2], s)
					if done then
						del(moving, m)
					end
				end
				yield()
			end
		end)
	end

end

function level_undo_apply()
	anims, input_queue = {}, {}
	
	deli(undo_actions)
		
	if(next(undo_actions)) sfx"47"

	::again::
	local step = deli(undo_actions)

	if step then
		for u in all(step) do
			if type(u) == "function" then
				u()
			else
				local a,b,c,d = unpack(u)
				a.pos[b][d], a.old_pos[b][d] = c, c
			end	
		end
		goto again
	end

	add(undo_actions, false)

	-- instant position change
	level_queue_position_change(2)

	level_food_check()
	anim_update()
end

function level_undo_record()
	if stat"0" > 1800 then -- prevents reaching memory limit
		-- deletes until a false is reached
		::next::
		deli(undo_actions, 1)
		if undo_actions[1] then 
			goto next
		end
		deli(undo_actions, 1) -- delete the false
	end

	local undo, prev_char = add(undo_actions, {}), current_char
	
	for _,o in next, objs do
		if o.old_pos then
			for i,p in inext, o.pos do
				
				local p2 = o.old_pos[i]

				for j = 1,4 do
					if p2[j] ~= p[j] then
						add(undo, {o, i, p2[j], j})
						p2[j] = p[j]
					end
				end

			end
		end


		local old_facing, old_portaled, old_no_draw = o.old_facing, o.old_portaled, o.old_no_draw

		if o.facing ~= old_facing then
			add(undo, function()
				o.old_facing, o.facing = old_facing, old_facing
			end)   
		end

		if o.portaled ~= old_portaled then
			add(undo, function()
				o.old_portaled, o.portaled, o.no_solid, o.no_move, o.draw_limit = old_portaled, old_portaled, old_portaled, old_portaled, old_portaled and 999 or 0
			end)   
		end

		if o.no_draw ~= old_no_draw then
			add(undo, function()
				o.no_draw, o.old_no_draw, o.no_move, o.no_solid = old_no_draw, old_no_draw, old_no_draw, old_no_draw
			end)
		end

		o.old_facing, o.old_portaled, o.old_no_draw = o.facing, o.portaled, o.no_draw
	end

	if #undo == 0 then
		deli(undo_actions)
	else
		add(undo, function()
			current_char = prev_char
		end)
	end
	
	if undo_actions[#undo_actions] then
		add(undo_actions, false)
	end
end

function level_food_check()
	level_food_gone = true
	for o in all(objs) do
		if(o.food) level_food_gone = false
	end
end

function level_portal_check()
	if level_food_gone then
		for o in all(chars) do
			if not character_spike_check[o] then -- used to prevent spiked birds from portalling
				for _,p in all_pos({pos = {o.pos[1]}, big = o.big}) do -- CHECK ALL POS OF BIG

					if not o.portaled 
					and not level_portaling_char
					and level_portal
					and level_portal.x == p[1] 
					and level_portal.y == p[2] then
						o.draw_limit, o.no_move, level_portaling_char = 1, true, o
						add(undo_actions, {function()
							o.draw_limit, o.no_move, level_portaling_char = 0
						end})
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

character_spike_check = {} -- prevent duplicates
function level_spike_check()
	for _, o in next, objs do
		if not o.no_solid then
			local bl = not o.is_block
			for _,p in all_pos(o) do
				local x, y = p[1], p[2]
				if y > 15 -- off screen
				or bl and not level_is_solid_dangerless(x, y) and level_is_solid(x, y) then
					o.no_move, o.no_solid, character_spike_check[o] = true, true, true
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

particles = {}


function particle_cloud_new(x, y, r, col)
	local mult = r / 3
	local a, v = rnd(), (rnd"0.4"+0.1) * mult
	local l = (rnd"30" + 50 + v*20) * mult
	add(particles, {
		x, y, 
		sin(a)*v, cos(a)*v-0.3 * mult, 
		-0.005, 
		0.95, 
		r, col or 1, 
		l, l
	})
end

function particle_segment(p, c)
	call_multi(particle_cloud_new, 6, p[1]*8+4, p[2]*8+4, 3, c)
end

function particle_thrown_new(x, y, col)
	local a, v = rnd(), rnd"0.4"+0.1
	local l = rnd"20" + 20 + v*20
	add(particles, {
		x, y, 
		sin(a)*v, (cos(a) - 0.25)*v, 
		0.02, 
		0.99, 
		2, col or 1, 
		l, l
	})
end

function particle_portal(x, y)
	local a, v = rnd(), rnd"0.2"+0.2
	local s, c, l = sin(a), cos(a), rnd"30" + 50 + v*20
	add(particles, {
		x + s*4, y + c*4, 
		s*v, c*v, 
		0, 
		0.95, 
		2, rnd(portal_COLS), 
		l, l
	})
end

function particles_update()
	for p in all(particles) do
		p[9] -= 1

		if p[9] <= 0 then
			del(particles, p)
			
		else
			p[4] += p[5] -- accelerate
			p[3] *= p[6] -- drag
			p[4] *= p[6]
			p[1] += p[3] -- move
			p[2] += p[4]
		end
	end
end

				tr_t, mode = -0.1, tr_mode
				
				music_play() -- fade in new music based on mode

				if tr_on_mid then
					tr_on_mid()
				end
			end

		end
	end

			r *= r*(288-192*r)
			circfill(0, 0, r, 0x1801)
			
			for c in all(tr_clouds) do
				local a = c[1] + t()/3

			end

		end
	end

do -- map generation

	local function check(x, y)
		local p = x|y<<8
		local m = ls_map[p]

			if s then
				local flip, s = s < 0, abs(s)-1
				local sx, sy, dx, dy = s%6*20, s\6*20+64, x*20 + 14, y*20 + 14
				
				add(ls_draws, function() -- waves, but kinda weird method?
					sspr(sx,sy, 20,20, dx,dy+cos(t()/4+dx/110)+0.5, 20,20, flip, false)
				end, 1)
				ls_mid += 1
				add(ls_draws, function()

				end)

function level_select_draw()

			end

	pal(0)
	for d in all(ls_draws_detail) do
		d()
	end

	-- levels
	pal(split"15,11,4,13,1", 0)
	for o in all(ls_options) do
		if o[3] ~= "warp" then -- level
			local solved = level_st(o)
			if solved > 0 then
				local x, y = o[1]*20+6, o[2]*20 + 2.5 + sin(t()/2+o[1]/4+o[2]/16)
				sspr(solved == 2 and 60 or 76,84, 16,16, x, y)
				outlined_text(o[5], x + 8 - #tostr(o[5]) * 3, y, solved == 2 and 8 or 4, 5)
			end
		end
	end

	pal(0)
	poke"0x5f54"

	ls_x, ls_xv = smooth_move(ls_xt+0.5/20, ls_x, ls_xv, 0.06, 0.81, 0.001)
	ls_y, ls_yv = smooth_move(ls_yt+0.5/20, ls_y, ls_yv, 0.06, 0.81, 0.001)

	camera(x,y)
	call(spr, split2[[
79,1,-3

78,1,13

		for i = t()%1,7 do
			i /= 7

			circfill(x,y,3,5)

		end

	end

-- level select updating

function level_st(m)
	return peek(0x5e10 + m[4])
end

function haskey(tab, key, val)
	for k,v in pairs(tab) do
		if(v[key] == val) return v, k
	end
end

ls_x, ls_y, _, ls_save_force = unpack(haskey(ls_options, 4, @0x5e01) or ls_options[1]) -- unpacks the x and y position of first level or starting level
ls_xt, ls_yt, ls_xv, ls_yv = ls_x, ls_y, 0, 0

ls_save_force += 0x5e10
poke(ls_save_force, max(1, @ls_save_force)) -- forces level to be unlocked


function level_select_update()
	if(tr_is() or anims[1]) return -- transitioning

	for i,d in pairs(DIRS) do
		if btnp(i) then
			local nx, ny = ls_xt + d[1], ls_yt + d[2]
			local info = ls_map[nx|ny<<8]
			if info and level_st(info) > 0 then
				sfx"60"
				ls_xt, ls_yt = nx, ny
			end
		end
	end

	if btnp"4" or btnp"5" then
		local info = ls_map[ls_xt|ls_yt<<8]
		if info then
			poke(0x5e01, info[4]) -- last selected option (save id)

			if info[3] == "warp" then
				if info[7] == "locked" and level_st(info) ~= 2 then
					return -- check for special level
				end
				
				if info[6] == "end" then
					poke(0x4301, 0xbe)
					creds()
				else
					load_cart(info[5])
				end
				
			else
				tr_start(2, function()
					level_init(info[3])
				end)
			end

			sfx"61"
			ls_fireworks(ls_xt, ls_yt, 15)
		end
	end
end

-- if pos is given, play no animations
function solve_anim(pos)
	while(tr_x and not pos) yield()
	local tested, info, first = {}, pos or haskey(ls_options, 3, current_save_id), 1

	local function solve_loop(x, y, m, d, lock)
		local info = ls_map[x|y<<8]
		if info and not tested[info] then
			local info6, iswarp = info[6], info[3] == "warp"
			if iswarp and not lock or not info6 or not d or info6 == d then
				tested[info] = true -- prevent loops

				if level_st(info) < m then -- update
					if not pos then -- play animation
						for i = 1,first do 
							yield() 
						end
						first = 35
						ls_fireworks(x,y, m == 2 and (sl_col or 15) or 13, true)
					end
					poke(0x5e10 + info[4], m)
				end

				if not info6 and m == 2 or iswarp and m > 0 then -- propagate on newly solved or unlocked warps
					for _,d in pairs(DIRS) do
						solve_loop(x + d[1], y + d[2], 1, info[4], info[7])
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	solve_loop(info[1], info[2], pos and level_st(info) or 2)

	if(solve_extra) anim_queue(solve_extra)
end

function ls_fireworks(x, y, c, s)
	fireworks_new(x*20+14-(camx or 0), y*20+14, c, s, 1)
end

for info in all(ls_options) do
	solve_anim(info)
end
description: Snekburd is a Pico-8 demake of Snakebird, by Noumenon Games, with new puzzles and mechanics! Navigate the snakebirds to eat all the fruit and head through the portal to complete the levels on each island. The first island's levels should serve as a quick tutorial to new players or a refresher for returning ones. The game featues about 70 levels, ranging from a little tricky to absurdly hard. Of course, if you haven't played the original Snakebird games, I highly recommend them. Especially Snakebird Primer if you find this demake too difficult. > Snekburd Trailer < Controls arrow keys : move Z/C : undo X/V : switch control Z/C/X/V : select level The pause menu contains extra options for enabling a grid, resetting/exiting the level, and disabling just the music. Testers Karoo13 Tuure Pancelor Squidlight LokiStriker I've also uploaded the game to itch.io. It has a sweet design as well as an additional option for a more subtle grid. https://werxzy.itch.io/snekburd If you're wanting to download the carts, you can download the zip from the itch.io page to get them all at once. If you're downloading them from the bbs, all the carts you will need are: While there is a level editor that can be accessed from the main carts (just left of level A at the start) the cart can run standalone and there is a dedicated BBS post for the Snekburd level editor ( https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?tid=156094 ). If you're updating your carts, make sure to include the new #snekburd_editor cart. Changelog v1.1 Updated level 34 (Fixed alternate solution) Updated level 36 (Extended solution) Updated level 44 (Extended solution) Added secret level (shh) Adjusted graphics in a few levels without changing their solutions. v1.1c slightly adjusted levels 5, 47 to remove alternate solutions reworked levels 14, 43 v1.2 Added level editor (accessable via left of level A or with #snekburd_editor ) Updated levels 7, 7?, 34, 5*, Z

description: This is a game I've been coding for a bit, Linecraft ! This is my first and biggest demake (though I've been working in other non-published projects before) so I'm very excited that other people will try it! Also, I'll keep it updated, so if you find any bug, leave it down below on the comments! I'll check them out and fix them in the following versions. The sounds and music were made by Munchkin (thank you :D) and the code and graphics were made by me. Thanks to kallanreed for his tline rotation function I used for the splash text in the game. Thanks to Felice for their implementation of the OpenSimplex noise generator on PICO-8 that I used for the world generation in the game. The code may look a little different in my cart, but that's due to changes in development (back when I thought this game could be made in a single cart!). Thanks to shiftalow for their 140-token trifill function , fast and very light! So have fun playing it! I hope you like it :) (mouse support is funky when playing on website, so you might need to click on the game screen every time you load a world or save it) WARNING IF PLAYING ON WEBSITE: Your worlds will get deleted once you reload the page/close it. Export your worlds by selecting your world, going to the options menu and clicking "Export World". It will send the world data to your clipboard. Mobile players cannot press CTRL-C to allow the copy to go through, so sadly they cannot preserve any worlds they save. How to play with buttons There are two types/colors of buttons?! Yes, to fit all the actions of Linecraft in a limited button set, there are two types of button presses detected in the game. The green buttons are simple, the button just needs to be pressed in order for that action to be performed. The yellow buttons are the first button that you need to press do such thing. Eg: If you want to move the player to the left, you first press the O button and then you press the left button. If you first press the left button, the left button will be detected as the first one and the action will not take place! --vacay volley
--by ellery j reyes

--TIMELINE:
--"rallytest" started on 7/16/23
--"volley" on 8/6/23
--Version 1.0 on 8/31/23

--[[
  STATIC VARIABLES
  ]]

--debug
show_debug = false
debug_active = false

--Menu variables
PP_UP_Y = 20
PP_DOWN_Y = 130

--Game variables
GRAV = 1
BALL_GRAV = .1
FLOOR_HEIGHT = 108
FRIC_VAR = .7
BALL_FRIC_VAR = .99

KILL_COOR_L = -100
KILL_COOR_R = 228

BONUS_TIME_MAX = 300

RED_TIME_MAX = 30

--Difficulty variables
CRAB_DIV = 40
GULL_DIV = 80

--Spawn variables
PLAYER_SPAWN_X, PLAYER_SPAWN_Y = 32, 90
BALL_SPAWN_X, BALL_SPAWN_Y = 64, 90

CLOUD_SPAWN_DELAY_MAX = 1500
SPAWN_DELAY_RANDOM = 30

--Crab variables
CRAB_SPAWN_DELAY_MIN = 300

--Gull variables
GULL_SPAWN_DELAY_MIN = 250
GULL_SPAWN_HEIGHT_MIN = 15
GULL_SPAWN_HEIGHT_VAR = 20

--Player variables
JUMP_SPEED = -6
DIVE_SPEED_X = 7
DIVE_SPEED_Y = -3
WALK_SPEED = 2
DIVE_CD_MAX = 20
STUN_CD_MAX = 30
INVI_TIME_MAX = 35
--for short and high hops
JUMP_TIME_MAX = 5

--Ball Variables
BALL_MAX_VY = 4
PLAYER_BALL_LAUNCH_Y = -3.5
GULL_BALL_LAUNCH_Y = -2
HIT_CD_MAX = 12
GULL_HIT_CD_MAX = 20

--Enemies variables
CRAB_WALK_SPEED = .75
GULL_FLY_SPEED = 1.5

--Particle variables
PRTCL_FLR_HEIGHT = FLOOR_HEIGHT - 2

--[[Init function]]
function _init()
  --palette
  --magenta to very dark brown
  pal(2, 2 + 128, 1)
  --light green to turquoise
  pal(11, 3 + 128, 1)
  --gray to dark blue
  pal(13, 12 + 128, 1)
  --orange to dark brown
  pal(9, 4 + 128, 1)
  --pink to dark peach
  pal(14, 15 + 128, 1)

  --set "game state"
  _draw = start_draw
  _update = start_update

  game_time = 0
  score = 0
  --create cart data
  cartdata("ejreyes_volley_game")
  --retrieve save data
  if dget(1) > 0 then
    high_score = dget(1)
  else
    high_score = 0
  end
  --create menu objects
  menu_buttons = {
    create_button("cred", 238, 24, 68 - 2, 24, 24, 2),
    create_button("play", 219, 52, 64 - 2, 24, 24, 3),
    create_button("ctrl", 206, 88, 68 - 2, 24, 24, 2)
  }
  tran_controller = create_transition_controller()
  select_controller = create_select_controller(menu_buttons)
  pp_controller = create_popup_controller()
  --create "back to start" pause menu item
  menuitem(1, "back to start", function() tran_controller:activate("start") end)
  --create clear level elements
  clear_game()
  --play ocean noises
  music(0, 10)
end

--[[
  CREATING OBJECTS
  ]]

--[[CREATE: Basic object]]
function create_basic(x, y, w, h)
  local b = {}
  b.pos_x, b.pos_y = x, y
  b.width, b.height = w, h
  b.vel_x, b.vel_y = 0, 0
  return b
end

--[[CREATE: Player object]]
function create_player(x, y)
  local p = create_basic(x, y, 14, 15)
  --[[player variables]]
  p.my_spr = 1
  p.direction = -1
  --[[Player state guide: "neutral", "dive", "stun"]]
  p.my_state = "neutral"
  --if player is touching the ground
  p.grounded = false
  --if player was touching the ground on the last frame
  p.ground_last = false
  --if player is alive
  p.alive = true
  --dive cooldown
  p.dive_cd = 0
  --stun cooldown
  p.stun_cd = 0
  --invincibility time
  p.invi_time = 0
  --jump height timer (important for jump height variability)
  p.jump_time = 0
  --ball hit cooldown
  p.hit_cd = 0
  --[[player draw]]
  p.draw = function(self)
    --draw sprite
    facing_right = self.direction == 1
    spr(self.my_spr, self.pos_x - 1, self.pos_y - 1, 2, 2, facing_right)
    --draw debug info
    if show_debug then self:print_debug() end
    --draw hitbox
    draw_hitbox(self, 8)
  end
  --[[player debug draw]]
  p.print_debug = function(self)
    print("player info", 2, 2, 1)
    print("direc:" .. self.direction)
    print("state:" .. self.my_state)
    print("pos_x:" .. self.pos_x)
    print("pos_y:" .. self.pos_y)
    print("vel_x:" .. self.vel_x)
    print("vel_y:" .. self.vel_y)
    print("jump t:" .. self.jump_time)
    print("hit cd:" .. self.hit_cd)
    print("ground:" .. tostr(self.grounded))
    print("g_last:" .. tostr(self.ground_last))
  end
  --[[player update]]
  p.update = function(self)
    --cooldown updates
    if self.stun_cd > 0 then self.stun_cd -= 1 end
    if self.jump_time > 0 then self.jump_time -= 1 end
    if self.invi_time > 0 then self.invi_time -= 1 end
    if self.dive_cd > 0 then self.dive_cd -= 1 end
    if self.hit_cd > 0 then self.hit_cd -= 1 end

    --[[STATE MACHINE HANDLER]]
    if self.my_state == "neutral" then
      --change to dive state
      if btnp(5) then
        sfx(4)
        self.my_state = "dive"
        self.dive_cd = DIVE_CD_MAX
        self.vel_x = self.direction * DIVE_SPEED_X
        self.vel_y = DIVE_SPEED_Y
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "dive" then
      --return to neutral state
      if self.dive_cd < 1 then self.my_state = "neutral" end
      --jump out of dive, return to neutral
      if self.grounded and btnp(4) then
        self.my_state = "neutral"
        self.vel_y = JUMP_SPEED
        self.dive_cd = 0
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "stun" then
      --this state set in collisions
      if self.stun_cd < 1 then self.my_state = "neutral" end
    elseif self.my_state == "over" then
      --over
    end

    --[[STATE MACHINE UPDATE]]
    if self.my_state == "neutral" then
      --jump input
      if btnp(4) and self.grounded then
        self.jump_time = JUMP_TIME_MAX
        --create jump particle effect
        make_floor_splash(self.pos_x + self.width / 2, 6)
        --play jump sound
        sfx(9)
      end
      --jump or reset jump_time
      if btn(4) and self.jump_time > 0 then
        self.vel_y = JUMP_SPEED
      else
        self.jump_time = 0
      end
      --movement input
      move = 0
      if btn(1) then move += 1 end
      if btn(0) then move -= 1 end
      if move == 0 then
        self.vel_x = self.vel_x * FRIC_VAR
      else
        self.vel_x = move * WALK_SPEED
        --create walking particle
        if self.grounded and game_time % 4 == 0 then
          local back_x = 0
          if self.direction > 0 then back_x = 4 else back_x = self.width - 5 end
          create_moving_particle(
            self.pos_x + back_x, PRTCL_FLR_HEIGHT,
            self.direction * -.1, 0, 1.6, .2, 2
          )
        end
        --update direction! Important!
        self.direction = sgn(move)
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "dive" then
      --update velocity
      self.vel_x = self.vel_x * .9
      --create "dragging" particles
      if self.grounded and game_time % 2 == 0 then
        local back_x = 0
        if self.direction > 0 then back_x = 5 else back_x = self.width - 6 end
        create_moving_particle(
          self.pos_x + back_x, PRTCL_FLR_HEIGHT,
          self.direction * -.25, -.25, 1.6, .1, 6
        )
        sfx(5)
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "stun" then
      --update velocity
      self.vel_x = self.vel_x * .9
    elseif self.my_state == "over" then
      --over
    end
    --[[UNIVERSAL UPDATE]]
    --update velocity
    self.vel_y += GRAV
    --update position
    self.pos_x += self.vel_x
    self.pos_y += self.vel_y
    --floor limit and grounded check
    self.ground_last = self.grounded
    if self.pos_y + self.height >= FLOOR_HEIGHT then
      self.pos_y = FLOOR_HEIGHT - self.height
      self.vel_y = 0
      self.grounded = true
    else
      self.grounded = false
    end
    --landing particles
    if self.grounded and not self.ground_last then
      make_floor_splash(self.pos_x + self.width / 2, 5)
    end
    --wall limit
    if self.pos_x < 0 then
      self.pos_x, self.vel_x = 0, 0
    end
    if self.pos_x > 128 - self.width then
      self.pos_x, self.vel_x = 128 - self.width, 0
    end
    --[[SPRITE UPDATE]]
    if self.my_state == "neutral" then
      --reset sprite to 1 if still 12 or 14
      if self.my_spr > 11 then self.my_spr = 1 end
      --update if player is moving
      if self.grounded then
        if abs(self.vel_x) > 1 then
          --running animation
          if self.my_spr < 9 then
            self.my_spr += 2
          else
            self.my_spr = 3
          end
        else
          --"standing" frame
          self.my_spr = 1
        end
      else
        --"jump" frame
        self.my_spr = 5
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "stun" then
      self.my_spr = 14
    elseif self.dive_cd > 0 then
      self.my_spr = 12
    end
  end
  --[[Stun player if not invincible]]
  p.stun_player = function(self)
    if self.invi_time < 1 then
      self.my_state = "stun"
      self.stun_cd = STUN_CD_MAX
      self.invi_time = INVI_TIME_MAX
      self.vel_y = JUMP_SPEED
      self.vel_x = self.direction * -1
    end
  end
  return p
end

--[[CREATE: Ball object]]
function create_ball(x, y)
  --NOTE: For this object, width and height are used as radius.
  local b = create_basic(x, y, 4, 4)
  b.draw = function(self)
    --set ball color
    local fill_col, outline_col = 6, 1
    if game_controller.bonus_time > 0 then
      fill_col, outline_col = 15, 2
    end
    --draw ball
    circfill(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, self.width + 1, outline_col)
    circfill(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, self.width, fill_col)
    circfill(self.pos_x - 1, self.pos_y - 1, 2, 7)
  end
  b.update = function(self)
    --update ball velocities
    self.vel_y += BALL_GRAV
    --cap ball velocity
    self.vel_y = min(self.vel_y, BALL_MAX_VY)
    self.vel_x = self.vel_x * BALL_FRIC_VAR
    --update ball position
    self.pos_x += self.vel_x
    self.pos_y += self.vel_y
    --floor limit (see game_update)
    --wall limit
    if self.pos_x < self.width then
      sfx(1)
      self.pos_x, self.vel_x = self.width, self.vel_x * -1
    end
    if self.pos_x > 128 - self.width then
      sfx(1)
      self.pos_x, self.vel_x = 128 - self.width, self.vel_x * -1
    end
    --create ball trail
    if (abs(self.vel_x) > .25 or abs(self.vel_y) > .25) and game_time % 3 == 0 then
      --adjust trail color depending on bonus time
      local t_col1, t_col2 = 13, 12
      if game_controller.bonus_time > 0 then t_col1, t_col2 = 8, 14 end
      create_trail_particle(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, self.width, 10, t_col1)
      create_trail_particle(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, self.width - 2, 8, t_col2)
      if game_controller.bonus_time > 0 then
        create_trail_particle(self.pos_x - 4 + rnd(8), self.pos_y - 4 + rnd(8), 1, 8, 7)
      end
    end
  end
  return b
end

--[[CREATE: Crab enemy object]]
function create_crab(spawn_type, multi)
  local xp, xv, flip = 0, 0, false
  --set position and velocity based on spawn type
  if spawn_type == 0 then
    xp, xv, flip = -18, CRAB_WALK_SPEED * multi, true
  else
    xp, xv, flip = 138, -CRAB_WALK_SPEED * multi, false
  end
  local c = create_basic(xp, FLOOR_HEIGHT - 8, 10, 8)
  c.hit_cd = 0
  c.vel_x = xv
  c.alive = true
  c.warn_time = 30
  c.flip_spr = flip
  c.my_sprite = 172
  --[[Draw crab]]
  c.draw = function(self)
    if self.warn_time > 0 then
      --draw warning
      if self.pos_x < 0 then
        spr(110, 0, 85, 2, 2)
      else
        spr(110, 111, 85, 2, 2)
      end
    else
      --draw sprite and draw hitbox
      spr(self.my_sprite, self.pos_x - 3, self.pos_y, 2, 1, self.flip_spr)
      draw_hitbox(self, 8)
      --draw velocity
      if show_debug then
        print("v:" .. tostr(self.vel_x), self.pos_x, self.pos_y - 6, 8)
      end
    end
  end
  --[[Update crab]]
  c.update = function(self)
    if self.warn_time > 0 then
      --update warn_time
      self.warn_time -= 1
    elseif self.alive then
      --update hit cooldown
      if self.hit_cd > 0 then self.hit_cd -= 1 end
      --create walking particles if vel_x is high enough
      if game_time % 4 == 0 and abs(self.vel_x) > 1.5 then
        local back_x = 0
        if self.vel_x > 0 then back_x = 2 else back_x = self.width - 3 end
        create_moving_particle(
          self.pos_x + back_x, PRTCL_FLR_HEIGHT,
          sgn(self.vel_x) * -.1, 0, 1.6, .2, 2
        )
      end
      --update position
      self.pos_x += self.vel_x
      --delete if out of bounds
      if self.pos_x < KILL_COOR_L or self.pos_x > KILL_COOR_R then
        del(crabs, self)
      end
    else
      --apply grav
      self.vel_y += GRAV / 2
      --update position
      self.pos_x += self.vel_x
      self.pos_y += self.vel_y
      --despawn when crab falls off screen
      if self.pos_y > 130 then
        del(crabs, self)
      end
    end
    --sprite controls
    if game_time % 4 == 0 then
      if self.alive then
        --walking animation
        if self.my_sprite < 174 then self.my_sprite += 2 else self.my_sprite = 172 end
      else
        --death animation
        --note: c.kill() should set sprite to 188 for this to work correctly!
        if self.my_sprite < 190 then self.my_sprite += 2 else self.my_sprite = 188 end
      end
    end
  end
  --[[Kill crab (the right way!)]]
  c.kill = function(self)
    self.vel_x = 0
    self.vel_y = -3
    self.alive = false
    self.my_sprite = 188
  end
  return c
end

--[[CREATE: Trail particle for ball]]
function create_trail_particle(x, y, r, life, col)
  local p = {}
  p.pos_x, p.pos_y = x, y
  p.radius, p.life, p.color = r, life, col
  --radius functions more as a maximum radius
  p.draw = function(self)
    circfill(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, min(self.radius, self.life), self.color)
  end
  p.update = function(self)
    if self.life > 0 then
      self.life -= 1
    else
      del(t_particles, self)
    end
  end
  add(t_particles, p)
end

--[[CREATE: Moving particle]]
function create_moving_particle(x, y, xv, yv, r, decay, col)
  local mp = {}
  mp.pos_x, mp.pos_y = x, y
  mp.vel_x, mp.vel_y = xv, yv
  --radius works as STARTING radius
  mp.radius, mp.decay, mp.color = r, decay, col
  mp.draw = function(self)
    circfill(self.pos_x, self.pos_y, self.radius, self.color)
  end
  mp.update = function(self)
    --update life
    if self.radius > 0 then
      self.radius -= decay
    else
      del(m_particles, self)
    end
    --update position
    self.pos_x += self.vel_x
    self.pos_y += self.vel_y
  end
  add(m_particles, mp)
end

--[[CREATE: Game controler object]]
function create_game_controller()
  local c = {}
  --misnomer: decides how often gulls or balloons spawn.
  c.gull_spawn_cd = GULL_SPAWN_DELAY_MIN
  c.crab_spawn_cd = 0
  c.cloud_delay_cd = CLOUD_SPAWN_DELAY_MAX
  c.exit_delay = 0
  c.balloon_count = 0
  c.bonus_time = 0
  c.prev_bonus_time = 0
  --for drawing the red zero when score resets
  c.red_time = 0
  --draw game controller
  c.draw = function(self)
    --draw balloon display
    for i = 1, 3 do
      if i <= self.balloon_count then
        spr(138, 115, i * 10 - 5)
      else
        spr(154, 115, i * 10 - 5)
      end
    end
    --draw debug
    if show_debug then self:draw_debug() end
  end
  --draw game controller debug
  c.draw_debug = function(self)
    print("game info", 64, 2, 2)
    print("memory:" .. stat(0))
    print("game time:" .. game_time)
    print("crab count:" .. #crabs)
    print("gull count:" .. #gulls)
    print("cloud count:" .. #clouds)
    print("balloon count:" .. #balloons)
    print("t ptcl count:" .. #t_particles)
    print("m ptcl count:" .. #m_particles)
    print("bonus t:" .. self.bonus_time)
    print("balloon #:" .. self.balloon_count)
  end
  --update game controller
  c.update = function(self)
    if score > 0 then
      self:spawn_elements()
    end
    self:update_balloons()
    self:spawn_clouds()
    --update red_time
    if self.red_time > 0 then self.red_time -= 1 end
  end
  --[[control the spawning of enemies]]
  c.spawn_elements = function(self)
    --update cooldowns
    if self.gull_spawn_cd > 0 then self.gull_spawn_cd -= 1 end
    if self.crab_spawn_cd > 0 then self.crab_spawn_cd -= 1 end
    --spawn gull
    if self.gull_spawn_cd < 1 then
      --choose to spawn gull or balloon
      if #balloons < 1 and flr(rnd(4)) == 0 then
        --spawn balloon
        add(balloons, create_balloon(flr(rnd(2)), flr(rnd(30)) + 10))
      else
        --randomize and spawn gull
        local g_height = GULL_SPAWN_HEIGHT_MIN + flr(rnd(GULL_SPAWN_HEIGHT_VAR))
        add(gulls, create_gull(flr(rnd(2)), g_height, dif_mult(score, GULL_DIV)))
      end
      --set delay cooldown
      local delay_rnd = flr(rnd(SPAWN_DELAY_RANDOM))
      local lvl_lim = min(score, 100) * 2
      self.gull_spawn_cd = GULL_SPAWN_DELAY_MIN + delay_rnd - lvl_lim
    end
    --spawn crab
    if self.crab_spawn_cd < 1 then
      --randomize and spawn crab
      add(crabs, create_crab(flr(rnd(2)), dif_mult(score, CRAB_DIV)))
      --set delay cooldown
      local delay_rnd = flr(rnd(SPAWN_DELAY_RANDOM))
      local lvl_lim = min(score, 150)
      self.crab_spawn_cd = CRAB_SPAWN_DELAY_MIN + delay_rnd - lvl_lim
    end
  end
  --[[control spawning of clouds]]
  c.spawn_clouds = function(self)
    --update cooldown
    if self.cloud_delay_cd > 0 then
      self.cloud_delay_cd -= 1
    elseif #clouds < 11 then
      add(clouds, create_cloud(-100))
      self.cloud_delay_cd = CLOUD_SPAWN_DELAY_MAX
    end
  end
  --[[controls balloon COUNT, not the objects]]
  c.update_balloons = function(self)
    --update bonus time
    if self.bonus_time > 0 then
      self.prev_bonus_time = self.bonus_time
      self.bonus_time -= 1
    end
    --play bonus time end sound
    if self.bonus_time == 0 and self.prev_bonus_time > 0 then
      sfx(14, 2)
      self.prev_bonus_time = 0
    end

    --if player hits 3 balloons
    if self.balloon_count > 2 then
      --start particles
      for i = 1, 3 do
        make_collision_splash(115 + 4, i * 10 - 1, 14)
      end
      self.balloon_count = 0
      self.bonus_time = BONUS_TIME_MAX
      sfx(11, 2)
    end
  end
  return c
end

        print("max osborn", self.pos_x + 32, self.true_y + 66, 9)
      end

    if self.my_state == "hide" then
      --see pp.activate()
    elseif self.my_state == "up" then
      if self.true_y >= PP_UP_Y + 2 then
        --lerp popup to PP_UP_Y
        self.true_y -= (self.true_y - PP_UP_Y) / 2
      else
        self.true_y = PP_UP_Y
        self.my_state = "show"
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "show" then
      --see pp.deactivate()
    elseif self.my_state == "down" then
      if self.true_y <= PP_DOWN_Y - 2 then
        --lerp popup to PP_DOWN_Y
        self.true_y += (PP_DOWN_Y - self.true_y) / 2
      else
        self.true_y = PP_DOWN_Y
        self.my_state = "hide"
      end
    end
  end
  pp.activate = function(self, type)
    if self.my_state == "hide" then
      self.true_y = PP_DOWN_Y
      self.my_type = type
      self.my_state = "up"
    end
  end
  pp.deactivate = function(self)
    if self.my_state == "show" then
      self.true_y = PP_UP_Y
      self.my_state = "down"
    end
  end
  return pp
end

--[[CREATE: Transition controller]]
function create_transition_controller()
  local tc = {}
  --[[STATE GUIDE: "in", "out", "neutral"]]
  tc.my_state = "neutral"
  --[[MENU GUIDE: "start", "game"]]
  tc.target_menu = "game"
  tc.t_radius = 0
  tc.state_time = 0
  --[[Draw transition]]
  --circfill(64, 64, 0, 7)
  tc.draw = function(self)
    if show_debug then
      print("state:" .. self.my_state, 2, 110, 1)
      print("st:" .. self.state_time)
    end
    --draw transition animation
    if self.my_state == "in" then
      local c_rad = (self.state_time - 10) * -12
      circfill(64, 64, c_rad, 13)
    elseif self.my_state == "out" then
      local c_rad = self.state_time * 12
      circfill(64, 64, c_rad, 13)
    end
  end
  --[[Update transition]]
  tc.update = function(self)
    if self.my_state == "in" then
      if self.state_time > 0 then
        self.state_time -= 1
      else
        --go to target menu
        if self.target_menu == "start" then
          clear_game()
          --stop music
          music(-1)
          --play menu sounds
          music(0, 0, 1)
          _draw, _update = start_draw, start_update
        else
          --stop music
          music(-1)
          --play game music
          music(1, 0, 3)
          _draw, _update = game_draw, game_update
        end
        self.my_state = "out"
        self.state_time = 10
      end
    elseif self.my_state == "out" then
      if self.state_time > 0 then
        self.state_time -= 1
      else
        self.my_state = "neutral"
      end
    end
  end
  tc.activate = function(self, menu)
    if self.my_state == "neutral" then
      --stop all music
      music(-1)
      self.my_state = "in"
      self.state_time = 10
      self.target_menu = menu
      --play transition sound
      if menu == "start" then sfx(3) else sfx(2) end
    end
  end
  return tc
end

  create_moving_particle(x + 2, PRTCL_FLR_HEIGHT + 1, vx, -vy, 2, .2, col)
end

function make_collision_splash(x, y, col)
  local p_speed = 1
  create_moving_particle(x, y, p_speed, p_speed, flr(rnd(2)) + 1, .3, col)
  create_moving_particle(x, y, -p_speed, p_speed, flr(rnd(2)) + 1, .3, col)
  create_moving_particle(x, y, p_speed, -p_speed, flr(rnd(2)) + 1, .3, col)
  create_moving_particle(x, y, -p_speed, -p_speed, flr(rnd(2)) + 1, .3, col)

function draw_hitbox(o, col)

    local brx, bry = o.pos_x + o.width - 1, o.pos_y + o.height - 1

  end
end

--[[Check overlap between two objects]]
--o1 and o2 must have pos_x, pos_y, width, and height variables
function overlap_check(o1, o2)
  local x_check, y_check = false, false
  if o1.pos_x + o1.width > o2.pos_x and o2.pos_x + o2.width > o1.pos_x then
    x_check = true
  end
  if o1.pos_y + o1.height > o2.pos_y and o2.pos_y + o2.height > o1.pos_y then
    y_check = true
  end
  return x_check and y_check
end

--[[Check overlap between two objects]]
--object 1's parameters are plugged in manually
--used for checking future overlaps
function overlap_check_plus(x, y, w, h, o2)
  local x_check, y_check = false, false
  local o1_px, o1_py = x, y
  if o1_px + w > o2.pos_x and o2.pos_x + o2.width > o1_px then
    x_check = true
  end
  if o1_py + h > o2.pos_y and o2.pos_y + o2.height > o1_py then
    y_check = true
  end
  return x_check and y_check
end

--[[Check overlap between two objects]]
--b1 has to be the ball obejct
--o1 has to a "square" object
function ball_overlap_check(b1, o1)
  local temp_x, temp_y = b1.pos_x - b1.width, b1.pos_y - b1.height
  local temp_w, temp_h = b1.width * 2, b1.height * 2
  return overlap_check_plus(temp_x, temp_y, temp_w, temp_h, o1)
end

--[[Update score (the right way!)]]

  --increase score (checking bonus_time)
  if game_controller.bonus_time > 0 then score += 2 else score += 1 end

  if score > high_score then
    high_score = score
    --update save data
    dset(1, high_score)
  end
end

--[[Converts game score to speed multiplier for enemies ]]
function dif_mult(score, div)
  capped_score = min(score, 100)
  return 1 + capped_score / div
end

function start_update()

  select_controller:update()

  --only create clouds
  game_controller:spawn_clouds()

  for c in all(clouds) do
    c:update()

function game_update()
  --update game_time
  game_time += 1

  --masterdebug toggle MAKE SURE ITS OFF!
  if debug_active and btnp(⬇️) then show_debug = not show_debug end

  --update transition
  tran_controller:update()
  --update game controller
  game_controller:update()
  --update crabs
  for c in all(crabs) do
    c:update()
    if c.alive then
      --check player overlap with enemy
      if overlap_check(player, c) then
        sfx(6)
        --stun player
        player:stun_player()
        --kill crab
        c:kill()
      end
      --check ball overlap
      if ball_overlap_check(ball, c) then
        --kill crab
        c:kill()
      end
    end
  end
  --update gulls
  for g in all(gulls) do
    g:update()
    if g.hit_cd < 1 and ball_overlap_check(ball, g) then
      sfx(1)
      --collision variables
      local g_center_x = g.pos_x + g.width / 2
      local g_center_y = g.pos_y + g.height / 2
      local g_point_x = (g_center_x + ball.pos_x) / 2
      local g_point_y = (g_center_y + ball.pos_y) / 2
      --update variables
      if g_center_x >= ball.pos_x then
        ball.vel_x = -2
      else
        ball.vel_x = 2
      end
      ball.vel_y = GULL_BALL_LAUNCH_Y * sgn(ball.vel_y)
      g.hit_cd = GULL_HIT_CD_MAX
      --set player hit cooldown to 0
      --so player can rebound immediately.
      player.hit_cd = 0
      --create particles
      make_collision_splash(g_point_x - 1, g_point_y - 1, 10)
    end
  end
  --update balloons
  for b in all(balloons) do
    b:update()
    if b.alive and ball_overlap_check(ball, b) then
      sfx(10)
      game_controller.balloon_count += 1
      --balloon splash
      make_collision_splash(115 + 4, game_controller.balloon_count * 10 - 1, 8)
      --set ball velocity
      ball.vel_x = ball.vel_x * .75
      ball.vel_y = ball.vel_y * .75
      --delete balloon (temporary)
      --del(balloons, b)
      b:kill()
    end
  end
  --update clouds
  for c in all(clouds) do
    c:update()
  end
  --update t_particles
  for p in all(t_particles) do
    p:update()
  end
  --update m_particles
  for mp in all(m_particles) do
    mp:update()
  end
  --update player
  player:update()
  --ball and player overlap
  if player.hit_cd < 1 and ball_overlap_check(ball, player) then
    --player hits ball sfx
    if game_controller.bonus_time > 0 then sfx(12) else sfx(8) end
    --collision variables
    local p_center_x = player.pos_x + player.width / 2
    local p_center_y = player.pos_y + player.height / 2
    local c_point_x = (p_center_x + ball.pos_x) / 2
    local c_point_y = (p_center_y + ball.pos_y) / 2
    --update variables
    if player.my_state == "dive" then
      ball.vel_x = (ball.pos_x - p_center_x) / 2
    else
      ball.vel_x = (ball.pos_x - p_center_x) / 3.5
    end
    ball.vel_y = PLAYER_BALL_LAUNCH_Y + player.vel_y / 10
    player.hit_cd = HIT_CD_MAX
    --create particles
    make_collision_splash(c_point_x - 1, c_point_y - 1, 10)
    ---update score variables
    increase_score()
  end
  --update ball
  ball:update()
  --floor limit check
  --adjust floor height for ball (quick fix)
  local ball_floor_h = FLOOR_HEIGHT - 2
  if ball.pos_y + ball.height >= ball_floor_h then
    ball.pos_y = ball_floor_h - ball.height
    ball.vel_y = ball.vel_y * -.8
    --create particle splash
    if abs(ball.vel_y) > .2 then
      --play sound effect depending on score
      if score > 0 then
        --if score is > 0, play fail sound and set red_time
        game_controller.red_time = RED_TIME_MAX
        sfx(15, 3)
      else
        sfx(1)
      end
      make_floor_splash(ball.pos_x, 6)
    end
    --reset score
    score = 0
  end
  --cap score so game doesn't crash at super high nummbers :^)
  score = min(score, 30000)
end

description: My Pico-8 game inspired by the 1980 Stern Electronics game and made possible by the excellent "Speako8 Speech Synthesis Library" by @bikibird - https://www.lexaloffle.com/bbs/?pid=116919#p How to Play Shoot the robots. Avoid the walls. Don't stay in a room for too long! Controls [X] - Laser (stands still so you can accurate fire in one of 8 directions) [O] - Laser (while running) Thanks To Finn for testing @bikibird for creating Speako8 Version History 0.80 - 26-Sep-2022 - Released 0.81 - 27-Sep-2022 - Otto now destroys robots 0.82 - 28-Sep-2022 - Updated credits and fixed bug walking through exit door
comment_1: This is - incredible, @pahammond . I will state that the voices in the original BERZERK would change pitch. I especially remember these two sentences together when you were shot, they were almost SANG out. "Got the humanoid." -- low pitch "Got the intruder." -- medium pitch And when Otto appeared: "Intruder alert. Intruder alert." -- low pitch In most cases the voices would repeat the words but at different pitches. https://youtu.be/ELE24jchei4?t=43 Here you can hear it almost singing those two sentences above as the player is shot. https://youtu.be/ELE24jchei4?t=99 Also when the player is hit he has this cool kind of rainbow effect appear around him as if he is dematerializing. I think this can be done in Pico-8.
comment_2: @pahammond , this is terrific. Congratulations! One favor, though, can you change the credit for Speako8 to just @bikibird ? I prefer to go just by my screen name in most places. Thanks.
comment_3: @pahammond . Great game - lots of fun especially when you get the 8 way fire. There is a bug that if you keep going left, when the room "x" position goes less than 1, the player is killed instantly when entering the room and then restarts as if they had entered the room from the left door. Also did you update the game so that you no longer score when a robot dies by any means? I'm sure that when I first played this, my score increased when a robot dies regardless of how it died...
comment_4: @bikibird . No problem, I’ll update it later today. My apologies, I should have checked.
comment_5: @phil . Damn, that’s the only bug my tester picked up and I thought I’d fixed it. Only happened on the vertical before though. I’ll fix it tonight. And no, I only ever award a score if the player bullet hits a robot.

game_code:
-- sphongos
-- by michael koloch

-- savegame 0 = unavailable, 1= available, 2.. = unlocked

u_ox = 1 -- ox tank capacity
--u_stability = 0 -- ox tank stability
u_speed = 0 -- speed boost
u_heat = 0 -- heat resistance
u_rad = 0 -- radiation resistance

u_ma = 0 -- case capacity
u_slots = 0 -- case slots

u_ls = 1 -- laser strength
u_rock = 0 -- rock dissolving
u_metal = 0 -- metal cutting

-- upgrades
suit_upgrades = {}
ox_upgrades = {40,50,60,70,80,99}

case_upgrades = {}
ma_upgrades = {8,16,32,48,64,99}
slot_upgrades = {1,2,3}

tool_upgrades = {}
ls_upgrades={1,2,4,6,8,10}

-- menu options
music_on = true

-- actors
actors = {} -- all actors
spawns = {} -- all spawns

-- particles
particles = {}

-- player
dir_x = 1
dir_y = 0

pl_spwn_x = 20
pl_spwn_y = 15
pl_speed = 1

block_x = false
block_y = false

step_timer = 0
step_speed = 9

in_heat = false
in_rad = false
damage_effect_timer = 0
damage_timer = 0

-- death
death_duration = 150
death_timer = death_duration*0.4
in_death = true

-- oxygen
ox_time = 20
ox_max  = 20
ox_perc = 0
ox_color = 11

-- case
ma_max = 6
materials = {}
objects = {}

collected_ma = {}
ma_slots = 1

ma_total = {} -- list of gathered materials
ma_plant = nil -- special ma plant
ma_quartz = nil -- special ma quartz
ma_fungi4 = nil -- special ma fungi4
-- tool
to_x = 0
to_y = 0

-- targeting
t_k = nil
	
t_x = 0
t_y = 0

-- laser
ls_t = false
ls_strength = 1
ls_b = 0

last_x=0
last_y=0

-- ui
-- colors

case_col = 9
tool_col = 10

-- upgrades
info_timer = 0
info_speed = 0.6
info_current_speed = info_speed
info_swap = false

-- analysis
analysis_duration = 1.8
analysis_can_bleep = true

-- messages
coms_msgs = {}
sci_msgs = {}
in_msgs_ui = false
available_mgs = {}
current_msg = 1

new_coms = true
new_sci = true

-- panel content
txts = {}
u_cursor_x = 0
in_upgrade_ui = false
in_science_ui = false

note_active = false
note_timer = 0
note_s = ""
note_l = 0
note_c = 7

last_l = 0
offset = 0

-- map handling
was_in_lab = true

-- logo
show_logo = true

function debug()
	-- skip intro
	death_timer = death_duration*0.99

	-- debug discoveries
	dset(31,1) -- discover fungi1
	dset(32,1) -- discover fungi2
	dset(33,1) -- discover fungi3
	dset(43,1) -- discover fungi4

	dset(34,1) -- discover rock
	dset(35,1) -- discover metal

	dset(41,1) -- discover fiber
	dset(42,1) -- discover quartz

	-- debug upgrades
	dset(1,6) -- oxygen upgrades (6)
	dset(3,2) -- speed upgrade
	dset(6,2) -- heat upgrade
	dset(7,2) -- rad upgrade

	dset(8,6) -- case upgrades (6)
	dset(9,3) -- slot upgrades (3)

	dset(10,6) -- blaster upgrades (6)
	dset(11,2) -- rock upgrade
	dset(12,2) -- metal upgrade

	-- debug totals
	dset(21,99) -- fungi1
	dset(22,99) -- fungi2
	dset(23,99) -- fungi3
	dset(24,99) -- rock
	dset(25,99) -- metal
end

function make_actor(k,x,y)
	a={
		k=k, -- actor sprite
		
		-- actor center in tiles
		x=x+0.5, -- position x
		y=y+0.5, -- position y
		
		-- movement physics
		dx=0, -- delta x
		dy=0, -- delta y
		friction=0.30,
		bounce=0.1,
		-- half width and height
		w=0.4,
		h=0.4,
		
		-- move animation frames
		frame=0, -- start anim frame
		frames=2, -- anim frame count
		fr_sp=0.2, -- animation speed

		t=0,
		drop = 64
	}
 
	add(actors,a)
 
	return a
end

function make_player(k,x,y)
	make_actor(k,x,y)
	a.frames=4
	a.w = 0.2
	a.h = 0.2
	a.off_y= 3 -- in pixels
	a.fr_sp=0.225 * pl_speed
	a.bounce=0
	return a
end

function make_spawn(k,x,y)
	s= {
	 k = k,
	 x = x,
	 y = y
	}

	add(spawns,s)
	return s
end

function delete_savegame()
	for i=0,63 do
		dset(i,0)
	end
	run()
end

function save_collected_materials()
	dset(21,ma_total[1].amount)
	dset(22,ma_total[2].amount)
	dset(23,ma_total[3].amount)
	dset(24,ma_total[4].amount)
	dset(25,ma_total[5].amount)

	for i=1,5 do
		if dget(i+20) > 0 then
			dset(i+30,1)
			ma_total[i].discovered = true
		end
	end

	update_upgrades()
end

function load_savegame()
	-- music toggle
	if(dget(0)  != 0) music_on = false

	-- stored material
	if(dget(21) != 0) ma_total[1].amount = dget(21)
	if(dget(22) != 0) ma_total[2].amount = dget(22)
	if(dget(23) != 0) ma_total[3].amount = dget(23)
	if(dget(24) != 0) ma_total[4].amount = dget(24)
	if(dget(25) != 0) ma_total[5].amount = dget(25)

	if(dget(31) != 0) ma_total[1].discovered = true
	if(dget(32) != 0) ma_total[2].discovered = true
	if(dget(33) != 0) ma_total[3].discovered = true
	if(dget(34) != 0) ma_total[4].discovered = true
	if(dget(35) != 0) ma_total[5].discovered = true
	
	if(dget(41) != 0) ma_plant.discovered = true
	if(dget(42) != 0) ma_quartz.discovered = true
	if(dget(43) != 0) ma_fungi4.discovered = true

	update_upgrades()

	--apply initial values
	
	dset(1,u_ox)
	dset(3,u_speed)
	dset(6,u_heat)
	dset(7,u_rad)
	
	dset(8,u_ma)
	dset(9,u_slots)

	end

-- true if pos on map is solid
function solid(x,y)

	--get cell value
	val=mget(x,y)
 
	-- check if flag 1 is set

end

-- solid_area
-- check if rectangle overlaps
-- with any wall

-- only for actors < tile
function solid_area(x,y,w,h)
	return
		solid(x-w-0.1,y-h) or
		solid(x+w,y-h-0.1) or
		solid(x-w,y+h) or
		solid(x+w,y+h)
end

-- solid_actor
-- true if [a] hits another
-- actor after moving dx,dy
function solid_actor(a,dx,dy)
	for actor in all(actors) do
		if actor != a then
  
			local x=(a.x+dx) - actor.x
			local y=(a.y+dy) - actor.y
			
			if((abs(x)<(a.w+actor.w)) and
			   (abs(y)<(a.h+actor.h))) then
 
				-- along x
				if(dx != 0 and abs(x) <
				 abs(a.x-actor.x)) 
				then
				 
--					v=abs(a.dx)>abs(actor.dx) and
--					 a.dx or actor.dx
--					a.dx,actor.dx = v,v
	
					local ca=
					 collide_event(a,actor) or
					 collide_event(actor,a)
					return not ca
				end
				
				-- along y
				if(dy != 0 and abs(y) <
				 abs(a.y-actor.y)) then
				  
--					v=abs(a.dy)>abs(actor.dy) and
--					 a.dy or actor.dy
--					a.dx,actor.dx = v,v
				 
					local ca=
					 collide_event(a,actor) or
					 collide_event(actor,a)
					return not ca
				
				end
			end
		end    
	end  
 
 return false 
end

-- solid_a
-- checks walls and actors
function solid_a(a, dx, dy)
	if solid_area(a.x+dx,a.y+dy,
	              a.w,a.h) then
		return true 
	end
		
	return solid_actor(a,dx,dy)
end

-- collide_event
-- return true if collected
-- or destroyed
function collide_event(a1,a2)

	-- if player collects material
	if a1==pl then
		local m = find_material(a2.k)

		-- pick up dropped material sample
		if (m != nil) then
			if collect_material(m.tag, 1) then
				del(actors,a2)
				sfx(3)

				for i=1,3 do
					make_particle(7,10+rnd(11),a2.x*8-1+rnd(3),a2.y*8-2,0,-1-rnd(3),0.6)
				end
			end
		return true
		end
	end
	
	if a1==pl and a2.k==38 then
		ox_time -= 2
		
		-- get hit direction
		local dx = sgn(pl.x-a2.x)
		local dy = sgn(pl.y-a2.y)
		
		-- apply hit
		pl.dx =dx * 0.1
		pl.dy =dy * 0.1
		
		--sfx(2)
		return true
	end

	--sfx(1) -- generic bump sfx
	
	return true
end

function move_actor(a)
	-- move along x
	-- if doesn't overlap wall
	if not solid_a(a,a.dx,0) then
		a.x += a.dx
	else
		a.dx *= -a.bounce
	end
	
	-- move along y
	if not solid_a(a,0,a.dy) then
		a.y += a.dy
	else
		a.dy *= -a.bounce
	end
	
	-- apply friction
	a.dx *= (1-a.friction)
	a.dy *= (1-a.friction)
	
	if (abs(a.dx) < 0.001) a.dx=0
	if (abs(a.dy) < 0.001) a.dy=0
	
	if a.k == 32 then
		current_step_speed = step_speed / (u_speed >= 2 and 1.2 or 1)

		if (abs(a.dx)<=0.01 and abs(a.dy)<=0.01) then
			a.frame = 0
			step_timer = 0
		else
			a.frame += a.fr_sp
			a.frame %= a.frames

			if(step_timer <= 0) then
				if player_in_lab() then
					sfx(21)
				else
					sfx(20)
					make_particle(5,90+rnd(11),a.x*8-1+flr(rnd(2)),a.y*8+flr(rnd(2)),0,0,0)

					p_col = in_heat and 9 or 
							in_rad and 11 or 
							u_speed>=2 and 6 or
							5
					for i=1,5 do
						make_particle(p_col,30+rnd(11),a.x*8-0.3+flr(rnd(0.7)),a.y*8+flr(rnd(1)),-0.25+rnd(0.51),-rnd(0.3),0.9)
					end
				end
				
				step_timer = current_step_speed
			end
			step_timer -= 1
		end
	end
	
	if(a.y >= 24) then
		a.x = flr(a.x) + 64.5
		a.y = a.y - 24
	end

	if(a.y < 0) then
	 a.x = flr(a.x) - 63.5
	 a.y = a.y + 24
	end	
	
	a.t += 1
end

function break_state(x,y,o)

	if(last_x==x) and (last_y==y) then
		ls_b += ls_strength
		ls_perc = ls_b/o.res
		sfx(5)
		if ls_b >= o.res then
			ls_b = 0
			ls_perc = 0
			return true
		else
			return false
		end
	else
		ls_b = 0
		last_x = x
		last_y = y
		return false
	end
end

		-- cut
		if o.needs_rock then
			if u_rock >= 2 then
				-- dissolving rock
				return true
			else
				-- needs rock dissolving upgrade
				return false
			end
		elseif o.needs_metal then
			if u_metal >= 2 then
				-- cutting metal
				return true
			else
				-- needs metal cutter upgrade
				return false
			end
		else
			-- cut it
			return true
		end
	end

	-- too weak!
	return false
end

function refill_ox()
	if(ox_time < ox_max*0.95) then
		ox_time = (ox_perc + 0.1-ox_perc*0.1) * ox_max
	else
		ox_time = ox_max
	end
end

function oxygen_handler()
	
	local tile = mget(pl.x,pl.y)
	
	if(not in_death) then
		if tile == 36 or tile == 37 then
			-- player walking in lava
			in_heat = true
			if(u_heat < 2) damage_player(3,18)
		elseif tile == 52 or tile == 53 then
			-- player walking in radiation
			in_rad = true
			if(u_rad < 2) damage_player(6,19)
		else
			in_heat = false
			in_rad = false
		end

		damage_timer -= 1
	end

	-- run out of oxygen
	if in_death then
		player_death()
	elseif ox_time <= -2 then
		player_death()
	end

	if (player_in_lab()) then
		refill_ox()
	elseif mget(pl.x,pl.y) == 56 or mget(pl.x,pl.y) == 57 then
		refill_ox()
	else
		ox_time -= 1/30 -- framerate
	end

	ox_perc = max(0, ox_time/ox_max)

	-- change color with ox level
	ox_color = suit_col

	if(not in_death) then
		
		if (ox_time <= 5) then
			if flr(time()*4)%2==1 then
				ox_color = 7
			else
				if(ox_color != 8) sfx(24)
				ox_color = 8
			end
		elseif(ox_perc <= 0.334) then
			ox_color=8
		end
	end
	
	if damage_effect_timer > 0 then
		if(damage_effect_timer % 3 != 0) ox_color = 8
	end
end

function collect_material(tag, amount)
	for i = 1, ma_slots do
		if collected_ma[i] != nil then
			if collected_ma[i].tag == tag then
				-- add material to same material
				if collected_ma[i].amount < ma_max then
					-- there is space left
					collected_ma[i].amount = min(ma_max, collected_ma[i].amount + amount)
					return true
				else
					-- material at capacity
					start_note("◀ case slot full",2,9)

					return false
				end
			end
		else
			-- add material to empty slot
			add_material(tag, amount)
			return true
		end
	end
	-- no slot left
	start_note("◀ no empty slots",2,9)
	
	return false
end

function analyse_material()
	-- add resources to storage
	for ma in all(collected_ma) do

		-- if special materials are found
		if(ma.tag == ma_plant.tag) then
			dset(41,1)
			if(ma_plant.discovered == false) found_new = true
			ma_plant.discovered = true
		end
		
		if(ma.tag == ma_quartz.tag) then
			dset(42,1)
			if(ma_quartz.discovered == false) found_new = true
			ma_quartz.discovered = true
		end

		if(ma.tag == ma_fungi4.tag) then
			dset(43,1)
			if(ma_fungi4.discovered == false) found_new = true
			ma_fungi4.discovered = true
		end

		for t in all(ma_total) do
			if(ma.tag == t.tag) then
				-- check if new material was delivered
				if(t.discovered == false) found_new = true
				t.amount += ma.amount
			end
		end

		found_some = true
	end

	-- save stored resources in savegame
	save_collected_materials()

	-- empty material case
	foreach(collected_ma,remove_material)
end

		s = u_cat[i].state

			if u_cat[i+1].pre then
				a = u_cat[i].icon.."-"
				b = "■-"
			else
				a = u_cat[i].icon.." "
				b = "■ "
			end
		else
			a = u_cat[i].icon.." "
			b = "■ "
		end

		if s == 0 or u_cat[i].discovered == false then
			add_panel_content(b, 1, 1)
		else
			if(s == 1) add_panel_content(a, 1, 13)
			if(s == 2) add_panel_content(a, 1, u_cat[i].color)
		end
	end

	if(u_cursor_x == nil) u_cursor_x = 0

	if btnp(1) then

		sfx(0)

		info_swap = false
		info_timer = 0
	end

		u_cursor_x = (u_cursor_x - 1) % #u_cat
		sfx(1)

		info_current_speed = info_speed
		info_swap = false
		info_timer = 0

	if flr(time()*4%2) == 0 then
		tx = add_panel_content("◀ ▶",1,7)
		tx.append = false
		tx.x = 4 * (2+u_cursor_x * 2)

	tx.x = 0

	p.x += p.dx
	p.y += p.dy

	p.dx *= p.drag
	p.dy *= p.drag

	p.t += 1
end

function make_particle(color,lifetime,x,y,dx,dy,drag)
	p ={
		color = color,
		lifetime = lifetime, -- in frames
		x = x,
		y = y,
		dx = dx or 0,
		dy = dy or -1,
		drag = drag or 0.9,

		t = 0,

description: - Controls Navigate the world and UI: Arrow keys/d-pad Interact the world and UI: X key/X button (Both Pico-8 buttons work) How To Play Go out and gather samples from your surroundings Research samples in the lab to unlock and upgrade abilities The game saves everything automatically! Post Mortem This post mortem is mostly me documenting the development of SPHONGOS and sharing some of my learnings. If there is anything specific you would like to know, just ask! How it started This game started as an entry for the A Game By Its Cover 2024 Jam on itch.io. I had a rough last year and after failing to get anywhere with game development I turned to Pico-8 and tried to give myself a proper time frame and goals. The idea was to finish no matter what. Why Pico-8 I felt like having seemingly endless possibilities with bigger game engines made me unfocused and I thought a lot about unimportant things. I couldn't get to a point where I was making a game. The tools that Pico-8 provides are limited in a way that it feels like a creative challenge and a puzzle to get your vision on the screen. It feels like a game in itself. Coding in Lua is fairly easy and there is a ton of documentation and help online, I feel. I always liked Pico-8 and since I got a Powkiddy RGB30 I played a lot of cool games from splore. Having my own game on this handheld device also seemed like a great motivation. The Idea The entries for the AGBIC jam are based on the cover art of the Famicase exhibition. I went through the selection from 2024 and picked a few that I thought were inspiring. I landed on Mushroom farmer https://famicase.com/24/softs/188.html I didn't have time to properly start right away, so I had a while to think what I wanted to do. In between I played Loddlenauts and loved the cleaning laser mechanic, because it is very satisfying. That's why I based the game around the idea of blasting fungi with a laser. Needless to say I strayed quite a bit from the famicase inspiration. Then I watched a few documentaries about fungi to have some knowledge to ground everything in. That turned out to be very helpful for coming up with ideas and narrative as well as names for things in the game. I had a few pages of notes about fungi and a bunch of words I could use to make things sound a bit more sciency :) Narrative The basic narrative idea is based on the concept of global warming leading to fungi being more resistant to the body heat of mammals. that's what keeps them from killing us at the moment, but it is starting to change. It felt like a good hook to base a sci-fi game on. The game does not explicitly mention any of that, but it helps to know what's going on in the world you are building. Development Disclaimer: This is the second Pico-8 project I ever started and the first I finished, so some of this might be old news, weird, or straight up wrong. I started with brainstorming a basic structure and content I wanted to have in the game like the upgrades, environments and life forms. It was faaar too much for the scope of the game of course and I ended up ditching a lot of things. I wish I would have kept the scope smaller from the beginning as I lost quite a bit of time working on systems that I ended up not needing at all. Playtesting If you take anything away from this post mortem, it should be PLAYTEST as much and as soon as possible! It helped more than anything to put this game into people's hands to see how bad it is. The balancing was waaay off. No one understood the UI. People didn't even understand they were dying. I learned so much from just observing people playing the game. If you've never done playtesting: For starters: get anyone, it doesn't really matter who Advanced: Get multiple people, that have a diverse experience with gaming Don't tell them anything about the game or how to play You can give them a sheet with information that you can ship with the game if needed, but sometimes it can help to just see them struggle and observe what they can figure out Don't talk to them while they are playing. Don't help if they are stuck - This can be hard to do, but it helps to let them figure out things and see how they do it or what they do instead - If they get stuck for very long, you can obviously help them out, but minimize the information to what they really need to advance Ask them to think out loud while playing - Just observing is good, but If they do the streamer thing and comment everything they are doing and what they are thinking while doing it, you'll get the most valuably information - You will be surprised what people assume is going on or what they are supposed to do Scope That was my biggest problem overall in the development of the game: scope! In hindsight, I should have worked more on the core mechanic of gathering the fungi and make it as fun as possible. It became fun 2 days before release, when I sat down and implemented a particle system. I was so stressed in that moment, because there was so much left to do, that I timed the implementation and only gave myself 30 minutes to do it. Luckily it worked out and it gave the game a huge boost. I then continued to use it in a lot of places to make everything juicier. I regret not having the time to implement anything moving into the environment. I had some life form early on, but had to kick them, as I realized that I can't finish if I'm going to make them work well and maybe even have to put in more. Workflow What I really liked about the development was my setup. I started out doing everything in Pico-8, but after a while, it was mentally too draining to keep coding with the pixel font and the tiny window. I switched to VSCode. I started a Git repository, where I now have all of my Pico-8 projects, because I feel they are too tiny to have a separate repository for every project. That way I was able to work at my Windows desktop PC and my trusty Linux Thinkpad in the kitchen or on the go whenever I felt like it. The one annoying thing about working with an external IDE is that I sometimes made changes in both VSCode and Pico-8 and lost some of them. If anyone knows a good solution for that other than being more disciplined about it, please tell me. Code I'm not a programmer. I never properly learned how to code. I picked it up through making games and other things over the years, so I can do quite a lot, but it might look weird to someone who actually studied it. That said, I wrote pretty much everything from scratch. The only thing I took from the demos that ship with Pico-8 is the collision implementation, because I didn't want to waste the time figuring it out myself. I don't think there is anything terribly innovative about this game's code, but if you see something you want to know more about, hit me up. UI I had a lot of fun working on the UI. As I have a background in graphics design, it comes quite easy to me and I enjoy tinkering with details, which can be a waste of time. But I think for this games it adds a lot to the sci-fi atmosphere. One of the first things I had implemented was VHS like tearing effect of the screen. It gave me a big boost in confidence and fun. Here's how I planned out some of the UI elements. In the bottom-right I even drew the case capacity display in pixels to make it all fit perfectly. As I printed most of the main panel I setup a function to add a line with some parameters to the UI. This function ended up being integral in getting a lot of information on the screen. Map Initially I planned to have a much bigger map. Luckily I was at a point where I could see the scope being to big already, so I cut it in half. It is now 4x4 rooms that are split so they occupy 8x2 rooms on the tile map. Here is how I worked on the final map. This part felt like how you think game design would be, but almost never is :D I drew the basic layout and put down stuff to mark everything you can collect in the game and where the rooms would connect. When I was mostly satisfied I took the photo above and drew it on the map. Polish I started polishing and adding effects quite late in the development. Anything that has particles was added 2 days before I uploaded the game for the first time to itch.io. A lot of sound effects were changed or added after that, because the visual effects added so much that I wanted to highlight them even more with sound. I'm very happy with how the whole game looks and feels. It's a great feeling when someone is playing it and you can hear where they are and what they are doing without looking. Release I know from experience that releasing games can be a lot of work, so I new I had more work to do after uploading the game. I ended up re-designing the logo. Fiddled a lot with screenshots and gifs. Fixed bugs. Implemented a few quality of life things after more playtesting. Fixed more bugs. Wrote this text! Contact Check out my games: https://mkoloch.itch.io Say hi on Mastodon: https://mastodon.social/@michaelkoloch Say hey on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/michaelkoloch.bsky.social

description: Hey everyone! Here is Will The Man Get Frog , a chill little game about composing silly or sweet haikus (short poems) and sharing them with the world! I wanted to make a game about constrained creation that felt easy to play, in the hope that people end up surprised by how fun it is to write stuff. It was my first serious project as an indie dev and it was published on Steam on February 14th 2024. Hope you'll like it! If you do, consider following me on Bluesky or itch.io ! There are been many updates since the initial release, so here is the changelog: Changelog v2.4.1, 11/01/2026: Fixed an error when capturing a screenshot v2.4, 28/02/2025: A full French translation! v2.3, 19/04/2024: Mouse support! Composing is now comfier than ever! A brand-new background and music themed around new year's eve! A not-so brand-new background and music with a big frog in it! A LOT more season words (more than twice as much)! the "..." punctuation mark, more mysterious than ever. "-ed" and "-es" suffixes. Add past tenses and plurals to anything. A delicate sprinkle of handpicked new words in almost every category. A few bug fixes and quality of life improvements v2.2, 14/02/2024: Available on Steam for Windows/Mac/Linux! A brand new title screen! More words, and a specific rework on adverbs to make them hopefully more enjoyable! A few QoL improvements That's it. v2.1, 10/10/2023: A brand new game mode, shared game! Challenge your friends to write with the same words as you! More adjectives, and more synonyms for every adjective! A new, dashing cover art! Automatic word sorting Some feedback and game layout rework v2.0, 14/08/2023: 2 new backgrounds, for fall and winter! MUSIC! 4 awesome, soothing tracks by c.diffin! LOTS of new words Word sorting Punctuation! Prefixes and suffixes QoL Improvements v1.0, 09/07/2023: Initial release

	local a = 0

function px2int(xy, d, flag)
	-- kirisute
	-- flag is shisyagonyu
	return sgn(d) * flr(sgn(d) * (xy+(flag and sgn(d) *4 or 0))/8)*8
end

function px2intf(xy, d, flag)
	-- kiriage
	-- "f" means "mae"
	return -1*sgn(d) * flr(-1*sgn(d) * (xy-(flag and sgn(d) *4 or 0))/8)*8
end

function iceblock_reset()
	iceblock_count = 0
	--1 ice gen de okasii kasho wo shusei
	for j=0, level_celh-1, 1 do
		for i=0, level_celw-1, 1 do
			local lx, ly = i+level_celx, j+level_cely
			if is_iceblock(i, j) then
				iceblock_count += 1
				local current_spr = mget(lx, ly)
				local f1, f2, f3, f4
				= fget(current_spr, 1), fget(current_spr, 2), fget(current_spr, 3), fget(current_spr, 4)
				if f1 then
					if fget(mget(lx, ly-1), 0) == false then f1 = false end
				end
				if f2 then
					if fget(mget(lx+1, ly), 0) == false then f2 = false end
				end
				if f3 then
					if fget(mget(lx, ly+1), 0) == false then f3 = false end
				end
				if f4 then
					if fget(mget(lx-1, ly), 0) == false then f4 = false end
				end
				mset(lx, ly, flag_to_iceblock(f1, f2, f3, f4))
			end
		end
	end
	if iceblock_count >= 30 then
		popup_set"32"
	end

	--2 iceblock no migi shita no kage wo shusei
	for j=0, level_celh-1, 1 do
		for i=0, level_celw-1, 1 do
			local lx, ly = i+level_celx, j+level_cely
			local current_spr = mget(lx, ly)
			if is_iceblock(i, j) then
				
				local next_spr = mget(i+1+level_celx, ly)
				if
					current_spr == 8 or current_spr ==25 or 
					current_spr == 39 or current_spr ==56 or
					current_spr == 50 or current_spr == 51 or 
					current_spr == 58 or current_spr == 59
				then	
					if
						next_spr == 10 or next_spr == 25 or
						next_spr == 42 or next_spr == 56 or
						next_spr == 56 or next_spr == 59 or
						next_spr == 57 or next_spr == 58
					then
						if current_spr == 8  then mset(lx, ly, 11) end
						if current_spr == 25 then mset(lx, ly, 12) end
						if current_spr == 39 then mset(lx, ly, 43) end
						if current_spr == 56 then mset(lx, ly, 59) end
						if
							current_spr == 50 or
							current_spr == 51 or
							current_spr == 58 or
							current_spr == 59 
						then
							mset(lx, ly, current_spr-16)
							
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function flag_to_iceblock(f1, f2, f3, f4)
	local a = 48
	if f1 then a+=1  end
	if f2 then a+=2  end
	if f3 then a+=4  end
	if f4 then a+=8  end
	return a
end
