-- class helper
function class(base)
	local nc={}
	if (base) setmetatable(nc,{__index=base}) 
	nc.new=function(...) 
		local no={}
		setmetatable(no,{__index=nc})
		local cur,q=no,{}
		repeat
			local mt=getmetatable(cur)
			if not mt then break end
			cur=mt.__index
			add(q,cur,1)
		until cur==nil
		for i=1,#q do
			if (rawget(q[i],'init')) rawget(q[i],'init')(no,...)
		end
		return no
	end
	return nc
end

-- event dispatcher
event=class()
function event:init()
	self._evt={}
end
function event:on(event,func,context)
	self._evt[event]=self._evt[event] or {}
	-- only one handler with same function
	self._evt[event][func]=context or self
end
function event:remove_handler(event,func,context)
	local e=self._evt[event]
	if (e and (context or self)==e[func]) e[func]=nil
end
function event:emit(event,...)
	for f,c in pairs(self._evt[event]) do
		f(c,...)
	end
end

-- sprite class for scene graph
sprite=class(event)
function sprite:init()
	self.children={}
	self.parent=nil
	self.x=0
	self.y=0
end
function sprite:set_xy(x,y)
	self.x=x
	self.y=y
end
function sprite:get_xy()
	return self.x,self.y
end
function sprite:add_child(child)
	child.parent=self
	add(self.children,child)
end
function sprite:remove_child(child)
	del(self.children,child)
	child.parent=nil
end
function sprite:remove_self()
	if self.parent then
		self.parent:remove_child(self)
	end
end
-- logical xor
function lxor(a,b) return not a~=not b end
-- common draw function
function sprite:_draw(x,y,fx,fy)
	spr(self.spr_idx,x+self.x,y+self.y,self.w or 1,self.h or 1,lxor(fx,self.fx),lxor(fy,self.fy))
end
function sprite:show(v)
	self.draw=v and self._draw or nil
end
function sprite:render(x,y,fx,fy)
	if (self.draw) self:draw(x,y,fx,fy)
	for i=1,#self.children do
		self.children[i]:render(x+self.x,y+self.y,lxor(fx,self.fx),lxor(fy,self.fy))
	end
end
function sprite:emit_update()
	self:emit("update")
	for i=1,#self.children do
		local child=self.children[i]
		if child then child:emit_update() end
	end
end

function puzzle:update_puzzle_numbers()
    local _s=self
	local function is_definite(arr,num)
		local n=#arr-1
		for i=1,#arr do n+=arr[i] end
		return (num==n) and 1 or 0
	end

	local h,w=_s.map_tile_h,_s.map_tile_w
	local data=_s.puzzle_data
	for i=1,h do
		local nums=data_to_nums(data[i])
		_s.numbers_h[i]=nums
		_s.numbers_h_is_definite[i]=is_definite(nums,w)
	end
	for i=1,w do
		local t={}
		for j=1,_s.map_tile_h do t[j]=data[j][i] end
		local nums=data_to_nums(t)
		_s.numbers_v[i]=nums
		_s.numbers_v_is_definite[i]=is_definite(nums,h)
	end
end

function puzzle:export()
	local w,h,md=self.map_tile_w,self.map_tile_h,self.map_data
	-- crop(include x check)
	local arr_v,arr_h={},{}
	for i=1,h do
		local j=1
		while j<=w do
			if md[i][j]!=0 then
				arr_v[i]=0
				j=w+1
			end
			j+=1
		end
		if(arr_v[i]==nil) arr_v[i]=1
	end
	for i=1,w do
		local j=1
		while j<=h do
			if md[j][i]!=0 then
				arr_h[i]=0
				j=h+1
			end
			j+=1
		end
		if(arr_h[i]==nil) arr_h[i]=1
	end
	local cut_t,cut_b,cut_l,cut_r=0,0,0,0
	local arr_h2=data_to_nums(arr_h)
	local arr_v2=data_to_nums(arr_v)
	if #arr_v2>0 then
		if(arr_v[1]==1) cut_t=arr_v2[1]
		if(arr_v[#arr_v]==1) cut_b=arr_v2[#arr_v2]
	end
	if #arr_h2>0 then
		if(arr_h[1]==1) cut_l=arr_h2[1]
		if(arr_h[#arr_h]==1) cut_r=arr_h2[#arr_h2]
	end

	local s=""
	for i=1+cut_t,h-cut_b do
		for j=1+cut_l,w-cut_r do
			s=s..(md[i][j]==1 and "1" or "0")
		end
	end
	s=data_encode(s,true)

	local w=self.map_tile_w-cut_l-cut_r
	local h=self.map_tile_h-cut_t-cut_b
	s=w..","..h..","..s.."/"
	printh(s,"@clip")
	_popup:open("exported")
end

	self.matchdata_h[tile_y]=m
	-- ム❎ひ
	local tt={}
	for i=1,self.map_tile_h do

	local t1=data_to_nums(tt)
	local t2=self.numbers_v[tile_x]
	local m,c=0,0
	if #t1==#t2 then
		for i=1,#t1 do

		end

	end
	self.matchdata_v[tile_x]=m

	local _s,c=self,0
	for i=1,#_s.matchdata_h do c+=_s.matchdata_h[i] end
	for i=1,#_s.matchdata_v do c+=_s.matchdata_v[i] end
	if #_s.matchdata_h+#_s.matchdata_v==c then
		local d1,d2=_s.puzzle_data,_s.map_data
		for i=1,#d1 do

	local d1,d2=self.puzzle_data,self.map_data
	for i=1,#d1 do

		for j=1,#d1[i] do

						local xy=i[3][3]+i[3][4]
						if(xy%2==1) dx*=-1.5
						if(xy%4<2) dy*=-1.5
					end
					local x,y,c=x1+dx,y1+dy,d[t+3]
					pset(x,y,c)
					if c==7 or c==7 then -- マぬ⧗ ミ🐱▤ム▤そ ムえひメ🅾️▥メ⌂まミ⌂⬆️ メ▒てマの😐

						pset(x,y+1,c)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		i[2]-=1
	end
	for i in all(self.eff_list) do

	end

function data_to_nums(t)
	local function is1(n) if n==1 then return 1 else return 0 end end
	local tt={}
	local counting_num=is1(t[1]) -- ムみひムあひメ⌂まムさ➡️ムえま ム☉つムお…
	local count_times=1 -- ムう░ ム☉つムお…ミしも ムみひムあひメ⌂まメˇう ム☉▤
	for i=2,#t do
		local n=is1(t[i])
		if counting_num==n then
			count_times+=1
			if i==#t and n==1 then tt[#tt+1]=count_times end
		else
			if n==0 then tt[#tt+1]=count_times
			elseif n==1 and i==#t then tt[#tt+1]=1 end
			counting_num=n
			count_times=1
		end
	end
	return tt
end

description: Little Eidolons An open-world rpg where you can catch, train, and battle with over 100 varieties of monsters! Gameplay Overview Gameplay is performed by navigating the overworld until you encounter either a wild Eidolon or an opposing trainer, which transitions the game to battle mode. Battle mode uses turn-based mechanics across a grid to allow you to fight - until all foes are defeated! If you (the little wizard guy) fall in battle, it's an immediate game over! So you'll want to use the rest of your team members to protect them. But there's benefits to getting the finishing hit - if they defeat a wild Eidolon, you'll catch it and add it to your team! And if they defeat a trainer or their Eidolons, said character will drop an Eido Gem, an item you can have a unit pick up during battle to permanently enhance them. Explore Mode Controls Arrow Keys: Move player ❎: Pull up team menu, which allows you to view your Eidolons, and toggle party members Battle Mode Controls Arrow Keys: Move Cursor 🅾️: Select character, choose a space for them to move, or an enemy/ally for them to perform an action on ❎: Deselect character, pull up unit info sheet Stat/Types Overview A Special Note There's an extremely rare class of Eidolons known as albinos - you'll immediately pick them out because they're usually white or light grey. If you see one, you should totally take the chance to catch them and show them off! (They're the counterpart to the Pokemon series' Shiny Pokemon.) Credits Coding, sprites, and sfx were made by SmartAlloc Music was made by Gruber and Oto Uses UltimaN3rd 's Binary Save System Uses thisismypassword 's shrink08 minifier Cover art was made by Redlink101 Additional thanks to FReDs72, Heracleum, merwok, ultiman3rd, AcousticLemmon, null, pancelor, morgan, and SquidLight for help, beta testing, and feedback. Changelog 1.0.1: Resolved an issue where a speedy player could input a second action before a unit's first one finished. 1.0.2: Resolved an issue which allowed players to teleport their units. 1.0.3: Added a new menu theme, compliments of Oto! 1.0.4: Fixed spawn intersection issue, legendary respawn issue, and modified the way the X button affects enemy range display and enemy details display. In addition, buffed the action 'Maximum Jelp'. 1.0.5: Resolved an issue where game bugged out when multiple button presses where made after catching an eidolon, and one where you could teleport the evoker after defeating a foe. 1.0.6: Minor map and volume changes

description: You were born in an unassuming star system but your fate lies in The Heavens Carve a path through the stars, conquer asteroids, colonize planets, and unearth the mysteries of an ancient alien race as you build your stellar empire. Your ultimate goal? Chart a course to the edge of the known universe! The universe awaits — are you ready? Controls & How to Play Master your controls to navigate the cosmic playground: Directional Pad Thrusters : Hold the UP button to engage. Turning : Use LEFT and RIGHT to maneuver your ship. Mini-map : Hold DOWN to view your galactic surroundings. Mechanics Tools Menu : Press the V key to access your tools menu, featuring your Cannon , Fuel Collector , Settlement , and Hyperdrive . Ore : Obliterate asteroids to collect Ore. Ammo : Automatically replenishes over time Fuel : When close to a fuel source such as a gas giant or the sun, equip your Fuel Collector from the tools menu and activate it with the C key. Hyperdrive : Once unlocked, grants you the ability to traverse between solar systems Resource Management : Balance your resources— blue Fuel , green Ammo , and yellow Ore —to power your journey. Colonization : Gather enough yellow Ore and land on an uncolonized habitable planet, and you can establish a new Settlement. Colonizing solar systems also increases your hyperdrive capability. Settlement Platforms : Platforms on Settlements replenish your fuel. Solar Expansion : Start new runs from any of your colonized solar systems. Expand out into the galaxy to further your progress. Probes : Collect alien probes to enhance your ships systems and extend your warp range, guiding you to the last star. Star Map : Open your star map by pressing the B button when your mini-map is open Activate your selected tool with the C key.
comment_1: Wow this is super cool.
comment_2: The gravity mechanics and graphics are so good, it feels pretty realistic :D
comment_3: I love the aesthetics and slow pace of this game, but I keep warping directly into the gravity well of a star on the second or third jump (3 times in 6 attempts). Am I missing something, or did I just get bad luck?
comment_4: If you're warping to the same star then it might be a small solar system with 1 planet and the chance of you ending up within the vicinity of a star is increased because it finds a random location within the system within range of the planets. Most of the time you can still escape the gravity of the star when warping within range by going perpendicular to the star so you end up in its orbit instead of fighting directly against its gravity. There are times when it's inescapable though and it's the luck of the draw given the rng.
comment_5: The dithering around planets looks so good! 🌍🤩

function add_new_dust(_x,_y,_dx,_dy,_l,_s,_g,_f)
 add(dust, {
  fade=_f,
  x=_x,
  y=_y,
  dx=_dx,
  dy=_dy,
  life=_l,
  orig_life=_l,
  rad=_s,
  col=7, --set to color
  grav=_g,
  draw=function(self)
   --this function takes care
   --of drawing the particle
        
   --clear the palette
   pal()
   palt()
        
   --draw the particle
   circfill(self.x,self.y,self.rad,self.col)
  end,
  update=function(self)
   --this is the update function
        
   --move the particle based on
   --the speed
   self.x+=self.dx
   self.y+=self.dy
   --and gravity
   self.dy+=self.grav
        
   --reduce the radius
   --this is set to 90%, but
   --could be altered
   self.rad*=0.9
        
   --reduce the life
   self.life-=1
        
   --set the color
   if type(self.fade)=="table" then
    --assign color from fade
    --this code works out how
    --far through the lifespan
    --the particle is and then
    --selects the color from the
    --table
    self.col=self.fade[flr(#self.fade*(self.life/self.orig_life))+1]
   else
    --just use a fixed color
    self.col=self.fade            
   end
         
    --if the dust has exceeded
   --its lifespan, delete it
   --from the table
   if self.life<0 then
    del(dust,self)
   end
  end
 })
end

  }

description: Oblivion Eve A roguelike action-platformer where you use upgradeable weapons to combo powerful enemies to their doom! Overcome tough fights, platforming challenges, puzzles, and more in your effort to free the titan who is incarcerated in the shifting prison's depths. Gameplay Overview Each time you venture into the shifting prison, the layout of the rooms will be randomized. And there's no map to guide your way, either - you'll need to do your best to navigate as the prison itself fights against you - by moving rooms, making you double back on yourself, and putting powerful enemies in your path. At the heart of the prison lies an enchained titan, who will fight against your every attempt to free them. For each of the four gems you destroy, you'll break one of the chains binding them. Find the titan four times, shatter all four chains to fully liberate them, and claim victory! And remember to use your ABC's: Always Be Comboing! Advanced Overview Each of the five weapons has a different moveset, featuring attacks with varying properties. As you progress through the prison, you'll get the ability to upgrade your attacks, by raising or lowering several properties: Size: How large the weapon is, which makes it easier to hit foes. Damage: How much enemy HP the weapon will remove on hit. Meter Gain: How much meter you gain on hit, which transforms you into stronger forms, and allows you to use ultimate attacks. Duration: How long the attack will stay out, making swings spin longer, and stabs go further. Recharge Rate: How long it is until you can use another attack afterwards. Controls Arrow Keys: Move Character, Move Menu Selection 🅾️ (Z): Jump, Choose Menu Selection ❎ (X): Attack, Previous Menu Enter: Pause Menu Credits Coding, Sprites, Design: SmartAlloc Music: extar Sound Effects: Munchkin Uses thisismypassword 's shrink08 minifier Thanks to bikibird, freds72, heracleum, josiah winslow, mazzetip, merwok, miss mouse, p01, pancelor, smalltestaccount, smellyfishtiks, and thisismypassword for tons of help throughout the development process. Additional thanks to merwok, ohhcurtains, redlink, rey k, spiderware, and yokoboko for playtesting and feedback. Changelog 1.0.0: Initial release 1.0.1: Small bug fixes and balance changes 1.0.2: Fixed issue where the same lore page could be picked up multiple times 1.0.3: Ultimates scale better at higher combos, replaced some rooms, added option to clear game data, fixed issue where a some graphics were partially cut off, fixed issue where game would crash when resetting cart during a run 1.0.4: Fixed issue where you could obtain the last two lore entries early, fixed issue with music resuming after ultimates, reworded tutorial text for clarity 1.0.5: Updated music, lowered boss health, buffed damage reduction upgrade, increased axe smash attack cooldown, decreased axe damage 1.0.6: Made it so the sword and spear side strong attacks have a better angle, increased boss laser size, replaced that annoying attack where a boss pulls a hammer from below 1.1.0: Added a new difficulty 'Oblivion'. Increased the damage of the axe while lowering its range, and buffed the size of the spear. Rebalanced enemies and bosses across the board to make the game more balanced and fun. Download For players who want to run the game offline or on a console, the itch.io page has a download for all the carts. Feel free to share your high scores in the comments below! description: Controls Story A young hero, fueled by dreams of becoming a revered paladin, embarks on a quest that will test his strength and intelligence. Inspired by tales of the Sunforged Knights, he eagerly undertakes the arduous trials that they administer and judge. Success promises not only rank among their esteemed order but also the rewards of riches and the fulfillment of a lifelong dream. How to Play There are 62 rooms. Use the items in each room to kill the monsters and exit as efficiently as possible. Resources are tight, but you may be surprised at how you can use them to make your heroic escape. Evaluations and Rewards After successfully exiting each room, you will be evaluated on your efficiency and rewarded diamonds! The less moves and actions you make to exit the room, the more diamonds you get. Collect as many diamonds as you can to reach higher ranks in the Sunforged Knights and become the greatest Paladin they've ever seen! Items Use the O-Button (Z or C on keyboard) to swap between your items. Each room has one or more items that you can use to kill the monsters, but they will be taken from you before you begin the next room. You will always have the winged boots of swiftness that carry you as far as you can go in any direction. There are 3 possible items that you can pick up and use: Sword : Swing it in any direction to kill a monster next to you. Shield : Run with the shield in hand to bash things in the room. Bow : Shoot an arrow across an entire room. You only get 1, so retrieve it to shoot again. Monsters Don't worry, we've selected relatively harmless monsters for these trials. They stand around looking menacing, but as long as you kill them quickly, you shouldn't have any problems from them even when you are staring them in the face. Extras For extra goodies available for download, visit Puzzles of the Paladins itch.io page to get: Full Instruction Booklet which includes all the game lore High Resolution Poster/Desktop Background of a map of all rooms (new) QR Code Stickers! 6 stickers as PNGs and a Printable PDF page That is just the start. I am using this game to try out all sorts of ways we can get creative with our games beyond the game development itself, so I look forward to sharing more goodies. Enter : Pause/menu About Praxis Fighter X is a fast-paced single stage retro shoot-em-up. Dodge bullets and fight off the militarized police force defending a corporate toxic sludge pipeline. Inspired by old-school shmups/STGs, the game focuses on reflex-based action and satisfying destruction while including some modern comforts like a smaller player hitbox and a focus mode. It's on the difficult side but with dedication and the power of 3 Continues you will persevere. Scoring Build your scoring multiplier and keep your combo meter up by taking out enemies and ground targets. Dealing damage also helps sustain your combo meter — once it runs out, your multiplier will begin falling. Tip 1: Your combo meter depletes more slowly while charging your bomb weapon. Tip 2: If your bomb collides with an enemy mid-air, you get your shot back with a shorter delay Tip 3: Collecting a powerup you already have or a 1UP when at 3 lives will give you points instead of the usual effect. Your current multiplier applies here too. Tip 4: Your multiplier also applies during boss fights. Try to take out all the boss's destructible parts while continously dealing damage for maximum points. Credits Praxis Fighter X was created by Eric Billingsley. Thanks to Krystian Majewski of Lazy Devs Academy for creating the Advanced Shmup Tutorial which inspired me to work on the game. Though I didn't use the solutions from the tutorial exactly, watching the videos was really helpful in understanding what makes shmups tick and what challenges I would need to plan for. Boghog's Shmup Workshop series was also really helpful. Thanks to Otto, LokiStriker, Louie Chapman, Catto, Glimm, Trog, TheGacko, Jonah Davidson, and Jeep Barnett for playtesting and feedback. Thanks to Aktane for feedback on my initially terrible bullet visibility and Heracleum for help with turret rendering tech. And thanks Maria for your encouragement and for being there for me all along the way. Future Plans Praxis Fighter X features a single stage and is meant to be a complete experience as is — there are currently no plans to expand it. description: Feathered Escape Soar to freedom in Feathered Escape , a platformer where you, as a trapped bird, navigate challenging environments, overcoming obstacles and adversaries to reclaim the open skies. ⬅️ and ➡️ to move left or right. ⬆️ to execute a wall or ceiling run. ⬇️ to descend without sliding on a platform. [X] or [Z] to jump. A+: Complete in 4 or fewer minutes, collecting all the fruits, and with 0 deaths. A: Complete in 5 or fewer minutes, collecting all the fruits. B: Complete in 15 or fewer minutes. C: Complete in 20 or fewer minutes. D: Complete in 30 or fewer minutes. F: Complete in more than 30 minutes. A+ Score: https://www.speedrun.com/Feathered_Escape?h=100&x=xk9z95g2 Any%: https://www.speedrun.com/Feathered_Escape?h=any&x=rkloz58k 100%: https://www.speedrun.com/Feathered_Escape?h=100&x=z27z95ok Best score so far by @skarrmann (spoiler alert) Moves If you'd rather tackle the moves on your own, feel free to skip this section. Variable Jump Height Control your jump height by adjusting the duration of the jump button press. Ceiling Run Execute a short run on the ceiling by holding the UP button. The character will cling for a brief period before descending. Ceiling Boost Boost your speed by initiating a ceiling run and promptly ending it with a tap on the jump button. Ceiling Corner Boost Speed boost by performing a ceiling run on a single block or close to the corner of one. Wall Sling Jump Pushing against the wall and holding the jump button will create an arc allowing you to jump over obsticles. Wall Jump Over Obsticles While wall running, push against the wall and hold the jump button to jump over obstacles. Air Control Leverage exceptional air control, allowing swift changes in direction or sudden midair stops. Make the most of it! Hop Over Blocks Moving will enable you to effortlessly hop over gaps. Versions Fixed an issue where milliseconds were not formatted correctly. Added completion time on the select level screen. End screen now displays completion time with milliseconds (e.g., "00:00:00.000"). Reworked the main screen. Resolved a bug that was causing menu malfunctions on Miyoo Mini. Introduced the "play level" option. Initial release
comment_1: This is super polished and unique, I love how you took the wall-jumping of the chicken from BAS and turned it into a fully fledged platformer. I also like how even though you only have one jump you can perform it in mid air if you walk off a platform first. I did pretty badly and skipped most of the fruits so I ended up with 218 deaths, 7 fruits, and a time of 22:16.
comment_2: This is unreasonably cool. ❤️ Glad it features the BAS bird and tileset, because that game was too difficult, but I loved the art. Seriously man, you have to stop.🤯
comment_3: @Munchkin Thanks for the positive feedback! Glad you enjoyed the game. Collecting the oranges on the first play isn't expected, but it's all part of the challenge. Happy gaming! 🍊🎮
comment_4: The tutorial was very helpful. Smooth action and difficult but forgiving stages are a lot of fun.
comment_5: Excellent job! The responsive controls and level design are reminiscent of both Dustforce and Super Meat Boy. I appreciate how you added these square blocks in the level layout. With a good understanding of movement and its execution, players can dash through levels, and it's fun to discover risky shortcuts. My score, first playthrough:

description: Tiny Tracks. Fast Laps Driftmania is an arcade time trial racing game. Your goal is to get the fastest possible time on each of the 15 challenging tracks Controls Up Arrow or Z: Accelerate Down Arrow: Brake + Reverse Left Arrow: Turn left Right Arrow: Turn right X: D-Brake R: Restart level P: Pause game + Options menu Tips You turn faster when holding the D-Brake Take a good look at the minimap before starting a track. You need to anticipate the turns to get the best times Grass does not slow you down. It reduces traction, which you can use to your advantage for drifting! Driving over yellow tiles will activate boost. Boost works with whatever direction you're facing - it doesn't matter where the arrow on the ground is pointing Garage customizations do not change car handling. Make your car look however you want it to! An optional ghost can be enabled in the pause menu. Replays are lost when exiting a track Changelog 1.0.1 Reduced medal difficulty across most tracks Reduced medal requirements for unlocking new tracks Ghost now defaults to ON 1.1.0 Revised D4: optional first jump pad, bigger second jump pad Arrow keys can now be used to change track selection and garage customization Additional medal tuning Credits Created by Max Bize Music by Vav Cars (based on) art by PixelArtM Cover art by TerracotaScarf Special Thanks to Community Members @thisismypassword for shrinko8. This game would not have been possible without it! @TheRoboZ for pd_rotate(). Very useful to get rotations in so few tokens! @johanp for VFX inspiration. The sprite stacking used here started by modifying your demo cart on the subject! You can follow more of my game development on Twitter Curious to look at the un-minified source? It's over here Interested in competing for the best possible times? Join the speedrun Discord and submit your times on speedrun.com/driftmania Need some more help? Watch the Gold Medal Guide
comment_1: Amazing, great use of sprite stacking for pseudo 3D and well polished. It's a good challenge to get the higher level medals. So far I've just done the A levels and got silver medals on them. I love all the level mechanics which also all also super polished. I can see myself playing this for quite a while into the future.
comment_2: This is excellent! Great feel, graphics, effects and sfx/music! I love my little customized car. This makes me wish for an arcade cabinet with a steering wheel. Great job!
comment_3: Wow! Very well done! Love It.
comment_4: Turning and drifting feels great. I appreciate how driving on grass only affects traction, and in some levels it adds to the joy of cutting corners. Track variety is fun, and there are a lot of tracks! The gold medal times are tight! One has to execute really well to earn them, but with tracks around 40 seconds each, the challenge isn't too strenuous for those with the drive for perfection. The ghost feature has been useful to see where the time gains are available and whether my current pace is acceptable. I've only gotten a handful of gold medals so far, and there is a lot of gameplay here for those looking to optimize. My only incredibly minor feedback is the "select track" menu is a little clunky to navigate in my opinion. I think pressing the up/down buttons to change tracks, rather than pressing the action buttons on the track's name, might be more intuitive. I don't think you need to fix this menu by any means, but I wanted to mention it since it tripped me up a few times.
comment_5: Very cool - congrats on the release! Happy to hear my little example was helpful!

   start, endi = start or 1, endi or #t

  if(endi - start < 1) then return t end
  local pivot = start

      end
      pivot = pivot + 1
    end
  end
   t = quicksort(cmp_fn,t, start, pivot - 1)
  return quicksort(cmp_fn,t, pivot + 1, endi)
end

function cubic_interpolate(y0,y1,y2,y3,mu)
	local mu2=mu*mu
	local a0=y3-y2-y0+y1
	local a1=y0-y1-a0
	local a2=y2-y0
	local a3=y1
	return(a0*mu*mu2+a1*mu2+a2*mu+a3)
end


function cubic_interpolate_2d_noise(x,y,scale)
	x/=scale
	y/=scale
	

	local xl=band(x,0xffff)--flr(x)
	local xr=xl+1
	local xl1=(xl-1)*31
	local xr1=(xr+1)*31
	
	xl*=31
	xr*=31

	
	
	
	local yl=band(y,0xffff)--flr(y)
	local yr=yl+1
	local yl1=(yl-1)*37
	local yr1=(yr+1)*37
	
	yl*=37
	yr*=37

	local dx=band(x,0x.ffff)--%1
	local dy=band(y,0x.ffff)--%1
	
	local rand_list=rand_list
	
	
	local a=rand_list[band(xl1+yl1,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local b=rand_list[band(xl+yl1,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local c=rand_list[band(xr+yl1,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local d=rand_list[band(xr1+yl1,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	

		local mu2=dx*dx
		local a0=d-c-a+b
		local m=(a0*dx*mu2+(a-b-a0)*mu2+(c-a)*dx+b)

	
	
	a=rand_list[band(xl1+yl,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	b=rand_list[band(xl+yl,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	c=rand_list[band(xr+yl,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	d=rand_list[band(xr1+yl,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
		
		 a0=d-c-a+b
		local n=(a0*dx*mu2+(a-b-a0)*mu2+(c-a)*dx+b)
	
	a=rand_list[band(xl1+yr,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	b=rand_list[band(xl+yr,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	c=rand_list[band(xr+yr,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	d=rand_list[band(xr1+yr,0x0fff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	

		 a0=d-c-a+b
		local o=(a0*dx*mu2+(a-b-a0)*mu2+(c-a)*dx+b)
	
	 a=rand_list[band(xl1+yr1,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	 b=rand_list[band(xl+yr1,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	 c=rand_list[band(xr+yr1,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	 d=rand_list[band(xr1+yr1,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
		
	a0=d-c-a+b
	local p=(a0*dx*mu2+(a-b-a0)*mu2+(c-a)*dx+b)

	 mu2=dy*dy
	 a0=p-o-m+n
	return(a0*dy*mu2+(m-n-a0)*mu2+(o-m)*dy+n)
	
	
end

function lerp_2d_noise(x,y,scale)
	x/=scale

	local xl=flr(x)
	local xr=xl+1
	local dx=x%1
	local yl=flr(y)
	local yr=yl+1
	local dy=y%1

	
	local rand_list=rand_list
	local k_rand_list_length=k_rand_list_length
	
	--unrolled hash 3d function here
	--local a=rand_list[flr(xl*31+yl*37)%k_rand_list_length]
	--local b=rand_list[flr(xl*31+yl*37)%k_rand_list_length]
	--local c=rand_list[flr(xl*31+yr*37)%k_rand_list_length]
	--local d=rand_list[flr(xl*31+yr*37)%k_rand_list_length]
	  
	local a=rand_list[band(xl*31+yl*37,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local b=rand_list[band(xl*31+yr*37,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local c=rand_list[band(xr*31+yl*37,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	local d=rand_list[band(xr*31+yr*37,0xfff)]--rand_3d(xl,yl,zl)
	  --
	
	local ab=a+(b-a)*dy
	local cd=c+(d-c)*dy
	return ab+(cd-ab)*dx
		
	
	
	
end

function handle_move()
	m_time=stat(1)
	local a_thrust=.004
	

	if(btn(4))thrust+=a_thrust
	if(btn(5))thrust+=-a_thrust
	
	if(v_length(velocity)>.7)then
		if(btn(3)) pitch_a+=.00010
		if(btn(2)) pitch_a-=.00010
		
		if(btn(0)) roll_a-=.00005
		if(btn(1)) roll_a+=.00005
		
		
	
		yaw_a=-((roll+.5)%1-.5)*.03*v_length(velocity)*.5
		yaw_a=mid(yaw_a,-.1,.1)
		
	else
		if(btn(0)) yaw_a+=.00010*v_length(velocity)
		if(btn(1)) yaw_a-=.00010*v_length(velocity)
	end
	
	
	thrust=mid(thrust,0,max_thrust)
	
	
	yaw+=yaw_a
	roll+=roll_a
	
	--roll=mid(roll,-.22,.22)
	
	pitch+=pitch_a
	
	
	
	yaw_a*=.95
	pitch_a*=.95
	roll_a*=.97
	
	camera_matrix = create_y_rotate(yaw)
	camera_matrix = matrix_multiply(camera_matrix,create_z_rotate(roll))
	camera_matrix = matrix_multiply(camera_matrix,create_x_rotate(pitch))
	
	unspin = inverse_matrix( camera_matrix)
	cam_vector=transform_vector({0,0,1},unspin)
	cam_vector_x=transform_vector({1,0,0},unspin)
	cam_vector_y=transform_vector({0,1,0},unspin)
	
	
	local k_drag=.22
	local k_lift=.2
	local mass=1
	local k_gravity=.3
	
	
	local thrust_vector=v_mult(cam_vector,thrust)
	local drag_vector=v_mult( v_normalize(velocity),-1*k_drag*v_length(velocity)^2)
	local lift_vector=v_mult( cam_vector_y,1*k_lift*v_dot(cam_vector,velocity)^2)
	local weight_vector=v_mult( {0,-1,0},mass*k_gravity)
	
	local force_vector={0,0,0}
	force_vector = v_add(force_vector,thrust_vector)
	force_vector = v_add(force_vector,lift_vector)
	force_vector = v_add(force_vector,weight_vector)
	force_vector = v_add(force_vector,drag_vector)
	
	local accel_vector= v_mult(force_vector,1/mass)
	velocity = v_add(velocity,accel_vector)

	
	cam_x+=velocity[1]
	cam_y+=velocity[2]
	cam_z+=velocity[3]
	
	local ground_height=max(map_function(cam_x/world_scale,cam_z/world_scale),2)
	if(cam_y<=ground_height)then
	
		--is this a crash or a landing?
		
		if(velocity[2]>-.4)then
			cam_y=ground_height+.1
			velocity[2]=-velocity[2]*.5
			
			if(cam_vector_y[2]<.25)is_crash=true
			
		else
			is_crash=true
		end
	end
	
	local nose_height=max(map_function((cam_x+cam_vector[1]*10)/world_scale,(cam_z+cam_vector[3]*10)/world_scale),2)
	if(cam_y<=nose_height)is_crash=true

	

	cam_ax*=.95
	cam_az*=.95
	
	
	while(cam_x/world_scale-map_x<0)do scroll_map(-1,0)   end
	while(cam_x/world_scale-map_x>=1)do scroll_map(1,0)   end
	while(cam_z/world_scale-map_y<0) do scroll_map(0,-1)  end
	while(cam_z/world_scale-map_y>=1)do scroll_map(0,1)   end
	

end

function find_open_flat_cell()
	local range=200--=world_scale*100

		local y=flr(rnd(range)*2-range)
		local ground_height=map_function(x,y)
		if(ground_height==0)return x,y
	end
end

function find_water_cell()
	local range=200--=world_scale*100
	while(true) do
		local x=flr(rnd(range)*2-range)
		local y=flr(rnd(range)*2-range)
		local ground_height=map_function(x,y)
		if(ground_height<0)return x,y
	end
end

function find_flat_area(r)
	while(true) do
	
		local x,y=find_open_flat_cell()
		local count=0
		local target_count=0
		for nx=x-r,x+r do
			for ny=x-r,x+r do
				local ground_height=map_function(nx,ny)
				if(ground_height<.25)count+=1
				target_count+=1
			end
		end
		if(count==target_count)return x,y
		
	end
end

	--finds unit vector from origin as well as magnitude
	local ox,oy=x2-x1,y2-y1
	local mag=100*sqrt((ox/100)^2+(oy/100)^2)
	return mag==0 and vec(unsplit"0,0,0") or vec(ox/mag,oy/mag,mag)

		if y1>y2 then

		local d=y2-y1
		for y=y1,y2 do
			local xval=x1+(x2-x1)*(d==0 and 1 or (y-y1)/d) & -1
			xl[y],xr[y]=min(xl[y] or 32767,xval),max(xr[y] or 0x8001,xval)
		end
		ymin,ymax=min(y1,ymin),max(y2,ymax)
	end
	for y=ymin,ymax do
		rectfill(xl[y],y,xr[y],y)
	end

	--math to hit a moving target. man this function is tight
	local deltav=(tgt.dx-o.dx)*kdir.y-(tgt.dy-o.dy)*kdir.x

				sfxcheck(26,3)

					mkki(5,o)
					--strong aura
					if(o.nrg<=0)o.a_str=nil
				else

				end
				--slight tracking
			end
		end
	end --hitstop

	--terrain collision
	if o.y>=10000 then
		if not o.g then
			sfx(4) --land sound

		if dy>4 then

			o.stn+=60

		--kamehame aura
		if charging or o.km_x==3 then 
			circfill(ox,oy,zoom*(3*kmc+4*sin(t/20))-i)
		end
		if charging then
			circ(ox,oy,zoom*3*(80-kmc-i))
			line(ox,oy,ox+aimx*1000,oy+aimy*1000) --aim line
			for i=0,1,.2 do

				for p=0,2 do
					line(ox+i,oy,ox+i+140*cos(linezo)+p,oy+140*sin(linezo)+p)

			local kamel,tip=(40-kmc)*90*zoom,60*zoom
			o.a_kdir=joyoutput(edir,7)

			if i==0 then

				o.km_aim,kamel=atanxy(edir),zoom*sight/2
				o.nrg+=.1

		dt,dr=1,30

function anmtki(ox,oy,spd,kspd,pour,dt,typ,usr,varki)
	--moves ki blasts
	--ki trail fx is done in dtrail
	yield()
	while dt>0 do
		yield()
		local tgt,track=usr.en,varki==5 and max(dt/300,.2) or .2
		local kdir=unitvector(ox,oy,tgt.x,tgt.y)
		local hit=kdir.m<pour+2
	
		if typ!=5 then
			spr(usr==mob and 118 or 119,zoomcam(tgt.x,cam_x)-16*kdir.x-4,zoomcam(tgt.y)-16*kdir.y-3)
			if varki==4 then
				local speedo=unitvector(0,0,kspd.dx,kspd.dy)
				delta(kspd,speedo,min(0,15-speedo.m))
				track=1
			end
			aim(kspd,tgt,track,kdir)
			if typ==4 then --genki dama
				if dt<100 then
					pour=min(1000,(50-abs(dt-50))*45)
					sfxcheck(29,2)
					if kdir.m<pour then
						kspd.dx,kspd.dy=0,0
						if(clock(3))hitcrc(usr,kdir,1,nil,4)
					end
				end
				if hit then
					dt=min(dt,100)
				end
			else
				if hit then
					hitcrc(usr,kdir,varki)
					usr.nrg+=1
					break
				end
				if oy>10100 then
					break
				end
			end
		end
		ox+=kspd.dx
		oy+=kspd.dy

		mkedst(ox,oy,kspd.dx/2,kspd.dy/2,pour,typ,usr,dt)
		if usr.km_x==2 or typ==4 then
			corothing(coros,lightning,ox,oy)
		end
		dt-=1
	end
end --antmki

description: The game's finally released! Hope you all enjoy it as much as I did making it! Gameplay HAKAI is a momentum based aerial fighting game that takes cues from Dragonball Z. Win three rounds to beat your opponent. If the timer runs out, whoever has the lower amount of health wins, and if the players' health are equal it's a draw. You can choose whatever combination of character, bullet and super type you want. All changing character does is pick your color, though if you're in Practice mode, the character of your opponent matches the AI that character would have in Arcade mode. Arcade Mode The 28th HAKAI Tournament has begun! Do you have what it takes to win? In this mode you can fight four increasingly-difficult AI opponents across the four maps. Local Versus Fight against your friend! The camera is set to zoom out much further to try to keep both players inside the screen at all times. Practice No time limit and infinite health versus a dummy. You can use the menu to enable/disable the dummy AI and command info. You will select the dummy's character and skills after confirming yours. Controls: Movement and Jumps Input left and right with the arrow keys to move on the ground. If you have some speed and input the opposite direction you will skid. Press Z/C on the ground to jump. If you jump while skidding you will "side jump" which cancels all your horizontal speed. Hold down before jumping to super jump, adding much more vertical speed. You can also do "super side jumps"! Dodging Press Z/C while airborne to dodge in the direction held with the arrow keys. If no direction is held you will dodge in whatever direction you are moving. Hold Z/C while a direction is held to fly. This drains energy , but you can still fly when you have none left. -Flying is a fast movement option and good for covering large distances. Charging Hold Z/C while no direction is held to charge energy . Charging for longer increases the speed at which energy is gained. You will also slow down and stop moving, even in midair. Physical Attacks Press X/V while a direction is held to do a dash . -The dash will auto track towards the opponent, and will automatically do a strike upon reaching them. -The direction held will choose the direction of the initial burst of speed. Hold X/V during a dash to start a heavy dash . -The heavy strike deals more damage and stun, and launches the opponent much farther. -The heavy dash gives an addition speed burst and is overall faster, but doesn't track as much making it easier to dodge it. -During a heavy dash , energy will be drained. -You cannot start a heavy dash if your energy bar is gray. If you press X/V while no direction is held you can cancel a dash . You cannot cancel a heavy dash! Projectiles Press X/V while no direction is held to shoot a projectile . - Projectiles auto aim and track on their own. They consume some energy to fire. You cannot fire a projectile without enough energy! -There are four kinds of projectile : Bullet, Heavy, Sniper, and Track. -Bullet has a higher fire rate. -Heavy has a low fire rate but is larger and deals more damage and stun. -Sniper travels faster than the others. -Track travels slowly but follows the opponent very well. Supers Hold X/V while no direction is held and your energy bar is flashing to charge a super ! -There are four kinds of super: Barrage, Nova, Beam, and Bomb. -All supers interrupt and damage players, even during dash or heavy dash . -While charging and firing a super you are immune to only projectiles . You are not immune to either kind of dash attack or any super . -The exception is the Nova attack, which after charged is immune to any other attack, including supers . -Beam will slow down a Nova. -Only the "beam" part of Beam has a hitbox. You can flank the beam and strike the opponent's backside. -If two beams collide they will do a beam clash. This restores energy to both players. Stunning All attacks stun the opponent a varying amount. The amount of stun a player has left is indicated by the combo meter. -While stunned you cannot do anything! Stunning opponents and combo-ing them is key to doing more damage, so keep this in mind before using a heavy dash and launching the opponent far away. -If a player hits the ground or the walls while stunned, they will receive more stun. All players bounce off the walls, but you need to hit the opponent hard into the ground to bounce them otherwise they will slide. "Bounces" deal more stun! Blocking All non-super projectiles and regular dashes can be blocked. -- lab cat (V1.4)
-- by ooooggll

-- changelog
--[[
	added permanent savedata and
	a button to reset it
--]]

cartdata"ooooggll-lab_cat"

function _init()
	menu, zs = true, {}
	
	win_time, sweep, page, 
	cutscene, selected, btn_delay =
	params"0,-257,0,0,1,0"
	
	music"48"
	
	-- keep palette after quitting
	poke(0x5f2e, 1)
	-- no btnp repeat
	poke(0x5f5c, -1)
	
	reset_time()
	total_frames, total_seconds, total_minutes = 0, 0, 0
	-- determines whether the player has used "skip level" or the run is uninterrupted
	
	buttons = split("begin,levels,achievements,settings,credits,reset save")
	
	achievements = {
		{"it's shtuck", "get a cube stuck in a wall."},
		{"really big mistakes", "undo 50 times in a row."},
		{"bonk", "hit your head in frustration\n20 times in a row."},
		{"potty break", "access the only bathroom."},
		{"my dearest friends", "view the credits."},
		{"speedrunner", "beat the game in under 09:00.\nclick \"begin\" to start."}
	}
	
	credits = "coding, art, levels\n\f6 ooooggll\n\f7ideas and moral support\n\f6 ummmm_ok\n\f7playtesting\n\f6 ddddpplo\n ummmm_ok\n aidan southam\n zer0dragon\n\f7sprite help\n\f6 ddddpplo\n\f7inspiration\n\f6 paraboxical\n\f7music\n\f6 ummmm_ok\n\f7label image art\n\f6 zer0dragon\n\f7guest levels\n\f6 ummmm_ok\n zer0dragon"
	
	-- achievement related variables
	bonk_progress, mistakes_progress, achievement_time, achievement_showing = 0, 0, 0, ""
	-- save data cleared notification
	reset_notify = 0
	
	settings = {
		{"swap 🅾️ and ❎.......", "🅾️ to undo and ❎ to progress\nthrough dialog."},
		{"colorblind mode......", "makes some colors easier to\ndistinguish."},
		{"disable particles....", "might increase performance\nslightly."},
		{"light sensitive......", "disables some flickering\nvisuals."},
		{"speedrun mode........", "shows speedrun clock and\nnumber of turns."},
		{"longer move delay....", "extends time after first move\nto make controls more precise."},
	}
	
	pause_buttons = split("resume,retry level,skip level,menu")

	level_progress, run_level_progress = dget(0), 0
	
	-- this is only used in cutscene 2
	camera_y = -4
end

-- @update
function _update()
	if (win_time == 0 and not showing_dialog and not paused) frame += 1
	
	second += frame \ 30
	frame %= 30
	
	minute += second \ 60
	second %= 60
	
	-- total time
	if (win_time == 0 and not showing_dialog and not paused and not menu) total_frames += 1
	
	total_seconds += total_frames \ 30
	total_frames %= 30
	
	total_minutes += total_seconds \ 60
	total_seconds %= 60
	
	btn_c, btn_x, btnp_c, btnp_x = btn(🅾️), btn(❎), btnp(🅾️), btnp(❎)
	if option"1" then
		btn_c, btn_x, btnp_c, btnp_x = btn_x, btn_c, btnp_x, btnp_c
	end
	btnp_ok = btnp_c or btnp_x
	
	if btn_delay > 0 then
		btn_delay -= 1
	end
	
	if btnp(⬅️) or btnp(➡️) or btnp(⬆️) or btnp(⬇️) then
		btn_delay = 10
	end	
	
	if (sweep > -257) sweep -= cutscene == 1 and 4 or 16
	
	if menu then
		-- click sound
		if (btnp_ok) sfx"13"
		if (btnp(⬅️) or btnp(➡️) or btnp(⬆️) or btnp(⬇️)) sfx"15"
		
		if page == 0 then
			selected += btnp(⬇️) and 1 or btnp(⬆️) and -1 or 0
			clamp_selected(6)
			
			if (selected ~= 6) reset_popup = false
			if (reset_notify > 0) reset_notify -= 1
			
			if btnp_ok then
				local button = buttons[selected]
				if button == "begin" then
					load_level(0)
					full_run, run_level_progress = true, 0
					total_frames, total_seconds, total_minutes = 0, 0, 0
					cutscene = 1
					_music(-1, 500)
				elseif button == "levels" then
					page, selected = 1, 1
				elseif button == "achievements" then
					page, selected = 2, 1
				elseif button == "settings" then
					page, selected = 3, 1
				elseif button == "credits" then
					page, selected = 4, 0
					give_achievement(5)
				elseif button == "reset save" then
					if reset_popup then
						for i = 0, 12 do
							dset(i, 0)
							level_progress = 0
						end
						
						reset_popup = false
						reset_notify = 30
					else
						reset_popup = true
					end
				end
			end
		elseif page == 1 then
			local last_selected = selected
			--selected += btnp(⬇️) and 8 or btnp(⬆️) and -8 or btnp(⬅️) and -1 or btnp(➡️) and 1 or 0
			selected += btnp(⬅️) and -1 or btnp(➡️) and 1 or 0
			if (selected - 1) \ 8 ~= (last_selected - 1) \ 8 then
				selected = last_selected
			end
			selected += btnp(⬆️) and -8 or btnp(⬇️) and 8 or 0
			
			if (selected < 1) selected = last_selected
			selected = min(selected, 33)
			
			if btnp_ok then
				if selected == 33 then
					page, selected = 0, 1
				elseif level_progress >= selected then
					load_level(selected - 1)
					if (selected == 1) music"0"
				end
			end
		elseif page == 2 then
			selected += btnp(⬇️) and 1 or btnp(⬆️) and -1 or 0
			clamp_selected(7)
			
			if (btnp_ok) and selected == 7 then
				page, selected = 0, 1
			end
		elseif page == 3 then
			selected += btnp(⬇️) and 1 or btnp(⬆️) and -1 or 0
			clamp_selected(7)
			
			if btnp_ok then
				if selected == 7 then
					page, selected = 0, 1
				else
					--settings[selected][3] = not settings[selected][3]
					dset(selected + 6, -dget(selected + 6) + 1)
				end
			end
		elseif page == 4 then
			-- reuse selected as a scroll for credits screen
			selected += btn(⬆️) and -1 or btn(⬇️) and 1 or 0
			selected = mid(0, selected, #split(credits, "\n") * 6 - 52)
			if btnp_ok then
				page = 0
				selected = 1
			end
		end
	elseif paused then
		-- pause button pressed
		if _btn() & 64 != 0 then
		 -- poke to close the menu
		 poke(0x5f30, 1)
		 paused = false
		 return
		end
		
		selected += btnp(⬇️) and 1 or btnp(⬆️) and -1 or 0
		clamp_selected(4)
		
		-- click sounds
		if (btnp_ok) sfx"13"
		if (btnp(⬅️) or btnp(➡️) or btnp(⬆️) or btnp(⬇️)) sfx"15"
		
		if btnp_ok then
			if selected == 1 then
				-- resume
				paused = false
				return
			elseif selected == 2 then
				-- retry
				load_level(lvl_id)
				return
			elseif selected == 3 then
				-- skip level
				if lvl_id < 31 then
					load_level(lvl_id + 1)
					full_run = false
					return
				end
			elseif selected == 4 then
				-- menu
				menu, paused, page, selected =
				true, false, 0, 1
				music"48"
				return
			end
		end
	elseif cutscene == 2 then
		if btnp_x and second == 7 then
			menu, cutscene, page, selected = true, 0, 0, 1
			music"48"
		end
		if second == 3 and frame == 0 then
			sfx"19"
		end
	elseif cutscene == 0 then
		-- main gameplay update @mainupdate
		
		-- pause button pressed
		if _btn() & 64 ~= 0 then
		 -- poke to close the menu
		 poke(0x5f30, 1)
		 if win_time == 0 then
			 paused, selected = true, 1
			 return
			end
		end
		
		if showing_dialog then
			local dialog = sub(text[lvl_id + 1], 2)
			if dialog and btnp_c then
				if #dialog == dialog_progress then
					showing_dialog = false
					sfx"13"
				else
					dialog_progress = #dialog
				end
			end
		end
		
		update_undo = true
		
		-- @optimize
		-- update portals first (so they can override turn)
		local portals = get_all(portal)
		for port in all(portals) do
			if (port.attached and not port.attached.portaling or not port.attached) port:update()
		end
		-- update portals inside portals afterwards
		for port in all(portals) do
			if (port.attached and port.attached.portaling) port:update()
		end
	
		-- update player second
		local p = get_obj(player)
		if p then
			p.pushable = false
		 p:update()
		 p.pushable = true
		end
		-- set laser receiver and nodes power off (lasers will set powered = true later)
		for obj in all(objects) do
			if obj.is_receiver or obj.is_node then
				obj.was_powered = obj.powered
				obj.powered = false
			end
		end
		-- update rest of objects
		for obj in all(objects) do
			if (obj.update and obj.name ~= player and obj.name ~= portal) obj:update()
		end
		
		-- make power/unpower sfx
		for obj in all(objects) do
			if obj.name == receiver or obj.name == node or obj.name == toggle_receiver or obj.name == toggle_node then
				if obj.powered then
					if (not obj.was_powered) sfx"17"
				elseif obj.was_powered then
					sfx"18"
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- make toggle walls solid or nonsolid
		local is_solid = false
		for obj in all(objects) do
			if obj.name == toggle_receiver or obj.name == toggle_node then
				if (not obj.powered) is_solid = true
			end
		end
		for obj in all(get_all(button)) do
			if (#objects_at(obj.x, obj.y, {name = box}) == 0) is_solid = true
		end
		
		for obj in all(get_all(wall)) do
			obj.solid = is_solid
		end
		
		if move_time > 0 then
			-- if moved, change turns by 1 and add undo
			if move_time == 5 then
			 turns += 1
			 if (update_undo) add_undo()
			end
			move_time -= 1
			if move_time == 0 then
				for obj in all(objects) do
					obj.draw_behind = nil
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- win state
		if win_time > 0 then
			if win_time == 8 then
				if lvl_id == 31 then
					-- cutscene = 2
					cutscene, camera_y = 2, -4
					music"-1"
					reset_time()
					-- speedrunner achievement
					if total_minutes < 9 and full_run then
						give_achievement(6)
					end
				else
					-- load next level
					run_level_progress = max(run_level_progress, lvl_id + 1)
			 	load_level(lvl_id + 1)
			 end
			end
			win_time -= 1
			if win_time == 24 then
				sweep = 128
			end
		else
			local won = true
			local goals = get_all(goal)
			for obj in all(goals) do
				if (#objects_at(obj.x, obj.y, {name = box}) == 0) won = false
			end
			local receivers = get_all(receiver)
			for obj in all(receivers) do
				if (not obj.powered) won = false
			end
			local nodes = get_all(node)
			for obj in all(nodes) do
				if (not obj.powered) won = false
			end
			local p = get_obj(player)
			local p_goal = get_obj(player_goal)
			if p and p_goal then
				p_goal.powered = won
				if p.x ~= p_goal.x or p.y ~= p_goal.y then
					won = false
				end
			end
			if (#goals > 0 or #receivers > 0 or #nodes > 0) and won then
			 win_time = 80
			 sfx"10"
			end
			if (win_time == 80 and option"3") win_time = 32
		
			if bonk_progress == 20 then
				give_achievement(3)
			end
			if mistakes_progress == 50 then
				give_achievement(2)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- @draw
function _draw()
	if menu then
		cls(15)
		draw_title()
		if page == 0 then
			for i, button in pairs(buttons) do
				?button, selected == i and 7 or 5, 48 + i * 10, i == selected and 11 or 7
			end
			
			?params"⬆️⬇️ navigate\n  🅾️❎ select,74,114,6"
		
			if reset_popup then
				?params"\#1are you sure?   \n🅾️/❎ to confirm\n⬆️/⬇️ to cancel ,60,60,7"
			end
			
			if reset_notify > 0 then
				?params"\#1save data\ncleared  ,74,60,7"
			end
		elseif page == 1 then
			-- levels page
			?params"⬅️⬆️⬇️➡️ navigate\n      🅾️❎ select,58,114,6"
			if (selected ~= 33 and level_progress >= selected) draw_mini_level(selected - 1)
			
			n = 1
			for y = 52, 111, 16 do
				for x = 3, 112, 14 do
					local unlocked = level_progress >= n

					rectfill(x + 1, y, x + 11, y + 10, unlocked and 7 or 6)
					rect(x + 1, y, x + 11, y + 10, n == selected and unlocked and 7 or 6)
					
					if (n == selected) rect(x, y - 1, x + 12, y + 11, 11)
					
					local num = tostr(n)
					if (#num == 1) num = "0" .. num
					if unlocked then
						?num, x + 3, y + 3, 1
					else
						spr(31, x + 3, y + 1)
					end
					
					n += 1
				end
			end
			?"back", 4, 116, selected == 33 and 11 or 7
		elseif page == 2 then
			-- achievements page
			?"⬆️⬇️ navigate\n  🅾️❎ select", 74, 114, 6
			y = 58
			-- print achievement buttons
			local total = 0
			for n, a in pairs(achievements) do
				local name, got = a[1], dget(n) == 1
				local hover = selected == n
				
				?name, hover and 7 or 5, y, hover and 11 or got and 7 or 6
				spr(got and 22 or 21, (hover and 11 or 9) + #name * 4, y - 1)
				y += 8
				if (got) total += 1
			end
			-- print achievement description
			if selected ~= 7 then
				?"\#1" .. achievements[selected][2], 5, 8, 7
			end
			?"\^w\^t" .. total .. "/6", 86, 34, total == 6 and 11 or 6
			?"back", selected == 7 and 7 or 5, 112, selected == 7 and 11 or 7
		elseif page == 3 then
			-- settings
			?params"⬆️⬇️ navigate\n  🅾️❎ select,74,114,6"
			
			for n, button in pairs(settings) do
				?button[1] .. (dget(n + 6) == 1 and "on" or "off"), selected == n and 7 or 5, 48 + n * 8, selected == n and 11 or 7
			end
			-- setting description
			if settings[selected] and settings[selected][2] then
				?"\#1" .. settings[selected][2], 5, 8, 7
			end
			
			?"back", selected == 7 and 7 or 5, 112, selected == 7 and 11 or 7
		elseif page == 4 then
			-- @credits
			clip(params"0,56,127,56")
			?credits, 5, 58 - selected, 7
			clip()
			?params"back,7,116,11"
			
			?params"  ⬆️⬇️ scroll\n  🅾️❎ select,74,114,6"
		end
	elseif cutscene == 1 then
		cls()
		pal()
		frame += 1
		-- small screen
		if (second == 0) poke(0x5f2c, 3)
		
		-- sleeping cat
		if second < 5 or second == 5 and frame > 25 then
			pal(1, 6)
			pal(11, 6)
			
			if frame == 1 then
				add(zs, {t = 0})
				-- purr
				sfx"16"
			end
		end
		
		spr(params"64,24,28,2,1")
		
		-- zzz
		for z in all(zs) do
			?"z", 32 + z.t / 10, 26 - z.t / 10, z.t < 10 and 7 or z.t < 20 and 6 or 5
			z.t += 1
			if (z.t > 40) del(zs, z)
		end
		
		-- end cutscene
		if second == 5 then
			sweep = 128
		end
		if second == 7 and frame == 15 then
			cutscene = 0
			poke(0x5f2c, 0)
			reset_time()
			music"0"
		end
	elseif cutscene == 2 then
		-- @end
		cls(1)
		frame += 1
		camera(-4, camera_y)
		rectfill(params"2,2,121,121,0")
		rectfill(params"0,0,119,119,15")
		
		-- draw saved mapdata
		local mapdata = ""
		
		local i = 1
		for x = 0, 14 do
			for y = 0, 14 do
				spr(tonum("0x" .. sub(mapdata, i, i + 1)), x * 8, y * 8)
				i += 2
			end
		end
		
		spr(params"1,56,56,1,1,true")
		spr(params"4,46,58")
		
		-- static tv
		rectfill(params"55,31,56,32,0")
		for x = 48, 63 do
			for y = 22, 30 do
				pset(x, y, rnd({5, 6, 6, 7}))
			end
		end
		rect(params"47,21,64,31,0")
		
		camera(-28, camera_y + 140)
		draw_title()
		camera(-4, camera_y)
		
		?params"thanks for playing!,25,-80,7"
		if (second > 2) ?params"\#1you escaped the simulation!,6,6,7"
		
		-- count achievements
		local total = 0
		for i = 1, 6 do
			total += dget(i)
		end
		?total .. "/6 achievements", 30, -70, 6
		?option"1" and "🅾️ to return to menu" or "❎ to return to menu", params"20,-16,11"
		-- print time (at x = 48)
		?full_run and "     valid run" or "    invalid run\n\f6a run is invalid if\n you skip a level. ", params"22,-50,7"
		camera(-46, camera_y + 170)
		draw_total_time(true)
				
		-- glide camera up
		if second > 6 then
			camera_y += (-132 - camera_y) / 8
			second = min(second, 7)
		end
	else
		-- @maindraw
		cls(1)
		
		-- rooms are 15x15 so we center it
		camera(-4, -4)
		-- drop shadow
		rectfill(params"2,2,121,121,0")
		-- cyan floor
		rectfill(params"0,0,119,119,15")
		
		-- draw objects
		for layer in all(layers) do
			if layer == "background" then
				if option"2" then
					-- change colors for colorblind mode
					pal(3, 11)
					pal(1, 12)
				end
				map(lvl_x, lvl_y, params"0,0,15,15,0x10")
				pal()
			elseif layer == "foreground" then
				map(lvl_x, lvl_y, params"0,0,15,15,0x2")
				pal()
			elseif layer == "decoration" then
				map(lvl_x, lvl_y, params"0,0,15,15,0x20")
			elseif layer == "behind" then
				for obj in all(objects) do
					if obj.attached
					and obj.is_portal
					and (obj.attached.draw_behind
					or obj.attached.portaling) then
						if obj.draw then
							obj:draw()
						else
							spr(obj.spr, obj.draw_x, obj.draw_y, 1, 1, obj.flip)
						end
					end
				end
			elseif layer == "bonk" then
				for obj in all(get_all(player)) do
					if (obj.bonk) obj:draw()
				end
			else
				for obj in all(objects) do
					if obj.name == layer
					and (not obj.attached
					or not obj.is_portal
					or not obj.attached.draw_behind
					and not obj.attached.portaling) then
						if obj.draw then
							-- if portal moved, it draws underneath (so it can go through another portal)
							-- otherwise, it draws later (on top)

-- @new
function new_obj(name, x, y, s)
	local obj = {
		x = x,
		y = y,
		spr = s,
		name = name
	}
	
	for k, v in pairs(name) do
		obj[k] = v
	end
	
	obj.draw_x, obj.draw_y = obj.x * 8, obj.y * 8
	obj.dirx, obj.diry = 1, 0
	
	-- @can
	function obj:can_move(dirx, diry, x, y, i, new_dirx, new_diry)
		local function solid_tile(tx, ty)
			local tile = mget(tx + lvl_x, ty + lvl_y)
			-- check flag 0 (wall) or 2 (glass)
			return fget(tile, 0) or fget(tile, 2)
		end
		
		-- if not moving, return true
		if (dirx == 0 and diry == 0) return true
		if not x then
			x, y = self.x, self.y
			i = 0
		elseif not y then
			i = x
			x, y = self.x, self.y
		end
		if self.attached and not new_dirx then
			new_dirx, new_diry = self.attached.dirx, self.attached.diry
		end
		-- push limit (also prevents
		-- infinite loops)
		if i >= 16 then
			return false
		end
		-- edges of level are solid
		if x + dirx < 0 or x + dirx > 14 or y + diry < 0 or y + diry > 14 then
			return false
		end
		-- check toggle walls
		if #objects_at(x + dirx, y + diry, {name = wall, tag = "solid"}) > 0 then
			-- it's shtuck
			if #objects_at(x + dirx, y + diry, {name = box}) > 0 then
				give_achievement(1)
			end
			return false
		end
		
		-- check if cubes ahead
		-- and if they can be pushed
		local obj = objects_at(x + dirx, y + diry, {tag = "pushable"})[1]
		if obj and not obj:can_move(dirx, diry, i + 1) then
			local port = obj.attached
			if port and port.is_portal then
				-- enter other portal cube
				local exit = get_exit(port)
				
				if port.dirx == -dirx
				and port.diry == -diry
				and exit
				and exit ~= self.attached
				and self:can_move(exit.dirx, exit.diry, portalx(exit), portaly(exit), i + 1, rotated(self, port, exit)) then
					self.portaling = true
					return true
				end
			end
			if self.attached and self.attached.is_portal then
				-- eat cubes
				port = self.attached
				local exit = get_exit(port)
				if (exit == obj.attached) return false
				
				-- check for infinite loop
				local o = obj
				local dx, dy = dirx, diry
				local j = 1
				
				while j < 16 and o do
					local portals = objects_at(o.x, o.y, {tag = "is_portal"})
					local p, e
					for p2 in all(portals) do
						if p2.dirx == -dx and p2.diry == -dy then
							p = p2
							e = get_exit(p)
						end
					end
					if e then
						-- cube at exit
						o = objects_at(e.x, e.y, {tag = "pushable"})[1]
						dx, dy = e.dirx, e.diry
					else
						-- next cube in chain
						o = objects_at(o.x + dx, o.y + dy, {tag = "pushable"})[1]
					end
					if o == obj then
						return false
					end
					j += 1
				end
				
				if new_dirx == dirx
				and new_diry == diry
				and exit
				and obj:can_move(exit.dirx, exit.diry, portalx(exit), portaly(exit), i + 1, rotated(obj, port, exit)) then
					obj.portaling = true
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		
		local portals = objects_at(x, y, {tag = "is_portal"})
		local enter
		-- find portal on this tile that's
		-- facing the right direction
		for port in all(portals) do
			if port.dirx == -dirx and port.diry == -diry then
				enter = port
				break
			end
		end
		
		-- this code is only for
		-- wall portals
		if enter and not enter.attached then
			local exit = get_exit(enter)
			
			if enter.dirx == -dirx and
			enter.diry == -diry and
			exit and
			exit ~= self.attached and
			self:can_move(exit.dirx, exit.diry, portalx(exit), portaly(exit), i + 1, rotated(self, enter, exit)) then
				self.portaling = true
				return true
			end
		end
		
		-- solid tiles
		return not solid_tile(x + dirx, y + diry)
	end
	
	-- @push
	function obj:push(x, y, startx, starty)
		if (x == 0 and y == 0) return
		if not (startx or starty) then
			startx, starty = self.x, self.y
		end
		
		local pushables = objects_at(startx + x, starty + y, {tag = "pushable"})
		for obj in all(pushables) do
			if obj == self then
				-- skip if obj is trying
				-- to push itself
				goto continue
			end
			
			if obj.attached and obj.attached.is_portal and obj.attached.dirx == -x and obj.attached.diry == -y and not obj:can_move(x, y) then
				-- skip pushing box if it
				-- has a portal on it and
				-- it's facing self
				goto continue
			end
			
			local port = self.attached
			if port and port.is_portal and port.dirx == x and port.diry == y and not obj:can_move(x, y) then
				-- skip pushing box if self
				-- has portal facing it (eat cubes)
				goto continue
			end
			
			obj:push(x, y)
			obj.x += x
			obj.y += y
			
			::continue::
		end
	end
	
	if (obj.init) obj:init()
	
	add(objects, obj)
	
	if name == player then
		new_obj(player_goal, x, y, 7)
	end
end

function objects_at(x, y, filter)
	local tag, name, exclude, exclude_tbl
	if (filter) tag, name, exclude, exclude_tbl = filter.tag, filter.name, filter.exclude, filter.exclude_tbl
	local list = {}
	for obj in all(objects) do
		if obj.x == x and obj.y == y and (not tag or obj[tag]) and (not name or obj.name == name) and obj ~= exclude then
			add(list, obj)
			for obj2 in all(exclude_tbl) do
				if obj == obj2 then
					del(list, obj)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- @addundo
function add_undo()
	local undo = {}
	
	for id, obj in pairs(objects) do
		undo[id] = {x = obj.x, y = obj.y, dir = xy_to_dir(obj)}
		if obj.name == player then
			undo[id].spr = obj.spr
			undo[id].flip = obj.flip
		end
		undo[id].solid = obj.solid
	end
	
	local changed
	local last_undo = undos[#undos]
	
	if last_undo then
		for k, v in pairs(undo) do
			local o1, o2 = last_undo[k], undo[k]
			if o1.x ~= o2.x
			or o1.y ~= o2.y
			or o1.solid ~= o2.solid then
				changed = true
				break
			end
		end
	else
		changed = true
	end
	
	if changed then
	 add(undos, undo)
	else
		turns -= 1
	end
	
	-- remove earlier undos if
	-- mem usage is too high
	-- limit is around 90% used
	while stat(0) > 1800 do
		deli(undos, 1)
	end
end

-- @undo
function do_undo()
	local undo = undos[#undos - 1]
	local before_undo = undos[#undos - 2]
	for k, obj in pairs(objects) do
		local last_obj = undo[k]
		obj.x = last_obj.x
		obj.y = last_obj.y
		obj.spr = last_obj.spr or obj.spr
		obj.solid = last_obj.solid
		if (#undos > 2) obj.dirx, obj.diry = dir_to_xy(last_obj.dir)
		obj.flip = last_obj.flip
		if not obj.is_portal and not obj.is_receiver then
			obj.draw_x, obj.draw_y = obj.x * 8, obj.y * 8
		end
	end
	for obj in all(objects) do
		if obj.attached and obj.name ~= box then
			obj.x = obj.attached.x + obj.dirx
			obj.y = obj.attached.y + obj.diry
		end
	end
	deli(undos, #undos)
	update_undo = false
	move_time = 4
	
	undoed_last_turn = true
	
	-- undo again if objects are
	-- in a portal after undo
	for port in all(get_all(portal)) do
		local travelers = objects_at(portalx(port), portaly(port))
		local exit = get_exit(port)
		if exit then
			for obj in all(travelers) do
				if obj.cant_portal
				or obj == port.attached
				or obj == exit.attached then
				 del(travelers, obj)
				end
			end
			
			if #travelers > 0 then
				do_undo()
			end
		end
	end
	
	turns -= 1
end

function get_obj(name, exclude)
	for obj in all(objects) do
		if obj.name == name and obj ~= exclude then
			return obj
		end
	end
end

function get_all(name)
	local list = {}
	for obj in all(objects) do
		if obj.name == name then
			add(list, obj)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function get_exit(obj)
	for exit in all(objects) do
		if exit.name == portal and exit ~= obj and exit.c == obj.c then
			return exit
		end
	end
end

function portalx(obj)
	return obj.x - obj.dirx
end
function portaly(obj)
	return obj.y - obj.diry
end

-- t = progress through animation
function dissolve(n, x, y, t, tbl)
	local pixel = 0
	pixels_dissolved = max(pixels_dissolved, t)
	t = t or 0
	for sy = (n \ 16) * 8, (n \ 16) * 8 + 7 do
		for sx = (n % 16) * 8, (n % 16) * 8 + 7 do
			if pixel > t and sget(sx, sy) ~= 0 then
				pset(x + sx % 8, y + sy % 8, sget(sx, sy))
			elseif pixel == t and pixels_dissolved < pixel + 1 and sget(sx, sy) ~= 0 and not option"3" then
				add(tbl, {x = x + sx % 8, y = y + sy % 8})
			end
			pixel += 1
		end
	end
end

		or sget(sx + 4, sy + 7) ~= 0 and 2
		or sget(sx + 4, sy) ~= 0 and 3
		or sget(sx + 7, sy + 4) ~= 0 and 4
	
	self.draw_x += self.s == 4 and 2 or self.s == 1 and -2 or 0
	self.draw_y += self.s == 2 and 2 or self.s == 3 and -2 or 0
	
	self.particles = {}
	self.c = sget(sx, sy) + sget(sx + 7, sy + 7)
	
	self.dirx = self.s == 1 and 1 or self.s == 4 and -1 or 0
	self.diry = self.s == 2 and -1 or	self.s == 3 and 1 or 0

	self.first_frame = true
end
function portal:update()
	-- attach to box if first frame
	if self.first_frame then
		local attached = objects_at(self.x - self.dirx, self.y - self.diry, {name = box})
		if #attached > 0 then
		 self.attached = attached[1]
		 self.attached.dirx = self.dirx
		 self.attached.diry = self.diry
			self.attached.attached = self
		end
		self.first_frame = false
	end
	if self.attached then
		self.x, self.y = self.attached.x + self.dirx, self.attached.y + self.diry
	end
	
	-- once everything is done moving
	-- take control of turn
	if move_time == 0 then
		local travelers = objects_at(self.x - self.dirx, self.y - self.diry)
		local exit = get_exit(self)
		if (not exit) return
		
		local sandwiched = false
		-- check if exit leads directly into other portal
		for port in all(get_all(portal)) do
			if portalx(port) == exit.x and portaly(port) == exit.y then
				sandwiched = true
			end
		end
		
		for obj in all(travelers) do
			if obj.cant_portal
			or not obj.portaling
			or obj == self.attached
			or obj == exit.attached then
			 del(travelers, obj)
			end
			if (not sandwiched) obj.portaling = nil
		end
		
		-- teleport objects to exit
		if not self.attached or not self.attached.portaling then
			for obj in all(travelers) do
				if (obj.attached) obj.draw_behind = true
		
				obj.x, obj.y = exit.x, exit.y
				obj.draw_x, obj.draw_y = (obj.x - exit.dirx) * 8, (obj.y - exit.diry) * 8
				
				-- rotate object based on portal directions
				obj.dirx, obj.diry = rotated(obj, self, exit)
				-- rotate attached object as well
				if obj.attached then
					obj.attached.dirx, obj.attached.diry = obj.dirx, obj.diry
				end
				
				-- push objects at exit
				obj:push(exit.dirx, exit.diry, exit.x - exit.dirx, exit.y - exit.diry)
				
				if obj.name == player then
					obj.spr = exit.s == 2 and 2 or exit.s == 3 and 3 or 1
					obj.flip = exit.s == 4
				end
				move_time = 5
				undoed_last_turn = false
			end
			if #travelers > 0 then
				sfx"11"
			end
		end
	end
end
function portal:draw()
	if self.attached then
		self.draw_x = self.attached.draw_x + self.dirx * 8
		self.draw_y = self.attached.draw_y + self.diry * 8
		
		self.spr = self.dirx == 1 and 32
			or self.diry == 1 and 33
			or self.diry == -1 and 48
			or self.dirx == -1 and 49
			
		self.draw_x -= self.dirx * 2
		self.draw_y -= self.diry * 2
		
		self.s = self.dirx == 1 and 1 or self.diry == -1 and 2 or self.diry == 1 and 3 or 4
		
		if (self.c == 11) self.spr += 2
	end
	if rnd() > 0.5 and not option"3" then
		if self.s == 1 then
			add(self.particles, {
				x = 0,
				y = rnd(8)
			})
		elseif self.s == 2 then
			add(self.particles, {
				x = rnd(8),
				y = 8
			})
		elseif self.s == 3 then
			add(self.particles, {
				x = rnd(8),
				y = 0
			})
		else
			add(self.particles, {
				x = 8,
				y = rnd(8)
			})
		end
	end
	if self.attached then
		spr(15, self.attached.draw_x, self.attached.draw_y)
	else
	 spr(mget(self.x - self.dirx + lvl_x, self.y - self.diry + lvl_y), (self.x - self.dirx) * 8, (self.y - self.diry) * 8)
	end
	
	local draw_particles = true
	if self.attached and (self.attached.portaling or self.attached.draw_behind) then
		draw_particles = false
	end
	
	for p in all(self.particles) do
		p.x += self.dirx / 2
		p.y += self.diry / 2
		if (draw_particles) pset(self.draw_x + p.x, self.draw_y + p.y, self.c)
	
		if self.s == 1 and p.x > 4 or self.s == 2 and p.y < 4 or self.s == 3 and p.y > 4 or self.s == 4 and p.x < 4 then
			del(self.particles, p)
		end
	end
	spr(self.spr, self.draw_x, self.draw_y)
end

		self.draw_x, self.draw_y = self.attached.draw_x + self.dirx * 8, self.attached.draw_y + self.diry * 8
	end

-- @stopped
function laser:stopped(x, y, dirx, diry, phase)
	if (phase > 0) return false
	local solids = {}
	for obj in all(get_all(box)) do
		add(solids, obj)
	end
	for obj in all(get_all(wall)) do
		if (obj.solid) add(solids, obj)
	end
	for obj in all(solids) do
		if (obj.x == x \ 8 or obj.y == y \ 8) and rcttouch(rct(obj.draw_x, obj.draw_y, 7, 7), rct(x, y, abs(diry), abs(dirx))) then
			if obj.attached and obj.attached.is_portal and obj.dirx == -dirx and obj.diry == -diry then
				return false
			end
			return true
		end
	end
	
	x \= 8
	y \= 8
	
	for port in all(get_all(portal)) do
		local hitbox
		if port.dirx == 1 then
			hitbox = rct(port.draw_x - 5, port.draw_y + 1, 6, 5)
		elseif port.dirx == -1 then
			hitbox = rct(port.draw_x + 6, port.draw_y + 1, 6, 5)
		elseif port.diry == 1 then
			hitbox = rct(port.draw_x + 1, port.draw_y - 5, 5, 6)
		elseif port.diry == -1 then
			hitbox = rct(port.draw_x + 1, port.draw_y + 6, 5, 6)
		end
		if rcttouch(hitbox, rct(x, y, abs(diry), abs(dirx))) then
			return false
		end
	end
	
	-- check solid map tiles
	if fget(mget(x + lvl_x, y + lvl_y), 0) or x < 0 or x > 14 or y < 0 or y > 14 then
		-- cancel if currently moving though portal
		if (not self.attached) return true
		-- not sure what bug this was meant to fix
		--[[
		if self.attached and self.attached.x == x and self.attached.y == y or x + dirx == self.attached.x and y + diry == self.attached.y then
			return false
		end
		--]]
		return true
	end
end
-- @shoot
function laser:shoot_laser(draw)
	local dirx, diry = self.dirx, self.diry
	local x = dirx == 1 and self.draw_x + 1
		or dirx == -1 and self.draw_x + 7
		or self.draw_x + 3
	local y = diry == 1 and self.draw_y + 1
		or diry == -1 and self.draw_y + 7
		or self.draw_y + 3
	local phase = 0
	
	if self.attached then
		x -= dirx * 8
		y -= diry * 8
		-- first 3 steps it'll be able to phase through its attached cube
		-- then after that, it will collide with it (like through portals)
		phase = 3
	end
	
	local do_particles = not option"3"

	-- shoot a laser
	while not self:stopped(x, y, dirx, diry, phase) do
		x += dirx * 4
		y += diry * 4
		phase -= 1
		
		if draw then
		 self:draw_laser(x, y, dirx, diry)
		else
			-- power laser nodes
			for obj in all(objects_at(x \ 8, y \ 8, {tag = "is_node"})) do
				if phase > 1 then --self.attached and self.attached.x == obj.x and self.attached.y == obj.y then
					obj.powered = false
				else
					obj.powered = true
				end
			end
		end
		
		-- go through portals
		for port in all(get_all(portal)) do
			local exit = get_exit(port)
			if (not exit) goto noportal
			local nocollide = {self.attached, port.attached, exit.attached}
			if (not self.attached) nocollide = {port.attached, exit.attached}
			if port.x - port.dirx == x \ 8 and port.y - port.diry == y \ 8 and port.dirx == -dirx and port.diry == -diry and exit and (not self.attached or (dirx ~= 0 or self.attached.draw_x % 8 == 0) and (diry ~= 0 or self.attached.draw_y % 8 == 0)) and #objects_at(port.x - port.dirx, port.y - port.diry, {name = box, exclude_tbl = nocollide}) + #objects_at(exit.x - exit.dirx, exit.y - exit.diry, {name = box, exclude_tbl = nocollide}) == 0 then
				dirx, diry = exit.dirx, exit.diry
				if exit.attached then
					exit.draw_x, exit.draw_y = exit.attached.draw_x, exit.attached.draw_y
				end
				
				x = dirx == 1 and exit.draw_x + 1
					or dirx == -1 and exit.draw_x + 7
					or exit.draw_x + 3
				y = diry == 1 and exit.draw_y + 1
					or diry == -1 and exit.draw_y + 7
					or exit.draw_y + 3
				
				if exit.attached then
					x += dirx * 8
					y += diry * 8
				end
				
				-- extend laser so it looks like it comes out of the portal
				if draw then
					self:draw_laser(x, y, dirx, diry)
					self:draw_laser(x, y, -dirx, -diry)
				end
				x += dirx * 3
				y += diry * 3
			end
		end
		
		::noportal::
		
		-- power receiver and turn off particles
		-- if it's not blocked by a cube
		local block = objects_at(x \ 8, y \ 8, {name = box})[1]
		if not block or block == self.attached then
			for obj in all(objects_at(x \ 8, y \ 8, {tag = "is_receiver"})) do
				if obj.dirx == -dirx and obj.diry == -diry then
					if not draw then
						obj.powered = true
					end
					do_particles = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	-- don't do particles if stuck in wall
	local walls = objects_at(self.x, self.y, {name = wall})
	if #walls > 0 then
		local obj2 = walls[1]
		if (obj2.solid) do_particles = false
	end
	
	-- clip out of wall
	local steps = 0
	while self:stopped(x, y, dirx, diry, 0) do
		x -= dirx
		y -= diry
		steps += 1
		if steps > 8 then
			do_particles = false
			break
		end
	end
	if dirx == 1 or diry == 1 then
		x += dirx
		y += diry
	end
	
	if draw and do_particles then
		add(self.particles, {
			x = rnd({x, x + abs(diry)}),
			y = rnd({y, y + abs(dirx)}),
			dirx = (dirx * -0.5) + rnd() - 0.5,
			diry = (diry * -0.5) + rnd() - 0.5,
			t = 0
		})
	end
end
function laser:draw_laser(x, y, dirx, diry)
	rectfill(x - dirx * 4, y - diry * 4, x + abs(diry), y + abs(dirx), self.c)

if (a.k=="basket") then

function move_obj(a, x1, y1)

	x1 = x1 or a.x+a.dx

	a.dy=mid(-.75,a.dy,.75)

function collide_mon(a)
	for i=1,#actor do
	if (actor[i].is_mon) then
		local m=actor[i]
		local dx=a.x-m.x
		local dy=a.y-m.y
		if dx^2+dy^2 < (a.r+m.r)^2
		then
			return m
		end
	end
	end
	return false

function dclr(d)
 local a,b,n=unpack(split(d,"|"))
 a,b=split(a),split(b)

  t[a[i]]=pars(b[i])

	if n then

	 _ENV[n]=t

function pars(v)
 if (v=="{}") return {}

	local t=dclr(data.."|out")

function updatemergeballs()
	for i,ball in pairs(mergeballs) do
		if ball.target.deleted==true then
			del(mergeballs,ball)
		else
			ball.offx*=.8
			ball.offy*=.8
			ball.radius+=(ball.target.radius-ball.radius)/4
			if ball.offx*ball.offx+ball.offy*ball.offy<4 then
				del(mergeballs,ball)
			end
		end
	end

function resolvecollisions()
	sortballs()
	
	local merges={}
	
	local count=#balls
	for i=1,count do
		local ball=balls[i]
		local ymin=ball.y-ball.radius
		for j=i+1,count do
			local other=balls[j]
			if other.ymax<ymin then
				break
			end
			
			local dx=ball.x-other.x
			local dy=ball.y-other.y
			if dy<128 and dy>-128 then
				local dist=sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
				if dist<ball.radius+other.radius then
					ball.hitcount+=1
					other.hitcount+=1
					local push=((ball.radius+other.radius)-dist)
					local str1=other.weight/(ball.weight+other.weight)
					dx/=dist
					dy/=dist
					ball.ix+=dx*push*str1
					ball.iy+=dy*push*str1
					other.ix-=dx*push*(1-str1)
					other.iy-=dy*push*(1-str1)
					if ball.size==other.size then
						add(merges,{ball, other})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	for i,ball in pairs(balls) do
		ball.x+=ball.ix*.7
		ball.y+=ball.iy*.7
		ball.vx+=ball.ix*.35
		ball.vy+=ball.iy*.35
	end
	
	for i,merge in pairs(merges) do
		local ball1=merge[1]
		local ball2=merge[2]
		if ball1.deleted!=true and ball2.deleted!=true then
			if ball1.framecount>9 and ball2.framecount>9 then
				sfx(ball1.size-1)
				score+=ball1.size
				if score>dget(0) then
					dset(0,score)
				end
				local x=(ball1.x+ball2.x)/2
				local y=(ball1.y+ball2.y)/2
				addball(ball1.size+1,x,y)
				local newball=balls[#balls]
				
				add(mergeballs,{
					offx=ball1.x-newball.x,
					offy=ball1.y-newball.y,
					radius=ball1.radius,
					radius2=getradius(ball1.size+1),
					color1=ball1.color1,
					color2=ball1.color2,
					target=newball
				})
				add(mergeballs,{
					offx=ball2.x-newball.x,
					offy=ball2.y-newball.y,
					radius=ball2.radius,
					radius2=getradius(ball2.size+1),
					color1=ball2.color1,
					color2=ball2.color2,
					target=newball
				})
				
				local pcount=newball.radius*3
				local bx,by=boardtoscr(newball.x,newball.y)
				for i=1,pcount do
					local a=i/pcount
					local dx=cos(a)
					local dy=sin(a)
					local x=bx+dx*newball.radius
					local y=by+dy*newball.radius
					add(particles,{
						x=x,
						y=y,
						ox=x,
						oy=y,
						vx=dx*newball.radius/4,
						vy=dy*newball.radius/4,
						color=rnd()<.5 and newball.color1 or newball.color2,
						life=60+rnd(30)
					})
				end
				
				del(balls,ball1)
				del(balls,ball2)
				ball1.deleted=true
				ball2.deleted=true
			end
		end
	end
end

function updateparticles()
	for i,p in pairs(particles) do
		p.ox=p.x
		p.oy=p.y
		p.x+=p.vx
		p.y+=p.vy
		p.vx+=rnd(.3)-.15
		p.vy+=rnd(.3)-.13
		p.vx*=.93
		p.vy*=.93
		p.life-=1
		if p.life<=0 then
			del(particles,p)
		end
	end
end

function scrtoboard(x,y)

function boardtoscr(x,y)
	return x+boardbx,y+boardby

function addball(size,x,y)
	local radius=getradius(size)
	local color1,color2=getcolors(size)
	add(balls,{
		x=x,
		y=y,
		ox=x,
		oy=y,
		vx=0,
		vy=0,
		ovx=0,
		ovy=0,
		ymax=y+radius,
		size=size,
		radius=radius,
		weight=radius,
		color1=color1,
		color2=color2,
		framecount=0,
		failcounter=0,
		hitcount=0
	})
end

function getcolors(size)
	local col1=(size-1)%7*2+2
	if size>7 then
		return col1+1+col1*16,(col1+1)*17
	else
		return col1*17,(col1+1)*17
	end
end

function sortballs()
	local maxfailcount=0
	local count=#balls
	for i=1,count do
		local ball=balls[i]
		local ymax=ball.y+ball.radius
		local ymin=ball.y-ball.radius
		if ymin<0 and ball.hitcount>0 then
			ball.failcounter+=1
			maxfailcount=max(maxfailcount,ball.failcounter)
		else
			ball.failcounter=0
		end
		ball.hitcount=0
		
		ball.ymax=ymax
		ball.ix=0
		ball.iy=0
		local dvx=ball.vx-ball.ovx
		local dvy=ball.vy-ball.ovy
		local accel=sqrt(dvx*dvx+dvy*dvy)
		local ospeed=ball.ovx*ball.ovx+ball.ovy*ball.ovy
		if accel>.3 and ospeed>1*1 then
			sfx(11.5+min(accel*4,6))
		end
		ball.ovx=ball.vx
		ball.ovy=ball.vy
		for j=i-1,1,-1 do
			local other=balls[j]
			if other.ymax<ymax then
				balls[j+1]=other
			else
				balls[j+1]=ball
				break
			end
			if j==1 then
				balls[j]=ball
			end
		end
	end
	
	if maxfailcount>0 then
		failcounter+=1
		if failcounter>120 then

			sfx(24)
		end
	else

	end

				local pitchbyte=@(addr+j*2)

function str2mem(data)
	local t, a, i, c, d, str, m = split(data)
	for a = 1, #t, 2 do  
		m, str, i = t[a], t[a+1], 1
		while i <= #str do
			c, d = ord(str, i, 2)
			if c == nil then break end  -- safeguard against nil value
			i += (c == 255) and 2 or 1
			if c > 16 then

				m += 1

		end
	end

description: MARBLE MERGER Seems like everybody's making a clone of Suika Game these days - here's mine! Instructions Drop marbles into the container - if two marbles of the same size touch each other, then they merge together to form a single larger marble, and you get some points (larger merges have larger value). If a marble comes to rest while going past the top of the container, you lose! It's an endless game, so post your high scores in the comments! Extra Thoughts My main goal here was to make this version of the game look and feel as smooth as I could manage. The three features which are most relevant to that goal are: 60 FPS Custom "slightly squishy" physics Antialiased circle-drawing I've been thinking about adding a mouse-only mode, which could make the game comfier to play on a phone. Let me know if that appeals to you, or if you have other feature-requests! I'm also happy to answer questions about how any part of the code works. Changelog 1.0.2: Adding a drop-cooldown and antialiasing-toggle in pause menu 1.0.1: Adding "circle of evolution" to UI, bugfix in transition-rendering 1.0.0: Original upload
